// Favorite drawing toolbar no longer auto-opens; drawing shortcuts now prefer TradingView's exposed drawing API.

(function() {
    'use strict';

    const C1_DIAG_DEBUG_KEY = 'tv_gcc_debug';
    const C1_LOG = {
        enabled: true,
        warn(scope, ...args) { if (this.enabled) console.warn(`[TV-GCC:${scope}]`, ...args); },
        error(scope, err) {
            if (!this.enabled) return;
            console.error(`[TV-GCC:${scope}]`, err);
            (this._ring = this._ring || []).push({ t: Date.now(), scope, msg: String(err) });
            if (this._ring.length > 50) this._ring.shift();
        }
    };
    const c1_queryCache = new Map();

    // 动态获取当前允许的最顶层挂载点，用于兼容 TV 的全屏模式
    function getUIRoot() {
        return document.fullscreenElement || document.body;
    }

    function c1_findOrWarn(selectors, label = 'selector') {
        const list = Array.isArray(selectors) ? selectors : [selectors];
        for (const selector of list) {
            try {
                const el = document.querySelector(selector);
                if (el) return el;
            } catch (e) {
                C1_LOG.warn('selector.parse', selector, e);
            }
        }
        if (!c1_findOrWarn._missing) c1_findOrWarn._missing = new Set();
        if (!c1_findOrWarn._missing.has(label)) {
            c1_findOrWarn._missing.add(label);
            C1_LOG.warn('selector.missing', `${label}: TradingView DOM may have changed`, list);
        }
        return null;
    }

    function c1_cachedQuery(selectors, ttlMs = 1500) {
        const key = Array.isArray(selectors) ? selectors.join('||') : String(selectors);
        const now = Date.now();
        const cached = c1_queryCache.get(key);
        if (cached && (now - cached.ts) < ttlMs && (!cached.el || cached.el.isConnected)) return cached.el;
        const el = c1_findOrWarn(selectors, key);
        c1_queryCache.set(key, { el, ts: now });
        return el;
    }

    function c1_setVisibilityAwareInterval(fn, intervalMs) {
        let id = null;
        const start = () => { if (id == null) id = setInterval(fn, intervalMs); };
        const stop = () => { if (id != null) { clearInterval(id); id = null; } };
        const handler = () => (document.hidden ? stop() : start());
        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handler);
        if (!document.hidden) start();
        return {
            stop() {
                stop();
                document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handler);
            }
        };
    }

    function c1_isVisibleNode(el) {
        if (!el || !el.isConnected) return false;
        const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (!rect.width || !rect.height) return false;
        const style = unsafeWindow.getComputedStyle ? unsafeWindow.getComputedStyle(el) : window.getComputedStyle(el);
        return !(style.display === 'none' || style.visibility === 'hidden' || Number(style.opacity || 1) === 0);
    }

        ],
        chartCanvas: [

        ],
        accountButton: [

    function c1_findCommonAncestor(nodes) {
        if (!nodes.length) return null;
        let current = nodes[0];
        while (current && current !== document.body) {
            if (nodes.every(node => current.contains(node))) return current;
            current = current.parentElement;
        }
        return null;
    }

    function c1_findNotifierToolbarHost() {
        const anchors = C1_TV_RUNTIME_SELECTORS.headerToolbarAnchors
            .map(selector => {
                try { return document.querySelector(selector); } catch (e) { return null; }
            })
            .filter(c1_isVisibleNode);
        if (!anchors.length) return null;

        let host = anchors.length > 1 ? c1_findCommonAncestor(anchors) : (anchors[0].parentElement || anchors[0]);
        while (host && host !== document.body) {
            const rect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (rect.width >= 480 && rect.height >= 32 && rect.height <= 96) return host;
            host = host.parentElement;
        }
        return null;
    }

    // 🌐 共享基础设施
    // ==========================================
    const C1_SHORTCUT_CODE_LABELS = {
        Backquote: '`',
        Minus: '-',
        Equal: '=',
        BracketLeft: '[',
        BracketRight: ']',
        Backslash: '\\',
        Semicolon: ';',
        Quote: "'",
        Comma: ',',
        Period: '.',
        Slash: '/',
        Space: 'SPACE',
        Tab: 'TAB',
        Escape: 'ESCAPE',
        Enter: 'ENTER',
        Backspace: 'BACKSPACE',
        Delete: 'DELETE'
    };

    const C1_SHORTCUT_KEY_ALIASES = {
        '⌘': 'META',
        CMD: 'META',
        COMMAND: 'META',
        '⌥': 'ALT',
        OPT: 'ALT',
        OPTION: 'ALT',
        '⌃': 'CTRL',
        CONTROL: 'CTRL',
        '⇧': 'SHIFT',
        ESC: 'ESCAPE',
        RETURN: 'ENTER',
        SPACEBAR: 'SPACE',
        '·': '`',
        '｀': '`'
    };

    const SharedTV = {
        toastTimeout: null,
        notifierContainer: null,
        notifierMountHost: null,
        notifierMountMode: 'floating',
        currentEl: null,

        ensureNotifierContainer: function() {
            if (!this.notifierContainer) {
                this.notifierContainer = document.createElement('div');
                this.notifierContainer.id = 'tv-custom-notifier-container';
            }

            const themeClasses = [...C1_THEME_OPTIONS.map(theme => `tv-custom-${theme.id}`), 'tv-custom-mocha', 'tv-custom-aurora'];
            const themeClass = 'tv-custom-' + c1_normalizeTheme(SysConfig.theme);
            this.notifierContainer.classList.remove(...themeClasses);
            this.notifierContainer.classList.add(themeClass);

            const toolbarHost = c1_findNotifierToolbarHost();
            const nextHost = toolbarHost || getUIRoot();
            const nextMode = toolbarHost ? 'inline' : 'floating';

            if (toolbarHost) toolbarHost.classList.add('tv-toast-toolbar-host');
            if (this.notifierContainer.parentElement !== nextHost) nextHost.appendChild(this.notifierContainer);

            this.notifierMountHost = nextHost;
            this.notifierMountMode = nextMode;
            this.notifierContainer.dataset.mode = nextMode;
            this.notifierContainer.classList.toggle('is-inline', nextMode === 'inline');
            this.notifierContainer.classList.toggle('is-floating', nextMode === 'floating');
        },

        refreshNotifierMount: function() {
            if (!this.notifierContainer) return;
            this.ensureNotifierContainer();
        },

        removeNotification: function() {
            if (this.currentEl) {
                let el = this.currentEl;
                el.classList.remove('show');
                setTimeout(() => { if (el.parentElement) el.remove(); }, 300);
                this.currentEl = null;
            }
        },

        showToast: function(text, isError = false, desc = '', duration = 2500) {
            try { if (SysConfig && SysConfig.showNotifications === false) return; } catch (e) { C1_LOG.warn('toast.gate', e); }
            try { if (SysConfig && SysConfig.hideNotificationsInImmersive !== false && c1_immersiveActive) return; } catch (e) { C1_LOG.warn('toast.immersive', e); }
            let explicitType = '';
            if (typeof isError === 'string' && typeof desc === 'string' && /^(warn|warning|error|neutral|success)$/i.test(desc)) {
                explicitType = desc.toLowerCase() === 'warn' ? 'warning' : desc.toLowerCase();
                desc = isError;
                isError = explicitType === 'error';
            }
            if (typeof duration === 'string' && /^(warn|warning|error|neutral|success)$/i.test(duration)) {
                explicitType = duration.toLowerCase() === 'warn' ? 'warning' : duration.toLowerCase();
                isError = explicitType === 'error';
                duration = 2500;
            }
            text = String(text ?? '');
            desc = String(desc ?? '');
            let oldToast = document.getElementById('tv-shortcut-toast');
            if (oldToast) oldToast.remove();

            this.ensureNotifierContainer();

            let type = 'success';
            if (/已执行|已开启|已展开|已切换|已显示|切换周期|切换品种|Executed|Opened|Expanded|shown|switched|Timeframe|Symbol/i.test(text)) type = 'success';
            else if (/已关闭|已折叠|已隐藏|Closed|Collapsed|hidden/i.test(text)) type = 'neutral';
            if (/(?:⚠️|🟡)|等待|注意|Warning|Wait/i.test(text)) type = 'warning';
            if (isError || /(?:❌|🚨|🔴|🚫)/u.test(text)) type = 'error';
            if (explicitType) type = explicitType;
            const isAlertToast = type === 'error';

            let displayText = text, displayDesc = desc;
            if (SysConfig.showToastEmoji === false) {
                const emojiRegex = /[\p{Emoji_Presentation}\p{Extended_Pictographic}\u200d\uFE0F]/gu;
                displayText = text.replace(emojiRegex, '').trim();
                if (displayDesc) displayDesc = desc.replace(emojiRegex, '').trim();
            }

            if (this.currentEl && this.currentEl.parentElement && this.currentEl.classList.contains('show')) {
                const iconEl = this.currentEl.querySelector('.tv-notification-icon');
                const titleEl = this.currentEl.querySelector('.tv-notification-title');
                let descEl = this.currentEl.querySelector('.tv-notification-desc');
                this.currentEl.classList.remove('is-success', 'is-error', 'is-warning', 'is-neutral');
                this.currentEl.classList.add(`is-${type}`);
                this.currentEl.setAttribute('role', isAlertToast ? 'alert' : 'status');
                this.currentEl.setAttribute('aria-live', isAlertToast ? 'assertive' : 'polite');
                iconEl.className = `tv-notification-icon tv-icon-${type}`;
                titleEl.textContent = displayText;
                if (displayDesc) {
                    if (descEl) descEl.textContent = displayDesc;
                    else { descEl = document.createElement('div'); descEl.className = 'tv-notification-desc'; descEl.textContent = displayDesc; this.currentEl.appendChild(descEl); }
                } else if (descEl) descEl.remove();

                if (this.toastTimeout) clearTimeout(this.toastTimeout);
                if (duration > 0) this.toastTimeout = setTimeout(() => { this.removeNotification(); }, duration);
                return;
            }

            this.notifierContainer.innerHTML = '';
            if (this.toastTimeout) clearTimeout(this.toastTimeout);

            const el = document.createElement('div');
            this.currentEl = el; el.className = `tv-notification is-${type}`;
            el.id = 'tv-shortcut-toast';
            el.setAttribute('role', isAlertToast ? 'alert' : 'status');
            el.setAttribute('aria-live', isAlertToast ? 'assertive' : 'polite');
            el.setAttribute('aria-atomic', 'true');
            const header = document.createElement('div');
            header.className = 'tv-notification-header';
            const icon = document.createElement('div');
            icon.className = `tv-notification-icon tv-icon-${type}`;
            const title = document.createElement('div');
            title.className = 'tv-notification-title';
            title.textContent = displayText;
            header.append(icon, title);
            el.appendChild(header);
            if (displayDesc) {
                const descNode = document.createElement('div');
                descNode.className = 'tv-notification-desc';
                descNode.textContent = displayDesc;
                el.appendChild(descNode);
            }
            this.notifierContainer.appendChild(el);
            void el.offsetWidth; el.classList.add('show');
            el.addEventListener('click', () => { if (this.toastTimeout) clearTimeout(this.toastTimeout); this.removeNotification(); });
            if (duration > 0) this.toastTimeout = setTimeout(() => { this.removeNotification(); }, duration);
        },

        normalizeShortcutString: function(value) {
            const raw = String(value || '').trim();
            if (!raw) return '';
            const parts = raw.split(/\s*\+\s*/).map(part => part.trim()).filter(Boolean);
            if (!parts.length) return '';
            const mods = { CTRL: false, ALT: false, SHIFT: false, META: false };
            let keyName = '';
            parts.forEach((part) => {
                let token = String(part || '').trim();
                if (!token) return;
                token = C1_SHORTCUT_KEY_ALIASES[token.toUpperCase()] || C1_SHORTCUT_KEY_ALIASES[token] || token;
                if (token.length === 1) token = token.toUpperCase();
                else token = token.toUpperCase();
                token = C1_SHORTCUT_KEY_ALIASES[token] || token;
                if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(mods, token)) mods[token] = true;
                else keyName = token;
            });
            if (!keyName || ['CONTROL', 'CTRL', 'ALT', 'OPTION', 'SHIFT', 'META', 'COMMAND', 'CMD'].includes(keyName)) return '';
            const ordered = [];
            if (mods.CTRL) ordered.push('CTRL');
            if (mods.ALT) ordered.push('ALT');
            if (mods.SHIFT) ordered.push('SHIFT');
            if (mods.META) ordered.push('META');
            ordered.push(keyName);
            return ordered.join(' + ');
        },
        getShortcutKeyFromCode: function(e) {
            const code = String(e?.code || '');
            if (!code) return '';
            const keyMatch = code.match(/^Key([A-Z])$/);
            if (keyMatch) return keyMatch[1];
            const digitMatch = code.match(/^Digit([0-9])$/);
            if (digitMatch) return digitMatch[1];
            if (/^F\d{1,2}$/.test(code)) return code;
            return C1_SHORTCUT_CODE_LABELS[code] || '';
        },
        getShortcutKeyFromLegacyCode: function(e) {
            // Last-resort compatibility for a few macOS/IME combinations that
            // report an empty/Unidentified `code`. Never override a valid code.
            const code = String(e?.code || '');
            if (code && code !== 'Unidentified') return '';
            if (String(e?.keyIdentifier || '').toUpperCase() === 'U+0060') return '`';
            const legacyCode = Number(e?.which || e?.keyCode || 0);
            return legacyCode === 192 ? '`' : '';
        },
        getShortcutKeyFromEventKey: function(e) {
            let keyName = e?.key;
            if (['Control', 'Alt', 'Shift', 'Meta'].includes(keyName)) return '';
            if (['Unidentified', 'Process', 'Dead'].includes(keyName)) return '';
            if (keyName === ' ') keyName = 'SPACE';
            if (!keyName) return '';
            if (keyName.length === 1) keyName = keyName.toUpperCase();
            return C1_SHORTCUT_KEY_ALIASES[String(keyName).toUpperCase()] || C1_SHORTCUT_KEY_ALIASES[keyName] || String(keyName).toUpperCase();
        },
        buildShortcutString: function(e, keyName) {
            if (!keyName) return '';
            const keys = [];
            if (e.ctrlKey) keys.push('CTRL');
            if (e.altKey) keys.push('ALT');
            if (e.shiftKey) keys.push('SHIFT');
            if (e.metaKey) keys.push('META');
            keys.push(keyName);
            return this.normalizeShortcutString(keys.join(' + '));
        },
        getShortcutCandidates: function(e) {
            // macOS 输入法可能让同一个按键同时呈现为 Backquote、`、· 或 ｀。
            // 同时保留物理键与逻辑字符候选，避免切换输入法后快捷键失效。
            const candidates = [];
            const add = (keyName) => {
                const shortcut = this.buildShortcutString(e, keyName);
                if (shortcut && !candidates.includes(shortcut)) candidates.push(shortcut);
            };
            add(this.getShortcutKeyFromCode(e));
            add(this.getShortcutKeyFromEventKey(e));
            add(this.getShortcutKeyFromLegacyCode(e));
            return candidates;
        },
        getShortcutString: function(e) {
            return this.getShortcutCandidates(e)[0] || null;
        },
        matchesShortcut: function(savedShortcut, eventShortcutOrCandidates) {
            const saved = this.normalizeShortcutString(savedShortcut);
            if (!saved) return false;
            const candidates = Array.isArray(eventShortcutOrCandidates) ? eventShortcutOrCandidates : [eventShortcutOrCandidates];
            return candidates.some(candidate => this.normalizeShortcutString(candidate) === saved);
        },
        simulateClick: function(element) {
            if (!element) return false;
            try {
                if (typeof element.click === 'function') element.click();
                else element.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, view: unsafeWindow, button: 0 }));
                return true;
            } catch (e) {
                C1_LOG.warn('native.singleClick', e);
                return false;
            }
        }
    };

    function c1_normalizeMacroShortcut(value) {
        const raw = String(value ?? '').trim();
        if (!raw) return '';
        const compact = raw.replace(/\s+/g, '').toUpperCase();
        if (/^(?:~|～|﹋|∼|˜)$/.test(compact) || /^(?:SHIFT|⇧)\+(?:~|～|﹋|∼|˜)$/.test(compact)) {
            return 'SHIFT + `';
        }
        return SharedTV.normalizeShortcutString(raw);
    }

        book: `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 19.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 6.5 17H20"/><path d="M6.5 2H20v20H6.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 4 19.5v-15A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 6.5 2z"/></svg>`,

        shield: `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 22s8-4 8-10V5l-8-3-8 3v7c0 6 8 10 8 10z"/></svg>`,

        gear: `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M12 1v3m0 16v3m9-12h3M1 12h3m15.07-6.07L17 8m-10 8l-2.07 2.07M19.07 18.07L17 16m-10-8L4.93 5.93"/></svg>`,
        list: `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="8" y1="6" x2="21" y2="6"/><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="21" y2="12"/><line x1="8" y1="18" x2="21" y2="18"/><line x1="3" y1="6" x2="3.01" y2="6"/><line x1="3" y1="12" x2="3.01" y2="12"/><line x1="3" y1="18" x2="3.01" y2="18"/></svg>`
    };
    function resolveIcon(iconStr) { return ICON_DICT[iconStr?.toLowerCase()] || ICON_DICT.note; }
    function c1_toolLabelIcon(label) {
        const text = String(label || '').trim();
        const match = text.match(/^(\p{Extended_Pictographic}|\p{Emoji_Presentation}|\p{Emoji}\uFE0F?)/u);
        return match ? match[0] : '•';
    }
    function c1_stripToolLabelIcon(label) {
        return String(label || '').replace(/^(\p{Extended_Pictographic}|\p{Emoji_Presentation}|\p{Emoji}\uFE0F?)\s*/u, '').trim();
    }

    function throttle(fn, wait) {
        let lastCall = 0;
        let timeoutId = null;
        let lastArgs = null;
        return function(...args) {
            const now = Date.now();
            const remaining = wait - (now - lastCall);
            lastArgs = args;
            if (remaining <= 0) {
                if (timeoutId) {
                    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
                    timeoutId = null;
                }
                lastCall = now;
                fn.apply(this, lastArgs);
                lastArgs = null;
                return;
            }
            if (!timeoutId) {
                timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
                    lastCall = Date.now();
                    timeoutId = null;
                    fn.apply(this, lastArgs || []);
                    lastArgs = null;
                }, remaining);
            }
        };
    }

    const C1_DEFERRED_STYLE_PATTERNS = [
        /#tv-settings-panel/,
        /#tv-tradegate-window/,
        /\.tv-tradegate-surface/,
        /#panel-tradegate/,
        /#panel-risk/,
        /#panel-macro/,
        /\.tv-side-panel/,
        /\.tv-draw-tool-picker-menu/,
        /\.tv-select-menu/,
        /\.rk-/,
        /\.tg-/,
        /\.macro-/,
        /\.cp-/,
        /\.cfg-input/,
        /\.tv-settings-/,
        /\.tv-dyn-/,
        /\.tv-sidebar-manager/,
        /\.tv-danger-/
    ];
    const C1_CRITICAL_STYLE_PATTERNS = [
        /#tv-custom-sidebar\b/,
        /#tv-custom-sidebar-right\b/,
        /\.tv-sidebar-trigger/,
        /#tv-custom-notifier-container/,
        /\.tv-notification/,
        /#tv-immersive-/,
        /#tv-first-time-modal/,
        /\.tv-first-time-/,
        /\.tv-modal-content/,
        /:root/,
        /--ui-/,
        /--my-/,
        /@keyframes/,
        /@media \(prefers-reduced-motion/
    ];
    let c1_deferredPanelCss = '';
    let c1_deferredStyleEl = null;

    function c1_splitStartupStyles(css) {
        const critical = [];
        const deferred = [];
        const source = String(css || '');
        let buffer = '';
        let depth = 0;
        let inString = '';
        let escaping = false;
        const flush = () => {
            if (!buffer) return;
            const isDeferred = C1_DEFERRED_STYLE_PATTERNS.some(pattern => pattern.test(buffer));
            const isCritical = C1_CRITICAL_STYLE_PATTERNS.some(pattern => pattern.test(buffer));
            (isDeferred && !isCritical ? deferred : critical).push(buffer);
            buffer = '';
        };
        for (const ch of source) {
            buffer += ch;
            if (escaping) { escaping = false; continue; }
            if (ch === '\\') { escaping = true; continue; }
            if (inString) {
                if (ch === inString) inString = '';
                continue;
            }
            if (ch === '"' || ch === "'") { inString = ch; continue; }
            if (ch === '{') depth++;
            else if (ch === '}') {
                depth = Math.max(0, depth - 1);
                if (depth === 0) flush();
            }
        }
        flush();
        return { critical: critical.join(''), deferred: deferred.join('') };
    }

    function c1_ensureDeferredPanelStyles() {
        if (!c1_deferredPanelCss || c1_deferredStyleEl) return;
        c1_deferredStyleEl = document.createElement('style');
        c1_deferredStyleEl.id = 'tv-gcc-panel-styles';
        c1_deferredStyleEl.textContent = c1_deferredPanelCss;
        document.head.appendChild(c1_deferredStyleEl);
    }

    const c1_styleSplit = c1_splitStartupStyles(style.textContent);
    c1_deferredPanelCss = c1_styleSplit.deferred;
    style.textContent = c1_styleSplit.critical;
    document.head.appendChild(style);
    (function injectAtlasUiFonts() {
        if (document.getElementById('tv-gcc-atlas-fonts')) return;
        const link = document.createElement('link');
        link.id = 'tv-gcc-atlas-fonts';
        link.rel = 'stylesheet';
        link.href = 'https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:opsz,wght@14..32,100..900&display=swap';
        document.head.appendChild(link);
        const face = document.createElement('style');
        face.id = 'tv-gcc-atlas-fontface';
        face.textContent = '@font-face{font-family:"Inter Variable";src:local("Inter Variable"),local("Inter");font-weight:100 900;font-display:swap;font-style:normal;}';
        document.head.appendChild(face);
    })();

    const C1_AVATAR_MAX_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024;

    function c1_isAllowedAvatarDataUri(src) {
        const value = String(src || '');
        const match = value.match(/^data:image\/(?:png|x-png|apng|jpe?g|webp|x-icon|vnd\.microsoft\.icon);base64,([a-z0-9+/=\s]+)$/i);
        if (!match) return false;
        const payload = match[1].replace(/\s+/g, '');
        if (!payload || payload.length % 4 === 1) return false;
        const padding = (payload.match(/=+$/) || [''])[0].length;
        const approximateBytes = Math.floor(payload.length * 3 / 4) - padding;
        return approximateBytes > 0 && approximateBytes <= C1_AVATAR_MAX_BYTES;
    }

    function c1_getDefaultEnabledDrawToolIds() {
        return C1_DRAW_TOOL_IDS.filter((id) => C1_DRAW_TOOL_LIBRARY[id]?.defaultEnabled);
    }

    function c1_normalizeEnabledDrawTools(raw) {
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return c1_getDefaultEnabledDrawToolIds();
        const seen = new Set();
        const normalized = [];
        raw.forEach((id) => {
            if (!C1_DRAW_TOOL_LIBRARY[id] || seen.has(id)) return;
            seen.add(id);
            normalized.push(id);
        });
        return normalized;
    }

    function c1_ensureDrawToolConfig() {
        if (SysConfig) SysConfig.enabledDrawTools = c1_normalizeEnabledDrawTools(SysConfig.enabledDrawTools);
        return SysConfig?.enabledDrawTools || c1_getDefaultEnabledDrawToolIds();
    }

    function c1_getEnabledDrawToolIds() {
        return c1_ensureDrawToolConfig().slice();
    }

    function c1_isManagedDrawTool(id) {
        return !!C1_DRAW_TOOL_LIBRARY[id];
    }

    function c1_isDrawToolEnabled(id) {
        return !c1_isManagedDrawTool(id) || c1_getEnabledDrawToolIds().includes(id);
    }

    function c1_getSmartMagnetToolIds(enabledIds = c1_getDefaultEnabledDrawToolIds()) {
        const ids = new Set(['measure']);
        enabledIds.forEach((id) => ids.add(id));
        return Array.from(ids);
    }

    function c1_getSmartMagnetDefaultRule(toolId) {
        return toolId === 'long' || toolId === 'short' ? 'off' : 'on';
    }

    function c1_getSmartMagnetDefaultRules(enabledIds = c1_getDefaultEnabledDrawToolIds()) {
        const rules = {};
        c1_getSmartMagnetToolIds(enabledIds).forEach((id) => {
            rules[id] = c1_getSmartMagnetDefaultRule(id);
        });
        return rules;
    }

    function c1_createDefaultSmartMagnetConfig() {
        return {
            enabled: true,
            toolRules: c1_getSmartMagnetDefaultRules()
        };
    }

    function c1_normalizeSmartMagnetConfig(raw, enabledIds = c1_getDefaultEnabledDrawToolIds()) {
        const defaults = {
            enabled: true,
            toolRules: c1_getSmartMagnetDefaultRules(enabledIds)
        };
        const next = raw && typeof raw === 'object' ? raw : {};
        const sourceRules = next.toolRules && typeof next.toolRules === 'object' ? next.toolRules : {};
        defaults.enabled = next.enabled !== false;
        Object.keys(defaults.toolRules).forEach((toolId) => {
            const value = sourceRules[toolId];
            defaults.toolRules[toolId] = ['on', 'off', 'ignore'].includes(value) ? value : defaults.toolRules[toolId];
        });
        return defaults;
    }

    function c1_ensureSmartMagnetConfig() {
        if (SysConfig) SysConfig.smartMagnet = c1_normalizeSmartMagnetConfig(SysConfig.smartMagnet, c1_getEnabledDrawToolIds());
        return SysConfig.smartMagnet;
    }

    function c1_isElementShown(el) {
        return !!(el && el.isConnected && el.classList?.contains('show'));
    }

    function c1_isTradeDataDemanded() {
        return c1_isElementShown(document.getElementById('panel-risk')) ||
            c1_isElementShown(document.getElementById('panel-tradegate')) ||
            !!(c1_tradeGateWindowEl && c1_tradeGateWindowEl.isConnected);
    }

    function c1_shouldHideImmersiveProfileCard() {
        return !!document.getElementById('tv-danger-confirm-modal');
    }

    function c1_syncImmersiveOverlayVisibility() {
        try { BearPet.applyImmersiveVisibility(); } catch (e) {}
        if (c1_immersiveProfileEl) {
            c1_immersiveProfileEl.classList.toggle('is-panel-obscured', c1_shouldHideImmersiveProfileCard());
        }
    }

    function c1_getVisiblePluginSurfaces() {
        const surfaces = [];
        if (document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel')) surfaces.push('settings');
        if (c1_tradeGateWindowEl && c1_tradeGateWindowEl.isConnected) surfaces.push('tradegateWindow');
        document.querySelectorAll('.tv-side-panel.show').forEach(el => {
            surfaces.push(el.id || 'sidePanel');
        });
        return surfaces;
    }

    function c1_markNativeAlertActive(duration = 7200) {
        c1_bearAlertHiddenUntil = Math.max(c1_bearAlertHiddenUntil, Date.now() + duration);
        document.documentElement.toggleAttribute('data-tv-control-native-alert-active', true);
        c1_syncImmersiveOverlayVisibility();
        if (c1_bearAlertRestoreTimer) clearTimeout(c1_bearAlertRestoreTimer);
        c1_bearAlertRestoreTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            c1_bearAlertRestoreTimer = null;
            if (Date.now() >= c1_bearAlertHiddenUntil) {
                c1_bearAlertHiddenUntil = 0;
                document.documentElement.removeAttribute('data-tv-control-native-alert-active');
                c1_syncImmersiveOverlayVisibility();
                c1_updateImmersiveProfileCard();
            }
        }, duration + 80);
    }

    function c1_syncOverlayStackState() {
        const root = document.documentElement;
        const surfaces = c1_getVisiblePluginSurfaces();
        root.toggleAttribute('data-tv-control-surface-open', surfaces.length > 0);
        root.toggleAttribute('data-tv-settings-open', surfaces.includes('settings'));
        root.toggleAttribute('data-tv-tradegate-window-open', surfaces.includes('tradegateWindow'));
        root.toggleAttribute('data-tv-control-native-alert-active', Date.now() < c1_bearAlertHiddenUntil);
        root.dataset.tvControlSurface = surfaces[0] || '';
        c1_syncImmersiveOverlayVisibility();
    }

    function c1_stopTradeScanLoop() {
        if (c1_tradeScanInterval) clearInterval(c1_tradeScanInterval);
        c1_tradeScanInterval = null;
    }

    function c1_startTradeScanLoop() {
        if (c1_tradeScanInterval || !c1_isTradeDataDemanded()) return;
        c1_tradeScanInterval = setInterval(() => {
            if (!c1_isTradeDataDemanded()) {
                c1_stopTradeScanLoop();
                return;
            }
            c1_scanTradeDialogThrottled();
        }, PERF_CONFIG.tradeScanMs);
        c1_scanTradeDialogThrottled();
    }

    function c1_refreshTradeScanLoop() {
        if (c1_isTradeDataDemanded()) c1_startTradeScanLoop();
        else c1_stopTradeScanLoop();
    }

    function c1_markReplayTransition(durationMs = PERF_CONFIG.replayTransitionGuardMs) {
        const nextUntil = Date.now() + Math.max(0, Number(durationMs) || 0);
        c1_replayTransitionUntil = Math.max(c1_replayTransitionUntil, nextUntil);
        c1_queryCache.clear();
    }

    function c1_isReplayModeActive() {
        const replayBtn = document.querySelector('#header-toolbar-replay, [data-name="header-toolbar-replay"], button[aria-label*="K线回放"], button[aria-label*="Bar Replay" i], button[title*="K线回放"], button[title*="Bar Replay" i]');
        const button = replayBtn?.matches?.('button')
            ? replayBtn
            : (replayBtn?.querySelector?.('button') || replayBtn?.closest?.('button') || replayBtn);
        if (!button) return false;
        if (button.getAttribute?.('aria-pressed') === 'true' || button.getAttribute?.('aria-checked') === 'true') return true;
        return /退出回放|结束回放|关闭回放|Exit Replay|Stop Replay|Close Replay/i.test(c1_readElementLabel(button));
    }

    function c1_isReplayStateUnstable() {
        return Date.now() < c1_replayTransitionUntil || c1_isReplayModeActive();
    }

    function c1_getTradeDialogDemandSnapshot(chartState, preferredId = '') {
        const dialog = c1_findTradeDialogRoot();
        const inputs = dialog ? Array.from(dialog.querySelectorAll('input')).slice(0, 8) : [];
        const inputSignature = inputs.map(input => c1_normalizeDomText(input.value)).join('|');
        const chart = c1_getChartApi();
        const selectionApi = c1_safeChartCall(() => chart?.selection?.()) || null;
        const selectedIds = (c1_safeChartCall(() => selectionApi?.allSources?.()) || []).map(item => String(item)).slice(0, 8).join(',');
        return {
            dialog,
            key: [
                chartState?.symbol || '',
                chartState?.interval || '',
                preferredId || '',
                selectedIds,
                dialog?.getAttribute('data-dialog-name') || '',
                dialog?.className || '',
                inputSignature
            ].join('||')
        };
    }

    function c1_parseTradeGatePresetList(value) {
        const rawList = Array.isArray(value) ? value : String(value || '').split(/[\n,，]+/);
        return [...new Set(rawList.map(item => String(item || '').trim().toUpperCase()).filter(Boolean))];
    }

    function c1_normalizeTradeGateSettings(raw = {}) {
        const next = {
            ...C1_TRADE_GATE_DEFAULT_SETTINGS,
            ...raw,
            symbolPresets: c1_parseTradeGatePresetList(raw?.symbolPresets?.length ? raw.symbolPresets : C1_TRADE_GATE_DEFAULT_SETTINGS.symbolPresets),
            htfPresets: c1_parseTradeGatePresetList(raw?.htfPresets?.length ? raw.htfPresets : C1_TRADE_GATE_DEFAULT_SETTINGS.htfPresets),
            // Never migrate affirmative execution checks across runs or releases.
            executionDefaults: { ...C1_TRADE_GATE_DEFAULT_SETTINGS.executionDefaults }
        };
        if (!next.symbolPresets.length) next.symbolPresets = [...C1_TRADE_GATE_DEFAULT_SETTINGS.symbolPresets];
        if (!next.htfPresets.length) next.htfPresets = [...C1_TRADE_GATE_DEFAULT_SETTINGS.htfPresets];
        next.defaultSymbol = String(next.defaultSymbol || C1_TRADE_GATE_DEFAULT_SETTINGS.defaultSymbol).trim().toUpperCase();
        next.defaultDirection = next.defaultDirection === 'bearish' ? 'bearish' : 'bullish';
        if (!next.htfPresets.includes(next.defaultHtfMode)) next.defaultHtfMode = next.htfPresets[0];
        next.frameworkVersion = 'v2.0';
        return next;
    }

    function c1_ensureTradeGateConfig() {
        const raw = SysConfig && SysConfig.tradeGate && typeof SysConfig.tradeGate === 'object'
            ? (SysConfig.tradeGate.settings && typeof SysConfig.tradeGate.settings === 'object' ? SysConfig.tradeGate.settings : SysConfig.tradeGate)
            : {};
        if (SysConfig) {
            SysConfig.tradeGate = { settings: c1_normalizeTradeGateSettings(raw) };
        }
        return SysConfig.tradeGate;
    }

    function c1_normalizeRiskPrefs(raw = {}) {
        const rawPrefs = raw && typeof raw === 'object' ? raw : {};
        const shouldApplyV2Defaults = Number(rawPrefs.uiDefaultsVersion || 0) < 2;
        const next = {
            ...C1_DEFAULT_RISK_PREFS,
            ...rawPrefs
        };
        next.compactMode = next.compactMode !== false;
        if (shouldApplyV2Defaults) {
            next.showTradeSnapshot = false;
            next.showTradeFees = false;
            next.showTradeMark = false;
            next.showResultFeeSummary = false;
            next.showResultNotional = false;
            next.showResultNotionalPct = false;
            next.showResultGrossProfit = false;
            next.showResultFeeNote = false;
        }
        next.showTradeSnapshot = next.showTradeSnapshot === true;
        next.showTradePnl = next.showTradePnl !== false;
        next.showTradeFees = next.showTradeFees === true;
        next.showTradeMark = next.showTradeMark === true;
        next.showResultFeeSummary = next.showResultFeeSummary === true;
        next.showResultNotional = next.showResultNotional === true;
        next.showResultNotionalPct = next.showResultNotionalPct === true;
        next.showResultGrossProfit = next.showResultGrossProfit === true;
        next.showResultFeeNote = next.showResultFeeNote === true;
        next.uiDefaultsVersion = 2;
        next.resultFeeMode = ['maker', 'taker', 'both'].includes(next.resultFeeMode) ? next.resultFeeMode : 'maker';
        next.snapshotFeeMode = ['maker', 'taker', 'both'].includes(next.snapshotFeeMode) ? next.snapshotFeeMode : 'maker';
        next.entryFeeSide = next.entryFeeSide === 'taker' ? 'taker' : 'maker';
        next.exitFeeSide = next.exitFeeSide === 'maker' ? 'maker' : 'taker';
        next.feeSource = 'manual';
        next.includeFeesInSizing = next.includeFeesInSizing === true;
        next.stopMode = next.stopMode === 'price' ? 'price' : 'ticks';
        next.riskBudget = Number.isFinite(Number(next.riskBudget)) && Number(next.riskBudget) > 0
            ? Number(next.riskBudget)
            : C1_DEFAULT_RISK_PREFS.riskBudget;
        next.manualMakerFeeRate = Number.isFinite(Number(next.manualMakerFeeRate)) && Number(next.manualMakerFeeRate) >= 0
            ? Number(next.manualMakerFeeRate)
            : C1_DEFAULT_RISK_PREFS.manualMakerFeeRate;
        next.manualTakerFeeRate = Number.isFinite(Number(next.manualTakerFeeRate)) && Number(next.manualTakerFeeRate) >= 0
            ? Number(next.manualTakerFeeRate)
            : C1_DEFAULT_RISK_PREFS.manualTakerFeeRate;
        return next;
    }

    function c1_ensureRiskPrefs() {
        if (SysConfig) SysConfig.riskPrefs = c1_normalizeRiskPrefs(SysConfig.riskPrefs);
        return SysConfig.riskPrefs;
    }

    function c1_readTradeGateRuntime() {
        try {
            const raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(C1_TRADE_GATE_RUNTIME_KEY) || '{}');
            return {
                currentRun: raw && typeof raw === 'object' ? raw.currentRun || null : null,
                history: Array.isArray(raw?.history) ? raw.history.slice(0, C1_TRADE_GATE_MAX_HISTORY) : []
            };
        } catch (e) {
            return { currentRun: null, history: [] };
        }
    }

    function c1_writeTradeGateRuntime(data) {
        try {
            localStorage.setItem(C1_TRADE_GATE_RUNTIME_KEY, JSON.stringify({
                currentRun: data?.currentRun || null,
                history: Array.isArray(data?.history) ? data.history.slice(0, C1_TRADE_GATE_MAX_HISTORY) : []
            }));
        } catch (e) { console.warn('[TV-GCC] tradegate runtime persist failed', e); }
    }

    function c1_preloadImmersiveAssets() {
        [C1_BEAR_SHEET, SysConfig?.avatar || defaultAvatar].filter(Boolean).forEach((src) => {
            try {
                if (c1_immersivePreloadImages.some(img => img.src === src)) return;
                const img = new Image();
                img.decoding = 'async';
                img.loading = 'eager';
                img.src = src;
                c1_immersivePreloadImages.push(img);
                img.decode?.().catch(() => {});
            } catch (e) {}
        });
    }

    const C1_CONFIG_EXPORT_VERSION = 2;

    function c1_clonePlain(value) {
        return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
    }

    function c1_getBundledDefaultPayload() {
        // Generate a clean baseline at runtime. Never ship a personal export,
        // cached calendar response, or Trade Gate history inside the userscript.
        return {
            version: C1_CONFIG_EXPORT_VERSION,
            exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            sysConfig: c1_clonePlain(C1_DEFAULT_CONFIG),
            macroConfig: c1_clonePlain(C2_DEFAULT_CONFIG),
            tradeGateRuntime: { currentRun: null, history: [] }
        };
    }

    function c1_buildConfigExportFileName(date = new Date(), version = C1_CONFIG_EXPORT_VERSION) {
        const pad = (value) => String(value).padStart(2, '0');
        const stamp = `${date.getFullYear()}${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}${pad(date.getDate())}`;
        return `TV-Control-${stamp}-v${version}.json`;
    }

        { id: 'cyber', label: 'Cyber' }
    ];
    const C1_THEME_IDS = new Set(C1_THEME_OPTIONS.map(theme => theme.id));

    function c1_normalizeTheme(theme) {
        const value = String(theme || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (value === 'mocha' || value === 'aurora') return C1_DEFAULT_CONFIG.theme;
        return C1_THEME_IDS.has(value) ? value : C1_DEFAULT_CONFIG.theme;
    }

    const C1_CORE_SIDEBAR_MODULES = {
        tradegate: { icon: 'target', defaultSide: 'left', defaultOrder: 10, defaultEnabled: true, label: { zh: 'Trade Gate', en: 'Trade Gate' } },
        macro: { icon: 'earth', defaultSide: 'left', defaultOrder: 30, defaultEnabled: true, label: { zh: '宏观日历', en: 'Macro Calendar' } },
        risk: { icon: 'shield', defaultSide: 'right', defaultOrder: 40, defaultEnabled: true, label: { zh: '风控底座', en: 'Risk Base' } }
    };

    function c1_createDefaultSidebarItems() {
        const items = {};
        Object.entries(C1_CORE_SIDEBAR_MODULES).forEach(([id, meta]) => {
            items[id] = {
                enabled: !!meta.defaultEnabled,
                side: meta.defaultSide,
                order: meta.defaultOrder
            };
        });
        items.risk.side = 'right';
        return items;
    }

    let SysConfig = {};

    const C1_IMMERSIVE_MARKET_COLOR_PRESETS = {
        crypto: ['#2f80ed', '#2563eb', '#0891b2', '#7c3aed'],
        gold: ['#b98520', '#c28a1a', '#a16207', '#d19a2a'],
        forex: ['#168e9e', '#0f9f9a', '#2f80ed', '#64748b']
    };

    const C1_IMMERSIVE_MARKET_COLOR_LEGACY_DEFAULTS = {
        crypto: '#2f80ed',
        gold: '#d89b12',
        forex: '#00a676',
        default: '#17212b'
    };

    function c1_isValidHexColor(value) {
        return /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(String(value || '').trim());
    }

    function c1_normalizeImmersiveMarketColors(raw) {
        const defaults = C1_DEFAULT_CONFIG.immersiveMarketColors;
        const source = raw && typeof raw === 'object' ? raw : {};
        return Object.keys(defaults).reduce((next, key) => {
            const value = String(source[key] || '').trim();
            const legacyDefault = String(C1_IMMERSIVE_MARKET_COLOR_LEGACY_DEFAULTS[key] || '').toLowerCase();
            next[key] = c1_isValidHexColor(value) && value.toLowerCase() !== legacyDefault ? value : defaults[key];
            return next;
        }, {});
    }

    function c1_getImmersiveMarketColor(kind) {
        SysConfig.immersiveMarketColors = c1_normalizeImmersiveMarketColors(SysConfig.immersiveMarketColors);
        return SysConfig.immersiveMarketColors[kind] || SysConfig.immersiveMarketColors.default || C1_DEFAULT_CONFIG.immersiveMarketColors.default;
    }

    function c1_getImmersiveMarketKind(parts = {}) {
        const joined = `${parts.exchange || ''}:${parts.symbol || ''}`.toUpperCase();
        if (joined.includes('USDT')) return 'crypto';
        if (/\b(XAU|GOLD)\b/.test(joined) || joined.includes('XAU') || joined.includes('GOLD')) return 'gold';
        const cleanSymbol = String(parts.symbol || '').toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z]/g, '');
        const currencies = new Set(['USD', 'EUR', 'GBP', 'JPY', 'CHF', 'AUD', 'CAD', 'NZD', 'CNH', 'HKD', 'SGD']);
        const base = cleanSymbol.slice(0, 3);
        const quote = cleanSymbol.slice(3, 6);
        if (cleanSymbol.length >= 6 && currencies.has(base) && currencies.has(quote)) return 'forex';
        return 'default';
    }

    function c1_buildImmersiveColorSettingsHTML() {
        SysConfig.immersiveMarketColors = c1_normalizeImmersiveMarketColors(SysConfig.immersiveMarketColors);
        const labels = {
            crypto: SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Crypto / USDT' : '虚拟货币 / USDT',
            gold: SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Gold' : '黄金',

        };
        const title = SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Immersive Text Colors' : '沉浸文字颜色';
        const subtitle = SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'market-specific HUD tone' : '不同市场的 HUD 主色';
        const cards = ['crypto', 'gold', 'forex'].map((kind) => {
            const current = c1_getImmersiveMarketColor(kind);
            const presets = (C1_IMMERSIVE_MARKET_COLOR_PRESETS[kind] || []).map((color) => (
                `<button type="button" class="tv-immersive-color-preset${current.toLowerCase() === color.toLowerCase() ? ' is-active' : ''}" data-kind="${kind}" data-color="${color}" style="--preset-color:${color};" data-tooltip="${c1_tradeGateEscape(color)}" aria-label="${c1_tradeGateEscape(color)}"></button>`
            )).join('');
            return `
                <label class="tv-immersive-color-card" style="--current-color:${c1_tradeGateEscape(current)}">

                    <div class="tv-immersive-color-row">
                        <span class="tv-immersive-color-current" aria-hidden="true"></span>

'Custom color' : '自定义颜色')}" aria-label="${c1_tradeGateEscape(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Custom color' : '自定义颜色')}">
                        <div class="tv-immersive-color-presets">${presets}</div>
                    </div>

        }).join('');
        return `<div class="tv-settings-immersive-group tv-settings-immersive-colors"><div class="tv-settings-immersive-group-head"><span>${c1_tradeGateEscape(title)}</span><small>${c1_tradeGateEscape(subtitle)}</small></div><div class="tv-immersive-color-grid">${cards}</div></div>`;
    }

    function c1_normalizeImmersiveTips(raw) {
        const list = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : (typeof raw === 'string' ? raw.split(/\r?\n/) : []);
        const tips = list.map(item => String(item || '').trim()).filter(Boolean);
        return tips.length ? tips : [...C1_DEFAULT_IMMERSIVE_TIPS];
    }

    function c1_normalizeImmersiveHudMode(value) {
        return value === 'dynamic' ? 'dynamic' : 'persistent';
    }

    function c1_normalizeImmersiveHudTheme(value) {
        return value === 'light' || value === 'dark' ? value : 'auto';
    }

    function c1_applyImmersiveHudTheme() {
        const root = document.documentElement;
        if (!root) return;
        const theme = c1_normalizeImmersiveHudTheme(SysConfig && SysConfig.immersiveHudTheme);
        root.classList.toggle('tv-hud-force-light', theme === 'light');
        root.classList.toggle('tv-hud-force-dark', theme === 'dark');
    }

    function c1_normalizeImmersiveHudDynamicMs(value) {
        const ms = Number(value);
        return Number.isFinite(ms) ? Math.round(Math.min(Math.max(ms, 500), 30000)) : C1_DEFAULT_CONFIG.immersiveHudDynamicMs;
    }

    function c1_normalizeImmersiveHudScale(value) {
        const scale = Number(value);
        return Number.isFinite(scale) ? Math.round(Math.min(Math.max(scale, 0.75), 1.4) * 100) / 100 : C1_DEFAULT_CONFIG.immersiveHudScale;
    }

    function c1_normalizeImmersiveProfileScale(value) {
        const scale = Number(value);
        return Number.isFinite(scale) ? Math.round(Math.min(Math.max(scale, 0.75), 1.25) * 100) / 100 : C1_DEFAULT_CONFIG.immersiveProfileScale;
    }

    function c1_normalizeIndicatorSlotVisibility(raw = {}) {
        const source = raw && typeof raw === 'object' ? raw : {};
        const next = {};
        for (let i = 1; i <= 12; i += 1) {
            const value = source[String(i)] ?? source[i];
            if (typeof value === 'boolean') next[String(i)] = value;
        }
        return next;
    }

    function c1_normalizeIndicatorSlotOrder(raw = []) {
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        const seen = new Set();
        const next = [];
        raw.forEach(item => {
            if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') return;
            const id = item.id == null ? '' : String(item.id).trim();
            const name = c1_normalizeDomText(item.name || item.title || '');
            if (!id && !name) return;
            const key = id ? `id:${id}` : `name:${name.toLowerCase()}`;
            if (seen.has(key)) return;
            seen.add(key);
            next.push({ id, name });
        });
        return next.slice(0, 12);
    }

    function c1_normalizeBearPetConfig(raw) {
        const defaults = C1_DEFAULT_CONFIG.bearPet;
        const source = raw && typeof raw === 'object' ? raw : {};
        const scale = Number(source.scale);
        const x = Number(source.x);
        const y = Number(source.y);
        const version = Number(source.defaultPositionVersion);
        const shouldMigrateDefaultPosition = !Number.isFinite(version) || version < defaults.defaultPositionVersion;
        return {
            ...defaults,
            enabled: source.enabled === undefined ? defaults.enabled : source.enabled === true,
            x: shouldMigrateDefaultPosition ? null : (Number.isFinite(x) ? x : null),
            y: shouldMigrateDefaultPosition ? null : (Number.isFinite(y) ? y : null),
            scale: Number.isFinite(scale) ? Math.min(Math.max(scale, 0.55), 1.8) : defaults.scale,
            mood: Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(C1_BEAR_MOODS, source.mood) ? source.mood : defaults.mood,
            immersiveMode: ['show', 'hide', 'only'].includes(source.immersiveMode) ? source.immersiveMode : defaults.immersiveMode,
            dragHintSeen: source.dragHintSeen === true,
            defaultPositionVersion: defaults.defaultPositionVersion
        };
    }

    function c1_initializeBearPet(options = {}) {
        const persist = options.persist !== false;
        SysConfig.bearPet = c1_normalizeBearPetConfig({
            ...C1_DEFAULT_CONFIG.bearPet,
            enabled: true,
            x: null,
            y: null,
            scale: C1_DEFAULT_CONFIG.bearPet.scale,
            mood: C1_DEFAULT_CONFIG.bearPet.mood,
            immersiveMode: C1_DEFAULT_CONFIG.bearPet.immersiveMode,
            dragHintSeen: false,
            defaultPositionVersion: C1_DEFAULT_CONFIG.bearPet.defaultPositionVersion
        });
        try {
            if (typeof BearPet !== 'undefined') {
                BearPet.destroy?.();
                BearPet.init?.();
                c1_startNativeAlertBearWatcher();
                BearPet.resetPosition?.();
                BearPet.temporaryMood?.('happy', 1800, SysConfig.bearPet.mood || 'idle');
                BearPet.showInitialDragHint?.();
            }
        } catch (err) {
            console.warn('[TV-GCC] Bear initialization failed', err);
        }
        if (persist) c1_saveConfig();
        return SysConfig.bearPet;
    }
