    function c1_getUsedShortcutKeys() {
        const keys = new Set();
        const tools = SysConfig.tools || {};
        c1_getActiveToolBindingEntries().forEach(({ id }) => {
            const key = SharedTV.normalizeShortcutString(tools[id]);
            if (key) keys.add(key);
        });
        (SysConfig.timeframes || []).forEach(item => { const key = SharedTV.normalizeShortcutString(item.key); if (key) keys.add(key); });
        (SysConfig.symbols || []).forEach(item => { const key = SharedTV.normalizeShortcutString(item.key); if (key) keys.add(key); });
        (SysConfig.panels || []).forEach(item => { const key = SharedTV.normalizeShortcutString(item.key); if (key) keys.add(key); });
        const macroKey = SharedTV.normalizeShortcutString(C2_CONFIG?.macroKey);
        if (macroKey) keys.add(macroKey);
        const immersiveKey = SharedTV.normalizeShortcutString(SysConfig.immersiveKey);
        if (immersiveKey) keys.add(immersiveKey);
        return keys;
    }

    function c1_ensureDefaultTimeframes() {
        if (!Array.isArray(SysConfig.timeframes)) SysConfig.timeframes = [];
        const required = [
            { id: 'tf_day', val: 'D', key: '6' },
            { id: 'tf_week', val: 'W', key: '7' },
            { id: 'tf_month', val: 'M', key: '8' }
        ];
        const usedKeys = new Set((SysConfig.timeframes || []).map(item => item?.key).filter(Boolean));
        const hasValue = (value) => SysConfig.timeframes.some(item => c1_normalizeIntervalCode(item?.val) === value);
        required.forEach(item => {
            const normalized = c1_normalizeIntervalCode(item.val);
            if (hasValue(normalized)) return;
            const key = usedKeys.has(item.key) ? '' : item.key;
            if (key) usedKeys.add(key);
            SysConfig.timeframes.push({ ...item, key });
        });
    }

    function c1_ensureSidebarConfig() {
        const existed = SysConfig.sidebarItems && typeof SysConfig.sidebarItems === 'object';
        const next = existed ? { ...SysConfig.sidebarItems } : c1_createDefaultSidebarItems();
        Object.entries(C1_CORE_SIDEBAR_MODULES).forEach(([id, meta]) => {
            const current = next[id] || {};
            next[id] = {
                enabled: existed ? current.enabled !== false : meta.defaultEnabled !== false,
                side: current.side === 'right' ? 'right' : (current.side === 'left' ? 'left' : meta.defaultSide),
                order: Number.isFinite(Number(current.order)) ? Number(current.order) : meta.defaultOrder
            };
        });
        if (!existed && SysConfig.riskFloatPosition === 'right') next.risk.side = 'right';

        const panelIds = new Set((SysConfig.panels || []).map(panel => `custom:${panel.id}`));
        Object.keys(next).forEach(id => {
            if (id.startsWith('custom:') && !panelIds.has(id)) delete next[id];
        });
        (SysConfig.panels || []).forEach((panel, idx) => {
            const id = `custom:${panel.id}`;
            const current = next[id] || {};
            next[id] = {
                enabled: Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(current, 'enabled') ? current.enabled !== false : true,
                side: current.side === 'right' ? 'right' : 'left',
                order: Number.isFinite(Number(current.order)) ? Number(current.order) : 20 + idx
            };
        });
        SysConfig.sidebarItems = next;
        SysConfig.riskFloatPosition = next.risk?.side === 'right' ? 'right' : 'left';
        return next;
    }

    function c1_normalizeShortcutBindings(config) {
        if (!config || typeof config !== 'object') return config;
        if (config.tools && typeof config.tools === 'object') {
            Object.keys(config.tools).forEach((id) => {
                config.tools[id] = SharedTV.normalizeShortcutString(config.tools[id]);
            });
        }
        ['timeframes', 'symbols', 'panels'].forEach((field) => {
            if (!Array.isArray(config[field])) return;
            config[field].forEach((item) => {
                if (item && typeof item === 'object') item.key = SharedTV.normalizeShortcutString(item.key);
            });
        });
        if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(config, 'immersiveKey')) {
            config.immersiveKey = SharedTV.normalizeShortcutString(config.immersiveKey);
        }
        return config;
    }

    function c1_ensureGlobalConfig() {
        if (!['zh', 'en'].includes(SysConfig.lang)) SysConfig.lang = C1_DEFAULT_CONFIG.lang;
        SysConfig.theme = c1_normalizeTheme(SysConfig.theme);
        const avatarPreset = String(SysConfig.avatarPreset || '').trim();
        if (!avatarPreset || (avatarPreset !== 'custom' && !C1_BUILTIN_AVATAR_PRESETS.some((preset) => preset.id === avatarPreset))) SysConfig.avatarPreset = C1_DEFAULT_AVATAR_PRESET;
        if (SysConfig.avatarPreset === 'custom') {
            if (!c1_isAllowedAvatarDataUri(SysConfig.avatar)) {
                SysConfig.avatarPreset = C1_DEFAULT_AVATAR_PRESET;
                SysConfig.avatar = c1_getBuiltinAvatarDataUri(SysConfig.avatarPreset);
            }
        } else {
            // Never trust an imported/localStorage avatar string for a built-in
            // preset. Reconstruct it locally so it cannot become an HTML sink.
            SysConfig.avatar = c1_getBuiltinAvatarDataUri(SysConfig.avatarPreset);
        }
        if (!SysConfig.tools || typeof SysConfig.tools !== 'object' || Array.isArray(SysConfig.tools)) SysConfig.tools = { ...C1_DEFAULT_CONFIG.tools };
        if (!Array.isArray(SysConfig.timeframes)) SysConfig.timeframes = c1_clonePlain(C1_DEFAULT_CONFIG.timeframes);
        if (!Array.isArray(SysConfig.symbols)) SysConfig.symbols = c1_clonePlain(C1_DEFAULT_CONFIG.symbols);
        if (!Array.isArray(SysConfig.panels)) SysConfig.panels = c1_clonePlain(C1_DEFAULT_CONFIG.panels);
        if (!String(SysConfig.tools.createAlert || '').trim()) SysConfig.tools.createAlert = 'T';
        if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(SysConfig.tools, 'instantAlert')) SysConfig.tools.instantAlert = 'ALT + A';
        if (typeof SysConfig.showNotifications !== 'boolean') SysConfig.showNotifications = true;
        if (typeof SysConfig.showToastEmoji !== 'boolean') SysConfig.showToastEmoji = true;
        if (typeof SysConfig.keepAutoScaleAfterReset !== 'boolean') SysConfig.keepAutoScaleAfterReset = false;
        if (typeof SysConfig.immersiveEnabled !== 'boolean') SysConfig.immersiveEnabled = true;
        if (typeof SysConfig.immersiveAutoStart !== 'boolean') SysConfig.immersiveAutoStart = false;
        if (typeof SysConfig.hideSidebarInImmersive !== 'boolean') SysConfig.hideSidebarInImmersive = true;
        if (typeof SysConfig.hideNotificationsInImmersive !== 'boolean') SysConfig.hideNotificationsInImmersive = true;
        if (typeof SysConfig.suppressNativeImmersiveToast !== 'boolean') SysConfig.suppressNativeImmersiveToast = true;
        SysConfig.immersiveHudMode = c1_normalizeImmersiveHudMode(SysConfig.immersiveHudMode);
        SysConfig.immersiveHudTheme = c1_normalizeImmersiveHudTheme(SysConfig.immersiveHudTheme);
        SysConfig.immersiveHudDynamicMs = c1_normalizeImmersiveHudDynamicMs(SysConfig.immersiveHudDynamicMs);
        SysConfig.immersiveHudScale = c1_normalizeImmersiveHudScale(SysConfig.immersiveHudScale);
        SysConfig.immersiveProfileScale = c1_normalizeImmersiveProfileScale(SysConfig.immersiveProfileScale);
        if (typeof SysConfig.immersiveKey !== 'string') SysConfig.immersiveKey = 'F';
        SysConfig.immersiveKey = SysConfig.immersiveKey.trim().toUpperCase();
        SysConfig.immersiveMarketColors = c1_normalizeImmersiveMarketColors(SysConfig.immersiveMarketColors);
        SysConfig.immersiveTips = c1_normalizeImmersiveTips(SysConfig.immersiveTips);
        SysConfig.indicatorSlotVisibility = c1_normalizeIndicatorSlotVisibility(SysConfig.indicatorSlotVisibility);
        SysConfig.indicatorSlotOrder = c1_normalizeIndicatorSlotOrder(SysConfig.indicatorSlotOrder);
        SysConfig.bearPet = c1_normalizeBearPetConfig(SysConfig.bearPet);
        c1_normalizeShortcutBindings(SysConfig);
        if (SysConfig.immersiveEnabled !== false && SysConfig.immersiveKey && SysConfig.tools && SysConfig.tools.path === SysConfig.immersiveKey) SysConfig.tools.path = '';
        c1_ensureDefaultTimeframes();
        c1_ensureSidebarConfig();
    }

    function c1_removeRetiredModuleConfig() {
        if (!SysConfig || typeof SysConfig !== 'object') return;
        delete SysConfig.checklist;
        delete SysConfig.drawingTemplateLibrary;
        if (SysConfig.sidebarItems) delete SysConfig.sidebarItems.checklist;
        if (SysConfig.tools) {
            delete SysConfig.tools.checklist;
            delete SysConfig.tools.immersiveMode;
            delete SysConfig.tools.minimalMode;
            delete SysConfig.tools.replayRandom;
            delete SysConfig.tools.templateLibrary;
            delete SysConfig.tools.chartUiTradeButtons;
            delete SysConfig.tools.chartUiIndicatorNames;
            delete SysConfig.tools.chartUiClean;
        }
        delete SysConfig.chartUiVisibility;
        delete SysConfig.chartUiCleanupActive;
        delete SysConfig.suppressUnsavedLeaveWarning;
    }

    function c1_migrateConfig(saved) {
        if (!saved || typeof saved !== 'object') return null;
        const next = { ...saved };
        const version = Number(next.__schemaVersion || 1);
        if (version < 2) {
            if (next.tools && typeof next.tools === 'object') {
                delete next.tools.replayRandom;
                delete next.tools.minimalMode;
                delete next.tools.immersiveMode;
            }
            delete next.replayRandom;
            next.__schemaVersion = 2;
        }
        if (version < 3) {
            if (Array.isArray(next.enabledDrawTools) && !next.enabledDrawTools.includes('note')) {
                next.enabledDrawTools = next.enabledDrawTools.concat('note');
            }
            next.__schemaVersion = 3;
        }
        if (version < 4) {
            if (Array.isArray(next.enabledDrawTools)) {
                next.enabledDrawTools = next.enabledDrawTools.filter(id => id !== 'note');
                if (!next.enabledDrawTools.includes('textNote')) next.enabledDrawTools = next.enabledDrawTools.concat('textNote');
            }
            if (next.tools && typeof next.tools === 'object') {
                if (!next.tools.textNote && next.tools.note) next.tools.textNote = next.tools.note;
                if (!next.tools.textNote) next.tools.textNote = 'Q';
                next.tools.note = '';
            }
            next.__schemaVersion = 4;
        }
        if (version < 5) {
            c1_normalizeShortcutBindings(next);
            next.__schemaVersion = 5;
        }
        if (version < 6) {
            next.tools = next.tools && typeof next.tools === 'object' ? { ...next.tools } : {};
            // The previous release incorrectly reserved Tab; duplicate cleanup may
            // have erased the user's watchlist binding. Restore it once on upgrade.
            if (!SharedTV.normalizeShortcutString(next.tools.watchlist)) next.tools.watchlist = 'TAB';
            next.__schemaVersion = 6;
        }
        if (!Number.isFinite(version) || version > C1_CONFIG_VERSION) {
            next.__schemaVersion = C1_CONFIG_VERSION;
        }
        return next;
    }

    function c1_isPlainConfigObject(value) {
        if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return false;
        const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(value);
        return proto === Object.prototype || proto === null;
    }

    function c1_configValidationError(path, message) {
        throw new Error(`${path}: ${message}`);
    }

    function c1_validateConfigTree(value, path = 'config', depth = 0) {
        if (depth > C1_CONFIG_IMPORT_MAX_DEPTH) c1_configValidationError(path, 'nesting is too deep');
        if (value == null || typeof value === 'boolean') return;
        if (typeof value === 'number') {
            if (!Number.isFinite(value)) c1_configValidationError(path, 'number must be finite');
            return;
        }
        if (typeof value === 'string') {
            if (value.length > C1_CONFIG_IMPORT_MAX_BYTES) c1_configValidationError(path, 'string is too long');
            return;
        }
        if (Array.isArray(value)) {
            if (value.length > C1_CONFIG_IMPORT_MAX_ARRAY_ITEMS) c1_configValidationError(path, 'array has too many items');
            value.forEach((item, index) => c1_validateConfigTree(item, `${path}[${index}]`, depth + 1));
            return;
        }
        if (!c1_isPlainConfigObject(value)) c1_configValidationError(path, 'must be a plain JSON object');
        const keys = Object.keys(value);
        if (keys.length > 500) c1_configValidationError(path, 'object has too many keys');
        keys.forEach((key) => {
            if (['__proto__', 'prototype', 'constructor'].includes(key)) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.${key}`, 'unsafe property name');
            c1_validateConfigTree(value[key], `${path}.${key}`, depth + 1);
        });
    }

    function c1_validateOptionalString(record, key, path, maxLength, allowEmpty = true) {
        if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(record, key)) return;
        const value = record[key];
        if (typeof value !== 'string') c1_configValidationError(`${path}.${key}`, 'must be a string');
        if (value.length > maxLength) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.${key}`, `must be at most ${maxLength} characters`);
        if (!allowEmpty && !value.trim()) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.${key}`, 'must not be empty');
    }

    function c1_validateShortcutValue(value, path, macro = false) {
        if (typeof value !== 'string') c1_configValidationError(path, 'shortcut must be a string');
        if (value.length > 64) c1_configValidationError(path, 'shortcut is too long');
        const normalized = macro ? c1_normalizeMacroShortcut(value) : SharedTV.normalizeShortcutString(value);
        if (!value.trim()) return '';
        if (!normalized) c1_configValidationError(path, 'shortcut is invalid');
        const parts = normalized.split(' + ');
        const key = parts.pop() || '';
        const modifiers = new Set(['CTRL', 'ALT', 'SHIFT', 'META']);
        if (parts.some((part) => !modifiers.has(part)) || new Set(parts).size !== parts.length) c1_configValidationError(path, 'shortcut modifiers are invalid');
        if (!/^(?:[A-Z0-9]{1,24}|[`\-=\[\]\\;',.\/]|SPACE|TAB|ESCAPE|ENTER|BACKSPACE|DELETE)$/.test(key)) c1_configValidationError(path, 'shortcut key is invalid');
        return normalized;
    }

    function c1_isAllowedMacroApiUrl(value) {
        try {
            const url = new URL(String(value || ''));
            return url.protocol === 'https:'
                && url.hostname === 'nfs.faireconomy.media'
                && !url.username
                && !url.password;
        } catch (e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    function c1_validateBindingArray(record, field, maxItems, path) {
        if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(record, field)) return;
        const list = record[field];
        if (!Array.isArray(list)) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.${field}`, 'must be an array');
        if (list.length > maxItems) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.${field}`, `must contain at most ${maxItems} items`);
        list.forEach((item, index) => {
            const itemPath = `${path}.${field}[${index}]`;
            if (!c1_isPlainConfigObject(item)) c1_configValidationError(itemPath, 'must be an object');
            c1_validateOptionalString(item, 'id', itemPath, 80);
            c1_validateOptionalString(item, 'key', itemPath, 64);
            if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(item, 'key')) c1_validateShortcutValue(item.key, `${itemPath}.key`);
            if (field === 'panels') {
                c1_validateOptionalString(item, 'title', itemPath, 200);
                c1_validateOptionalString(item, 'icon', itemPath, 64);
                c1_validateOptionalString(item, 'content', itemPath, 200000);
            } else {
                c1_validateOptionalString(item, 'val', itemPath, 160);
            }
        });
    }

    function c1_validateSysConfigImport(sysConfig, path = 'config.sysConfig') {
        if (!c1_isPlainConfigObject(sysConfig)) c1_configValidationError(path, 'must be an object');
        if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(sysConfig, '__schemaVersion')) {
            const version = Number(sysConfig.__schemaVersion);
            if (!Number.isInteger(version) || version < 1 || version > C1_CONFIG_VERSION) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.__schemaVersion`, 'unsupported schema version');
        }
        if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(sysConfig, 'lang') && !['zh', 'en'].includes(sysConfig.lang)) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.lang`, 'must be zh or en');
        if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(sysConfig, 'theme') && ![...C1_THEME_IDS, 'mocha', 'aurora'].includes(String(sysConfig.theme || '').toLowerCase())) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.theme`, 'unsupported theme');
        c1_validateOptionalString(sysConfig, 'username', path, 120);
        c1_validateOptionalString(sysConfig, 'avatarPreset', path, 32);
        c1_validateOptionalString(sysConfig, 'avatar', path, Math.ceil(C1_AVATAR_MAX_BYTES * 4 / 3) + 256);
        if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(sysConfig, 'avatarPreset')) {
            const allowedPresets = new Set(['custom', ...C1_BUILTIN_AVATAR_PRESETS.map((preset) => preset.id)]);
            if (!allowedPresets.has(sysConfig.avatarPreset)) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.avatarPreset`, 'unknown avatar preset');
            if (sysConfig.avatarPreset === 'custom' && !c1_isAllowedAvatarDataUri(sysConfig.avatar)) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.avatar`, 'custom avatar must be a PNG/JPEG/WebP/ICO data URI under 2 MB');
        }
        if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(sysConfig, 'tools')) {
            if (!c1_isPlainConfigObject(sysConfig.tools)) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.tools`, 'must be an object');
            const entries = Object.entries(sysConfig.tools);
            if (entries.length > 160) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.tools`, 'has too many bindings');
            entries.forEach(([id, shortcut]) => {
                if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/.test(id)) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.tools`, 'contains an invalid binding id');
                c1_validateShortcutValue(shortcut, `${path}.tools.${id}`);
            });
        }
        if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(sysConfig, 'immersiveKey')) c1_validateShortcutValue(sysConfig.immersiveKey, `${path}.immersiveKey`);
        c1_validateBindingArray(sysConfig, 'timeframes', 120, path);
        c1_validateBindingArray(sysConfig, 'symbols', 240, path);
        c1_validateBindingArray(sysConfig, 'panels', 120, path);
        ['enabledDrawTools', 'indicatorSlotOrder', 'immersiveTips'].forEach((field) => {
            if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(sysConfig, field)) return;
            if (!Array.isArray(sysConfig[field])) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.${field}`, 'must be an array');
            const maxItems = field === 'immersiveTips' ? 100 : 200;
            if (sysConfig[field].length > maxItems) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.${field}`, `must contain at most ${maxItems} items`);
            sysConfig[field].forEach((value, index) => {
                if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.length > (field === 'immersiveTips' ? 500 : 80)) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.${field}[${index}]`, 'contains an invalid string');
            });
        });
        const booleanFields = ['riskEnabled', 'showNotifications', 'showToastEmoji', 'keepAutoScaleAfterReset', 'immersiveEnabled', 'immersiveAutoStart', 'hideSidebarInImmersive', 'hideNotificationsInImmersive', 'suppressNativeImmersiveToast', 'openImmersiveOnLoad', 'minimalModeActive'];
        booleanFields.forEach((field) => {
            if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(sysConfig, field) && typeof sysConfig[field] !== 'boolean') c1_configValidationError(`${path}.${field}`, 'must be boolean');
        });
        if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(sysConfig, 'panelScale')) {
            const scale = Number(sysConfig.panelScale);
            if (!Number.isFinite(scale) || scale < 0.5 || scale > 2) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.panelScale`, 'must be between 0.5 and 2');
        }
    }

    function c1_validateMacroConfigImport(macroConfig, path = 'config.macroConfig') {
        if (!c1_isPlainConfigObject(macroConfig)) c1_configValidationError(path, 'must be an object');
        if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(macroConfig, 'macroKey')) c1_validateShortcutValue(macroConfig.macroKey, `${path}.macroKey`, true);
        c1_validateOptionalString(macroConfig, 'macroIcon', path, 32);
        if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(macroConfig, 'macroIcon') && !['earth', 'list', 'zap', 'target', 'star', 'shield'].includes(macroConfig.macroIcon)) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.macroIcon`, 'unsupported icon');
        c1_validateOptionalString(macroConfig, 'macroApiUrl', path, 2048, false);
        if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(macroConfig, 'macroApiUrl') && !c1_isAllowedMacroApiUrl(macroConfig.macroApiUrl)) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.macroApiUrl`, 'must be an allowed HTTPS macro endpoint');
        if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(macroConfig, 'macroPrefs')) {
            const prefs = macroConfig.macroPrefs;
            if (!c1_isPlainConfigObject(prefs) || !Array.isArray(prefs.currencies)) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.macroPrefs.currencies`, 'must be an array');
            const allowed = new Set(['USD', 'EUR', 'GBP', 'JPY', 'AUD', 'CAD', 'XAU', 'CRYPTO']);
            if (!prefs.currencies.length || prefs.currencies.length > allowed.size || prefs.currencies.some((item) => typeof item !== 'string' || !allowed.has(item))) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.macroPrefs.currencies`, 'contains an unsupported currency');
        }
        if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(macroConfig, 'customPanels')) {
            if (!Array.isArray(macroConfig.customPanels) || macroConfig.customPanels.length > 100) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.customPanels`, 'must be an array with at most 100 items');
        }
        if (macroConfig.cache != null) {
            if (!c1_isPlainConfigObject(macroConfig.cache)) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.cache`, 'must be an object or null');
            if (!Number.isFinite(Number(macroConfig.cache.time)) || Number(macroConfig.cache.time) < 0) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.cache.time`, 'must be a valid timestamp');
            if (Number(macroConfig.cache.time) > Date.now()) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.cache.time`, 'future cache timestamps are not accepted');
            if (!Array.isArray(macroConfig.cache.data) || macroConfig.cache.data.length > C1_CONFIG_IMPORT_MAX_ARRAY_ITEMS) c1_configValidationError(`${path}.cache.data`, 'must be a bounded array');
            macroConfig.cache.data.forEach((item, index) => {
                const itemPath = `${path}.cache.data[${index}]`;
                if (!c1_isPlainConfigObject(item)) c1_configValidationError(itemPath, 'must be an object');
                ['title', 'country', 'date', 'impact', 'forecast', 'previous'].forEach((field) => c1_validateOptionalString(item, field, itemPath, 1000));
            });
        }
    }

    function c1_validateConfigPayload(parsed) {
        c1_validateConfigTree(parsed);
        if (!c1_isPlainConfigObject(parsed)) c1_configValidationError('config', 'root must be an object');
        const wrapped = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(parsed, 'sysConfig');
        if (wrapped) {
            if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(parsed, 'version')) {
                const version = Number(parsed.version);
                if (!Number.isInteger(version) || version < 1 || version > C1_CONFIG_EXPORT_VERSION) c1_configValidationError('config.version', 'unsupported export version');
            }
            c1_validateSysConfigImport(parsed.sysConfig);
            if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(parsed, 'macroConfig')) c1_validateMacroConfigImport(parsed.macroConfig);
            if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(parsed, 'tradeGateRuntime') && !c1_isPlainConfigObject(parsed.tradeGateRuntime)) c1_configValidationError('config.tradeGateRuntime', 'must be an object');
        } else {
            // v1 exports were the SysConfig object itself.
            c1_validateSysConfigImport(parsed, 'config');
        }
        return c1_clonePlain(parsed);
    }

    function c1_captureConfigStorage() {
        const snapshot = new Map();
        [V20_STORAGE_KEY, P2_STORAGE_KEY, C1_TRADE_GATE_RUNTIME_KEY].forEach((key) => snapshot.set(key, localStorage.getItem(key)));
        return snapshot;
    }

    function c1_restoreConfigStorage(snapshot) {
        snapshot.forEach((value, key) => {
            if (value == null) localStorage.removeItem(key);
            else localStorage.setItem(key, value);
        });
    }

    function c1_applyConfigPayload(parsed, options = {}) {
        const safePayload = c1_validateConfigPayload(parsed);
        const nextSys = safePayload.sysConfig && c1_isPlainConfigObject(safePayload.sysConfig) ? safePayload.sysConfig : safePayload;
        const previousSysConfig = SysConfig;
        const previousMacroConfig = C2_CONFIG;
        const previousTempAvatar = c1_tempAvatar;
        const storageSnapshot = c1_captureConfigStorage();
        try {
            const migrated = c1_migrateConfig(nextSys) || nextSys;
            SysConfig = c1_clonePlain({ ...C1_DEFAULT_CONFIG, ...migrated });
            SysConfig.tools = { ...C1_DEFAULT_CONFIG.tools, ...(c1_isPlainConfigObject(SysConfig.tools) ? SysConfig.tools : {}) };
            c1_removeRetiredModuleConfig();
            c1_ensureDrawToolConfig();
            c1_ensureTradeGateConfig();
            c1_ensureRiskPrefs();
            c1_ensureSmartMagnetConfig();
            c1_ensureGlobalConfig();
            if (!c1_saveConfig()) throw new Error('main config storage write failed');

            if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(safePayload, 'macroConfig')) {
                C2_CONFIG = c2_normalizeConfig(safePayload.macroConfig);
                if (!c2_saveConfig()) throw new Error('macro config storage write failed');
            } else if (options.clearMissingSections) {
                localStorage.removeItem(P2_STORAGE_KEY);
            }

            if (safePayload.tradeGateRuntime && c1_isPlainConfigObject(safePayload.tradeGateRuntime)) {
                const runtime = {
                    currentRun: safePayload.tradeGateRuntime.currentRun || null,
                    history: Array.isArray(safePayload.tradeGateRuntime.history) ? safePayload.tradeGateRuntime.history.slice(0, C1_TRADE_GATE_MAX_HISTORY) : []
                };
                localStorage.setItem(C1_TRADE_GATE_RUNTIME_KEY, JSON.stringify(runtime));
            } else if (options.clearMissingSections) {
                localStorage.removeItem(C1_TRADE_GATE_RUNTIME_KEY);
            }
            c1_tempAvatar = SysConfig.avatar || defaultAvatar;
            c1_applyImmersiveHudTheme();
            return true;
        } catch (error) {
            SysConfig = previousSysConfig;
            C2_CONFIG = previousMacroConfig;
            c1_tempAvatar = previousTempAvatar;
            try { c1_restoreConfigStorage(storageSnapshot); }
            catch (rollbackError) { console.error('[TV-GCC] Config import rollback failed', rollbackError); }
            throw error;
        }
    }

    function c1_restoreBundledDefaults() {
        const payload = c1_getBundledDefaultPayload();
        if (!payload) throw new Error('Bundled default config missing');
        c1_applyConfigPayload(payload, { clearMissingSections: true });
    }


    function c1_loadConfig() {
        try {
            const raw = localStorage.getItem(V20_STORAGE_KEY);
            let saved = raw ? c1_migrateConfig(JSON.parse(raw)) : null;
            const merged = saved ? { ...C1_DEFAULT_CONFIG, ...saved } : C1_DEFAULT_CONFIG;
            SysConfig = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(merged));
            SysConfig.tools = { ...C1_DEFAULT_CONFIG.tools, ...(SysConfig.tools || {}) }; c1_removeRetiredModuleConfig();
            SysConfig.riskDisplayMode = 'floating';
            if (!SysConfig.riskFloatPosition) SysConfig.riskFloatPosition = 'left';
            c1_ensureDrawToolConfig();
            c1_ensureTradeGateConfig();
            c1_ensureRiskPrefs();
            c1_ensureSmartMagnetConfig();
            c1_ensureGlobalConfig();
            c1_tempAvatar = SysConfig.avatar || defaultAvatar;
        } catch(e) { C1_LOG.warn('config.load', e); SysConfig = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(C1_DEFAULT_CONFIG)); c1_removeRetiredModuleConfig(); c1_ensureDrawToolConfig(); c1_ensureRiskPrefs(); c1_ensureSmartMagnetConfig(); c1_ensureGlobalConfig(); c1_tempAvatar = defaultAvatar; }
        c1_applyImmersiveHudTheme();
    }
    c1_loadConfig();
    function t(key) { const table = I18N[SysConfig?.lang] || I18N.zh || {}; return table[key] || I18N.zh?.[key] || key; }
    function c1_lang(en, zh) { return SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? en : zh; }
    function c1_saveConfig() {
        c1_removeRetiredModuleConfig(); c1_ensureDrawToolConfig(); c1_ensureTradeGateConfig(); c1_ensureRiskPrefs(); c1_ensureSmartMagnetConfig(); c1_ensureGlobalConfig();
        SysConfig.__schemaVersion = C1_CONFIG_VERSION;
        try { localStorage.setItem(V20_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(SysConfig)); return true; }
        catch (err) { console.warn('[TV-GCC] c1_saveConfig storage write failed', err); return false; }
    }
    function c1_buildThemeSwatchesHTML(tagName = 'button') {
        return C1_THEME_OPTIONS.map(theme => `<${tagName} type="button" class="tv-theme-dot" data-theme="${theme.id}" data-tooltip="${theme.label}" aria-label="${theme.label}"></${tagName}>`).join('');
    }
    function c1_settingsTitleLabel(iconKey, label) {
        return `<span class="tv-settings-title-chip"><span class="tv-settings-title-icon">${resolveIcon(iconKey)}</span><span>${String(label || '')}</span></span>`;
    }

    function c1_buildAvatarPresetHTML() {
        const activePreset = String(SysConfig.avatarPreset || '').trim();
        return C1_BUILTIN_AVATAR_PRESETS.map((preset) => {
            const src = c1_getBuiltinAvatarDataUri(preset.id);
            const label = SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? preset.labelEn : preset.labelZh;
            const active = activePreset === preset.id ? ' is-active' : '';
            return `<button type="button" class="tv-avatar-preset${active}" data-avatar-preset="${preset.id}" data-tooltip="${c1_tradeGateEscape(label)}" aria-label="${c1_tradeGateEscape(label)}"><img src="${src}" alt=""></button>`;
        }).join('');
    }

    let c1_toggleMotionResizeBound = false;
    const c1_toggleMotionLast = new Map();
    function c1_updateToggleIndicator(group) {
        if (!group || !group.isConnected) return;
        let indicator = group.querySelector(':scope > .tv-toggle-indicator');
        if (!indicator) {
            indicator = document.createElement('span');
            indicator.className = 'tv-toggle-indicator';
            indicator.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
            group.prepend(indicator);
        }
        const active = Array.from(group.children).find(child => child !== indicator && child.classList?.contains('is-active'));
        if (!active) {
            group.classList.remove('is-ready');
            return;
        }
        if (group.offsetWidth <= 0 || group.offsetHeight <= 0 || active.offsetWidth <= 0 || active.offsetHeight <= 0) {
            group.classList.remove('is-ready');
            group.dataset.toggleMotionNeedsPrime = '1';
            return;
        }
        const needsVisiblePrime = group.dataset.toggleMotionNeedsPrime === '1';
        if (needsVisiblePrime) group.classList.add('is-priming');
        indicator.style.width = `${active.offsetWidth}px`;
        indicator.style.height = `${active.offsetHeight}px`;
        indicator.style.transform = `translate3d(${active.offsetLeft}px, ${active.offsetTop}px, 0)`;
        group.classList.add('is-ready');
        if (needsVisiblePrime) {
            delete group.dataset.toggleMotionNeedsPrime;
            requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                if (group.isConnected) group.classList.remove('is-priming');
            }));
        }
        const motionKey = group.dataset.toggleMotionKey;
        if (motionKey) {
            c1_toggleMotionLast.set(motionKey, {
                width: active.offsetWidth,
                height: active.offsetHeight,
                x: active.offsetLeft,
                y: active.offsetTop
            });
        }
    }
    function c1_mountToggleMotion(root = document) {
        const groups = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll?.('.tv-toggle-motion') || []);
        groups.forEach(group => {
            const firstMount = !group.dataset.toggleMotionBound;
            const motionKey = group.dataset.toggleMotionKey;
            const previous = motionKey ? c1_toggleMotionLast.get(motionKey) : null;
            const shouldPrime = firstMount && !previous;
            if (shouldPrime) group.classList.add('is-priming');
            if (!group.querySelector(':scope > .tv-toggle-indicator')) {
                const indicator = document.createElement('span');
                indicator.className = 'tv-toggle-indicator';
                indicator.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
                group.prepend(indicator);
            }
            if (firstMount) {
                group.dataset.toggleMotionBound = '1';
                group.addEventListener('click', () => requestAnimationFrame(() => c1_updateToggleIndicator(group)));
            }
            if (firstMount && previous) {
                const indicator = group.querySelector(':scope > .tv-toggle-indicator');
                if (indicator) {
                    indicator.style.width = `${previous.width}px`;
                    indicator.style.height = `${previous.height}px`;
                    indicator.style.transform = `translate3d(${previous.x}px, ${previous.y}px, 0)`;
                    group.classList.add('is-ready');
                }
                requestAnimationFrame(() => c1_updateToggleIndicator(group));
            } else {
                c1_updateToggleIndicator(group);
            }
            if (shouldPrime) {
                requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    if (group.isConnected) group.classList.remove('is-priming');
                }));
            }
        });
        if (!c1_toggleMotionResizeBound) {
            c1_toggleMotionResizeBound = true;
            window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                document.querySelectorAll('.tv-toggle-motion').forEach(group => c1_updateToggleIndicator(group));
            });
        }
    }
    function c1_refreshToggleMotionNow(root = document) {
        Array.from(root.querySelectorAll?.('.tv-toggle-motion') || []).forEach(group => c1_updateToggleIndicator(group));
    }
    function c1_rememberToggleMotionFromElement(element) {
        const group = element?.closest?.('.tv-toggle-motion');
        if (!group?.dataset?.toggleMotionKey) return;
        const indicator = group.querySelector(':scope > .tv-toggle-indicator');
        if (!indicator) return;
        const rect = indicator.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (!rect.width || !rect.height) return;
        const groupRect = group.getBoundingClientRect();
        c1_toggleMotionLast.set(group.dataset.toggleMotionKey, {
            width: rect.width,
            height: rect.height,
            x: rect.left - groupRect.left,
            y: rect.top - groupRect.top
        });
    }
    const C1_SPARK_CLICK_DEFAULTS = {
        sparkColor: '#ff7043',
        sparkCount: 12,
        sparkRadius: 25,
        sparkSize: 10,
        duration: 500,
        easing: 'ease-out',
        extraScale: 1,
        bleed: 40,
        lineWidth: 2,
        triggerOnClick: true
    };
    const c1_sparkClickEffects = new WeakMap();
    function c1_resolveSparkClickTargets(targets) {
        if (!targets) return [];
        if (typeof targets === 'string') return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(targets));
        if (targets instanceof Element) return [targets];
        try { return Array.from(targets).filter(target => target instanceof Element); } catch (e) { return []; }
    }
    function c1_sparkEase(progress, easing) {
        if (easing === 'linear') return progress;
        if (easing === 'ease-in') return progress * progress;
        if (easing === 'ease-in-out') return progress < 0.5 ? 2 * progress * progress : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * progress + 2, 2) / 2;
        return progress * (2 - progress);
    }
    function c1_attachSparkClickEffect(targets, options = {}) {
        const elements = c1_resolveSparkClickTargets(targets);
        const controllers = elements.map(target => {
            const previous = c1_sparkClickEffects.get(target);
            if (previous) previous.destroy();
            const config = { ...C1_SPARK_CLICK_DEFAULTS, ...options };
            const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            const originalPosition = target.style.position;
            const computedPosition = getComputedStyle(target).position;
            const sparks = [];
            let rafId = 0;
            let dpr = 1;

            if (computedPosition === 'static') target.style.position = 'relative';
            canvas.className = 'tv-spark-click-canvas';
            canvas.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
            Object.assign(canvas.style, {
                position: 'absolute',
                left: `-${config.bleed}px`,
                top: `-${config.bleed}px`,
                width: '0px',
                height: '0px',
                pointerEvents: 'none',
                zIndex: '9999',
                overflow: 'visible'
            });
            target.appendChild(canvas);

            const resize = () => {
                if (!target.isConnected) return;
                const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
                dpr = Math.max(1, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
                const width = Math.max(1, rect.width + config.bleed * 2);
                const height = Math.max(1, rect.height + config.bleed * 2);
                canvas.style.width = `${width}px`;
                canvas.style.height = `${height}px`;
                canvas.width = Math.round(width * dpr);
                canvas.height = Math.round(height * dpr);
                ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
            };
            const draw = (now) => {
                const width = canvas.width / dpr;
                const height = canvas.height / dpr;
                ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
                for (let index = sparks.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
                    const spark = sparks[index];
                    const progress = Math.min((now - spark.startTime) / config.duration, 1);
                    const eased = c1_sparkEase(progress, config.easing);
                    const distance = eased * config.sparkRadius * config.extraScale;
                    const segmentLength = config.sparkSize * (1 - eased);
                    const startX = spark.x + distance * Math.cos(spark.angle);
                    const startY = spark.y + distance * Math.sin(spark.angle);
                    const endX = spark.x + (distance + segmentLength) * Math.cos(spark.angle);
                    const endY = spark.y + (distance + segmentLength) * Math.sin(spark.angle);
                    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - progress);
                    ctx.strokeStyle = config.sparkColor;
                    ctx.lineWidth = config.lineWidth;
                    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(startX, startY);
                    ctx.lineTo(endX, endY);
                    ctx.stroke();
                    if (progress >= 1) sparks.splice(index, 1);
                }
                ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
                if (sparks.length) rafId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
                else rafId = 0;
            };
            const trigger = (clientX, clientY) => {
                if (!target.isConnected) return;
                resize();
                const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
                const targetRect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
                const x = Number.isFinite(clientX) ? clientX - rect.left : targetRect.left + targetRect.width / 2 - rect.left;
                const y = Number.isFinite(clientY) ? clientY - rect.top : targetRect.top + targetRect.height / 2 - rect.top;
                const startTime = performance.now();
                for (let index = 0; index < config.sparkCount; index += 1) {
                    sparks.push({ x, y, angle: (Math.PI * 2 * index) / config.sparkCount, startTime });
                }
                if (!rafId) rafId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
            };
            const handleClick = (event) => {
                if (event.button && event.button !== 0) return;
                trigger(event.clientX, event.clientY);
            };
            const resizeObserver = typeof ResizeObserver === 'function' ? new ResizeObserver(resize) : null;
            resize();
            if (resizeObserver) resizeObserver.observe(target);
            else window.addEventListener('resize', resize, { passive: true });
            if (config.triggerOnClick !== false) target.addEventListener('click', handleClick);

            const controller = {
                trigger,
                triggerCenter: () => trigger(NaN, NaN),
                destroy() {
                    if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
                    if (config.triggerOnClick !== false) target.removeEventListener('click', handleClick);
                    if (resizeObserver) resizeObserver.disconnect();
                    else window.removeEventListener('resize', resize);
                    canvas.remove();
                    if (computedPosition === 'static') target.style.position = originalPosition;
                    c1_sparkClickEffects.delete(target);
                }
            };
            c1_sparkClickEffects.set(target, controller);
            return controller;
        });
        return {
            triggerAll() { controllers.forEach(controller => controller.triggerCenter()); },
            destroy() { controllers.forEach(controller => controller.destroy()); }
        };
    }
    function c1_triggerSparkClickEffect(target, clientX, clientY) {
        const controller = target ? c1_sparkClickEffects.get(target) : null;
        if (controller) controller.trigger(clientX, clientY);
    }

    function c1_refreshSmartMagnetSettingsState(panel = document) {
        const smartMagnet = c1_ensureSmartMagnetConfig();
        const enabled = smartMagnet.enabled !== false;
        const copyEl = panel.querySelector('#tv-smart-magnet-copy');
        const rulesWrap = panel.querySelector('#tv-smart-magnet-rules');
        if (copyEl) copyEl.style.opacity = enabled ? '1' : '0.68';
        if (rulesWrap) rulesWrap.style.opacity = enabled ? '1' : '0.58';
        panel.querySelectorAll('.tv-smart-magnet-rule').forEach((select) => {
            select.disabled = !enabled;
        });
    }

    function c1_bindSmartMagnetControls(panel) {
        const smartMagnet = c1_ensureSmartMagnetConfig();
        const toggle = panel.querySelector('#tv-smart-magnet-toggle');
        if (toggle) {
            toggle.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                smartMagnet.enabled = e.target.checked;
                c1_refreshSmartMagnetSettingsState(panel);
            });
        }
        panel.querySelectorAll('.tv-smart-magnet-rule').forEach((select) => {
            select.addEventListener('change', () => {
                smartMagnet.toolRules[select.dataset.toolId] = ['on', 'off', 'ignore'].includes(select.value) ? select.value : 'ignore';
            });
        });
        c1_refreshSmartMagnetSettingsState(panel);
    }

    function c1_getActiveToolBindingEntries() {
        const entries = [];
        Object.entries(TOOL_DICT).forEach(([cat, dict]) => {
            Object.entries(dict || {}).forEach(([id, conf]) => {
                if (cat === 'draw' && !c1_isDrawToolEnabled(id)) return;
                entries.push({ cat, id, conf });
            });
        });
        return entries;
    }

    function c1_playWelcomeSound() { try { const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext; if (!AudioContext) return; const ctx = new AudioContext(); const playTone = (freq, type, time, dur) => { const osc = ctx.createOscillator(); const gain = ctx.createGain(); osc.type = type; osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime + time); gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0, ctx.currentTime + time); gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.15, ctx.currentTime + time + 0.05); gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + time + dur); osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(ctx.destination); osc.start(ctx.currentTime + time); osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + time + dur); }; playTone(659.25, 'sine', 0, 0.25); playTone(880.00, 'sine', 0.15, 0.5); } catch(e) {} }
    function c1_playImmersiveTipSound() { try { const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext; if (!AudioContext) return; const ctx = new AudioContext(); const variants = [ [{ f: 760, to: 1120, t: 0, d: 0.16, type: 'sine', v: 0.075 }], [{ f: 660, t: 0, d: 0.10, type: 'triangle', v: 0.065 }, { f: 990, t: 0.075, d: 0.13, type: 'sine', v: 0.058 }], [{ f: 1180, to: 780, t: 0, d: 0.18, type: 'sine', v: 0.06 }, { f: 520, t: 0.04, d: 0.12, type: 'triangle', v: 0.035 }], [{ f: 587.33, t: 0, d: 0.09, type: 'sine', v: 0.052 }, { f: 739.99, t: 0.055, d: 0.09, type: 'sine', v: 0.052 }, { f: 987.77, t: 0.11, d: 0.12, type: 'sine', v: 0.046 }], [{ f: 880, t: 0, d: 0.08, type: 'square', v: 0.032 }, { f: 1320, t: 0.045, d: 0.08, type: 'triangle', v: 0.046 }] ]; const notes = variants[Math.floor(Math.random() * variants.length)]; let endAt = 0; notes.forEach(note => { const osc = ctx.createOscillator(); const gain = ctx.createGain(); osc.type = note.type || 'sine'; osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(note.f, ctx.currentTime + note.t); if (note.to) osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(note.to, ctx.currentTime + note.t + Math.max(0.03, note.d * 0.62)); gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, ctx.currentTime + note.t); gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(note.v || 0.055, ctx.currentTime + note.t + 0.012); gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, ctx.currentTime + note.t + note.d); osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(ctx.destination); osc.start(ctx.currentTime + note.t); osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + note.t + note.d + 0.02); endAt = Math.max(endAt, note.t + note.d); }); setTimeout(() => ctx.close?.(), Math.ceil((endAt + 0.12) * 1000)); } catch(e) {} }
    function c1_getGreeting() { const hour = new Date().getHours(); if (hour < 5) return t('gNight'); if (hour < 9) return t('gMorning'); if (hour < 12) return t('gForenoon'); if (hour < 14) return t('gNoon'); if (hour < 19) return t('gAfternoon'); return t('gEvening'); }

    function c1_normalizeDomText(value) {
        return String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    }

    function c1_readFirstValid(candidates = []) {
        for (const value of candidates) {
            const next = c1_normalizeDomText(value);
            if (next) return next;
        }
        return '';
    }

    function c1_splitSelectorList(selectors) {
        if (Array.isArray(selectors)) return selectors;
        return String(selectors || '').split(',').map(item => item.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    }

    function c1_queryFirstVisible(selectors, root = document, visibleOnly = true, label = '') {
        if (root === document) {
            const cached = c1_cachedQuery(selectors, 1500);
            if (cached && (!visibleOnly || c1_isVisibleNode(cached))) return cached;
            if (!visibleOnly && cached === null) return null;
        }
        for (const selector of c1_splitSelectorList(selectors)) {
            try {
                const el = root.querySelector(selector);
                if (!el) continue;
                if (!visibleOnly || c1_isVisibleNode(el)) return el;
            } catch (e) { C1_LOG.warn('selector.query', label || selector, e); }
        }
        if (label) c1_findOrWarn._missing?.add?.(label);
        return null;
    }

    function c1_readElementLabel(el) {
        return c1_readFirstValid([
            el?.getAttribute?.('aria-label'),
            el?.getAttribute?.('aria-description'),
            el?.getAttribute?.('title'),
            el?.getAttribute?.('data-tooltip'),
            el?.getAttribute?.('data-tooltip-text'),
            el?.getAttribute?.('data-name'),
            el?.innerText,
            el?.textContent
        ]);
    }

    function c1_isTradingPanelCollapsed() {
        const toggle = c1_queryFirstVisible(C1_TV_RUNTIME_SELECTORS.bottomPanelVisibilityButton, document, false);
        const label = c1_readElementLabel(toggle).toLowerCase();
        if (/打开面板|open panel/.test(label)) return true;
        if (/隐藏面板|hide panel|close panel/.test(label)) return false;
        if (document.querySelector('[class*="is-collapsed-"]')) return true;
        return null;
    }

    function c1_safeChartCall(getter) {
        try { return getter(); } catch (e) { return null; }
    }

    function c1_getChartApi() {
        try {
            const widgetApi = c1_getWidgetApi();
            if (widgetApi?.activeChart) return widgetApi.activeChart();
        } catch (e) {}
        return null;
    }

    let c1_widgetApiCache = null;

    function c1_collectWidgetApiCandidates() {
        const candidates = [
            unsafeWindow?.tvWidget,
            unsafeWindow?.widget,
            unsafeWindow?.TradingViewApi
        ];
        try {
            Object.keys(unsafeWindow || {}).forEach(key => {
                if (!/tv|tradingview|widget|chart/i.test(key)) return;
                const value = unsafeWindow[key];
                if (value && typeof value === 'object') candidates.push(value);
            });
        } catch (e) {}
        return Array.from(new Set(candidates.filter(Boolean)));
    }

    function c1_getWidgetApi() {
        if (c1_widgetApiCache && typeof c1_widgetApiCache.activeChart === 'function') return c1_widgetApiCache;
        for (const candidate of c1_collectWidgetApiCandidates()) {
            if (candidate && typeof candidate.activeChart === 'function') {
                c1_widgetApiCache = candidate;
                return candidate;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    function c1_callWidgetMethod(methodName, ...args) {
        const widgetApi = c1_getWidgetApi();
        if (!widgetApi || typeof widgetApi[methodName] !== 'function') return false;
        try {
            const result = widgetApi[methodName](...args);
            if (result && typeof result.catch === 'function') {
                result.catch((e) => console.warn(`[TV Control] widget.${methodName} async failed:`, e));
            }
            return true;
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn(`[TV Control] widget.${methodName} failed:`, e);
            return false;
        }
    }

    function c1_setWidgetFullscreenMode(active) {
        return c1_callWidgetMethod(active ? 'startFullscreen' : 'exitFullscreen');
    }

    function c1_setChartAutoScaleEnabled(enabled) {
        const chart = c1_getChartApi();
        const methods = [
            'setAutoScale',
            'setAutoscale',
            'setPriceScaleAutoScale',
            'setPriceScaleAutoscale',
            'setRightPriceScaleAutoScale',
            'setRightPriceScaleAutoscale'
        ];
        for (const method of methods) {
            if (!chart || typeof chart[method] !== 'function') continue;
            try {
                chart[method](!!enabled);
                return true;
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        const priceScaleCandidates = [
            c1_safeChartCall(() => chart?.priceScale?.('right')),
            c1_safeChartCall(() => chart?.getPanes?.()?.[0]?.getMainSourcePriceScale?.()),
            c1_safeChartCall(() => chart?.getMainSourcePriceScale?.())
        ].filter(Boolean);
        for (const priceScale of priceScaleCandidates) {
            for (const method of methods) {
                if (typeof priceScale[method] !== 'function') continue;
                try {
                    priceScale[method](!!enabled);
                    return true;
                } catch (e) {}
            }
        }

        const widgetMethods = [
            'setAutoScale',
            'setAutoscale',
            'setPriceScaleAutoScale',
            'setPriceScaleAutoscale'
        ];
        const widgetApi = c1_getWidgetApi();
        for (const method of widgetMethods) {
            if (!widgetApi || typeof widgetApi[method] !== 'function') continue;
            try {
                widgetApi[method](!!enabled);
                return true;
            } catch (e) {}
        }
        return false;
    }

    function c1_schedulePostResetAutoScalePreference() {
        if (SysConfig.keepAutoScaleAfterReset === true) return;
        [120, 360, 900].forEach(delay => {
            setTimeout(() => { c1_setChartAutoScaleEnabled(false); }, delay);
        });
    }

    function c1_scheduleAltRResetScalePreference() {
        c1_schedulePostResetAutoScalePreference();
    }

    function c1_isChartReadyForImmersive() {
        const canvas = c1_queryFirstVisible(C1_TV_RUNTIME_SELECTORS.chartCanvas, document, true);
        const symbolButton = c1_queryFirstVisible(C1_TV_RUNTIME_SELECTORS.symbolButton, document, true);
        const fullButton = c1_getImmersiveModeButton();
        const chartApi = c1_getChartApi();
        if (!canvas || !symbolButton || !fullButton || !chartApi) return false;
        const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (rect.width < 320 || rect.height < 240) return false;
        return document.visibilityState === 'visible';
    }

    function c1_closeNativePopupsAndDialogs() {
        return c1_callWidgetMethod('closePopupsAndDialogs');
    }

    function c1_sanitizeSymbol(value) {
        return String(value || '').trim().replace(/%3A/ig, ':').toUpperCase();
    }

    function c1_extractSymbolFromLocation() {
        try {
            const url = new URL(location.href);
            const fromQuery = c1_sanitizeSymbol(url.searchParams.get('symbol'));
            if (fromQuery) return fromQuery;
            const parts = url.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean);
            const symbolIdx = parts.indexOf('symbols');
            if (symbolIdx !== -1 && parts[symbolIdx + 1]) return c1_sanitizeSymbol(decodeURIComponent(parts[symbolIdx + 1]).replace('-', ':'));
        } catch (e) {}
        return '';
    }

    function c1_extractTitleSnapshot() {
        const title = String(document.title || '');
        const symbolMatch = title.match(/^([^\s]+)\s+([+\-−]?\d[\d,.]*)/i);
        return {
            symbol: c1_sanitizeSymbol(symbolMatch?.[1] || ''),
            priceText: symbolMatch ? symbolMatch[2].replace(/−/g, '-').replace(/,/g, '') : ''
        };
    }

    function c1_normalizeIntervalCode(value) {
        const rawText = c1_normalizeDomText(value).replace(/\s+/g, '');
        if (!rawText) return '';
        // TradingView resolutions are case-sensitive: lowercase `m` is minute,
        // while uppercase `M` is month. Preserve calendar multipliers before
        // applying any case-insensitive natural-language aliases.
        const calendarCode = rawText.match(/^(\d+)?([DWM])$/);
        if (calendarCode) {
            const count = Math.max(1, Number(calendarCode[1] || 1));
            return count === 1 ? calendarCode[2] : `${count}${calendarCode[2]}`;
        }
        if (/^\d+$/.test(rawText)) return rawText;
        const text = rawText.toLowerCase();
        const directMap = {
            '1分钟': '1', '1分': '1', '1min': '1', '1minute': '1', '1m': '1',
            '5分钟': '5', '5分': '5', '5min': '5', '5minutes': '5', '5m': '5',
            '15分钟': '15', '15分': '15', '15min': '15', '15minutes': '15', '15m': '15',
            '1小时': '60', '1h': '60', '1hour': '60', '60分钟': '60', '60分': '60',
            '4小时': '240', '4h': '240', '4hours': '240', '240分钟': '240', '240分': '240',
            '1日': 'D', '1天': 'D', '天': 'D', '1d': 'D', '1day': 'D', 'd': 'D',
            '1周': 'W', '周': 'W', '1w': 'W', '1week': 'W', 'w': 'W',
            '1月': 'M', '1个月': 'M', '一个月': 'M', '月': 'M', '1mo': 'M', '1month': 'M'
        };
        if (directMap[text]) return directMap[text];
        const minuteMatch = text.match(/^(\d+)(分钟|分|minutes?|mins?|min|m)$/);
        if (minuteMatch) return minuteMatch[1];
        const hourMatch = text.match(/^(\d+)(小时|hours?|h)$/);
        if (hourMatch) return String(Number(hourMatch[1]) * 60);
        const dayMatch = text.match(/^(\d+)(日|天|days?|d)$/);
        if (dayMatch) return Number(dayMatch[1]) === 1 ? 'D' : `${Number(dayMatch[1])}D`;
        const weekMatch = text.match(/^(\d+)(周|weeks?|w)$/);
        if (weekMatch) return Number(weekMatch[1]) === 1 ? 'W' : `${Number(weekMatch[1])}W`;
        const monthMatch = text.match(/^(\d+)(月|个月|months?|mo)$/);
        if (monthMatch) return Number(monthMatch[1]) === 1 ? 'M' : `${Number(monthMatch[1])}M`;
        return String(value || '').trim();
    }

    function c1_formatIntervalLabel(value) {
        const normalized = c1_normalizeIntervalCode(value);
        const zhMap = {
            '1': '1分',
            '5': '5分',
            '15': '15分',
            '60': '1小时',
            '240': '4小时',
            '360': '6小时',
            D: '1日',
            W: '1周',
            M: '1个月'
        };
        const enMap = {
            '1': '1m',
            '5': '5m',
            '15': '15m',
            '60': '1H',
            '240': '4H',
            '360': '6H',
            D: '1D',
            W: '1W',
            M: '1M'
        };
        const map = SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? enMap : zhMap;
        return map[normalized] || String(value || '');
    }

    function c1_extractDomChartSnapshot() {
        const symbolButton = c1_queryFirstVisible(C1_TV_RUNTIME_SELECTORS.symbolButton, document, false);
        const activeIntervalButton = c1_queryFirstVisible(C1_TV_RUNTIME_SELECTORS.activeIntervalButton, document, false);
        const chartCanvas = c1_queryFirstVisible(C1_TV_RUNTIME_SELECTORS.chartCanvas, document, false);
        const canvasLabel = c1_normalizeDomText(chartCanvas?.getAttribute('aria-label') || '');
        const canvasMatch = canvasLabel.match(/^([^，,]+)[，,]\s*([^，,]+?)(?:的图表|\s+chart\b|$)/i);
        const symbol = c1_readFirstValid([
            symbolButton?.innerText,
            symbolButton?.textContent,
            canvasMatch?.[1]
        ]);
        const intervalText = c1_readFirstValid([
            activeIntervalButton?.getAttribute('aria-label'),
            activeIntervalButton?.innerText,
            canvasMatch?.[2]
        ]);
        return {
            symbol: c1_sanitizeSymbol(symbol),
            interval: c1_normalizeIntervalCode(intervalText)
        };
    }

    function c1_resolveSymbolTickSize(symbolInfo) {
        if (!symbolInfo || typeof symbolInfo !== 'object') return null;
        const directTick = [
            symbolInfo.min_tick,
            symbolInfo.minTick,
            symbolInfo.tick_size,
            symbolInfo.tickSize
        ].map(Number).find(value => Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0);
        if (Number.isFinite(directTick)) return directTick;
        const priceScale = Number(symbolInfo.pricescale ?? symbolInfo.priceScale);
        const minMove = Number(symbolInfo.minmov ?? symbolInfo.minMove);
        if (!Number.isFinite(priceScale) || priceScale <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(minMove) || minMove <= 0) return null;
        const tickSize = minMove / priceScale;
        return Number.isFinite(tickSize) && tickSize > 0 ? tickSize : null;
    }

    function c1_resolveChartSnapshot() {
        const chart = c1_getChartApi();
        const titleState = c1_extractTitleSnapshot();
        const domState = c1_extractDomChartSnapshot();
        const apiSymbolInfo = c1_safeChartCall(() => chart?.symbolExt?.()) || c1_safeChartCall(() => chart?.resolvedSymbol?.()) || null;
        const apiSymbol = c1_readFirstValid([
            apiSymbolInfo?.full_name,
            apiSymbolInfo?.pro_name,
            apiSymbolInfo?.name,
            c1_safeChartCall(() => chart?.symbol?.())
        ]);
        const priceText = c1_readFirstValid([
            c1_safeChartCall(() => chart?.lastPrice?.()),
            titleState.priceText
        ]);
        const priceValue = (() => {
            const parsed = parseFloat(String(priceText || '').replace(/,/g, ''));
            return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
        })();
        const interval = c1_readFirstValid([
            c1_safeChartCall(() => chart?.resolution?.()),
            c1_safeChartCall(() => chart?.interval?.()),
            domState.interval
        ]);

        return {
            symbol: c1_sanitizeSymbol(apiSymbol || domState.symbol || c1_extractSymbolFromLocation() || titleState.symbol),
            priceText: String(priceText || ''),
            priceValue,
            tickSize: c1_resolveSymbolTickSize(apiSymbolInfo),
            interval,
            updatedAt: Date.now()
        };
    }

    const C1_TRADE_DIALOG_LABELS = {
        entry: ['进场价格', 'entry price'],
        tp: ['止盈水平', 'profit level', 'take profit'],
        sl: ['止损水平', 'stop level'],
        stopBoundary: ['账户规模', 'account size', '风险', 'risk', 'qty精度', 'qty precision', '模板', 'template']
    };

    function c1_getDialogScanState(root) {
        if (!root) return { inputNodes: [], sequenceNodes: [], textNodes: [] };
        const inputCount = root.querySelectorAll('input').length;
        const stamp = `${root.childElementCount}|${inputCount}`;
        const cached = c1_dialogScanCache.get(root);
        if (cached && cached.stamp === stamp) return cached;
        const sequenceNodes = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('label, span, div, p, td, th, button, input'));
        const inputNodes = sequenceNodes.filter(node => node.tagName === 'INPUT');
        const textNodes = sequenceNodes.filter(node => node.tagName !== 'INPUT');
        const next = { stamp, inputNodes, sequenceNodes, textNodes };
        c1_dialogScanCache.set(root, next);
        return next;
    }

    function c1_isVisibleField(el) {
        if (!el || !(el instanceof HTMLElement)) return false;
        if (el.tagName !== 'INPUT') return false;
        if (el.type === 'hidden' || el.disabled) return false;
        const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        const style = getComputedStyle(el);
        return rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0 && style.visibility !== 'hidden' && style.display !== 'none';
    }

    function c1_collectInputsFromContainer(container, seen, values) {
        if (!container) return false;
        const inputs = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('input')).filter(input => {
            if (seen.has(input)) return false;
            if (!c1_isVisibleField(input)) return false;
            const value = c1_normalizeDomText(input.value);
            return value !== '';
        });
        if (!inputs.length) return false;
        inputs.forEach(input => {
            seen.add(input);
            values.push(c1_normalizeDomText(input.value));
        });
        return true;
    }

    function c1_findLabelNodes(root, aliases) {
        const aliasSet = new Set(aliases.map(item => c1_normalizeDomText(item).toLowerCase()));
        return c1_getDialogScanState(root).textNodes.filter(node => aliasSet.has(c1_normalizeDomText(node.textContent).toLowerCase()));
    }

    function c1_collectInputValuesByVisualRow(root, aliases, maxCount = 2) {
        const labelNodes = c1_findLabelNodes(root, aliases);
        const inputs = c1_getDialogScanState(root).inputNodes.filter(c1_isVisibleField);
        for (const labelNode of labelNodes) {
            const labelRect = labelNode.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (!labelRect.width && !labelRect.height) continue;
            const labelCenterY = labelRect.top + labelRect.height / 2;
            const candidates = inputs.map(input => {
                const rect = input.getBoundingClientRect();
                const centerY = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
                const deltaY = Math.abs(centerY - labelCenterY);
                const rightSide = rect.left >= (labelRect.right - 12);
                return { input, rect, deltaY, rightSide };
            }).filter(item => item.deltaY <= Math.max(20, labelRect.height * 1.5))
              .sort((a, b) => {
                  if (a.rightSide !== b.rightSide) return a.rightSide ? -1 : 1;
                  if (a.deltaY !== b.deltaY) return a.deltaY - b.deltaY;
                  return a.rect.left - b.rect.left;
              });
            if (!candidates.length) continue;
            const values = [];
            candidates.slice(0, maxCount).forEach(({ input }) => {
                const value = c1_normalizeDomText(input.value);
                if (value) values.push(value);
            });
            if (values.length) return values;
        }
        return [];
    }

    function c1_collectInputValuesSequential(root, aliases, stopAliases = [], maxCount = 3) {
        const aliasSet = new Set(aliases.map(item => c1_normalizeDomText(item).toLowerCase()));
        const stopSet = new Set(stopAliases.map(item => c1_normalizeDomText(item).toLowerCase()));
        const nodes = c1_getDialogScanState(root).sequenceNodes;
        for (let index = 0; index < nodes.length; index++) {
            const node = nodes[index];
            const text = c1_normalizeDomText(node.textContent).toLowerCase();
            if (!aliasSet.has(text)) continue;
            const values = [];
            for (let cursor = index + 1; cursor < nodes.length; cursor++) {
                const current = nodes[cursor];
                const currentText = c1_normalizeDomText(current.textContent).toLowerCase();
                if (stopSet.has(currentText)) break;
                if (current.tagName === 'INPUT' && c1_isVisibleField(current)) {
                    const value = c1_normalizeDomText(current.value);
                    if (value) values.push(value);
                    if (values.length >= maxCount) break;
                }
            }
            if (values.length) return values;
        }
        return [];
    }

    function c1_collectInputValuesNearLabel(root, aliases, stopAliases = []) {
        const visualValues = c1_collectInputValuesByVisualRow(root, aliases, 2);
        if (visualValues.length) return visualValues;

        const sequentialValues = c1_collectInputValuesSequential(root, aliases, stopAliases, 3);
        if (sequentialValues.length) return sequentialValues;

        const aliasSet = new Set(aliases.map(item => c1_normalizeDomText(item).toLowerCase()));
        const stopSet = new Set(stopAliases.map(item => c1_normalizeDomText(item).toLowerCase()));
        const values = [];
        const seen = new Set();
        const allNodes = c1_getDialogScanState(root).sequenceNodes;
        const labelNodes = allNodes.filter(node => aliasSet.has(c1_normalizeDomText(node.textContent).toLowerCase()));

        labelNodes.forEach(labelNode => {
            const candidateBlocks = [
                labelNode.closest('label'),
                labelNode.parentElement,
                labelNode.parentElement?.parentElement,
                labelNode.parentElement?.parentElement?.parentElement
            ].filter(Boolean);

            for (const block of candidateBlocks) {
                if (c1_collectInputsFromContainer(block, seen, values)) return;
            }

            let sibling = labelNode.nextElementSibling;
            let hop = 0;
            while (sibling && hop < 4) {
                const siblingText = c1_normalizeDomText(sibling.textContent).toLowerCase();
                if (stopSet.has(siblingText)) break;
                if (c1_collectInputsFromContainer(sibling, seen, values)) break;
                sibling = sibling.nextElementSibling;
                hop++;
            }
        });

        return values.filter(Boolean);
    }

    function c1_scoreTradeDialog(dialog) {
        const text = c1_normalizeDomText(dialog?.innerText).toLowerCase();
        let score = 0;
        if (!text) return score;
        if (text.includes('进场价格') || text.includes('entry price')) score += 4;
        if (text.includes('止损水平') || text.includes('stop level')) score += 3;
        if (text.includes('止盈水平') || text.includes('profit level') || text.includes('take profit')) score += 2;
        if (text.includes('多头') || text.includes('空头') || text.includes('long') || text.includes('short')) score += 1;
        return score;
    }

    function c1_findTradeDialogRoot() {
        if (document.visibilityState !== 'visible') return null;
        if (c1_lastTradeDialogRoot && c1_lastTradeDialogRoot.isConnected) {
            const cachedScore = c1_scoreTradeDialog(c1_lastTradeDialogRoot);
            if (cachedScore >= 4) return c1_lastTradeDialogRoot;
        }
        const candidates = Array.from(new Set(C1_TV_RUNTIME_SELECTORS.dialogRoots.flatMap((selector) => {
            try { return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(selector)); } catch (e) { return []; }
        })));
        const scoreDialog = (dialog) => {
            const text = c1_normalizeDomText(dialog.innerText).toLowerCase();
            let score = 0;
            if (!text) return score;
            if (text.includes('进场价格') || text.includes('entry price')) score += 4;
            if (text.includes('止损水平') || text.includes('stop level')) score += 3;
            if (text.includes('止盈水平') || text.includes('profit level') || text.includes('take profit')) score += 2;
            if (text.includes('多头') || text.includes('空头') || text.includes('long') || text.includes('short')) score += 1;
            return score;
        };
        let bestDialog = null;
        let bestScore = 0;
        candidates.forEach(dialog => {
            const score = scoreDialog(dialog);
            if (score > bestScore) {
                bestScore = score;
                bestDialog = dialog;
            }
        });
        c1_lastTradeDialogRoot = bestScore >= 4 ? bestDialog : null;
        return c1_lastTradeDialogRoot;
    }

    function c1_parseTradeDialog(dialog = null) {
        const root = dialog || c1_findTradeDialogRoot();
        if (!root) return null;

        const chartState = c1_resolveChartSnapshot();
        const dialogText = c1_normalizeDomText(root.innerText);
        const entryValues = c1_collectInputValuesByVisualRow(root, C1_TRADE_DIALOG_LABELS.entry, 1);
        const tpValues = c1_collectInputValuesSequential(root, C1_TRADE_DIALOG_LABELS.tp, C1_TRADE_DIALOG_LABELS.sl, 3);
        const slValues = c1_collectInputValuesSequential(root, C1_TRADE_DIALOG_LABELS.sl, C1_TRADE_DIALOG_LABELS.stopBoundary, 3);

        const entry = entryValues[0] || '';
        const tp = tpValues.length > 1 ? tpValues[1] : (tpValues[0] || '');
        const sl = slValues.length > 1 ? slValues[1] : (slValues[0] || '');
        const tpTicks = tpValues[0] || '';
        const slTicks = slValues[0] || '';
        let rr = '';
        if (tpValues.length >= 2 && slValues.length >= 2) {
            const tpTicksVal = parseFloat(tpTicks);
            const slTicksVal = parseFloat(slTicks);
            if (Number.isFinite(tpTicksVal) && Number.isFinite(slTicksVal) && slTicksVal > 0) rr = (tpTicksVal / slTicksVal).toFixed(2);
        } else {
            const entryVal = parseFloat(entry);
            const tpVal = parseFloat(tp);
            const slVal = parseFloat(sl);
            if (Number.isFinite(entryVal) && Number.isFinite(tpVal) && Number.isFinite(slVal) && Math.abs(entryVal - slVal) > 0) rr = (Math.abs(tpVal - entryVal) / Math.abs(entryVal - slVal)).toFixed(2);
        }

        if (!entry) return null;

        let direction = t('uiDirUnk');
        if (/多头|\blong\b/i.test(dialogText)) direction = t('uiDirLong');
        else if (/空头|\bshort\b/i.test(dialogText)) direction = t('uiDirShort');

        return {
            symbol: chartState.symbol || (SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Unknown Symbol' : '未知品种'),
            interval: chartState.interval || '',
            priceText: chartState.priceText || '',
            direction,
            entry,
            tpTicks: tpTicks || '',
            slTicks: slTicks || '',
            tp: tp || (SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Not Found' : '未找到'),
            sl: sl || (SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Not Found' : '未找到'),
            rr: rr || (SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Not Found' : '未找到'),
            timestamp: Date.now()
        };
    }

    function c1_getEntityId(raw) {
        if (raw == null) return '';
        if (typeof raw === 'string' || typeof raw === 'number') return String(raw);
        if (raw.id != null) return String(raw.id);
        if (raw.entityId != null) return String(raw.entityId);
        if (raw.sourceId != null) return String(raw.sourceId);
        return '';
    }

    function c1_getTrustedPositionShapeDirection(...values) {
        for (const value of values) {
            if (typeof value !== 'string') continue;
            const compact = value.trim().toLowerCase().split('@')[0].replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
            if (compact === 'longposition' || compact === 'linetoollongposition') return 'long';
            if (compact === 'shortposition' || compact === 'linetoolshortposition') return 'short';
        }
        return '';
    }

    function c1_readMapLikeEntries(value) {
        if (!value) return [];
        if (value instanceof Map) return Array.from(value.entries());
        if (Array.isArray(value)) {
            return value.map(item => Array.isArray(item) && item.length >= 2 ? item : [c1_getEntityId(item), item]);
        }
        if (typeof value === 'object') return Object.entries(value);
        return [];
    }

    function c1_collectNumericLeaves(value, path = '', out = [], seen = new WeakSet()) {
        if (value == null) return out;
        if (typeof value === 'number') {
            if (Number.isFinite(value)) out.push({ path, value });
            return out;
        }
        if (typeof value === 'string') {
            const normalized = value.replace(/,/g, '');
            if (/^[+\-]?\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(normalized)) out.push({ path, value: parseFloat(normalized) });
            return out;
        }
        if (typeof value !== 'object') return out;
        if (seen.has(value)) return out;
        seen.add(value);
        if (Array.isArray(value)) {
            value.forEach((item, index) => c1_collectNumericLeaves(item, `${path}[${index}]`, out, seen));
            return out;
        }
        Object.keys(value).forEach(key => {
            const nextPath = path ? `${path}.${key}` : key;
            c1_collectNumericLeaves(value[key], nextPath, out, seen);
        });
        return out;
    }

    function c1_extractPointPrices(points = []) {
        const values = [];
        points.forEach(point => {
            if (!point || typeof point !== 'object') return;
            const price = [point.price, point.value, point.y, point.price1, point.price2].map(item => Number(item)).find(Number.isFinite);
            if (Number.isFinite(price)) values.push(price);
        });
        return values;
    }

    function c1_countNumericDecimals(value) {
        if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return 0;
        const text = String(value).toLowerCase();
        if (text.includes('e-')) {
            const [coefficient, exponentText] = text.split('e-');
            const exponent = parseInt(exponentText, 10);
            const coefficientDecimals = (coefficient.split('.')[1] || '').replace(/0+$/, '').length;
            return Number.isFinite(exponent) ? exponent + coefficientDecimals : 0;
        }
        if (!text.includes('.')) return 0;
        return text.split('.')[1].replace(/0+$/, '').length;
    }

    function c1_guessTickSizeForSymbol(symbol, priceValue) {
        const normalized = c1_sanitizeSymbol(symbol || '');
        const prefix = normalized.includes(':') ? normalized.split(':')[0] : '';
        const base = normalized.includes(':') ? normalized.split(':').pop() : normalized;
        const clean = (base.split('.')[0] || base).replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/gi, '').toUpperCase();
        const cryptoBase = clean.match(/^(.*?)(USDT|USDC|BUSD|USD|BTC|ETH)$/)?.[1] || '';
        const isCrypto = /^(BTC|ETH|SOL|XRP|ADA|DOGE|BNB|AVAX|DOT|LINK|LTC|BCH|TRX|TON|SHIB|SUI|APT|ARB|OP|NEAR|ATOM|FIL|UNI|ETC|XLM|ICP|PEPE)$/.test(cryptoBase) ||
            /^(BINANCE|BYBIT|BITGET|OKX|COINBASE|KRAKEN|KUCOIN|MEXC|GATEIO|BITSTAMP|GEMINI|DERIBIT|HTX|HUOBI)$/.test(prefix);
        if (!isCrypto && /^[A-Z]{3}JPY$/.test(clean)) return 0.001;
        if (!isCrypto && /^[A-Z]{6}$/.test(clean)) return 0.00001;
        if (clean === 'XAUUSD') return 0.01;
        if (clean === 'XAGUSD') return 0.001;
        if (!Number.isFinite(priceValue)) return 0.01;
        if (priceValue > 10000) return 0.1;
        if (priceValue > 1000) return 0.01;
        if (priceValue > 100) return 0.001;
        if (priceValue > 1) return 0.0001;
        return 0.00001;
    }

    function c1_formatPriceWithTick(value, tickSize) {
        if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return '';
        const decimals = Math.max(c1_countNumericDecimals(tickSize), 0);
        return value.toFixed(decimals);
    }

    function c1_sanitizeProbeValue(value, depth = 0, seen = new WeakSet()) {
        if (value == null) return value;
        if (depth > 3) return '[depth-limited]';
        if (typeof value === 'number' || typeof value === 'boolean') return value;
        if (typeof value === 'string') return value.length > 180 ? `${value.slice(0, 180)}...` : value;
        if (typeof value === 'function') return `[Function ${value.name || 'anonymous'}]`;
        if (typeof value !== 'object') return String(value);
        if (seen.has(value)) return '[circular]';
        seen.add(value);
        if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.slice(0, 12).map(item => c1_sanitizeProbeValue(item, depth + 1, seen));
        const out = {};
        Object.keys(value).slice(0, 40).forEach(key => {
            out[key] = c1_sanitizeProbeValue(value[key], depth + 1, seen);
        });
        return out;
    }

    function c1_pickNumericCandidate(candidates, keywords = []) {
        const lowered = keywords.map(item => String(item).toLowerCase());
        let best = null;
        candidates.forEach(candidate => {
            const path = String(candidate.path || '').toLowerCase();
            let score = 0;
            lowered.forEach(keyword => {
                if (path.includes(keyword)) score += keyword.length;
            });
            if (!score) return;
            if (!best || score > best.score || (score === best.score && path.length < best.path.length)) {
