                best = { score, path, value: candidate.value };
            }
        });
        return best ? best.value : null;
    }

    function c1_dedupeNumericValues(values = []) {
        const seen = new Set();
        return values.filter(value => {
            if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) return false;
            const key = value.toFixed(10);
            if (seen.has(key)) return false;
            seen.add(key);
            return true;
        });
    }

    function c1_parseTradeShape(chart, chartState, preferredId = '') {
        if (!chart) return null;
        const shapes = c1_safeChartCall(() => chart.getAllShapes?.()) || [];
        const selectionApi = c1_safeChartCall(() => chart.selection?.()) || null;
        const selectedIds = new Set((c1_safeChartCall(() => selectionApi?.allSources?.()) || []).map(item => String(item)));
        const lineToolsState = c1_safeChartCall(() => chart.getLineToolsState?.()) || null;
        const storedSources = c1_readMapLikeEntries(lineToolsState?.sources);
        if ((!Array.isArray(shapes) || !shapes.length) && !storedSources.length) return null;
        const storedSourceMap = new Map(storedSources.map(([entryId, entry]) => [String(c1_getEntityId(entryId || entry)), entry]));

        const descriptorMap = new Map();
        (Array.isArray(shapes) ? shapes : []).forEach((shape, index) => {
            const id = c1_getEntityId(shape);
            if (!id) return;
            const label = c1_normalizeDomText([
                shape?.name,
                shape?.type,
                shape?.tool,
                shape?.source,
                shape?.title
            ].filter(Boolean).join(' '));
            const positionDirection = c1_getTrustedPositionShapeDirection(
                shape?.name,
                shape?.type,
                shape?.tool,
                shape?.source
            );
            descriptorMap.set(id, { id, label, positionDirection, raw: shape, index, storedEntry: null });
        });
        storedSources.forEach(([entryId, entry], index) => {
            const id = c1_getEntityId(entryId || entry);
            if (!id) return;
            const storedState = entry?.state || entry || null;
            const storedLabel = c1_normalizeDomText([
                entry?.ownerSource,
                entry?.name,
                storedState?.name,
                storedState?.toolname,
                storedState?.linetool,
                storedState?.type,
                storedState?.source,
                storedState?.state
            ].filter(Boolean).join(' '));
            const storedPositionDirection = c1_getTrustedPositionShapeDirection(
                entry?.ownerSource,
                entry?.name,
                storedState?.name,
                storedState?.toolname,
                storedState?.linetool,
                storedState?.type,
                storedState?.source
            );
            const prev = descriptorMap.get(id) || { id, label: '', positionDirection: '', raw: null, index: -1, storedEntry: null };
            descriptorMap.set(id, {
                id,
                label: c1_normalizeDomText([prev.label, storedLabel].filter(Boolean).join(' ')),
                positionDirection: prev.positionDirection || storedPositionDirection,
                raw: prev.raw,
                index: Math.max(prev.index, index),
                storedEntry: entry
            });
        });

        const descriptors = Array.from(descriptorMap.values()).filter(item => item.id);
        if (!descriptors.length) return null;

        descriptors.sort((a, b) => {
            const aSelected = selectedIds.has(a.id) ? 1 : 0;
            const bSelected = selectedIds.has(b.id) ? 1 : 0;
            if (aSelected !== bSelected) return bSelected - aSelected;
            const aPreferred = preferredId && a.id === preferredId ? 1 : 0;
            const bPreferred = preferredId && b.id === preferredId ? 1 : 0;
            if (aPreferred !== bPreferred) return bPreferred - aPreferred;
            return b.index - a.index;
        });

        const candidateMap = new Map();
        const pushCandidates = (list) => {
            list.forEach(descriptor => {
                if (!descriptor?.id || candidateMap.has(descriptor.id)) return;
                candidateMap.set(descriptor.id, descriptor);
            });
        };
        pushCandidates(descriptors.filter(descriptor => selectedIds.has(descriptor.id)));
        if (preferredId) pushCandidates(descriptors.filter(descriptor => descriptor.id === preferredId));
        pushCandidates(descriptors.filter(descriptor => descriptor.positionDirection).slice(0, 8));
        // Some TradingView builds expose the trusted type only through getProperties/state.
        // Inspect a small recent tail, but reject it below unless an explicit position type is present.
        pushCandidates(descriptors.slice(0, 16));
        const candidateDescriptors = Array.from(candidateMap.values());

        let bestMatch = null;
        for (const descriptor of candidateDescriptors) {
            const shapeApi = c1_safeChartCall(() => chart.getShapeById?.(descriptor.id)) || null;
            const props = c1_safeChartCall(() => shapeApi?.getProperties?.()) || null;
            const points = c1_safeChartCall(() => shapeApi?.getPoints?.()) || [];
            const storedEntry = descriptor.storedEntry || storedSourceMap.get(descriptor.id) || null;
            const storedState = storedEntry?.state || storedEntry || null;
            const rawDirection = descriptor.positionDirection || c1_getTrustedPositionShapeDirection(
                props?.name,
                props?.type,
                props?.toolname,
                props?.linetool,
                storedState?.name,
                storedState?.type,
                storedState?.toolname,
                storedState?.linetool
            );
            if (!rawDirection) continue;
            const pointPrices = c1_dedupeNumericValues([
                ...c1_extractPointPrices(points),
                ...c1_extractPointPrices(storedState?.points || [])
            ]);
            const numericLeaves = c1_collectNumericLeaves({
                descriptor: descriptor.raw,
                properties: props,
                points,
                state: storedState
            });

            const explicitEntry = c1_pickNumericCandidate(numericLeaves, ['entryprice', 'entry_price', 'entry', 'avgprice', 'avg_price', 'openprice', 'open_price']);
            const explicitTp = c1_pickNumericCandidate(numericLeaves, ['takeprofit', 'take_profit', 'target', 'profit', 'tp']);
            const explicitSl = c1_pickNumericCandidate(numericLeaves, ['stoploss', 'stop_loss', 'stoplevel', 'stop', 'sl']);
            const isVisibleShape = props?.visible !== false;
            const isActiveShape = isVisibleShape || selectedIds.has(descriptor.id) || (preferredId && descriptor.id === preferredId);

            let entry = explicitEntry;
            let tp = explicitTp;
            let sl = explicitSl;
            let tpTicksText = '';
            let slTicksText = '';
            let rrFromLevels = '';

            if (!isActiveShape) continue;
            {
                const entryPoint = pointPrices.find(Number.isFinite);
                const tickSize = Number.isFinite(chartState?.tickSize) && chartState.tickSize > 0
                    ? chartState.tickSize
                    : c1_guessTickSizeForSymbol(chartState?.symbol || '', entryPoint);
                const stopTicks = Number(props?.stopLevel);
                const profitTicks = Number(props?.profitLevel);
                if (Number.isFinite(entryPoint)) entry = entryPoint;
                if (Number.isFinite(stopTicks) && stopTicks >= 0) {
                    slTicksText = String(stopTicks);
                    if (rawDirection === 'short') sl = entryPoint + (stopTicks * tickSize);
                    else sl = entryPoint - (stopTicks * tickSize);
                }
                if (Number.isFinite(profitTicks) && profitTicks >= 0) {
                    tpTicksText = String(profitTicks);
                    if (rawDirection === 'short') tp = entryPoint - (profitTicks * tickSize);
                    else tp = entryPoint + (profitTicks * tickSize);
                }
                if (Number.isFinite(profitTicks) && Number.isFinite(stopTicks) && stopTicks > 0) {
                    rrFromLevels = (profitTicks / stopTicks).toFixed(2);
                }
            }

            if ((!Number.isFinite(entry) || !Number.isFinite(tp) || !Number.isFinite(sl)) && pointPrices.length >= 3) {
                const sorted = [...pointPrices].sort((a, b) => a - b);
                if (rawDirection === 'short') {
                    entry = Number.isFinite(entry) ? entry : sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length / 2)];
                    tp = Number.isFinite(tp) ? tp : sorted[0];
                    sl = Number.isFinite(sl) ? sl : sorted[sorted.length - 1];
                } else {
                    entry = Number.isFinite(entry) ? entry : sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length / 2)];
                    tp = Number.isFinite(tp) ? tp : sorted[sorted.length - 1];
                    sl = Number.isFinite(sl) ? sl : sorted[0];
                }
            }

            const direction = rawDirection;
            if (!Number.isFinite(entry) || !direction) continue;
            let score = 4;
            if (selectedIds.has(descriptor.id)) score += 2;
            if (preferredId && descriptor.id === preferredId) score += 1;
            if (props?.visible === true) score += 3;
            if (rawDirection) score += 2;
            if (Number.isFinite(explicitEntry)) score += 3;
            if (Number.isFinite(explicitTp)) score += 2;
            if (Number.isFinite(explicitSl)) score += 2;
            if (pointPrices.length >= 3) score += 2;

            const rr = rrFromLevels || (Number.isFinite(tp) && Number.isFinite(sl) && Math.abs(entry - sl) > 0
                ? (Math.abs(tp - entry) / Math.abs(entry - sl)).toFixed(2)
                : '');

            const data = {
                source: 'shape',
                shapeId: descriptor.id,
                symbol: chartState?.symbol || (SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Unknown Symbol' : '未知品种'),
                interval: chartState?.interval || '',
                priceText: chartState?.priceText || '',
                direction: direction === 'short' ? t('uiDirShort') : t('uiDirLong'),
                entry: c1_formatPriceWithTick(entry, Number.isFinite(chartState?.tickSize) && chartState.tickSize > 0 ? chartState.tickSize : c1_guessTickSizeForSymbol(chartState?.symbol || '', entry)),
                tpTicks: tpTicksText,
                slTicks: slTicksText,
                tp: Number.isFinite(tp) ? c1_formatPriceWithTick(tp, Number.isFinite(chartState?.tickSize) && chartState.tickSize > 0 ? chartState.tickSize : c1_guessTickSizeForSymbol(chartState?.symbol || '', tp)) : (SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Not Found' : '未找到'),
                sl: Number.isFinite(sl) ? c1_formatPriceWithTick(sl, Number.isFinite(chartState?.tickSize) && chartState.tickSize > 0 ? chartState.tickSize : c1_guessTickSizeForSymbol(chartState?.symbol || '', sl)) : (SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Not Found' : '未找到'),
                rr: rr || (SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Not Found' : '未找到'),
                timestamp: Date.now()
            };
            if (!bestMatch || score > bestMatch.score) bestMatch = { score, data };
        }

        return bestMatch && bestMatch.score >= 4 ? bestMatch.data : null;
    }

    function c1_collectTradeProbe(chart) {
        const selectionApi = c1_safeChartCall(() => chart?.selection?.()) || null;
        const selectedIds = (c1_safeChartCall(() => selectionApi?.allSources?.()) || []).map(item => String(item));
        const shapes = c1_safeChartCall(() => chart?.getAllShapes?.()) || [];
        const lineToolsState = c1_safeChartCall(() => chart?.getLineToolsState?.()) || null;
        const storedSources = c1_readMapLikeEntries(lineToolsState?.sources);
        const recentSources = storedSources.slice(-3).map(([id, entry]) => {
            const state = entry?.state || entry || {};
            return {
                id: String(id),
                ownerSource: c1_normalizeDomText(entry?.ownerSource || ''),
                name: c1_normalizeDomText([entry?.name, state?.name, state?.toolname, state?.linetool, state?.type].filter(Boolean).join(' ')),
                keys: Object.keys(state || {}).slice(0, 12),
                pointCount: Array.isArray(state?.points) ? state.points.length : 0
            };
        });
        const recentShapes = (Array.isArray(shapes) ? shapes : []).slice(-5).map((shape, index) => {
            const id = c1_getEntityId(shape);
            const shapeApi = c1_safeChartCall(() => chart?.getShapeById?.(id)) || null;
            const props = c1_safeChartCall(() => shapeApi?.getProperties?.()) || null;
            const points = c1_safeChartCall(() => shapeApi?.getPoints?.()) || [];
            return {
                index: Math.max(0, (Array.isArray(shapes) ? shapes.length : 0) - 5 + index),
                id,
                label: c1_normalizeDomText([
                    shape?.name,
                    shape?.type,
                    shape?.tool,
                    shape?.source,
                    shape?.title
                ].filter(Boolean).join(' ')),
                shapeKeys: Object.keys(shape || {}).slice(0, 12),
                propertyKeys: Object.keys(props || {}).slice(0, 40),
                propertySample: c1_sanitizeProbeValue(props),
                pointsSample: c1_sanitizeProbeValue(points),
                shapeApiMethods: shapeApi ? Object.getOwnPropertyNames(Object.getPrototypeOf(shapeApi)).filter(name => name !== 'constructor').slice(0, 40) : [],
                pointCount: Array.isArray(points) ? points.length : 0,
                pointPrices: c1_extractPointPrices(points)
            };
        });
        return {
            hasChartApi: !!chart,
            hasGetAllShapes: typeof chart?.getAllShapes === 'function',
            hasGetShapeById: typeof chart?.getShapeById === 'function',
            hasGetLineToolsState: typeof chart?.getLineToolsState === 'function',
            hasSelectionApi: !!selectionApi,
            selectedIds,
            shapeCount: Array.isArray(shapes) ? shapes.length : 0,
            sourceCount: storedSources.length,
            recentSources,
            recentShapes
        };
    }

    function c1_createTVStateBridge() {
        const bridge = {
            started: false,
            cleanups: [],
            chartState: { symbol: '', priceText: '', priceValue: null, tickSize: null, interval: '', updatedAt: 0 },
            tradeDialogData: null,
            tradeProbe: null,
            latestTradeShapeId: '',
            tradeDialogCacheKey: '',
            tradeDialogCacheAt: 0,

            syncChart(force = false) {
                if (!force && document.visibilityState !== 'visible') return this.chartState;
                const prev = this.chartState;
                const resolved = c1_resolveChartSnapshot();
                const resolvedSymbol = resolved.symbol || prev.symbol || '';
                const symbolChanged = !!(prev.symbol && resolved.symbol && resolved.symbol !== prev.symbol);
                const next = {
                    symbol: resolvedSymbol,
                    priceText: resolved.priceText || (symbolChanged ? '' : prev.priceText) || '',
                    priceValue: Number.isFinite(resolved.priceValue) ? resolved.priceValue : (symbolChanged ? null : prev.priceValue),
                    tickSize: Number.isFinite(resolved.tickSize) && resolved.tickSize > 0 ? resolved.tickSize : (symbolChanged ? null : prev.tickSize),
                    interval: resolved.interval || prev.interval || '',
                    updatedAt: resolved.updatedAt || prev.updatedAt || Date.now()
                };
                if (symbolChanged) {
                    this.tradeDialogData = null;
                    this.latestTradeShapeId = '';
                    this.tradeDialogCacheKey = '';
                    this.tradeDialogCacheAt = 0;
                    c1_cachedTradeData = null;
                }
                if (!next.symbol && !next.priceText && prev.updatedAt) return prev;
                const changed = (
                    next.symbol !== prev.symbol ||
                    next.priceText !== prev.priceText ||
                    next.tickSize !== prev.tickSize ||
                    next.interval !== prev.interval
                );
                if (!prev.updatedAt || changed) {
                    this.chartState = next;
                }
                return this.chartState;
            },

            syncTradeDialog(force = false) {
                if (!force && document.visibilityState !== 'visible') return this.tradeDialogData;
                if (!c1_isTradeDataDemanded()) return this.tradeDialogData;
                const chartState = this.syncChart(force);
                const chart = c1_getChartApi();
                const demand = c1_getTradeDialogDemandSnapshot(chartState, this.latestTradeShapeId);
                const now = Date.now();
                if (this.tradeDialogData && demand.key === this.tradeDialogCacheKey && (now - this.tradeDialogCacheAt) < PERF_CONFIG.tradeScanMs) {
                    return this.tradeDialogData;
                }
                this.tradeProbe = null;
                const parsedFromDialog = c1_parseTradeDialog(demand.dialog);
                const parsedFromShape = parsedFromDialog ? null : c1_parseTradeShape(chart, chartState, this.latestTradeShapeId);
                const parsed = parsedFromDialog || parsedFromShape;
                if (parsed?.shapeId) this.latestTradeShapeId = parsed.shapeId;
                this.tradeDialogData = parsed;
                if (parsed) c1_cachedTradeData = parsed;
                this.tradeDialogCacheKey = demand.key;
                this.tradeDialogCacheAt = now;
                return this.tradeDialogData;
            },

            getChartState(force = false) {
                return this.syncChart(force);
            },

            getTradeDialogData(force = false) {
                return this.syncTradeDialog(force);
            },

            getTradeProbe(force = false) {
                if (force || !this.tradeProbe) this.tradeProbe = c1_collectTradeProbe(c1_getChartApi());
                return this.tradeProbe;
            },

            addCleanup(fn) {
                if (typeof fn === 'function') this.cleanups.push(fn);
            },

            trySubscribe(factory, handler) {
                try {
                    const sub = factory?.();
                    if (sub && typeof sub.subscribe === 'function') {
                        sub.subscribe(null, handler);
                        this.addCleanup(() => {
                            try {
                                if (typeof sub.unsubscribe === 'function') sub.unsubscribe(null, handler);
                                else if (typeof sub.unsubscribeAll === 'function') sub.unsubscribeAll(null);
                            } catch (e) {}
                        });
                        return true;
                    }
                } catch (e) {}
                return false;
            },

            init() {
                if (this.started) return this;
                this.started = true;
                const throttledChartSync = throttle(() => { this.syncChart(true); }, 120);
                const throttledDialogSync = throttle(() => {
                    if (!c1_isTradeDataDemanded()) return;
                    this.syncTradeDialog(true);
                }, PERF_CONFIG.tradeScanMs);
                const throttledInteractiveSync = throttle(() => {
                    this.syncChart(true);
                    if (c1_isTradeDataDemanded()) this.syncTradeDialog(true);
                }, 160);

                this.syncChart(true);
                if (c1_isTradeDataDemanded()) this.syncTradeDialog(true);

                const chart = c1_getChartApi();
                if (chart) {
                    this.trySubscribe(() => chart.onSymbolChanged?.(), throttledChartSync);
                    this.trySubscribe(() => chart.onIntervalChanged?.(), throttledChartSync);
                    this.trySubscribe(() => chart.onDataLoaded?.(), throttledChartSync);
                    this.trySubscribe(() => chart.selection?.()?.onChanged?.(), throttledDialogSync);
                }

                const titleEl = document.querySelector('title');
                if (titleEl) {
                    const titleObserver = new MutationObserver(() => { throttledChartSync(); });
                    titleObserver.observe(titleEl, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true });
                    this.addCleanup(() => titleObserver.disconnect());
                }

                const onFocus = () => {
                    throttledChartSync();
                    if (c1_isTradeDataDemanded()) throttledDialogSync();
                };
                const onVisibility = () => {
                    if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') onFocus();
                };
                const onPointerMove = (event) => {
                    if (document.visibilityState !== 'visible') return;
                    if (!event || !event.buttons) return;
                    throttledInteractiveSync();
                };
                const onPointerEnd = () => { throttledInteractiveSync(); };
                window.addEventListener('focus', onFocus);
                document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibility);
                window.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove, true);
                window.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerEnd, true);
                window.addEventListener('mouseup', onPointerEnd, true);
                window.addEventListener('keyup', onPointerEnd, true);
                this.addCleanup(() => window.removeEventListener('focus', onFocus));
                this.addCleanup(() => document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibility));
                this.addCleanup(() => window.removeEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove, true));
                this.addCleanup(() => window.removeEventListener('pointerup', onPointerEnd, true));
                this.addCleanup(() => window.removeEventListener('mouseup', onPointerEnd, true));
                this.addCleanup(() => window.removeEventListener('keyup', onPointerEnd, true));
                return this;
            },

            destroy() {
                this.cleanups.forEach(fn => {
                    try { fn(); } catch (e) {}
                });
                this.cleanups = [];
                this.started = false;
            }
        };
        return bridge;
    }

    function c1_getTVStateBridge() {
        if (!c1_tvStateBridge) c1_tvStateBridge = c1_createTVStateBridge();
        return c1_tvStateBridge;
    }

    // 幽灵雷达
    function c1_scanTradeDialog() {
        c1_getTVStateBridge().syncTradeDialog(true);
    }
    const c1_scanTradeDialogThrottled = throttle(c1_scanTradeDialog, PERF_CONFIG.tradeScanMs);

    // ==========================================
    // ⚙️ 面板工坊与API宏观设置集成
    // ==========================================
    const P2_STORAGE_KEY = 'tv_macro_news_v12';
    const C2_DEFAULT_MACRO_API_URL = 'https://nfs.faireconomy.media/ff_calendar_thisweek.json';
    const C2_DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
        macroPrefs: { currencies: ['USD', 'EUR', 'GBP', 'XAU', 'CRYPTO'] },
        macroKey: 'SHIFT + `',
        macroIcon: 'zap',
        cache: null,
        macroApiUrl: C2_DEFAULT_MACRO_API_URL,
        customPanels: []
    };
    const MACRO_ASSETS = [ { id: 'USD', label: 'USD (美系)' }, { id: 'EUR', label: 'EUR (欧系)' }, { id: 'GBP', label: 'GBP (英镑)' }, { id: 'JPY', label: 'JPY (日元)' }, { id: 'AUD', label: 'AUD (澳元)' }, { id: 'CAD', label: 'CAD (加元)' }, { id: 'XAU', label: 'XAU (黄金)' }, { id: 'CRYPTO', label: 'BTC/ETH (币圈)' } ];

    let C2_CONFIG = {};
    function c2_normalizeConfig(raw) {
        const source = c1_isPlainConfigObject(raw) ? c1_clonePlain(raw) : {};
        const allowedCurrencies = new Set(MACRO_ASSETS.map((asset) => asset.id));
        const sourceCurrencies = Array.isArray(source.macroPrefs?.currencies) ? source.macroPrefs.currencies : C2_DEFAULT_CONFIG.macroPrefs.currencies;
        const currencies = [...new Set(sourceCurrencies.filter((item) => typeof item === 'string' && allowedCurrencies.has(item)))];
        const hasMacroKey = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(source, 'macroKey');
        const macroKey = hasMacroKey ? c1_normalizeMacroShortcut(source.macroKey) : C2_DEFAULT_CONFIG.macroKey;
        const macroIcon = ['earth', 'list', 'zap', 'target', 'star', 'shield'].includes(source.macroIcon) ? source.macroIcon : C2_DEFAULT_CONFIG.macroIcon;
        const macroApiUrl = c1_isAllowedMacroApiUrl(source.macroApiUrl) ? String(source.macroApiUrl) : C2_DEFAULT_MACRO_API_URL;
        const cacheTime = Number(source.cache?.time);
        const cache = c1_isPlainConfigObject(source.cache)
            && Number.isFinite(cacheTime)
            && cacheTime >= 0
            && cacheTime <= Date.now()
            && Array.isArray(source.cache.data)
            && source.cache.data.length <= C1_CONFIG_IMPORT_MAX_ARRAY_ITEMS
            ? { time: cacheTime, data: c1_clonePlain(source.cache.data) }
            : null;
        return {
            ...source,
            macroPrefs: { ...(c1_isPlainConfigObject(source.macroPrefs) ? source.macroPrefs : {}), currencies: currencies.length ? currencies : ['USD'] },
            macroKey,
            macroIcon,
            cache,
            macroApiUrl,
            customPanels: Array.isArray(source.customPanels) ? source.customPanels.slice(0, 100) : []
        };
    }

    function c2_loadConfig() {
        let saved = null;
        try {
            const raw = localStorage.getItem(P2_STORAGE_KEY);
            saved = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
        } catch (e) {
            C1_LOG.warn('macro.config', '配置已损坏，回退默认值', e);
            saved = null;
        }
        const previousMacroKey = saved?.macroKey;
        C2_CONFIG = c2_normalizeConfig(saved || C2_DEFAULT_CONFIG);
        if (saved && previousMacroKey !== C2_CONFIG.macroKey) {
            try { localStorage.setItem(P2_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(C2_CONFIG)); }
            catch (e) { C1_LOG.warn('macro.config', '快捷键迁移暂未写入存储', e); }
        }
    }
    c2_loadConfig();
    function c2_saveConfig() {
        C2_CONFIG = c2_normalizeConfig(C2_CONFIG);
        try { localStorage.setItem(P2_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(C2_CONFIG)); return true; }
        catch (err) { console.warn('[TV-GCC] c2_saveConfig storage write failed', err); return false; }
    }

    const PanelManager = {
        panelEntries: new Map(),
        mountables: new Set(),

        resetPanels() {
            this.panelEntries.clear();
            c1_activePanel = null;
        },

        registerMountable(el) {
            if (el) this.mountables.add(el);
            return el;
        },

        unregisterMountable(el) {
            if (el) this.mountables.delete(el);
        },

        registerPanel({ id, panel, trigger, onOpen = null, onClose = null }) {
            if (!id || !panel || !trigger) return null;
            this.registerMountable(panel);
            const prev = this.panelEntries.get(id) || {};
            const entry = { ...prev, id, panel, trigger, onOpen, onClose };
            this.panelEntries.set(id, entry);
            panel.dataset.panelManagerId = id;
            trigger.dataset.panelManagerId = id;
            return entry;
        },

        closePanel(id) {
            const entry = this.panelEntries.get(id);
            if (!entry) return;
            entry.panel.classList.remove('show');
            entry.trigger.classList.remove('active');
            if (typeof entry.onClose === 'function') {
                try { entry.onClose(entry); } catch (e) {}
            }
            if (c1_activePanel === entry.panel) c1_activePanel = null;
            c1_refreshTradeScanLoop();
            try { c1_syncOverlayStackState(); } catch (e) {}
        },

        closeAll() {
            this.panelEntries.forEach((entry, id) => { this.closePanel(id); });
            c1_activePanel = null;
            try { c1_syncOverlayStackState(); } catch (e) {}
        },

        openPanel(id) {
            const entry = this.panelEntries.get(id);
            if (!entry) return false;
            this.closeAll();
            entry.panel.offsetHeight;
            entry.panel.classList.add('show');
            entry.trigger.classList.add('active');
            c1_activePanel = entry.panel;
            if (typeof entry.onOpen === 'function') {
                try { entry.onOpen(entry); } catch (e) {}
            }
            c1_refreshTradeScanLoop();
            try { c1_syncOverlayStackState(); } catch (e) {}
            return true;
        },

        togglePanel(id) {
            const entry = this.panelEntries.get(id);
            if (!entry) return false;
            if (c1_activePanel === entry.panel) {
                this.closeAll();
                return false;
            }
            return this.openPanel(id);
        },

        getMountedElements() {
            const mounted = [];
            this.mountables.forEach(el => {
                const stillMounted = !!(el && (el.isConnected || (el.id && document.getElementById(el.id) === el)));
                if (stillMounted) mounted.push(el);
                else this.mountables.delete(el);
            });
            return mounted;
        }
    };

    function c1_getSidebarFeaturePlacement(feature) {
        if (!feature || feature.surface !== 'sidebar') return null;
        c1_ensureSidebarConfig();
        const cfg = SysConfig.sidebarItems?.[feature.id] || {};
        if (cfg.enabled === false) return null;
        return {
            side: cfg.side === 'right' ? 'right' : 'left',
            order: Number.isFinite(Number(cfg.order)) ? Number(cfg.order) : (feature.order || 0)
        };
    }

    const FeatureRegistry = {
        features: new Map(),

        clear() {
            this.features.clear();
        },

        register(feature) {
            if (!feature?.id) return null;
            this.features.set(feature.id, feature);
            return feature;
        },

        get(id) {
            return this.features.get(id) || null;
        },

        findByTriggerId(triggerId) {
            for (const feature of this.features.values()) {
                if (feature.triggerId === triggerId) return feature;
            }
            return null;
        },

        getSidebarFeatures() {
            return [...this.features.values()]
                .filter(feature => feature.surface === 'sidebar')
                .sort((a, b) => {
                    const pa = c1_getSidebarFeaturePlacement(a);
                    const pb = c1_getSidebarFeaturePlacement(b);
                    return (pa?.order ?? a.order ?? 0) - (pb?.order ?? b.order ?? 0);
                });
        },

        buildSidebar(root, sidebarContainers) {
            this.getSidebarFeatures().forEach(feature => {
                const placement = c1_getSidebarFeaturePlacement(feature);
                if (!placement) return;
                const container = sidebarContainers?.[placement.side] || sidebarContainers?.left || sidebarContainers;
                if (container && typeof feature.build === 'function') feature.build(root, container, placement.side);
            });
        },

        trigger(id) {
            const feature = this.get(id) || this.findByTriggerId(id);
            if (feature?.toggle && feature.toggle() !== undefined) return true;
            const triggerId = feature?.triggerId || id;
            const btn = document.getElementById(`trigger-${triggerId}`);
            if (!btn) return false;
            btn.click();
            return true;
        },

        refresh(id) {
            const feature = this.get(id);
            if (!feature || typeof feature.refresh !== 'function') return false;
            feature.refresh();
            return true;
        }
    };

    function c1_closeAllPanels() {
        PanelManager.closeAll();
    }

    function c1_openTradeGatePanelFromBear() {
        const opened = PanelManager.openPanel('tradegate');
        if (opened) {
            try { FeatureRegistry.refresh('tradegate'); } catch (e) {}
            return true;
        }
        const trigger = document.getElementById('trigger-tradegate');
        if (trigger) {
            SharedTV.simulateClick(trigger);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    function c1_scheduleRiskRefresh() {
        if (!SysConfig.riskEnabled) return;
        [120, 360, 800, 1400].forEach(delay => {
            setTimeout(() => {
                try {
                    const bridge = c1_getTVStateBridge();
                    bridge.syncChart(true);
                    bridge.syncTradeDialog(true);
                    if (typeof RiskManager !== 'undefined') {
                        RiskManager.forceLoadCount = 0;
                        RiskManager.syncAccount();
                        RiskManager.syncTV();
                    }
                } catch (e) {}
            }, delay);
        });
    }

    function c1_hideSidebarTooltip() {
        if (!c1_sidebarTooltipEl) return;
        c1_sidebarTooltipEl.classList.remove('show');
    }

    function c1_ensureSidebarTooltip() {
        if (!c1_sidebarTooltipEl) {
            c1_sidebarTooltipEl = document.createElement('div');
            c1_sidebarTooltipEl.className = 'tv-native-tooltip tv-custom-themed tv-custom-' + (SysConfig.theme || 'dark');
            c1_sidebarTooltipEl.style.zIndex = '1000017';
            document.body.appendChild(c1_sidebarTooltipEl);
        } else if (c1_sidebarTooltipEl.parentElement !== document.body) {
            c1_sidebarTooltipEl.style.zIndex = '1000017';
            document.body.appendChild(c1_sidebarTooltipEl);
        }
        return c1_sidebarTooltipEl;
    }

    function c1_positionSidebarTooltip(trigger, tooltip) {
        if (!trigger || !tooltip) return;
        const rect = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
        const isRight = !!trigger.closest('#tv-custom-sidebar-right');
        tooltip.classList.toggle('is-left', isRight);
        tooltip.classList.toggle('is-right', !isRight);
        tooltip.classList.remove('is-top', 'is-bottom');
        tooltip.style.visibility = 'hidden';
        tooltip.classList.add('show');
        const tipRect = tooltip.getBoundingClientRect();
        const gap = 10;
        let left = isRight ? rect.left - tipRect.width - gap : rect.right + gap;
        let top = rect.top + rect.height / 2 - tipRect.height / 2;
        left = Math.max(8, Math.min(left, window.innerWidth - tipRect.width - 8));
        top = Math.max(8, Math.min(top, window.innerHeight - tipRect.height - 8));
        tooltip.style.left = `${Math.round(left)}px`;
        tooltip.style.top = `${Math.round(top)}px`;
        tooltip.style.visibility = '';
    }

    function c1_getUnifiedTooltipText(target) {
        if (!target) return '';
        const explicit = target.getAttribute?.('data-tooltip') || target.getAttribute?.('data-tip') || target.getAttribute?.('title');
        if (explicit && String(explicit).trim()) return String(explicit).trim();
        const aria = target.getAttribute?.('aria-label');
        const text = String(aria || '').trim();
        if (!text) return '';
        const visibleText = String(target.innerText || target.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
        return visibleText && visibleText === text ? '' : text;
    }

    function c1_positionUnifiedTooltip(trigger, tooltip) {
        if (!trigger || !tooltip) return;
        const rect = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
        tooltip.classList.remove('is-left', 'is-right', 'is-top', 'is-bottom');
        tooltip.style.removeProperty('--tv-tooltip-arrow-left');
        tooltip.style.visibility = 'hidden';
        tooltip.classList.add('show');
        const tipRect = tooltip.getBoundingClientRect();
        const gap = 9;
        const viewportPad = 8;
        const roomTop = rect.top;
        const roomBottom = window.innerHeight - rect.bottom;
        const placeTop = roomTop >= tipRect.height + gap || roomTop >= roomBottom;
        let left = rect.left + rect.width / 2 - tipRect.width / 2;
        let top = placeTop ? rect.top - tipRect.height - gap : rect.bottom + gap;
        left = Math.max(viewportPad, Math.min(left, window.innerWidth - tipRect.width - viewportPad));
        top = Math.max(viewportPad, Math.min(top, window.innerHeight - tipRect.height - viewportPad));
        const arrowLeft = Math.max(12, Math.min(rect.left + rect.width / 2 - left, tipRect.width - 12));
        tooltip.style.left = `${Math.round(left)}px`;
        tooltip.style.top = `${Math.round(top)}px`;
        tooltip.style.setProperty('--tv-tooltip-arrow-left', `${Math.round(arrowLeft)}px`);
        tooltip.classList.add(placeTop ? 'is-top' : 'is-bottom');
        tooltip.style.visibility = '';
    }

    function c1_shouldUseUnifiedTooltip(target) {
        if (!target) return false;
        if (!target.closest?.('#tv-settings-panel, #tv-tradegate-window, .tv-side-panel, #tv-first-time-modal, #tv-danger-confirm-modal, #tv-immersive-profile-card, #tv-work-journey-bear-host')) return false;
        if (target.closest?.('.tv-settings-nav-btn, .tg-answer, .tg-chip, .tg-toggle, .tg-btn, .tv-settings-footer-btn, .tv-settings-display-trigger')) return false;
        if (target.matches?.('.tv-settings-nav-btn, .tg-answer, .tg-chip, .tg-toggle, .tg-btn, .tv-settings-footer-btn, .tv-settings-display-trigger')) return false;
        if (target.matches?.('button, [role="button"]')) {
            const visibleText = String(target.innerText || target.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
            const hasIconOnlyClass = target.matches('.tv-settings-icon-btn, .tv-settings-mini-btn, .tv-side-panel-close, .rk-head-btn, .tv-record-btn, .tv-draw-tool-remove, .cp-del, .dyn-del-btn, #macro-refresh-btn, #macro-settings-btn, #tv-refresh-tip');
            const isTruncated = target.scrollWidth > target.clientWidth + 2;
            if (visibleText.length > 1 && !hasIconOnlyClass && !isTruncated) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    function c1_showUnifiedTooltip(target) {
        if (!target || target.closest?.('.tv-sidebar-trigger')) return;
        if (!c1_shouldUseUnifiedTooltip(target)) return;
        const text = c1_getUnifiedTooltipText(target);
        if (!text) return;
        if (c1_activeNativeTooltipTarget && c1_activeNativeTooltipTarget !== target) {
            c1_restoreUnifiedTooltipTitle();
        }
        c1_activeNativeTooltipTarget = target;
        c1_activeNativeTooltipTitle = target.getAttribute?.('title') || '';
        if (c1_activeNativeTooltipTitle && !target.dataset.tvNativeTitle) {
            target.dataset.tvNativeTitle = c1_activeNativeTooltipTitle;
            target.removeAttribute('title');
        }
        const tooltip = c1_ensureSidebarTooltip();
        tooltip.textContent = text;
        c1_positionUnifiedTooltip(target, tooltip);
    }

    function c1_restoreUnifiedTooltipTitle() {
        if (c1_activeNativeTooltipTarget && c1_activeNativeTooltipTarget.isConnected) {
            const savedTitle = c1_activeNativeTooltipTarget.dataset?.tvNativeTitle || c1_activeNativeTooltipTitle;
            if (savedTitle) {
                c1_activeNativeTooltipTarget.setAttribute('title', savedTitle);
                delete c1_activeNativeTooltipTarget.dataset.tvNativeTitle;
            }
        }
        c1_activeNativeTooltipTarget = null;
        c1_activeNativeTooltipTitle = '';
    }

    function c1_hideUnifiedTooltip() {
        c1_restoreUnifiedTooltipTitle();
        c1_hideSidebarTooltip();
    }

    function c1_bindUnifiedTooltips() {
        document.addEventListener('mouseover', (event) => {
            const target = event.target?.closest?.('[data-tooltip], [data-tip], [title]');
            if (!target || target === c1_activeNativeTooltipTarget) return;
            c1_showUnifiedTooltip(target);
        }, true);
        let c1_unifiedTooltipMousemoveScheduled = false;
        document.addEventListener('mousemove', () => {
            if (!c1_activeNativeTooltipTarget) return;
            if (c1_unifiedTooltipMousemoveScheduled) return;
            if (!c1_sidebarTooltipEl?.classList.contains('show')) return;
            c1_unifiedTooltipMousemoveScheduled = true;
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                c1_unifiedTooltipMousemoveScheduled = false;
                if (c1_activeNativeTooltipTarget && c1_sidebarTooltipEl?.classList.contains('show')) {
                    c1_positionUnifiedTooltip(c1_activeNativeTooltipTarget, c1_sidebarTooltipEl);
                }
            });
        }, { capture: true, passive: true });
        document.addEventListener('mouseout', (event) => {
            if (!c1_activeNativeTooltipTarget) return;
            const next = event.relatedTarget;
            if (next instanceof Node && c1_activeNativeTooltipTarget.contains(next)) return;
            c1_hideUnifiedTooltip();
        }, true);
        document.addEventListener('focusin', (event) => {
            const target = event.target?.closest?.('[data-tooltip], [data-tip], [title]');
            if (target) c1_showUnifiedTooltip(target);
        }, true);
        document.addEventListener('focusout', c1_hideUnifiedTooltip, true);
        document.addEventListener('mousedown', c1_hideUnifiedTooltip, true);
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
            if (event.key === 'Escape') c1_hideUnifiedTooltip();
        }, true);
    }

    function c1_bindSidebarTooltip(btn, label) {
        const text = String(label || '').trim();
        btn.dataset.tooltip = text;
        btn.removeAttribute('title');
        btn.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
            if (!btn.dataset.tooltip) return;
            const tooltip = c1_ensureSidebarTooltip();
            tooltip.textContent = btn.dataset.tooltip;
            c1_positionSidebarTooltip(btn, tooltip);
        });
        btn.addEventListener('mousemove', () => {
            if (c1_sidebarTooltipEl?.classList.contains('show')) c1_positionSidebarTooltip(btn, c1_sidebarTooltipEl);
        });
        btn.addEventListener('mouseleave', c1_hideSidebarTooltip);
        btn.addEventListener('mousedown', c1_hideSidebarTooltip);
    }

    function c1_createSidebarButton(sidebarContainer, id, svgIcon, panelDOM, clickHook = null, label = '') {
        const btn = document.createElement('div'); btn.className = 'tv-sidebar-trigger'; btn.id = `trigger-${id}`; btn.innerHTML = svgIcon; btn.setAttribute('role', 'button'); btn.setAttribute('aria-label', label || id); c1_bindSidebarTooltip(btn, label || id); sidebarContainer.appendChild(btn);
        PanelManager.registerPanel({ id, panel: panelDOM, trigger: btn, onOpen: clickHook });
        let rightClickHandledAt = 0;
        const activateSidebarButton = (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            c1_hideSidebarTooltip();
            if (id === 'tradegate' && c1_tradeGateWindowEl) c1_closeTradeGateWindow();
            PanelManager.togglePanel(id);
        };
        btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.button && e.button !== 0) return;
            activateSidebarButton(e);
        });
        btn.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
            if (e.button !== 2) return;
            rightClickHandledAt = Date.now();
            activateSidebarButton(e);
        }, true);
        btn.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            if (Date.now() - rightClickHandledAt > 350) activateSidebarButton(e);
        }, true);
        if (sidebarContainer.id === 'tv-custom-sidebar-right') c1_scheduleRightSidebarAlign();
    }

    function c1_getLeftToolbarRect() {
        const candidates = [];
        [
            '[data-name="drawing-toolbar"]',
            '[data-name="left-toolbar"]',
            '[data-name="drawing-toolbar"] > div',
            '[class*="drawing-toolbar"]',
            '[class*="left-toolbar"]'
        ].forEach(selector => {
            try {
                document.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach(el => {
                    if (!c1_isVisibleNode(el)) return;
                    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                    if (rect.width < 36 || rect.width > 96 || rect.height < 240) return;
                    if (rect.left > 160) return;
                    candidates.push(rect);
                });
            } catch (e) {}
        });
        if (!candidates.length) return null;
        candidates.sort((a, b) => {
            const scoreA = Math.abs(a.left) + Math.abs(52 - a.width) + Math.max(0, 260 - a.height);
            const scoreB = Math.abs(b.left) + Math.abs(52 - b.width) + Math.max(0, 260 - b.height);
            return scoreA - scoreB;
        });
        return candidates[0];
    }

    function c1_getRightToolbarRect() {
        const candidates = [];
        [
            '[data-name="right-toolbar"]',
            '[data-name="right-toolbar"] > div',
            '[class*="right-toolbar"]'
        ].forEach(selector => {
            try {
                document.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach(el => {
                    if (!c1_isVisibleNode(el)) return;
                    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                    if (rect.width < 28 || rect.width > 96 || rect.height < 120) return;
                    if (rect.right < window.innerWidth - 160) return;
                    candidates.push(rect);
                });
            } catch (e) {}
        });
        if (!candidates.length) return null;
        candidates.sort((a, b) => {
            const scoreA = Math.abs(window.innerWidth - a.right) + Math.abs(52 - a.width);
            const scoreB = Math.abs(window.innerWidth - b.right) + Math.abs(52 - b.width);
            return scoreA - scoreB;
        });
        return candidates[0];
    }

    function c1_getRightToolbarBottomReserve(toolbarRect) {
        const nodes = [];
        const selectors = [
            'button',
            '[role="button"]',
            '[aria-label*="help" i]',
            '[title*="help" i]',
            '[data-tooltip*="help" i]',
            '[aria-label*="帮助"]',
            '[title*="帮助"]'
        ];
        selectors.forEach(selector => {
            try { document.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach(el => nodes.push(el)); } catch (e) {}
        });
        let reserveTop = null;
        const seen = new Set();
        nodes.forEach(el => {
            const host = el?.closest?.('button, [role="button"]') || el;
            if (!host || seen.has(host) || host.closest?.('#tv-custom-sidebar-right, #tv-custom-sidebar, .tv-side-panel, #tv-settings-panel')) return;
            seen.add(host);
            if (!c1_isVisibleNode(host)) return;
            const rect = host.getBoundingClientRect?.();
            if (!rect || rect.width < 18 || rect.height < 18 || rect.width > 80 || rect.height > 80) return;
            const inRightRail = toolbarRect
                ? rect.left >= toolbarRect.left - 12 && rect.right <= toolbarRect.right + 12
                : rect.right > window.innerWidth - 90;
            if (!inRightRail) return;
            if (rect.bottom < window.innerHeight - 260) return;
            reserveTop = reserveTop === null ? rect.top : Math.min(reserveTop, rect.top);
        });
        return reserveTop === null ? 18 : Math.max(18, window.innerHeight - reserveTop + 8);
    }

    function c1_hideRightProductIcon(root = document) {
        const scanRoot = root && root.querySelectorAll ? root : document;
        const nodes = [];
        const selectors = [
            '[data-name*="product" i]',
            '[aria-label*="product" i]',
            '[title*="product" i]',
            '[data-tooltip*="product" i]',
            '[data-tooltip-text*="product" i]',
            '[aria-label*="broker" i]',
            '[title*="broker" i]',
            '[data-tooltip*="broker" i]',
            '[aria-label*="产品"]',
            '[title*="产品"]',
            '[data-tooltip*="产品"]',
            '[data-tooltip-text*="产品"]',
            'button',
            '[role="button"]'
        ];
        selectors.forEach(selector => {
            try {
                if (scanRoot instanceof HTMLElement && scanRoot.matches?.(selector)) nodes.push(scanRoot);
                scanRoot.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach(el => nodes.push(el));
            } catch (e) {}
        });
        const seen = new Set();
        nodes.forEach(el => {
            if (!el || seen.has(el) || el.closest?.('#tv-custom-sidebar-right, #tv-custom-sidebar, .tv-side-panel, #tv-settings-panel')) return;
            seen.add(el);
            // 不隐藏账户/交易按钮，防止回放 DOM 变化时误隐藏导致"已登出"外观
            const isAccountButton = C1_TV_RUNTIME_SELECTORS.accountButton.some(
                sel => { try { return el.matches(sel); } catch (e) { return false; } }
            );
            if (isAccountButton) return;
            const text = [
                el.getAttribute?.('aria-label'),
                el.getAttribute?.('title'),
                el.getAttribute?.('data-name'),
                el.getAttribute?.('data-tooltip'),
                el.getAttribute?.('data-tooltip-text'),
                el.textContent
            ].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
            if (!/(产品|product|broker)/i.test(text)) return;
            const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect?.();
            if (!rect || rect.width < 18 || rect.height < 18 || rect.width > 82 || rect.height > 82) return;
            if (rect.right < window.innerWidth - 130 || rect.bottom < window.innerHeight - 260) return;
            let target = el;
            let cursor = el;
            for (let hops = 0; hops < 4 && cursor?.parentElement; hops++) {
                const parent = cursor.parentElement;
                if (parent.closest?.('#tv-custom-sidebar-right, #tv-custom-sidebar, .tv-side-panel, #tv-settings-panel')) break;
                const parentRect = parent.getBoundingClientRect?.();
                if (!parentRect || parentRect.width > 96 || parentRect.height > 96 || parentRect.right < window.innerWidth - 150) break;
                target = parent;
                cursor = parent;
            }
            target.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
            target.style.setProperty('visibility', 'hidden', 'important');
            target.style.setProperty('pointer-events', 'none', 'important');
            target.setAttribute('data-tv-control-hidden-product-icon', '1');
        });
    }

    function c1_scheduleRightProductIconCleanup(root = document) {
        const scanRoot = root && root.querySelectorAll
            ? root
            : (root?.parentElement && root.parentElement.querySelectorAll ? root.parentElement : document);
        c1_rightProductIconPendingRoots.add(scanRoot);
        if (c1_rightProductIconScanTimer) return;
        c1_rightProductIconScanTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            c1_rightProductIconScanTimer = null;
            const roots = [...c1_rightProductIconPendingRoots];
            c1_rightProductIconPendingRoots.clear();
            roots.forEach((pendingRoot) => {
                if (pendingRoot === document || pendingRoot?.isConnected) c1_hideRightProductIcon(pendingRoot);
            });
        }, 60);
    }

    function c1_startRightProductIconCleanup() {
        c1_hideRightProductIcon(document);
        [180, 600, 1400, 2600].forEach((delay) => {
            const timer = setTimeout(() => {
                c1_rightProductIconWarmupTimers.delete(timer);
                c1_hideRightProductIcon(document);
            }, delay);
            c1_rightProductIconWarmupTimers.add(timer);
        });
        if (c1_rightProductIconObserver) return;
        c1_rightProductIconObserver = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
            mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
                if (mutation.type !== 'childList') return;
                mutation.addedNodes.forEach((node) => {
                    const root = node instanceof HTMLElement ? node : node.parentElement;
                    if (root) c1_scheduleRightProductIconCleanup(root);
                });
            });
        });
        c1_rightProductIconObserver.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }

    function c1_stopRightProductIconCleanup() {
        if (c1_rightProductIconObserver) {
            c1_rightProductIconObserver.disconnect();
            c1_rightProductIconObserver = null;
        }
        if (c1_rightProductIconScanTimer) {
            clearTimeout(c1_rightProductIconScanTimer);
            c1_rightProductIconScanTimer = null;
        }
        c1_rightProductIconPendingRoots.clear();
        c1_rightProductIconWarmupTimers.forEach(timer => clearTimeout(timer));
        c1_rightProductIconWarmupTimers.clear();
    }

    let c1_routeChangePending = false;
    function c1_handleTradingViewRouteChange() {
        if (c1_routeChangePending) return;
        c1_routeChangePending = true;
        c1_queryCache.clear();
        c1_stopRightProductIconCleanup();
        setTimeout(() => {
            c1_startRightProductIconCleanup();
            c1_routeChangePending = false;
        }, 120);
    }

    function c1_bindTradingViewRouteWatcher() {
        if (c1_bindTradingViewRouteWatcher.bound) return;
        c1_bindTradingViewRouteWatcher.bound = true;
        window.addEventListener('popstate', c1_handleTradingViewRouteChange, { passive: true });
        ['pushState', 'replaceState'].forEach((method) => {
            const original = history[method];
            if (typeof original !== 'function' || original.__tvGccWrapped) return;
            const wrapped = function(...args) {
                const result = original.apply(this, args);
                setTimeout(c1_handleTradingViewRouteChange, 0);
                return result;
            };
            wrapped.__tvGccWrapped = true;
            history[method] = wrapped;
        });
    }

    function c1_alignRightSidebarContainer() {
        const container = document.getElementById('tv-custom-sidebar-right');
        if (!container) return true;
        const toolbarRect = c1_getRightToolbarRect();
        if (!toolbarRect) {
            container.style.right = '0px';
            container.style.width = '52px';
            container.style.top = '';
            container.style.bottom = '';
            return false;
        }
        const toolbarWidth = Math.min(72, Math.max(36, toolbarRect.width));
        const nextRight = Math.max(0, window.innerWidth - toolbarRect.right);
        container.style.right = `${Math.round(nextRight)}px`;
        container.style.width = `${Math.round(toolbarWidth)}px`;
        container.style.top = `${Math.round(Math.max(0, toolbarRect.top))}px`;
        container.style.bottom = `${Math.round(c1_getRightToolbarBottomReserve(toolbarRect))}px`;
        return true;
    }

    function c1_alignLeftSidebarContainer() {
        const container = document.getElementById('tv-custom-sidebar');
        if (!container) return true;
        const toolbarRect = c1_getLeftToolbarRect();
        if (!toolbarRect) {
            container.style.left = '0px';
            container.style.width = '52px';
            container.style.top = '';
            container.style.bottom = '';
            return false;
        }
        const toolbarWidth = Math.min(72, Math.max(36, toolbarRect.width));
        container.style.left = `${Math.round(Math.max(0, toolbarRect.left))}px`;
        container.style.width = `${Math.round(toolbarWidth)}px`;
        container.style.top = `${Math.round(Math.max(0, toolbarRect.top))}px`;
        container.style.bottom = `${Math.round(Math.max(18, window.innerHeight - toolbarRect.bottom))}px`;
        return true;
    }

    function c1_alignSidebarContainers() {
        const leftAligned = c1_alignLeftSidebarContainer();
        const rightAligned = c1_alignRightSidebarContainer();
        return leftAligned && rightAligned;
    }

    function c1_scheduleRightSidebarAlign(retries = 8) {
        if (c1_rightSidebarAlignTimer) clearTimeout(c1_rightSidebarAlignTimer);
        const run = (remaining) => {
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                const aligned = c1_alignSidebarContainers();
                if (!aligned && remaining > 0) c1_rightSidebarAlignTimer = setTimeout(() => run(remaining - 1), 250);
                else c1_rightSidebarAlignTimer = null;
            });
        };
        c1_rightSidebarAlignTimer = setTimeout(() => run(retries), 0);
    }

    function c1_updateSidebarVisibility() {
        const hideForImmersive = c1_immersiveActive && SysConfig.hideSidebarInImmersive !== false;
        if (hideForImmersive) c1_hideSidebarTooltip();
        ['tv-custom-sidebar', 'tv-custom-sidebar-right'].forEach(id => {
            const el = document.getElementById(id);
            if (!el) return;
            const hasTrigger = !!el.querySelector('.tv-sidebar-trigger');
            el.style.display = hasTrigger ? 'flex' : 'none';
            el.classList.toggle('tv-immersive-sidebar-hidden', hasTrigger && hideForImmersive);
        });
    }

    function c1_ensureSidebarContainer(root, side = 'left') {
        const id = side === 'right' ? 'tv-custom-sidebar-right' : 'tv-custom-sidebar';
        let container = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!container) {
            container = document.createElement('div');
            container.id = id;
            root.appendChild(container);
        }
        if (side === 'right') c1_scheduleRightSidebarAlign();
        return PanelManager.registerMountable(container);
    }

    function c1_createPanelShell({
        id,
        title,
        panelClass = 'tv-side-panel tv-custom-themed',
        bodyClass = 'tv-side-panel-content',
        bodyId = '',
        bodyHtml = '',
        titleHtml = false,
        headerActions = null,
        closeClass = 'tv-side-panel-close',
        closeText = '✕'
    }) {
        c1_ensureDeferredPanelStyles();
        const panel = document.createElement('div');
        panel.id = id;
        panel.className = panelClass;

        const header = document.createElement('div');
        header.className = 'tv-side-panel-header';

        const heading = document.createElement('h3');
        if (titleHtml) heading.innerHTML = c1_safeHtml(title);
        else heading.textContent = String(title ?? '');
        header.appendChild(heading);

        const actions = document.createElement('div');
        actions.className = 'tv-side-panel-header-actions';

        const normalizeHeaderAction = (node) => {
            if (!node || node.nodeType !== Node.ELEMENT_NODE) return node;
            node.classList.add('tv-panel-head-btn');
            if (!node.getAttribute('role') && node.tagName !== 'BUTTON') node.setAttribute('role', 'button');
            if (!node.getAttribute('tabindex') && node.tagName !== 'BUTTON') node.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
            return node;
        };

        if (headerActions) {
            if (typeof headerActions === 'string') {
                const wrap = document.createElement('div');
                wrap.innerHTML = c1_safeHtml(headerActions);
                Array.from(wrap.childNodes).forEach(node => actions.appendChild(normalizeHeaderAction(node)));
            } else if (Array.isArray(headerActions)) {
                headerActions.forEach(node => { if (node) actions.appendChild(normalizeHeaderAction(node)); });
            }
        }

        const close = document.createElement('span');
        close.className = closeClass;
        close.textContent = closeText;
        actions.appendChild(close);
        header.appendChild(actions);

        const body = document.createElement('div');
        body.className = bodyClass;
        if (bodyId) body.id = bodyId;
        if (bodyHtml) body.innerHTML = bodyHtml;

        panel.appendChild(header);
        panel.appendChild(body);
        panel.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); });
        close.onclick = c1_closeAllPanels;

        PanelManager.registerMountable(panel);
        return { panel, header, heading, body, close, actions };
    }

    function c1_initTradeGate(tgHost) {
        c1_tradeGateCompactHost = tgHost;
        tgHost.classList.add('tg-compact-host');
        tgHost.style.setProperty('--tg-scale', String(SysConfig.panelScale || 1));
        if (c1_tradeGateCompactUnsubscribe) c1_tradeGateCompactUnsubscribe();
        c1_tradeGateCompactUnsubscribe = c1_getTradeGateStore().subscribe(() => { c1_renderTradeGateCompact(); });
        c1_bindTradeGateCompact(tgHost);
        c1_renderTradeGateCompact();
    }

    function c1_createTradeGateEngine() {
        const STATUS = {
            WAIT_HTF: 'WAIT_HTF',
            DESCEND_TO_MTF: 'DESCEND_TO_MTF',
            WAIT_MTF: 'WAIT_MTF',
            READY_FOR_LTF: 'READY_FOR_LTF',
            READY_TO_EXECUTE: 'READY_TO_EXECUTE',
            INVALIDATED: 'INVALIDATED'
        };
        const ROUTES = { NAV_1: 'NAV_1', NAV_2: 'NAV_2', NAV_3: 'NAV_3', NAV_4: 'NAV_4', NAV_5: 'NAV_5' };
        const QUESTIONS = {
            htf_story_clear: { stage: 'htf' },
            htf_event_reached: { stage: 'htf' },
            htf_fresh_break: { stage: 'htf' },
            htf_open_air: { stage: 'htf' },
            htf_pullback_complex: { stage: 'htf' },
            htf_realigned_trend: { stage: 'htf' },
            htf_retest_new_poi: { stage: 'htf' },
            htf_intentional_countertrend: { stage: 'htf' },
            htf_enough_room: { stage: 'htf' },
            mtf_n1_align: { stage: 'mtf' },
            mtf_n1_return_poi: { stage: 'mtf' },
            mtf_n1_ora: { stage: 'mtf' },
            mtf_n2_align: { stage: 'mtf' },
            mtf_n2_return_poi: { stage: 'mtf' },
            mtf_n2_ora: { stage: 'mtf' },
            mtf_n3_align: { stage: 'mtf' },
            mtf_n3_ora: { stage: 'mtf' },
            mtf_n3_management: { stage: 'mtf' },
            mtf_n4_align: { stage: 'mtf' },
            mtf_n4_ora: { stage: 'mtf' },
            mtf_n4_target: { stage: 'mtf' },
            mtf_n4_dynamic: { stage: 'mtf' },
            mtf_n4_invalidated: { stage: 'mtf' },
            mtf_n5_strong_momentum: { stage: 'mtf' },
            mtf_n5_ref_alive: { stage: 'mtf' }
        };
        const QUESTION_PROGRESS_COUNTS = {
            htf_story_clear: 0,
            htf_event_reached: 1,
            htf_fresh_break: 2,
            htf_open_air: 3,
            htf_pullback_complex: 2,
            htf_realigned_trend: 3,
            htf_retest_new_poi: 4,
            htf_intentional_countertrend: 4,
            htf_enough_room: 5,
            mtf_n1_align: 3,
            mtf_n1_return_poi: 4,
            mtf_n1_ora: 5,
            mtf_n2_align: 5,
            mtf_n2_return_poi: 6,
            mtf_n2_ora: 7,
            mtf_n3_align: 6,
            mtf_n3_ora: 7,
            mtf_n3_management: 8,
            mtf_n4_align: 4,
            mtf_n4_ora: 5,
            mtf_n4_target: 6,
            mtf_n4_dynamic: 7,
            mtf_n4_invalidated: 8
        };
        const ROUTE_QUESTION_COUNTS = { pending: 9, NAV_1: 7, NAV_2: 9, NAV_3: 9, NAV_4: 9, NAV_5: 8 };

        function createRun(meta) {
            return {
                id: `run-${Date.now()}`,
                meta: {
                    symbol: String(meta.symbol || '').trim().toUpperCase(),
                    htfMode: meta.htfMode,
                    direction: meta.direction,
                    note: String(meta.note || '').trim(),
                    startedAt: new Date().toISOString()
                },
                route: null,
                status: STATUS.WAIT_HTF,
                stage: 'htf',
                currentQuestionId: 'htf_story_clear',
                answers: [],
                executionPlan: null,
                result: null,
                completedAt: null,
                lastMessageKey: null
            };
        }

        function cloneRun(run) {
            return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(run));
        }

        function getQuestion(questionId) {
            if (!questionId || !QUESTIONS[questionId]) return null;
            return { id: questionId, ...QUESTIONS[questionId] };
        }

        function getQuestionCount(route) {
            return ROUTE_QUESTION_COUNTS[route || 'pending'];
        }

        function getAnsweredCount(run) {
            if (!run) return 0;
            if (run.currentQuestionId && QUESTION_PROGRESS_COUNTS[run.currentQuestionId] !== undefined) {
                return QUESTION_PROGRESS_COUNTS[run.currentQuestionId];
            }
            if (run.route && (run.stage === 'execution' || run.stage === 'result')) {
                return Math.max(0, getQuestionCount(run.route) - 1);
            }
            const uniqueAnswered = new Set((run.answers || [])
                .map(entry => entry?.questionId)
                .filter(questionId => Boolean(QUESTIONS[questionId])));
            return uniqueAnswered.size;
        }

        function logAnswer(run, questionId, answer, outcomeKey) {
            run.answers = run.answers || [];
            const last = run.answers[run.answers.length - 1];
            if (last && last.questionId === questionId && last.answer === answer && last.outcomeKey === outcomeKey) {
                last.timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
                return;
            }
            run.answers.push({ questionId, answer, outcomeKey, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });
        }

        function setRoute(run, route) {
            run.route = route;
        }

        function setQuestion(run, questionId, status, stage = run.stage) {
            run.currentQuestionId = questionId;
            run.status = status;
            run.stage = stage;
        }

        function processQuestionAnswer(inputRun, answer) {
            const run = cloneRun(inputRun);
            const id = run.currentQuestionId;
            const beforeKey = `${run.stage}|${run.status}|${run.route || ''}|${run.currentQuestionId || ''}`;
            let outcomeKey = 'outcome.no_action';
            switch (id) {
                case 'htf_story_clear':
                    if (answer) {
                        setQuestion(run, 'htf_event_reached', STATUS.WAIT_HTF, 'htf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.continue_required_htf_event';
                    } else {
                        setQuestion(run, 'htf_story_clear', STATUS.WAIT_HTF, 'htf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.wait_htf_story';
                    }
                    break;
                case 'htf_event_reached':
                    if (answer) {
                        setQuestion(run, 'htf_pullback_complex', STATUS.WAIT_HTF, 'htf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.pullback_family_confirmed';
                    } else {
                        setQuestion(run, 'htf_fresh_break', STATUS.WAIT_HTF, 'htf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.check_momentum_family';
                    }
                    break;
                case 'htf_fresh_break':
                    if (answer) {
                        setQuestion(run, 'htf_open_air', STATUS.WAIT_HTF, 'htf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.check_nav4_mtf_follow';
                    } else {
                        setQuestion(run, 'htf_event_reached', STATUS.WAIT_HTF, 'htf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.wait_family_trigger';
                    }
                    break;
                case 'htf_open_air':
                    if (answer) {
                        setRoute(run, ROUTES.NAV_4);
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n4_align', STATUS.DESCEND_TO_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.route_nav4_descend';
                    } else {
                        setQuestion(run, 'htf_event_reached', STATUS.WAIT_HTF, 'htf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.wait_htf_rescan';
                    }
                    break;
                case 'htf_pullback_complex':
                    if (answer) {
                        setQuestion(run, 'htf_realigned_trend', STATUS.WAIT_HTF, 'htf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.complex_pullback_check_nav2_nav3';
                    } else {
                        run.pendingRoute = ROUTES.NAV_1;
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n5_strong_momentum', STATUS.DESCEND_TO_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.check_nav5_momentum';
                    }
                    break;
                case 'htf_realigned_trend':
                    if (answer) {
                        setQuestion(run, 'htf_retest_new_poi', STATUS.WAIT_HTF, 'htf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.htf_realigned_wait_retest';
                    } else {
                        setQuestion(run, 'htf_intentional_countertrend', STATUS.WAIT_HTF, 'htf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.check_nav3_intent';
                    }
                    break;
                case 'htf_retest_new_poi':
                    if (answer) {
                        run.pendingRoute = ROUTES.NAV_2;
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n5_strong_momentum', STATUS.DESCEND_TO_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.check_nav5_momentum';
                    } else {
                        setQuestion(run, 'htf_retest_new_poi', STATUS.WAIT_HTF, 'htf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.wait_htf_retest';
                    }
                    break;
                case 'htf_intentional_countertrend':
                    if (answer) {
                        setQuestion(run, 'htf_enough_room', STATUS.WAIT_HTF, 'htf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.countertrend_intent_ack';
                    } else {
                        setQuestion(run, 'htf_intentional_countertrend', STATUS.WAIT_HTF, 'htf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.wait_no_countertrend';
                    }
                    break;
                case 'htf_enough_room':
                    if (answer) {
                        setRoute(run, ROUTES.NAV_3);
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n3_align', STATUS.DESCEND_TO_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.route_nav3_descend';
                    } else {
                        setQuestion(run, 'htf_enough_room', STATUS.WAIT_HTF, 'htf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.wait_no_room_countertrend';
                    }
                    break;
                case 'mtf_n1_align':
                    if (answer) {
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n1_return_poi', STATUS.WAIT_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.mtf_wait_return_poi';
                    } else {
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n1_align', STATUS.WAIT_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.mtf_wait_alignment';
                    }
                    break;
                case 'mtf_n1_return_poi':
                    if (answer) {
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n1_ora', STATUS.WAIT_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.mtf_check_ora';
                    } else {
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n1_return_poi', STATUS.WAIT_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.mtf_wait_return_poi';
                    }
                    break;
                case 'mtf_n1_ora':
                    if (answer) {
                        run.stage = 'execution';
                        run.currentQuestionId = null;
                        run.status = STATUS.READY_FOR_LTF;
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.open_execution_card';
                    } else {
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n1_ora', STATUS.WAIT_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.mtf_wait_location_quality';
                    }
                    break;
                case 'mtf_n2_align':
                    if (answer) {
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n2_return_poi', STATUS.WAIT_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.mtf_wait_return_poi';
                    } else {
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n2_align', STATUS.WAIT_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.mtf_wait_realign';
                    }
                    break;
                case 'mtf_n2_return_poi':
                    if (answer) {
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n2_ora', STATUS.WAIT_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.mtf_check_ora';
                    } else {
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n2_return_poi', STATUS.WAIT_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.mtf_wait_return_poi';
                    }
                    break;
                case 'mtf_n2_ora':
                    if (answer) {
                        run.stage = 'execution';
                        run.currentQuestionId = null;
                        run.status = STATUS.READY_FOR_LTF;
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.nav2_ready_execution';
                    } else {
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n2_ora', STATUS.WAIT_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.mtf_wait_location_quality';
                    }
                    break;
                case 'mtf_n3_align':
                    if (answer) {
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n3_ora', STATUS.WAIT_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.mtf_check_ora';
                    } else {
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n3_align', STATUS.WAIT_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.mtf_wait_countertrend_alignment';
                    }
                    break;
                case 'mtf_n3_ora':
                    if (answer) {
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n3_management', STATUS.WAIT_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.nav3_lock_management';
                    } else {
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n3_ora', STATUS.WAIT_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.mtf_wait_location_quality';
                    }
                    break;
                case 'mtf_n3_management':
                    if (answer) {
                        run.stage = 'execution';
                        run.currentQuestionId = null;
                        run.status = STATUS.READY_FOR_LTF;
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.nav3_ready_execution';
                    } else {
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n3_management', STATUS.WAIT_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.wait_define_management';
                    }
                    break;
                case 'mtf_n4_align':
                    if (answer) {
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n4_ora', STATUS.WAIT_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.mtf_check_ora';
                    } else {
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n4_align', STATUS.WAIT_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.wait_cleaner_continuation';
                    }
                    break;
                case 'mtf_n4_ora':
                    if (answer) {
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n4_target', STATUS.WAIT_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.nav4_define_target';
                    } else {
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n4_ora', STATUS.WAIT_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.mtf_wait_location_quality';
                    }
                    break;
                case 'mtf_n4_target':
                    if (answer) {
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n4_dynamic', STATUS.WAIT_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.nav4_define_follow';
                    } else {
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n4_target', STATUS.WAIT_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.wait_define_target';
                    }
                    break;
                case 'mtf_n4_dynamic':
                    if (answer) {
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n4_invalidated', STATUS.WAIT_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.nav4_final_kill_check';
                    } else {
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n4_dynamic', STATUS.WAIT_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.wait_define_follow';
                    }
                    break;
                case 'mtf_n4_invalidated':
                    if (answer) {
                        run.stage = 'result';
                        run.currentQuestionId = null;
                        run.status = STATUS.INVALIDATED;
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.nav4_invalidated';
                    } else {
                        run.stage = 'execution';
                        run.currentQuestionId = null;
                        run.status = STATUS.READY_FOR_LTF;
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.nav4_ready_execution';
                    }
                    break;
                case 'mtf_n5_strong_momentum':
                    if (answer) {
                        setRoute(run, ROUTES.NAV_5);
                        setQuestion(run, 'mtf_n5_ref_alive', STATUS.WAIT_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.nav5_check_ref';
                        delete run.pendingRoute;
                    } else {
                        const fallbackRoute = run.pendingRoute === ROUTES.NAV_2 ? ROUTES.NAV_2 : ROUTES.NAV_1;
                        const fallbackQuestion = fallbackRoute === ROUTES.NAV_2 ? 'mtf_n2_align' : 'mtf_n1_align';
                        setRoute(run, fallbackRoute);
                        setQuestion(run, fallbackQuestion, STATUS.DESCEND_TO_MTF, 'mtf');
                        outcomeKey = fallbackRoute === ROUTES.NAV_2 ? 'outcome.route_nav2_descend' : 'outcome.route_nav1_descend';
                        delete run.pendingRoute;
                    }
                    break;
                case 'mtf_n5_ref_alive':
                    if (answer) {
                        run.stage = 'execution';
                        run.currentQuestionId = null;
                        run.status = STATUS.READY_FOR_LTF;
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.nav5_ready_execution';
                    } else {
                        run.stage = 'result';
                        run.currentQuestionId = null;
                        run.status = STATUS.INVALIDATED;
                        outcomeKey = 'outcome.nav5_invalidated';
                    }
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
