            const afterKey = `${run.stage}|${run.status}|${run.route || ''}|${run.currentQuestionId || ''}`;
            const last = run.answers?.[run.answers.length - 1];
            if (beforeKey !== afterKey || !last || last.questionId !== id || last.answer !== answer || last.outcomeKey !== outcomeKey) {
                logAnswer(run, id, answer, outcomeKey);
            }
            return run;
        }

        function replayAnswers(meta, answers) {
            let run = createRun(meta);
            (answers || [])
                .filter(entry => QUESTIONS[entry.questionId])
                .forEach(entry => {
                    run = processQuestionAnswer(run, entry.answer);
                });
            return run;
        }

        function lockExecutionPlan(inputRun, plan) {
            const run = cloneRun(inputRun);
            run.executionPlan = { ...plan };
            if (!plan.ltfTriggerPrinted) {
                run.status = STATUS.READY_FOR_LTF;
                run.stage = 'execution';
                return { run, messageKey: 'execution_wait_ltf_trigger' };
            }
            if (!plan.stopAnchored) {
                run.status = STATUS.INVALIDATED;
                run.stage = 'result';
                return { run, messageKey: 'execution_invalid_stop' };
            }
            if (!plan.beLocked || !plan.tpLocked) {
                run.status = STATUS.READY_FOR_LTF;
                run.stage = 'execution';
                return { run, messageKey: 'execution_wait_management_lock' };
            }
            run.status = STATUS.READY_TO_EXECUTE;
            run.stage = 'result';
            return { run, messageKey: 'execution_authorized' };
        }

        function invalidateRun(inputRun, reasonKey = 'manual_invalidation') {
            const run = cloneRun(inputRun);
            run.status = STATUS.INVALIDATED;
            run.stage = 'result';
            run.currentQuestionId = null;
            run.answers = run.answers || [];
            run.answers.push({
                questionId: 'manual_invalidation',
                answer: true,
                outcomeKey: reasonKey,
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            });
            return run;
        }

        function finalizeRun(inputRun, result) {
            const run = cloneRun(inputRun);
            run.result = { ...result };
            run.completedAt = new Date().toISOString();
            return run;
        }

        return {
            STATUS,
            ROUTES,
            createRun,
            finalizeRun,
            getAnsweredCount,
            getQuestion,
            getQuestionCount,
            invalidateRun,
            lockExecutionPlan,
            processQuestionAnswer,
            replayAnswers
        };
    }

    function c1_tradeGateEscape(value) {
        return String(value ?? '')
            .replaceAll('&', '&amp;')
            .replaceAll('<', '&lt;')
            .replaceAll('>', '&gt;')
            .replaceAll('"', '&quot;')
            .replaceAll("'", '&#39;');
    }

    function c1_formatTradeGateSymbol(value) {
        const full = String(value || '').trim().toUpperCase();
        const short = full.includes(':') ? full.split(':').pop() : full;
        return {
            full,
            short: short || full
        };
    }

    function c1_normalizeTradeGateSymbolIdentity(raw) {
        return String(raw || '')
            .trim()
            .toUpperCase()
            .split(':')
            .pop()
            .replace(/^.*\//, '')
            .replace(/\.P$/, '')
            .replace(/PERP$/, '')
            .replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '');
    }

    function c1_detectTradeGateLiveSymbol() {
        const snapshot = c1_getTVStateBridge().getChartState(true);
        if (snapshot?.symbol) return c1_normalizeTradeGateSymbolIdentity(snapshot.symbol);
        try {
            const path = location.pathname || '';
            const chartMatch = path.match(/\/chart\/[^/]+\/([^/?#]+)/i);
            if (chartMatch) return c1_normalizeTradeGateSymbolIdentity(decodeURIComponent(chartMatch[1]));
            const symbolMatch = path.match(/\/symbols\/([^/?#]+)/i);
            if (symbolMatch) return c1_normalizeTradeGateSymbolIdentity(decodeURIComponent(symbolMatch[1]));
        } catch (e) {}
        const titleMatch = String(document.title || '').toUpperCase().match(/\b[A-Z0-9]{2,20}(?:USDT|USD)(?:\.P|PERP)?\b/);
        return titleMatch ? c1_normalizeTradeGateSymbolIdentity(titleMatch[0]) : '';
    }

    function c1_getTradeGateContextMismatch(run) {
        const locked = c1_normalizeTradeGateSymbolIdentity(run?.meta?.symbol);
        const live = c1_detectTradeGateLiveSymbol();
        return locked && live && locked !== live ? { locked, live } : null;
    }

    function c1_blockMismatchedTradeGateProgress(run) {
        const mismatch = c1_getTradeGateContextMismatch(run);
        if (!mismatch) return false;
        SharedTV.showToast(c1_lang(
            `Locked to ${mismatch.locked}; switch back or start a new run.`,
            `已锁定 ${mismatch.locked}；请切回或新建检查。`
        ), true);
        return true;
    }

    function c1_tradeGateSymbolHTML(value, className = '') {
        const symbol = c1_formatTradeGateSymbol(value);
        const cls = className ? ` class="${c1_tradeGateEscape(className)}"` : '';
        const title = symbol.full && symbol.full !== symbol.short ? ` title="${c1_tradeGateEscape(symbol.full)}"` : '';
        return `<span${cls}${title}>${c1_tradeGateEscape(symbol.short || value)}</span>`;
    }

    function c1_safeHtml(value) {
        const template = document.createElement('template');
        template.innerHTML = String(value ?? '');
        template.content.querySelectorAll('script, iframe, object, embed, link, meta, style').forEach(node => node.remove());
        const urlAttrs = new Set(['href', 'src', 'xlink:href', 'formaction', 'action']);
        template.content.querySelectorAll('*').forEach(node => {
            Array.from(node.attributes || []).forEach(attr => {
                const name = attr.name.toLowerCase();
                const rawValue = String(attr.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
                if (name === 'srcdoc' || name.startsWith('on') || (urlAttrs.has(name) && /^(javascript:|data:text\/html)/i.test(rawValue))) {
                    node.removeAttribute(attr.name);
                }
            });
        });
        return template.innerHTML;
    }

    function c1_createTradeGateStore() {
        const Engine = c1_createTradeGateEngine();
        const runtime = c1_readTradeGateRuntime();
        const listeners = new Set();
        const state = {
            currentRun: runtime.currentRun || null,
            history: Array.isArray(runtime.history) ? runtime.history.slice(0, C1_TRADE_GATE_MAX_HISTORY) : [],
            settings: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(c1_ensureTradeGateConfig().settings)),
            view: 'main',
            archiveNotice: null
        };
        const store = {
            Engine,
            state,
            getText() {
                return c1_buildTradeGateText(SysConfig.lang);
            },
            subscribe(listener) {
                listeners.add(listener);
                return () => listeners.delete(listener);
            },
            emit() {
                listeners.forEach(listener => {
                    try { listener(this.state); } catch (e) {}
                });
            },
            syncSettingsFromConfig(emit = false) {
                state.settings = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(c1_ensureTradeGateConfig().settings));
                if (emit) this.emit();
            },
            persistRuntime() {
                c1_writeTradeGateRuntime({ currentRun: state.currentRun, history: state.history });
            },
            persistSettings() {
                state.settings = c1_normalizeTradeGateSettings(state.settings);
                SysConfig.tradeGate = { settings: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state.settings)) };
                c1_saveConfig();
            },
            setView(view) {
                state.view = view;
                this.emit();
            },
            clearRun() {
                state.currentRun = null;
                state.archiveNotice = null;
                state.view = 'main';
                this.persistRuntime();
                this.emit();
            },
            archive(run) {
                state.history = [run, ...state.history.filter(item => item.id !== run.id)].slice(0, C1_TRADE_GATE_MAX_HISTORY);
                state.currentRun = null;
                state.archiveNotice = this.getText().archivedToast(state.history.length);
                state.view = 'main';
                this.persistRuntime();
                this.emit();
            },
            answer(answer) {
                if (!state.currentRun) return;
                state.currentRun = Engine.processQuestionAnswer(state.currentRun, answer);
                this.persistRuntime();
                this.emit();
            },
            goBack() {
                if (!state.currentRun) return;
                const run = state.currentRun;
                const preserveId = (nextRun) => { nextRun.id = run.id; return nextRun; };
                if (run.stage === 'execution') {
                    state.currentRun = preserveId(Engine.replayAnswers(run.meta, (run.answers || []).slice(0, -1)));
                } else if (run.stage === 'result' && run.executionPlan) {
                    const answers = (run.answers || []).filter(entry => Engine.getQuestion(entry.questionId));
                    state.currentRun = preserveId(Engine.replayAnswers(run.meta, answers));
                    state.currentRun.executionPlan = {
                        ...(run.executionPlan || {}),
                        ltfTriggerPrinted: false,
                        stopAnchored: false,
                        beLocked: false,
                        tpLocked: false
                    };
                    state.currentRun.stage = 'execution';
                    state.currentRun.status = Engine.STATUS.READY_FOR_LTF;
                    state.currentRun.lastMessageKey = null;
                    state.currentRun.result = null;
                    state.currentRun.completedAt = null;
                } else if ((run.answers || []).length) {
                    state.currentRun = preserveId(Engine.replayAnswers(run.meta, run.answers.slice(0, -1)));
                } else {
                    state.currentRun = null;
                }
                this.persistRuntime();
                this.emit();
            },
            manualInvalidate() {
                if (!state.currentRun) return;
                state.currentRun = Engine.invalidateRun(state.currentRun);
                state.currentRun.lastMessageKey = 'manual_invalidation';
                this.persistRuntime();
                this.emit();
            },
            endReview() {
                if (!state.currentRun) return false;
                this.archive(Engine.finalizeRun(state.currentRun, {
                    executed: false,
                    ruleBroken: false,
                    stoppedAt: state.currentRun.stage || 'result',
                    notExecutedReason: 'manual_abort',
                    pnlR: '',
                    comfortScore: '',
                    notes: ''
                }));
                return true;
            },
            submitStart(payload) {
                const symbol = String(payload.symbol || '').trim();
                if (!symbol) return false;
                state.currentRun = Engine.createRun({
                    symbol,
                    htfMode: payload.htfMode,
                    direction: payload.direction,
                    note: payload.note || ''
                });
                state.archiveNotice = null;
                this.persistRuntime();
                this.emit();
                return true;
            },
            submitExecution(payload) {
                if (!state.currentRun) return false;
                const result = Engine.lockExecutionPlan(state.currentRun, payload);
                state.currentRun = result.run;
                state.currentRun.lastMessageKey = String(result.messageKey || '');
                this.persistRuntime();
                this.emit();
                return true;
            },
            submitResult(payload) {
                if (!state.currentRun) return false;
                this.archive(Engine.finalizeRun(state.currentRun, payload));
                return true;
            },
            saveSettings(nextSettings) {
                state.settings = c1_normalizeTradeGateSettings({ ...state.settings, ...nextSettings });
                this.persistSettings();
                state.view = 'main';
                this.emit();
                return true;
            },
            exportHistory() {
                c1_downloadJsonFile(`trade-gate-history-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.json`, state.history);
            },
            clearHistory() {
                state.history = [];
                state.archiveNotice = null;
                this.persistRuntime();
                this.emit();
                SharedTV.showToast(this.getText().historyCleared);
                return true;
            }
        };
        return store;
    }

    function c1_getTradeGateStore() {
        if (!c1_tradeGateStore) c1_tradeGateStore = c1_createTradeGateStore();
        return c1_tradeGateStore;
    }

    function c1_getTradeGateSnapshot() {
        const store = c1_getTradeGateStore();
        store.syncSettingsFromConfig();
        return {
            Engine: store.Engine,
            Text: store.getText(),
            runtime: {
                currentRun: store.state.currentRun,
                history: store.state.history
            },
            settings: store.state.settings,
            store
        };
    }

    function c1_tradeGateQuestionText(textMap, id) {
        if (id === 'manual_invalidation') return textMap.msg.manual_invalidation;
        return textMap.questionMap[id] || id || textMap.noData;
    }

    function c1_tradeGateRouteText(textMap, id) {
        return textMap.routeText[id] || textMap.noData;
    }

    function c1_tradeGateBranchLabel(textMap, questionId, fallbackStage = 'htf') {
        const id = String(questionId || '');
        const familyText = textMap.familyText || {};
        if (id === 'htf_story_clear') return familyText.htfFilter || String(fallbackStage || 'HTF').toUpperCase();
        if (['htf_event_reached', 'htf_pullback_complex', 'htf_realigned_trend', 'htf_retest_new_poi', 'htf_intentional_countertrend', 'htf_enough_room'].includes(id)) {
            return familyText.pullback || String(fallbackStage || 'HTF').toUpperCase();
        }
        if (['htf_fresh_break', 'htf_open_air'].includes(id)) {
            return familyText.momentum || String(fallbackStage || 'HTF').toUpperCase();
        }
        return String(fallbackStage || 'HTF').toUpperCase();
    }

    function c1_tradeGateStatusText(textMap, id) {
        return textMap.statusTextMap[id] || id || textMap.noData;
    }

    function c1_tradeGateStatusCopy(textMap, id) {
        return textMap.statusCopyMap[id] || textMap.noData;
    }

    function c1_renderTradeGateCompact() {
        if (!c1_tradeGateCompactHost) return;
        const { Engine, Text, runtime, settings } = c1_getTradeGateSnapshot();
        const run = runtime.currentRun || null;
        const host = c1_tradeGateCompactHost;
        const symbolHint = (() => {
            try {
                const titleMatch = (document.title || '').toUpperCase().match(/\b[A-Z0-9]{2,20}(?:USDT|USD)(?:\.P|PERP)?\b/);
                return titleMatch ? titleMatch[0].replace(/\.P$/, '').replace(/PERP$/, '') : '';
            } catch (e) { return ''; }
        })();
        const quickSymbols = settings.symbolPresets || [];
        let bodyHtml = '';

        if (!run) {
            bodyHtml = `
                <section class="tg-compact-card tg-compact-hero">
                    <p class="tg-compact-kicker">${c1_tradeGateEscape(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Quick Decision' : '快速决策')}</p>
                    <h4 class="tg-compact-question">${c1_tradeGateEscape(Text.noRun)}</h4>
                    <p class="tg-compact-muted">${c1_tradeGateEscape(Text.noRunBody)}</p>
                    ${symbolHint ? `<div class="tg-compact-status"><span class="tg-compact-pill">${c1_tradeGateEscape(Text.tvSymbolHint)}</span><span class="tg-compact-pill">${c1_tradeGateEscape(symbolHint)}</span></div>` : ''}
                </section>
                <form class="tg-compact-card" id="tg-compact-start-form">
                    <div class="tg-compact-grid">
                        <label class="tg-compact-field">
                            <span>${c1_tradeGateEscape(Text.symbol)}</span>
                            <input name="symbol" value="${c1_tradeGateEscape(symbolHint || settings.defaultSymbol || '')}" required />
                        </label>
                        <label class="tg-compact-field">
                            <span>${c1_tradeGateEscape(Text.htfMode)}</span>
                            <select name="htfMode">${(settings.htfPresets || []).map(item => `<option value="${c1_tradeGateEscape(item)}"${item === settings.defaultHtfMode ? ' selected' : ''}>${c1_tradeGateEscape(item)}</option>`).join('')}</select>
                        </label>
                    </div>
                    <label class="tg-compact-field">
                        <span>${c1_tradeGateEscape(Text.direction)}</span>
                        <select name="direction">
                            <option value="bullish"${settings.defaultDirection === 'bullish' ? ' selected' : ''}>${c1_tradeGateEscape(Text.option.bullish)}</option>
                            <option value="bearish"${settings.defaultDirection === 'bearish' ? ' selected' : ''}>${c1_tradeGateEscape(Text.option.bearish)}</option>
                        </select>
                    </label>
                    ${quickSymbols.length ? `<div class="tg-compact-chips">${quickSymbols.map(item => `<button type="button" class="tg-compact-chip" data-action="fill-symbol" data-value="${c1_tradeGateEscape(item)}">${c1_tradeGateEscape(item)}</button>`).join('')}</div>` : ''}
                    <div class="tg-compact-actions">
                        <button type="submit" class="tg-compact-btn tg-compact-btn-primary">${c1_tradeGateEscape(Text.start)}</button>
                        <button type="button" class="tg-compact-btn tg-compact-btn-soft" data-action="open-full">${c1_tradeGateEscape(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Open Checklist' : '打开检查单')}</button>
                    </div>
                </form>
            `;
        } else if (run.stage === 'execution') {
            bodyHtml = `
                <section class="tg-compact-card tg-compact-hero">
                    <div class="tg-compact-status">
                        <span class="tg-compact-pill">${c1_tradeGateEscape(c1_tradeGateRouteText(Text, run.route))}</span>
                        <span class="tg-compact-pill">${c1_tradeGateEscape(c1_tradeGateStatusText(Text, run.status))}</span>
                    </div>
                    <p class="tg-compact-kicker">${c1_tradeGateEscape(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Hand Off' : '切换到执行')}</p>
                    <h4 class="tg-compact-question">${c1_tradeGateEscape(Text.executionReadyTitle)}</h4>
                    <p class="tg-compact-muted">${c1_tradeGateEscape(c1_tradeGateStatusCopy(Text, run.status))}</p>
                </section>
                <section class="tg-compact-card">
                    <div class="tg-compact-status">
                        ${c1_tradeGateSymbolHTML(run.meta.symbol, 'tg-compact-pill')}
                        <span class="tg-compact-pill">${c1_tradeGateEscape(run.meta.htfMode)}</span>
                        <span class="tg-compact-pill">${c1_tradeGateEscape(Text.option[run.meta.direction])}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="tg-compact-actions">
                        <button type="button" class="tg-compact-btn tg-compact-btn-primary" data-action="open-full">${c1_tradeGateEscape(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Open Full Checklist' : '打开完整检查单')}</button>
                        <button type="button" class="tg-compact-btn tg-compact-btn-soft" data-action="reset-run">${c1_tradeGateEscape(Text.newRun)}</button>
                    </div>
                </section>
            `;
        } else if (run.stage === 'result') {
            bodyHtml = `
                <section class="tg-compact-card tg-compact-hero">
                    <div class="tg-compact-status">
                        <span class="tg-compact-pill">${c1_tradeGateEscape(run.route ? c1_tradeGateRouteText(Text, run.route) : Text.invalidTitle)}</span>
                        <span class="tg-compact-pill">${c1_tradeGateEscape(c1_tradeGateStatusText(Text, run.status))}</span>
                    </div>
                    <p class="tg-compact-kicker">${c1_tradeGateEscape(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Result' : '结果')}</p>
                    <h4 class="tg-compact-question">${c1_tradeGateEscape(Text.invalidTitle)}</h4>
                    <p class="tg-compact-muted">${c1_tradeGateEscape(c1_tradeGateStatusCopy(Text, run.status))}</p>
                </section>
                <section class="tg-compact-card">
                    <div class="tg-compact-actions">
                        <button type="button" class="tg-compact-btn tg-compact-btn-primary" data-action="reset-run">${c1_tradeGateEscape(Text.newRun)}</button>
                        <button type="button" class="tg-compact-btn tg-compact-btn-soft" data-action="open-full">${c1_tradeGateEscape(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Open Full Review' : '打开全版复盘')}</button>
                    </div>
                </section>
            `;
        } else {
            const question = Engine.getQuestion(run.currentQuestionId);
            bodyHtml = `
                <section class="tg-compact-card tg-compact-hero">
                    <div class="tg-compact-status">
                        <span class="tg-compact-pill">${c1_tradeGateEscape(run.route ? c1_tradeGateRouteText(Text, run.route) : c1_tradeGateBranchLabel(Text, question?.id, question?.stage || 'HTF'))}</span>
                        <span class="tg-compact-pill">${c1_tradeGateEscape(c1_tradeGateStatusText(Text, run.status))}</span>
                    </div>
                    <p class="tg-compact-kicker">${c1_tradeGateEscape(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Current Question' : '当前判断')}</p>
                    <h4 class="tg-compact-question">${c1_tradeGateEscape(c1_tradeGateQuestionText(Text, question?.id))}</h4>
                    <p class="tg-compact-muted">${c1_tradeGateEscape(c1_tradeGateStatusCopy(Text, run.status))}</p>
                </section>
                <section class="tg-compact-card">
                    <div class="tg-compact-status">
                        ${c1_tradeGateSymbolHTML(run.meta.symbol, 'tg-compact-pill')}
                        <span class="tg-compact-pill">${c1_tradeGateEscape(run.meta.htfMode)}</span>
                        <span class="tg-compact-pill">${c1_tradeGateEscape(Text.option[run.meta.direction])}</span>
                        <span class="tg-compact-pill">${c1_tradeGateEscape(`${Engine.getAnsweredCount(run)} / ${Engine.getQuestionCount(run.route)}`)}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="tg-compact-actions">
                        <button type="button" class="tg-compact-btn tg-compact-btn-success" data-action="answer" data-value="yes">${c1_tradeGateEscape(Text.answerYes)}</button>
                        <button type="button" class="tg-compact-btn tg-compact-btn-danger" data-action="answer" data-value="no">${c1_tradeGateEscape(Text.answerNo)}</button>
                    </div>
                    <div class="tg-compact-actions">
                        <button type="button" class="tg-compact-btn tg-compact-btn-soft" data-action="invalidate">${c1_tradeGateEscape(Text.invalidate)}</button>
                        <button type="button" class="tg-compact-btn tg-compact-btn-soft" data-action="open-full">${c1_tradeGateEscape(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Open Full Checklist' : '打开完整检查单')}</button>
                    </div>
                </section>
            `;
        }

        const contextMismatch = c1_getTradeGateContextMismatch(run);
        if (contextMismatch) {
            const warning = SysConfig.lang === 'en'
                ? `Locked to ${contextMismatch.locked}; current chart: ${contextMismatch.live}.`
                : `已锁定 ${contextMismatch.locked}；当前为 ${contextMismatch.live}。`;
            bodyHtml = `<section class="tg-compact-card tg-compact-hero" role="alert"><p class="tg-compact-kicker">${c1_tradeGateEscape(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Symbol mismatch' : '品种不一致')}</p><p class="tg-compact-muted">${c1_tradeGateEscape(warning)}</p></section>${bodyHtml}`;
        }

        host.innerHTML = `
            <div class="tg-scale-frame"><div class="tg-compact-shell">
                <div class="tg-compact-head">
                    <p class="tg-compact-meta">${c1_tradeGateEscape(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Quick Decision Surface' : '盘中极简决策面')}</p>
                </div>
                <div class="tg-compact-body">${bodyHtml}</div>
            </div></div>
        `;
        c1_styleSelects(host);
    }

    function c1_stopTradeGateWindowSymbolRefresh() {
        if (c1_tradeGateWindowSymbolTimer) clearInterval(c1_tradeGateWindowSymbolTimer);
        c1_tradeGateWindowSymbolTimer = null;
    }

    function c1_startTradeGateWindowSymbolRefresh(renderFn) {
        c1_stopTradeGateWindowSymbolRefresh();
        if (typeof renderFn !== 'function') return;
        c1_tradeGateWindowSymbolTimer = setInterval(() => {
            if (!c1_tradeGateWindowEl || !c1_tradeGateWindowEl.isConnected) {
                c1_stopTradeGateWindowSymbolRefresh();
                return;
            }
            renderFn();
        }, PERF_CONFIG.tradeScanMs);
    }

    function c1_bindTradeGateCompact(tgHost) {
        if (!tgHost || tgHost.dataset.tgCompactBound === '1') return;
        tgHost.dataset.tgCompactBound = '1';
        tgHost.addEventListener('click', async (event) => {
            const actionEl = event.target.closest('[data-action]');
            if (!actionEl || !tgHost.contains(actionEl)) return;
            const store = c1_getTradeGateStore();
            const Text = store.getText();
            const action = actionEl.dataset.action;
            if (action === 'fill-symbol') {
                const input = tgHost.querySelector('#tg-compact-start-form [name="symbol"]');
                if (input) input.value = actionEl.dataset.value || '';
                return;
            }
            if (action === 'open-full') {
                c1_openTradeGateWindow();
                return;
            }
            if (action === 'reset-run') {
                if (store.state.currentRun) {
                    const ok = await c1_showDangerConfirm({
                        title: Text.discardRunTitle,
                        body: Text.discardRunBody,
                        confirmText: Text.newRun,
                        cancelText: SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Cancel' : '取消'
                    });
                    if (!ok) return;
                }
                store.clearRun();
                return;
            }
            if (action === 'invalidate' && store.state.currentRun) {
                const ok = await c1_showDangerConfirm({
                    title: Text.invalidateTitle,
                    body: Text.invalidateBody,
                    confirmText: Text.invalidate,
                    cancelText: SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Cancel' : '取消'
                });
                if (!ok) return;
                store.manualInvalidate();
                return;
            }
            if (action === 'end' && store.state.currentRun) {
                const ok = await c1_showDangerConfirm({
                    title: Text.endReviewTitle,
                    body: Text.endReviewBody,
                    confirmText: Text.endReview,
                    cancelText: SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Cancel' : '取消'
                });
                if (!ok) return;
                store.endReview();
                return;
            }
            if (action === 'answer' && store.state.currentRun) {
                if (c1_blockMismatchedTradeGateProgress(store.state.currentRun)) return;
                store.answer(actionEl.dataset.value === 'yes');
            }
        });
        tgHost.addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
            const form = event.target;
            if (!(form instanceof HTMLFormElement) || form.id !== 'tg-compact-start-form') return;
            event.preventDefault();
            c1_markSubmitting(form);
            const data = new FormData(form);
            const symbol = c1_normalizeTradeGateSymbolIdentity(data.get('symbol'));
            if (!symbol) return;
            const liveSymbol = c1_detectTradeGateLiveSymbol();
            if (liveSymbol && liveSymbol !== symbol) {
                SharedTV.showToast(c1_lang(
                    `Current chart: ${liveSymbol}. Use it or switch charts.`,
                    `当前为 ${liveSymbol}；请使用该品种或切换图表。`
                ), true);
                return;
            }
            c1_getTradeGateStore().submitStart({
                symbol,
                htfMode: data.get('htfMode'),
                direction: data.get('direction'),
                note: ''
            });
        });
    }

    function c1_closeTradeGateWindow({ immediate = false } = {}) {
        if (c1_tradeGateWindowEl) {
            const closingEl = c1_tradeGateWindowEl;
            if (closingEl.dataset.closing === '1') return;
            closingEl.dataset.closing = '1';
            c1_cleanupPortaledMenus();
            closingEl.classList.remove('show');
            const cleanup = () => {
                if (typeof closingEl.__tgCleanup === 'function') closingEl.__tgCleanup();
                c1_stopTradeGateWindowSymbolRefresh();
                PanelManager.unregisterMountable(closingEl);
                if (closingEl.parentElement) closingEl.remove();
                if (c1_tradeGateWindowEl === closingEl) c1_tradeGateWindowEl = null;
                c1_renderTradeGateCompact();
                c1_refreshTradeScanLoop();
                c1_syncOverlayStackState();
            };
            if (immediate) cleanup();
            else setTimeout(cleanup, 265);
        }
    }

    function c1_destroySettingsPanelNow({ persist = true } = {}) {
        const panel = document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel');
        if (!panel) return;
        document.removeEventListener('mousedown', c1_handleSettingsOutsidePointer, true);
        c1_cleanupPortaledMenus();
        if (c1_settingsAutoSaveTimer) { clearTimeout(c1_settingsAutoSaveTimer); c1_settingsAutoSaveTimer = null; }
        c1_captureSettingsUiState(panel);
        if (persist) c1_persistSettingsPanelState(panel);
        c1_recordingId = null;
        c2_recordingId = null;
        c1_recordingButton = null;
        if (c1_clockInterval) { clearInterval(c1_clockInterval); c1_clockInterval = null; }
        panel.remove();
        c1_syncOverlayStackState();
    }

    function c1_isTypingTarget(target) {
        if (!target || target.nodeType !== 1) return false;
        if (target.isContentEditable || target.closest?.('[contenteditable="true"], [role="textbox"]')) return true;
        return ['INPUT', 'TEXTAREA', 'SELECT'].includes(target.tagName);
    }

    function c1_shouldBypassGlobalShortcut(e, isRecording = false) {
        if (!e) return true;
        if (e.isComposing || Number(e.keyCode) === 229 || Number(e.which) === 229) return true;
        try { if (e.getModifierState?.('AltGraph')) return true; } catch (error) {}
        // Escape remains available for closing the active overlay even when focus is inside it.
        if (e.key === 'Escape' || e.code === 'Escape') return false;
        const pathTarget = e.composedPath?.().find?.((node) => node?.nodeType === 1) || e.target;
        // Tab is a user-managed shortcut (watchlist by default). Preserve native
        // focus movement only while the user is actively editing a text field.
        if (e.key === 'Tab' || e.code === 'Tab') return !isRecording && c1_isTypingTarget(pathTarget);
        if (isRecording) return false;
        return c1_isTypingTarget(pathTarget);
    }

    function c1_handleTradeGateCompactKeydown(e) {
        if (!c1_activePanel || c1_activePanel.id !== 'panel-tradegate') return false;
        if (c1_isTypingTarget(e.target)) return false;
        const run = c1_getTradeGateStore().state.currentRun;
        const click = (selector) => {
            const btn = document.querySelector(selector);
            if (!btn) return false;
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            btn.click();
            return true;
        };
        if (!run && e.code === 'Enter') {
            return click('#panel-tradegate #tg-compact-start-form [type="submit"]');
        }
        if (!run) return false;
        if ((run.stage === 'htf' || run.stage === 'mtf') && (e.code === 'Enter' || e.code === 'Space')) {
            return click('#panel-tradegate [data-action="answer"][data-value="yes"]');
        }
        if ((run.stage === 'htf' || run.stage === 'mtf') && e.code === 'Backspace') {
            return click('#panel-tradegate [data-action="answer"][data-value="no"]');
        }
        if ((run.stage === 'htf' || run.stage === 'mtf') && e.code === 'KeyX') {
            return click('#panel-tradegate [data-action="invalidate"]');
        }
        if ((run.stage === 'execution' || run.stage === 'result') && e.code === 'Enter') {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            c1_openTradeGateWindow();
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    function c1_openTradeGateWindow() {
        c1_ensureDeferredPanelStyles();
        if (c1_tradeGateWindowEl) {
            return;
        }
        c1_destroySettingsPanelNow();
        PanelManager.closePanel('tradegate');
        c1_closeAllPanels();
        const overlay = document.createElement('div');
        overlay.id = 'tv-tradegate-window';
        overlay.className = 'tv-custom-themed is-opening';
        overlay.innerHTML = `<div class="tg-window-stage"><div class="tg-window-frame"><div id="tv-tradegate-window-host" class="tv-tradegate-surface tv-tradegate-full"></div></div></div>`;
        overlay.addEventListener('mousedown', (event) => {
            if (event.target === overlay) c1_closeTradeGateWindow();
        });
        getUIRoot().appendChild(overlay);
        c1_tradeGateWindowEl = overlay;
        const tradeGateScale = Math.max(0.7, Math.min(1.3, Number(SysConfig.panelScale) || 1));
        overlay.style.setProperty('--tg-scale', String(tradeGateScale));
        overlay.style.setProperty('--tg-entry-scale', String(tradeGateScale * 0.925));
        PanelManager.registerMountable(overlay);
        c1_applyTheme();
        c1_createTradeGateApp(overlay.querySelector('#tv-tradegate-window-host'));
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            if (!overlay.isConnected) return;
            overlay.classList.add('show');
            c1_mountToggleMotion(overlay);
        });
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (overlay.isConnected) overlay.classList.remove('is-opening');
        }, 280);
        c1_refreshTradeScanLoop();
        c1_syncOverlayStackState();
    }

    function c1_createTradeGateApp(tgHost) {
        const store = c1_getTradeGateStore();
        const Engine = store.Engine;
        let Text = store.getText();
        const state = store.state;
        let c1_lastTradeGateRenderedView = null;

        const {
            STATUS,
            ROUTES,
            createRun,
            finalizeRun,
            getAnsweredCount,
            getQuestion,
            getQuestionCount,
            invalidateRun,
            lockExecutionPlan,
            processQuestionAnswer,
            replayAnswers
        } = Engine;

        const OPTIONS = {
            direction: ['bullish', 'bearish'],
            mtfConfirmationType: ['ibos', 'bos_3c', 'ora', 'no_idm'],
            entryType: ['limit', 'market'],
            entryTrigger: ['ltf_bos', 'ltf_choch_2bos', 'demand_holds', 'supply_fails', 'v_rebound_entry1', 'v_rebound_entry2', 'v_rebound_entry3'],
            orderType: ['limit', 'market'],
            stopBasis: ['ltf_poi', 'swing', 'supply_demand', 'structure', 'ref_mtf_a', 'ref_mtf_recent_low', 'sweep_low'],
            beBasis: ['mtf_ibos', 'weak_point', 'fixed_r', 'none'],
            tpBasis: ['htf_weak', 'mtf_weak', 'dynamic_follow', 'partial'],
            executionMode: ['ltf_refined', 'mtf_direct'],
            nav5RefSituation: ['situation_1', 'situation_2', 'situation_3', 'situation_4'],
            refMtfSituation: ['situation_1', 'situation_2', 'situation_3', 'situation_4'],
            nav3SubType: ['nav3_standard', 'nav3_bidirectional'],
            notExecutedReason: ['setup_cancelled', 'no_fill', 'news_filter', 'session_end', 'manual_abort', 'invalidated'],
            stoppedAt: ['none', 'htf', 'mtf', 'execution', 'result']
        };

        const tgText = (key) => Text[key] ?? key;
        const tgGet = (selector) => tgHost.querySelector(selector);

        function escapeHtml(value) {
            return String(value ?? '')
                .replaceAll('&', '&amp;')
                .replaceAll('<', '&lt;')
                .replaceAll('>', '&gt;')
                .replaceAll('"', '&quot;')
                .replaceAll("'", '&#39;');
        }

        function normalizeDetectedSymbol(raw) {
            return c1_normalizeTradeGateSymbolIdentity(raw);
        }

        function detectTradingViewSymbol() {
            return c1_detectTradeGateLiveSymbol();
        }

        function getDisplayedTradeGateSymbol(fallback = '') {
            // Once a run exists its symbol is an immutable audit context. Live
            // chart state is displayed separately as a mismatch warning.
            return fallback || detectTradingViewSymbol() || '';
        }

        let c1_lastTradeGateDisplayedSymbol = detectTradingViewSymbol();

        function persistRuntime() { store.persistRuntime(); }

        function persistSettings() { store.persistSettings(); }

        function questionText(id) {
            if (id === 'manual_invalidation') return Text.msg.manual_invalidation;
            return Text.questionMap[id] || id || tgText('noData');
        }

        function routeText(id) {
            return Text.routeText[id] || tgText('noData');
        }

        function statusText(id) {
            return Text.statusTextMap[id] || id || tgText('noData');
        }

        function statusCopy(id, run) {
            if (run && run.route && Text.routeStatusCopy && Text.routeStatusCopy[run.route] && Text.routeStatusCopy[run.route][id]) {
                return Text.routeStatusCopy[run.route][id];
            }
            return Text.statusCopyMap[id] || tgText('noData');
        }

        function optionText(id) {
            return Text.option[id] || id || tgText('noData');
        }

        function messageText(id) {
            return id ? Text.msg[id] || id : '';
        }

        function yesNo(value) {
            if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return tgText('noData');
            if (SysConfig.lang === 'en') return value ? 'Yes' : 'No';
            return value ? '是' : '否';
        }

        function tone(status) {
            if (status === STATUS.DESCEND_TO_MTF) return 'state-descend';
            if (status === STATUS.READY_FOR_LTF || status === STATUS.READY_TO_EXECUTE) return 'state-ready';
            if (status === STATUS.INVALIDATED) return 'state-invalid';
            return 'state-wait';
        }

        function progressStageText(stage) {
            if (stage === 'start') return SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Start' : '开始';
            if (stage === 'htf') return 'HTF';
            if (stage === 'mtf') return 'MTF';
            if (stage === 'execution') return tgText('execution');
            if (stage === 'result') return tgText('result');
            return String(stage || '').toUpperCase();
        }

        function buildProgressSteps(run) {
            const order = ['start', 'htf', 'mtf', 'execution', 'result'];
            const current = run?.currentQuestionId ? getQuestion(run.currentQuestionId)?.stage || run.stage || 'start' : run?.stage || 'start';
            const currentIndex = order.indexOf(current);
            return order.map((stage, index) => {
                let stateName = 'pending';
                if (!run && stage === 'start') stateName = 'current';
                else if (run) {
                    if (index < currentIndex) stateName = 'done';
                    if (index === currentIndex) stateName = 'current';
                    if (current === 'htf' && stage === 'start') stateName = 'done';
                }
                return { label: progressStageText(stage), state: stateName };
            });
        }

        function renderProgressTrack(run) {
            return `<ol class="tg-progress-track">${buildProgressSteps(run).map(item => `<li class="tg-progress-step tg-is-${item.state}"><span class="tg-progress-dot"></span><span>${escapeHtml(item.label)}</span></li>`).join('')}</ol>`;
        }

        function orderedAnswers(run) {
            return [...(run?.answers || [])].sort((a, b) => (Date.parse(a.timestamp || '') || 0) - (Date.parse(b.timestamp || '') || 0));
        }

        function recentDisplayAnswers(run) {
            const byQuestion = new Map();
            orderedAnswers(run).forEach(answer => {
                if (!answer?.questionId) return;
                byQuestion.set(answer.questionId, answer);
            });
            return Array.from(byQuestion.values())
                .sort((a, b) => (Date.parse(a.timestamp || '') || 0) - (Date.parse(b.timestamp || '') || 0));
        }

        function answerLabelsForQuestion(questionId) {
            const custom = Text.answerLabels?.[questionId];
            if (custom?.yes && custom?.no) return custom;
            return { yes: tgText('answerYes'), no: tgText('answerNo') };
        }

        function selectField(name, label, values, selected, rawText = false) {
            return `<label class="tg-field"><span>${escapeHtml(label)}</span><select name="${escapeHtml(name)}">${values.map(value => `<option value="${escapeHtml(value)}"${selected === value ? ' selected' : ''}>${escapeHtml(rawText ? value : optionText(value))}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>`;
        }

        function symbolField(value) {
            const listId = 'tg-symbol-presets';
            return `<label class="tg-field"><span>${escapeHtml(tgText('symbol'))}</span><input name="symbol" type="text" list="${listId}" value="${escapeHtml(value)}" required /><datalist id="${listId}">${state.settings.symbolPresets.map(symbol => `<option value="${escapeHtml(symbol)}"></option>`).join('')}</datalist></label>`;
        }

        function textAreaField(name, label, value, rows = 3) {
            return `<label class="tg-field"><span>${escapeHtml(label)}</span><textarea name="${escapeHtml(name)}" rows="${rows}">${escapeHtml(value)}</textarea></label>`;
        }

        function boolField(name, label, current, fallback, onLabel, offLabel) {
            const resolved = current === undefined || current === null || current === '' ? Boolean(fallback) : Boolean(current);
            return `<div class="tg-bool-field"><span class="tg-bool-label">${escapeHtml(label)}</span><div class="tg-segment tv-toggle-motion" data-bool-name="${escapeHtml(name)}"><input type="hidden" name="${escapeHtml(name)}" value="${resolved ? 'true' : 'false'}" /><button type="button" class="tg-toggle${resolved ? ' is-active' : ''}" data-action="set-bool" data-bool-value="true">${escapeHtml(onLabel)}</button><button type="button" class="tg-toggle${!resolved ? ' is-active' : ''}" data-action="set-bool" data-bool-value="false">${escapeHtml(offLabel)}</button></div></div>`;
        }

        function toBool(value) {
            return String(value) === 'true';
        }

        function formatRunTime(run) {
            const raw = run?.completedAt || run?.meta?.startedAt || '';
            const date = raw ? new Date(raw) : null;
            if (!date || Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return tgText('noData');
            return date.toLocaleString(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'en-US' : 'zh-CN', {
                hour12: false,
                year: 'numeric',
                month: '2-digit',
                day: '2-digit',
                hour: '2-digit',
                minute: '2-digit'
            });
        }

        function renderStateBanner(run) {
            const label = run.route ? routeText(run.route) : c1_tradeGateBranchLabel(Text, run.currentQuestionId, run.stage);
            const progress = run.route ? `${getAnsweredCount(run)} / ${getQuestionCount(run.route)}` : '';
            return `<div class="tg-banner tg-status-strip ${tone(run.status)}"><strong>${escapeHtml(label)}</strong><span class="tg-pill">${escapeHtml(statusText(run.status))}</span>${progress ? `<span class="tg-pill tg-progress-pill">${escapeHtml(progress)}</span>` : ''}<p>${escapeHtml(statusCopy(run.status, run))}</p></div>`;
        }

        function renderContextMismatch(run) {
            const mismatch = c1_getTradeGateContextMismatch(run);
            if (!mismatch) return '';
            const message = SysConfig.lang === 'en'
                ? `Run locked to ${mismatch.locked}; current chart is ${mismatch.live}. Progress is paused until you switch back or start a new run.`
                : `已锁定 ${mismatch.locked}；当前为 ${mismatch.live}。切回或新建检查。`;
            return `<div class="tg-banner tg-status-strip state-invalid tg-context-mismatch" role="alert"><strong>${escapeHtml(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Symbol mismatch' : '品种不一致')}</strong><p>${escapeHtml(message)}</p></div>`;
        }

        function renderMeta(run) {
            if (!run) {
                return `<section class="tg-card cp-card tg-hero"><p class="tg-kicker">${escapeHtml(tgText('current'))}</p><div class="tg-screen-head"><h3>${escapeHtml(tgText('noRun'))}</h3><p>${escapeHtml(tgText('startHint'))}</p></div>${renderProgressTrack(null)}</section>`;
            }
            const symbol = c1_formatTradeGateSymbol(getDisplayedTradeGateSymbol(run.meta.symbol));
            const symbolTitle = symbol.full && symbol.full !== symbol.short ? ` title="${escapeHtml(symbol.full)}"` : '';
            return `<section class="tg-card cp-card tg-meta-card"><div class="tg-rail-head"><p class="tg-kicker">${escapeHtml(tgText('current'))}</p><span class="tg-pill">${escapeHtml(statusText(run.status))}</span></div><div class="tg-detail-grid"><div><strong${symbolTitle}>${escapeHtml(symbol.short)}</strong><p>${escapeHtml(tgText('symbol'))}</p></div><div><strong>${escapeHtml(run.meta.htfMode)}</strong><p>${escapeHtml(tgText('htfMode'))}</p></div><div><strong>${escapeHtml(optionText(run.meta.direction))}</strong><p>${escapeHtml(tgText('direction'))}</p></div></div>${renderProgressTrack(run)}</section>`;
        }

        function renderTrail(run) {
            const answers = recentDisplayAnswers(run).slice(-6);
            if (answers.length < 2) return '';
            return `<section class="tg-card cp-card tg-trail-card"><div class="tg-rail-head"><p class="tg-kicker">${escapeHtml(tgText('answerTrail'))}</p><span class="tg-pill">${answers.length}</span></div><ol class="tg-trail-list">${answers.map(answer => `<li class="tg-trail-item"><span class="tg-trail-dot ${answer.answer ? 'is-yes' : 'is-no'}"></span><span class="tg-trail-question">${escapeHtml(questionText(answer.questionId))}</span><strong class="tg-trail-answer">${escapeHtml(yesNo(answer.answer))}</strong></li>`).join('')}</ol></section>`;
        }

        function renderPlan(run) {
            const plan = run?.executionPlan;
            if (!plan) return '';
            const rows = [
                [tgText('mtfConfirmationType'), optionText(plan.mtfConfirmationType)],
                [tgText('executionMode'), optionText(plan.executionMode)]
            ];
            if (plan.entryTrigger) {
                rows.push([tgText('entryTrigger'), optionText(plan.entryTrigger)]);
            }
            rows.push(
                [tgText('orderType'), optionText(plan.orderType || plan.entryType)],
                [tgText('stopBasis'), optionText(plan.stopBasis)],
                [tgText('beBasis'), optionText(plan.beBasis)],
                [tgText('tpBasis'), optionText(plan.tpBasis)]
            );
            if (plan.vRebound) {
                rows.push([tgText('vRebound'), tgText('confirmYes')]);
            }
            const refMtfValue = plan.refMtfSituation || plan.nav5RefSituation;
            if ((run.route === ROUTES.NAV_5 || run.route === ROUTES.NAV_4) && refMtfValue) {
                rows.push([tgText('refMtfSituation'), optionText(refMtfValue)]);
            }
            if (run.route === ROUTES.NAV_3 && plan.nav3SubType) {
                rows.push([tgText('nav3SubType'), optionText(plan.nav3SubType)]);
            }
            return `<section class="tg-card cp-card tg-plan-card"><div class="tg-rail-head"><p class="tg-kicker">${escapeHtml(tgText('plan'))}</p><span class="tg-pill">${rows.length}</span></div><div class="tg-plan-list">${rows.map(([label, value]) => `<div class="tg-plan-row"><span>${escapeHtml(label)}</span><strong>${escapeHtml(value)}</strong></div>`).join('')}</div></section>`;
        }

        function renderHistorySheet() {
            if (!state.history.length) {
                return `<div class="tg-view"><section class="tg-card cp-card tg-empty-state"><div class="tg-screen-head"><p class="tg-kicker">${escapeHtml(tgText('historyTitle'))}</p><h3>${escapeHtml(tgText('historyCount')(0))}</h3><p>${escapeHtml(tgText('historyEmpty'))}</p></div><div class="tg-actions"><button type="button" class="tg-btn tg-btn-ghost" data-action="go-main">${escapeHtml(tgText('flowView'))}</button></div></section></div>`;
            }
            return `<div class="tg-view"><section class="tg-card cp-card tg-history-toolbar"><div class="tg-screen-head"><p class="tg-kicker">${escapeHtml(tgText('historyTitle'))}</p><h3>${escapeHtml(tgText('historyCount')(state.history.length))}</h3><p>${escapeHtml(tgText('historySubtitle'))}</p></div><div class="tg-actions"><button type="button" class="tg-btn tg-btn-primary" data-action="export-history">${escapeHtml(tgText('exportHistory'))}</button><button type="button" class="tg-btn tg-btn-warn" data-action="clear-history">${escapeHtml(tgText('clearHistory'))}</button><button type="button" class="tg-btn tg-btn-ghost" data-action="go-main">${escapeHtml(tgText('flowView'))}</button></div></section><section class="tg-history-list">${state.history.map(run => {
                const note = run?.result?.notes || run?.meta?.note || '';
                const pnl = run?.result?.pnlR ? String(run.result.pnlR).trim() : tgText('noData');
                const statusClass = run?.status === STATUS.INVALIDATED ? 'is-invalid' : 'is-ready';
                return `<article class="tg-card cp-card tg-history-item ${statusClass}"><div class="tg-history-head"><div><p class="tg-kicker">${escapeHtml(tgText('archivedAt'))}</p><h4>${escapeHtml(run?.meta?.symbol || tgText('noData'))}</h4><p class="tg-muted">${escapeHtml(formatRunTime(run))}</p></div><div class="tg-toolbar-meta"><span class="tg-pill">${escapeHtml(run?.route ? routeText(run.route) : tgText('current'))}</span><span class="tg-pill">${escapeHtml(statusText(run?.status))}</span></div></div><div class="tg-history-summary"><div><strong>${escapeHtml(run?.route ? routeText(run.route) : tgText('current'))}</strong><p>${escapeHtml(tgText('route'))}</p></div><div><strong>${escapeHtml(statusText(run?.status))}</strong><p>${escapeHtml(tgText('statusLabel'))}</p></div><div><strong>${escapeHtml(yesNo(run?.result?.executed))}</strong><p>${escapeHtml(tgText('executed'))}</p></div><div><strong>${escapeHtml(pnl)}</strong><p>${escapeHtml(tgText('pnlR'))}</p></div></div>${note ? `<p class="tg-history-note"><strong>${escapeHtml(tgText('note'))}:</strong> ${escapeHtml(note)}</p>` : ''}</article>`;
            }).join('')}</section></div>`;
        }

        function renderStartPreview() {
            const previewTitle = tgText('startPreviewTitle');
            const symbol = detectTradingViewSymbol() || state.settings.defaultSymbol || tgText('noData');
            const detailRows = [
                [tgText('symbol'), symbol, 'symbol'],
                [tgText('htfMode'), state.settings.defaultHtfMode || tgText('noData'), 'htfMode'],
                [tgText('direction'), optionText(state.settings.defaultDirection), 'direction'],
                [tgText('statusLabel'), SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Ready' : '准备', 'status']
            ];
            const detailHtml = detailRows.map(([label, value, key]) => {
                const display = key === 'symbol' ? c1_formatTradeGateSymbol(value) : null;
                const title = display?.full && display.full !== display.short ? ` title="${escapeHtml(display.full)}"` : '';
                return `<div><span>${escapeHtml(label)}</span><strong data-start-preview="${escapeHtml(key)}"${title}>${escapeHtml(display ? display.short : value)}</strong></div>`;
            }).join('');
            return `<section class="tg-card cp-card tg-start-preview-card"><div class="tg-rail-head"><p class="tg-kicker">${escapeHtml(tgText('current'))}</p><span class="tg-pill">${escapeHtml(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Ready' : '准备')}</span></div><div class="tg-start-preview-title">${escapeHtml(previewTitle)}</div><div class="tg-start-preview-detail-grid">${detailHtml}</div>${renderProgressTrack(null)}</section>`;
        }

        function renderStartCard() {
            const detected = detectTradingViewSymbol();
            const symbol = detected || state.settings.defaultSymbol;
            const startCopy = SysConfig.lang === 'en'
                ? ['Trade Setup', 'Quick Symbols', 'Optional Note', 'Keep context only when it helps execution.']
                : ['交易基础', '快捷品种', '可选备注', '只有确实有助于执行时再写。'];
            const quickSymbols = state.settings.symbolPresets.length
                ? `<section class="tg-start-section tg-start-section-quick"><div class="tg-exec-section-head"><strong>${escapeHtml(startCopy[1])}</strong></div><div class="tg-chips">${state.settings.symbolPresets.map(symbolPreset => `<button type="button" class="tg-chip" data-action="use-symbol" data-value="${escapeHtml(symbolPreset)}">${escapeHtml(symbolPreset)}</button>`).join('')}</div></section>`
                : '';
            return `<section class="tg-card cp-card tg-hero tg-stage-card tg-start-card tg-start-launch-card"><div class="tg-start-launch-head"><div class="tg-screen-head"><p class="tg-kicker">${escapeHtml(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Ready Check' : '准备检查')}</p><h3>${escapeHtml(tgText('noRun'))}</h3><p>${escapeHtml(tgText('noRunBody'))}</p></div></div>${state.archiveNotice ? `<p class="tg-notice">${escapeHtml(state.archiveNotice)}</p>` : ''}${detected ? `<p class="tg-muted tg-start-detected">${escapeHtml(tgText('tvSymbolHint'))}: <strong>${escapeHtml(detected)}</strong></p>` : ''}<form id="tg-start-form" class="tg-stack tg-start-form"><section class="tg-start-section tg-start-core-section"><div class="tg-exec-section-head"><strong>${escapeHtml(startCopy[0])}</strong></div><div class="tg-field-grid tg-start-grid">${symbolField(symbol)}${selectField('htfMode', tgText('htfMode'), state.settings.htfPresets, state.settings.defaultHtfMode, true)}${selectField('direction', tgText('direction'), OPTIONS.direction, state.settings.defaultDirection)}</div>${quickSymbols ? `<div class="tg-start-quick-inline">${quickSymbols}</div>` : ''}</section><details class="tg-start-note-wrap"><summary><strong>${escapeHtml(startCopy[2])}</strong><span>${escapeHtml(startCopy[3])}</span></summary><div class="tg-start-note">${textAreaField('note', tgText('note'), '', 2)}</div></details><div class="tg-card tg-card--flex cp-card tg-flow-footer tg-start-footer"><p class="tg-muted">${escapeHtml(tgText('startHint'))}</p><div class="tg-actions"><button class="tg-btn tg-btn-primary tg-start-primary" type="submit">${escapeHtml(tgText('start'))}</button></div></div></form></section>`;
        }

        function renderQuestionCard(run) {
            const question = getQuestion(run.currentQuestionId);
            const answers = answerLabelsForQuestion(question?.id);
            const contextMismatch = c1_getTradeGateContextMismatch(run);
            const answerAvailability = contextMismatch
                ? ` aria-disabled="true" title="${escapeHtml(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? `Switch back to ${contextMismatch.locked} to continue` : `切回 ${contextMismatch.locked} 后继续检查`)}"`
                : '';
            const symbol = c1_formatTradeGateSymbol(getDisplayedTradeGateSymbol(run.meta.symbol));
            const symbolTitle = symbol.full && symbol.full !== symbol.short ? ` title="${escapeHtml(symbol.full)}"` : '';
            const context = `
                <div class="tg-question-context">
                    <span>${escapeHtml(tgText('symbol'))}: <strong${symbolTitle}>${escapeHtml(symbol.short || tgText('noData'))}</strong></span>
                    <span>${escapeHtml(tgText('htfMode'))}: <strong>${escapeHtml(run.meta.htfMode || tgText('noData'))}</strong></span>
                    <span>${escapeHtml(tgText('direction'))}: <strong>${escapeHtml(optionText(run.meta.direction))}</strong></span>
                </div>
            `;
            const structureNotesMap = tgText('routeStructureNotes');
            const structureNote = structureNotesMap && run.route ? structureNotesMap[run.route] : '';
            const structureBlock = structureNote ? `<div class="tg-exec-structure-note" data-route="${escapeHtml(run.route)}"><span class="tg-exec-structure-note-label">${escapeHtml(tgText('routeStructureNotesTitle'))}</span><p>${escapeHtml(structureNote)}</p></div>` : '';
            return `<section class="tg-card cp-card tg-hero tg-stage-card tg-question-card">${renderStateBanner(run)}<div class="tg-screen-head"><div class="tg-question-meta"><p class="tg-kicker">${escapeHtml(tgText('question'))}</p></div><h3>${escapeHtml(questionText(question?.id))}</h3><p>${escapeHtml(statusCopy(run.status, run))}</p></div>${context}${structureBlock}<div class="tg-answer-grid"><button type="button" class="tg-answer tg-answer-yes" data-action="answer" data-value="yes"${answerAvailability}>${escapeHtml(answers.yes)}</button><button type="button" class="tg-answer tg-answer-no" data-action="answer" data-value="no"${answerAvailability}>${escapeHtml(answers.no)}</button></div><div class="tg-card tg-card--flex cp-card tg-flow-footer"><p class="tg-muted">${escapeHtml(tgText('startHint'))}</p><div class="tg-actions"><button type="button" class="tg-btn tg-btn-ghost" data-action="back">${escapeHtml(tgText('back'))}</button><button type="button" class="tg-btn tg-btn-warn" data-action="invalidate">${escapeHtml(tgText('invalidate'))}</button><button type="button" class="tg-btn tg-btn-ghost" data-action="end">${escapeHtml(tgText('endReview'))}</button></div></div></section>`;
        }

        function renderExecutionCard(run) {
            const plan = run.executionPlan || {};
            const orderTypeValue = plan.orderType || plan.entryType || 'limit';
            const entryTriggerValue = plan.entryTrigger || 'ltf_bos';
            const entryFields = `${selectField('mtfConfirmationType', tgText('mtfConfirmationType'), OPTIONS.mtfConfirmationType, plan.mtfConfirmationType || 'ibos')}${selectField('executionMode', tgText('executionMode'), OPTIONS.executionMode, plan.executionMode || 'ltf_refined')}${selectField('entryTrigger', tgText('entryTrigger'), OPTIONS.entryTrigger, entryTriggerValue)}${selectField('orderType', tgText('orderType'), OPTIONS.orderType, orderTypeValue)}`;
            const managementFields = `${selectField('stopBasis', tgText('stopBasis'), OPTIONS.stopBasis, plan.stopBasis || 'ltf_poi')}${selectField('beBasis', tgText('beBasis'), OPTIONS.beBasis, plan.beBasis || 'mtf_ibos')}${selectField('tpBasis', tgText('tpBasis'), OPTIONS.tpBasis, plan.tpBasis || 'htf_weak')}${(run.route === ROUTES.NAV_5 || run.route === ROUTES.NAV_4) ? selectField('refMtfSituation', tgText('refMtfSituation'), OPTIONS.refMtfSituation, plan.refMtfSituation || plan.nav5RefSituation || 'situation_1') : ''}${run.route === ROUTES.NAV_3 ? selectField('nav3SubType', tgText('nav3SubType'), OPTIONS.nav3SubType, plan.nav3SubType || 'nav3_standard') : ''}`;
            const vReboundEligible = run.route === ROUTES.NAV_1 || run.route === ROUTES.NAV_2 || run.route === ROUTES.NAV_4;
            const vReboundCheck = vReboundEligible ? boolField('vRebound', tgText('vRebound'), plan.vRebound, false, tgText('confirmYes'), tgText('confirmNo')) : '';
            const checks = `${boolField('ltfTriggerPrinted', tgText('ltfTriggerPrinted'), plan.ltfTriggerPrinted, false, tgText('confirmYes'), tgText('confirmNo'))}${boolField('stopAnchored', tgText('stopAnchored'), plan.stopAnchored, false, tgText('confirmYes'), tgText('confirmNo'))}${boolField('beLocked', tgText('beLocked'), plan.beLocked, false, tgText('confirmYes'), tgText('confirmNo'))}${boolField('tpLocked', tgText('tpLocked'), plan.tpLocked, false, tgText('confirmYes'), tgText('confirmNo'))}${vReboundCheck}`;
            const tpHintMap = tgText('routeTpHint');
            const tpHintText = tpHintMap && run.route ? tpHintMap[run.route] : '';
            const tpHintBlock = tpHintText ? `<div class="tg-exec-tp-hint" data-route="${escapeHtml(run.route)}"><span class="tg-exec-tp-hint-label">${escapeHtml(tgText('routeTpHintTitle'))}</span><p>${escapeHtml(tpHintText)}</p>${plan.vRebound ? `<p class="tg-exec-tp-hint-vreb">${escapeHtml(tgText('vReboundHint'))}</p>` : ''}</div>` : '';
            return `<section class="tg-card cp-card tg-hero tg-stage-card tg-ready tg-execution-card"><div class="tg-screen-head tg-exec-head"><p class="tg-kicker">${escapeHtml(tgText('execution'))}</p><h3>${escapeHtml(run.route ? routeText(run.route) : tgText('executionReadyTitle'))}</h3></div>${tpHintBlock}<form id="tg-exec-form" class="tg-stack tg-exec-form"><section class="tg-exec-section tg-exec-plan"><div class="tg-exec-section-head"><strong>${escapeHtml(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Core Execution' : '核心执行')}</strong></div><div class="tg-field-grid tg-exec-primary-grid">${entryFields}</div><div class="tg-exec-subsection"><div class="tg-exec-section-head tg-exec-subhead"><strong>${escapeHtml(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Management Rules' : '管理依据')}</strong></div><div class="tg-field-grid tg-exec-management-grid">${managementFields}</div></div></section><section class="tg-exec-section tg-exec-checks"><div class="tg-exec-section-head"><strong>${escapeHtml(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Rule Checklist' : '规则确认')}</strong></div><div class="tg-bool-grid">${checks}</div></section><div class="tg-exec-bottom"><div class="tg-exec-note">${textAreaField('note', tgText('note'), plan.note || '', 1)}</div><div class="tg-card tg-card--flex cp-card tg-execution-footer"><p class="tg-muted">${escapeHtml(messageText(run.lastMessageKey) || statusCopy(run.status, run))}</p><div class="tg-actions"><button type="button" class="tg-btn tg-btn-ghost" data-action="back">${escapeHtml(tgText('back'))}</button><button type="button" class="tg-btn tg-btn-warn" data-action="invalidate">${escapeHtml(tgText('invalidate'))}</button><button class="tg-btn tg-btn-primary" type="submit">${escapeHtml(tgText('lockPlan'))}</button></div></div></div></form></section>`;
        }

        function renderResultCard(run) {
            const result = run.result || {};
            const title = run.status === STATUS.INVALIDATED ? tgText('invalidTitle') : (run.route ? routeText(run.route) : tgText('executionReadyTitle'));
            const toneClass = run.status === STATUS.INVALIDATED ? 'tg-invalid' : 'tg-ready';
            const resultCopy = SysConfig.lang === 'en'
                ? ['Outcome', 'Review']
                : ['结果状态', '复盘记录'];
            return `<section class="tg-card cp-card tg-hero tg-stage-card tg-result-card ${toneClass}">${renderStateBanner(run)}<div class="tg-screen-head"><p class="tg-kicker">${escapeHtml(tgText('result'))}</p><h3>${escapeHtml(title)}</h3><p>${escapeHtml(messageText(run.lastMessageKey) || statusCopy(run.status, run))}</p></div><form id="tg-result-form" class="tg-stack"><div class="tg-result-layout"><section class="tg-result-section"><div class="tg-exec-section-head"><strong>${escapeHtml(resultCopy[0])}</strong></div><div class="tg-field-grid tg-result-grid">${boolField('executed', tgText('executed'), result.executed, false, tgText('executedYes'), tgText('executedNo'))}${boolField('ruleBroken', tgText('ruleBroken'), result.ruleBroken, false, tgText('brokenYes'), tgText('brokenNo'))}${selectField('stoppedAt', tgText('stoppedAt'), OPTIONS.stoppedAt, result.stoppedAt || 'result')}${selectField('notExecutedReason', tgText('notExecutedReason'), OPTIONS.notExecutedReason, result.notExecutedReason || (run.status === STATUS.INVALIDATED ? 'invalidated' : 'setup_cancelled'))}</div></section><section class="tg-result-section"><div class="tg-exec-section-head"><strong>${escapeHtml(resultCopy[1])}</strong></div><div class="tg-field-grid tg-result-metrics"><label class="tg-field"><span>${escapeHtml(tgText('pnlR'))}</span><input name="pnlR" type="text" value="${escapeHtml(result.pnlR ?? '')}" /></label><label class="tg-field"><span>${escapeHtml(tgText('comfort'))}</span><input name="comfortScore" type="text" value="${escapeHtml(result.comfortScore ?? '')}" /></label></div>${textAreaField('resultNotes', tgText('resultNotes'), result.notes || '', 3)}</section></div><div class="tg-card tg-card--flex cp-card tg-flow-footer tg-result-footer"><p class="tg-muted">${escapeHtml(messageText(run.lastMessageKey) || statusCopy(run.status, run))}</p><div class="tg-actions"><button type="button" class="tg-btn tg-btn-ghost" data-action="back">${escapeHtml(tgText('back'))}</button><button class="tg-btn tg-btn-primary" type="submit">${escapeHtml(tgText('archive'))}</button></div></div></form></section>`;
        }

        function renderSettingsSheet() {
            const isEn = SysConfig.lang === 'en';
            const hotkeyCard = `<section class="tg-settings-panel-card tg-settings-hotkeys"><div class="tg-settings-section-head"><strong>${escapeHtml(isEn ? 'Hotkeys' : '快捷键')}</strong></div><div class="tg-settings-hotkey-list"><div class="tg-settings-hotkey-row"><span>${escapeHtml(tgText('summonHotkey'))}</span><strong>${escapeHtml(SysConfig.tools.tradegate || t('unbound'))}</strong></div><div class="tg-settings-hotkey-row"><span>${escapeHtml(isEn ? 'Full Window Hotkey' : '全版浮窗热键')}</span><strong>${escapeHtml(SysConfig.tools.tradegateFull || t('unbound'))}</strong></div></div><p class="tg-muted">${escapeHtml(tgText('followsGlobalLang'))}</p><div class="tg-actions"><button type="button" class="tg-btn tg-btn-ghost" data-action="open-control-settings">${escapeHtml(tgText('openControlSettings'))}</button></div></section>`;
            const presetsCard = `<section class="tg-settings-panel-card tg-settings-presets"><div class="tg-settings-section-head"><strong>${escapeHtml(isEn ? 'Presets' : '预设列表')}</strong></div><div class="tg-stack">${textAreaField('symbolPresets', tgText('symbolPresets'), state.settings.symbolPresets.join(', '), 2)}${textAreaField('htfPresets', tgText('htfPresets'), state.settings.htfPresets.join(', '), 2)}</div></section>`;
            const defaultsCard = `<section class="tg-settings-panel-card tg-settings-defaults is-wide"><div class="tg-settings-section-head"><strong>${escapeHtml(isEn ? 'Defaults' : '默认项')}</strong></div><div class="tg-field-grid">${selectField('defaultHtfMode', tgText('defaultHtf'), state.settings.htfPresets, state.settings.defaultHtfMode, true)}${selectField('defaultDirection', tgText('defaultDir'), OPTIONS.direction, state.settings.defaultDirection)}<label class="tg-field"><span>${escapeHtml(tgText('defaultSymbol'))}</span><input name="defaultSymbol" value="${escapeHtml(state.settings.defaultSymbol)}" /></label></div><div class="tg-settings-section-head"><strong>${escapeHtml(tgText('execDefaults'))}</strong></div><p class="tg-muted">${escapeHtml(isEn ? 'Safety confirmations are never prefilled. Every run requires four fresh confirmations.' : '安全确认不再使用默认值；每次运行都必须重新完成四项确认。')}</p></section>`;
            return `<div class="tg-view tg-settings-view"><section class="tg-card cp-card tg-settings-sheet"><div class="tg-screen-head"><p class="tg-kicker">${escapeHtml(tgText('settingsTitle'))}</p><h3>${escapeHtml(tgText('settingsSubtitle'))}</h3><p>${escapeHtml(tgText('managedByControl'))}</p></div><form id="tg-settings-form" class="tg-stack tg-settings-form"><div class="tg-settings-grid">${hotkeyCard}${presetsCard}${defaultsCard}</div><div class="tg-card tg-card--flex cp-card tg-flow-footer tg-settings-actions"><p class="tg-muted">${escapeHtml(isEn ? 'Save here only changes Trade Gate defaults.' : '这里仅保存 Trade Gate 自身默认项。')}</p><div class="tg-actions"><button type="button" class="tg-btn tg-btn-ghost" data-action="go-main">${escapeHtml(tgText('flowView'))}</button><button type="submit" class="tg-btn tg-btn-primary">${escapeHtml(tgText('saveSettings'))}</button></div></div></form></section></div>`;
        }

        function renderMainView() {
            const coreCard = !state.currentRun
                ? renderStartCard()
                : state.currentRun.stage === 'execution'
                    ? renderExecutionCard(state.currentRun)
                    : state.currentRun.stage === 'result'
                        ? renderResultCard(state.currentRun)
                        : renderQuestionCard(state.currentRun);
            if (!state.currentRun) {
                return `<div class="tg-view tg-start-view"><div class="tv-grid-container tg-start-layout"><div class="tv-col tg-stack tg-start-side-rail">${renderStartPreview()}</div><div class="tv-col tg-stack tg-main-rail">${coreCard}</div></div></div>`;
            }
            const trail = renderTrail(state.currentRun);
            return `<div class="tg-view">${renderContextMismatch(state.currentRun)}<div class="tv-grid-container tg-full-layout${trail ? '' : ' no-trail'}"><div class="tv-col tg-stack tg-side-rail">${renderMeta(state.currentRun)}${renderPlan(state.currentRun)}</div><div class="tv-col tg-stack tg-main-rail">${coreCard}</div>${trail ? `<div class="tv-col tg-stack tg-side-rail">${trail}</div>` : ''}</div></div>`;
        }

        function renderScaleGroup() {
            const presets = [0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 1.1, 1.2, 1.3];
            return `<div class="tg-scale-group tv-toggle-motion" data-toggle-motion-key="tradegate-scale">${presets.map(scale => `<button type="button" class="tg-scale-pill${Math.abs((SysConfig.panelScale || 1) - scale) < 0.001 ? ' is-active' : ''}" data-action="set-scale" data-scale="${scale}">${scale}x</button>`).join('')}</div>`;
        }

        function renderToolbar() {
            const summary = state.currentRun ? statusText(state.currentRun.status) : tgText('idleSummary');
            const currentSymbolValue = state.currentRun ? getDisplayedTradeGateSymbol(state.currentRun.meta?.symbol) : '';
            const currentSymbol = currentSymbolValue ? c1_tradeGateSymbolHTML(currentSymbolValue, 'tg-pill tg-current-symbol') : '';
            return `<div class="tg-toolbar"><div class="tg-toolbar-top"><div class="tg-toolbar-copy"><h4 class="tg-toolbar-title">${escapeHtml(t('tgPanelTitle'))}</h4><p class="tg-toolbar-sub">${escapeHtml(summary)}</p></div><div class="tg-toolbar-meta">${renderScaleGroup()}${currentSymbol}<span class="tg-pill tg-full-hotkey-pill">${escapeHtml(SysConfig.tools.tradegateFull || t('unbound'))}</span></div></div><div class="tg-toolbar-actions"><div class="tg-toolbar-nav tv-toggle-motion" data-toggle-motion-key="tradegate-view"><button type="button" class="tg-btn tg-btn-ghost${state.view === 'main' ? ' is-active' : ''}" data-action="go-main" aria-label="${escapeHtml(tgText('flowView'))}">${escapeHtml(tgText('flowView'))}</button><button type="button" class="tg-btn tg-btn-ghost${state.view === 'history' ? ' is-active' : ''}" data-action="toggle-history" aria-label="${escapeHtml(tgText('historyTitle'))}">${escapeHtml(tgText('historyTitle'))}</button><button type="button" class="tg-btn tg-btn-ghost${state.view === 'settings' ? ' is-active' : ''}" data-action="toggle-settings" aria-label="${escapeHtml(tgText('settingsTitle'))}">${escapeHtml(tgText('settingsTitle'))}</button></div><div class="tg-toolbar-utility"><button type="button" class="tg-btn tg-btn-primary" data-action="new-run" aria-label="${escapeHtml(tgText('newRun'))}">${escapeHtml(tgText('newRun'))}</button><button type="button" class="tg-btn tg-btn-close" data-action="close-window" aria-label="${escapeHtml(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Close Trade Gate window' : '关闭 Trade Gate 浮窗')}">${escapeHtml(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Close' : '关闭浮窗')}</button></div></div></div>`;
        }

        function syncToolbar(shell) {
            const toolbar = shell.querySelector('.tg-toolbar');
            if (!toolbar) {
                shell.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', renderToolbar());
                return;
            }
            const summary = state.currentRun ? statusText(state.currentRun.status) : tgText('idleSummary');
            const summaryEl = toolbar.querySelector('.tg-toolbar-sub');
            if (summaryEl) summaryEl.textContent = summary;

            const meta = toolbar.querySelector('.tg-toolbar-meta');
            const symbol = state.currentRun ? getDisplayedTradeGateSymbol(state.currentRun.meta?.symbol) : '';
            let symbolPill = toolbar.querySelector('.tg-current-symbol');
            if (symbol) {
                if (!symbolPill && meta) {
                    symbolPill = document.createElement('span');
                    symbolPill.className = 'tg-pill tg-current-symbol';
                    const hotkeyPill = toolbar.querySelector('.tg-full-hotkey-pill');
                    meta.insertBefore(symbolPill, hotkeyPill || null);
                }
                if (symbolPill) {
                    const display = c1_formatTradeGateSymbol(symbol);
                    symbolPill.textContent = display.short;
                    if (display.full && display.full !== display.short) symbolPill.title = display.full;
                    else symbolPill.removeAttribute('title');
                }
            } else if (symbolPill) {
                symbolPill.remove();
            }

            const hotkeyPill = toolbar.querySelector('.tg-full-hotkey-pill');
            if (hotkeyPill) hotkeyPill.textContent = SysConfig.tools.tradegateFull || t('unbound');

            toolbar.querySelectorAll('.tg-scale-pill').forEach(btn => {
                const scale = parseFloat(btn.dataset.scale);
                btn.classList.toggle('is-active', Math.abs((SysConfig.panelScale || 1) - scale) < 0.001);
            });
            toolbar.querySelector('[data-action="go-main"]')?.classList.toggle('is-active', state.view === 'main');
            toolbar.querySelector('[data-action="toggle-history"]')?.classList.toggle('is-active', state.view === 'history');
            toolbar.querySelector('[data-action="toggle-settings"]')?.classList.toggle('is-active', state.view === 'settings');
        }

        function syncToolbarScaleOnly(shell) {
            const toolbar = shell?.querySelector?.('.tg-toolbar');
            if (!toolbar) return;
            toolbar.querySelectorAll('.tg-scale-pill').forEach(btn => {
                const scale = parseFloat(btn.dataset.scale);
                btn.classList.toggle('is-active', Math.abs((SysConfig.panelScale || 1) - scale) < 0.001);
            });
            c1_refreshToggleMotionNow(toolbar.querySelector('.tg-scale-group') || toolbar);
        }

        function render() {
            Text = store.getText();
            store.syncSettingsFromConfig();
            const content = state.view === 'history' ? renderHistorySheet() : state.view === 'settings' ? renderSettingsSheet() : renderMainView();
            let shell = tgHost.querySelector(':scope > .tg-shell');
            if (!shell) {
                tgHost.innerHTML = `<div class="tg-shell">${renderToolbar()}<div class="tg-body-scroll">${content}</div></div>`;
                shell = tgHost.querySelector(':scope > .tg-shell');
            } else {
                syncToolbar(shell);
                c1_refreshToggleMotionNow(shell.querySelector('.tg-toolbar') || shell);
                const body = shell.querySelector('.tg-body-scroll');
                if (body) {
                    const applyContent = () => {
                        if (!body.isConnected) return;
                        c1_closeStyledSelects();
                        body.innerHTML = content;
                        c1_styleSelects(body);
                        c1_mountToggleMotion(body);
                    };
                    if (state.view === c1_lastTradeGateRenderedView) applyContent();
                    else requestAnimationFrame(applyContent);
                } else {
                    shell.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `<div class="tg-body-scroll">${content}</div>`);
                }
            }
            c1_lastTradeGateRenderedView = state.view;
            c1_mountToggleMotion(tgHost);
            c1_styleSelects(tgHost);
        }

        function setBoolField(button) {
            const group = button.closest('[data-bool-name]');
            if (!group) return;
            const hidden = group.querySelector('input[type="hidden"]');
            if (!hidden) return;
            hidden.value = button.dataset.boolValue;
            group.querySelectorAll('.tg-toggle').forEach(toggle => toggle.classList.remove('is-active'));
            button.classList.add('is-active');
        }

        function archive(run) {
            store.archive(run);
        }

        function answerQuestion(answer) {
            if (c1_blockMismatchedTradeGateProgress(state.currentRun)) return;
            store.answer(answer);
        }

        function goBack() {
            store.goBack();
        }

        function manualInvalidate() {
            store.manualInvalidate();
        }

        function endReview() {
            store.endReview();
        }

        function downloadHistory() {
            store.exportHistory();
        }

        function clearHistory() {
            store.clearHistory();
        }

        function tradeGateConfirm({ title, body, confirmText, danger = false }) {
            return c1_showDangerConfirm({
                title,
                body,
                confirmText,
                cancelText: SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Cancel' : '取消',
                items: danger ? [SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'This cannot be undone from inside Trade Gate.' : '此操作无法在 Trade Gate 内撤销。'] : []
            });
        }

        function submitStart(form) {
            const data = new FormData(form);
