            const requestedSymbol = c1_normalizeTradeGateSymbolIdentity(data.get('symbol'));
            const liveSymbol = detectTradingViewSymbol();
            if (liveSymbol && requestedSymbol && liveSymbol !== requestedSymbol) {
                SharedTV.showToast(SysConfig.lang === 'en'
                    ? `Current chart: ${liveSymbol}. Use it or switch charts.`
                    : `当前为 ${liveSymbol}；请使用该品种或切换图表。`, true);
                return;
            }
            store.submitStart({
                symbol: requestedSymbol || data.get('symbol'),
                htfMode: data.get('htfMode'),
                direction: data.get('direction'),
                note: data.get('note')
            });
        }

        function syncStartPreviewFromForm() {
            const form = tgGet('#tg-start-form');
            const preview = tgHost.querySelector('.tg-start-preview-card');
            if (!form || !preview) return;
            const data = new FormData(form);
            const previewValues = {
                symbol: String(data.get('symbol') || '').trim() || tgText('noData'),
                htfMode: String(data.get('htfMode') || '').trim() || tgText('noData'),
                direction: optionText(data.get('direction'))
            };
            Object.entries(previewValues).forEach(([key, value]) => {
                const node = preview.querySelector(`[data-start-preview="${key}"]`);
                if (node) node.textContent = value;
            });
        }

        function submitExecution(form) {
            if (c1_blockMismatchedTradeGateProgress(state.currentRun)) return;
            const data = new FormData(form);
            const executionPlan = {
                mtfConfirmationType: data.get('mtfConfirmationType'),
                executionMode: data.get('executionMode'),
                entryType: data.get('orderType') || null,
                entryTrigger: data.get('entryTrigger') || null,
                orderType: data.get('orderType') || null,
                stopBasis: data.get('stopBasis'),
                beBasis: data.get('beBasis'),
                tpBasis: data.get('tpBasis'),
                nav5RefSituation: data.get('refMtfSituation') || null,
                refMtfSituation: data.get('refMtfSituation') || null,
                nav3SubType: data.get('nav3SubType') || null,
                ltfTriggerPrinted: toBool(data.get('ltfTriggerPrinted')),
                stopAnchored: toBool(data.get('stopAnchored')),
                beLocked: toBool(data.get('beLocked')),
                tpLocked: toBool(data.get('tpLocked')),
                vRebound: toBool(data.get('vRebound')),
                note: data.get('note')
            };
            if (!executionPlan.ltfTriggerPrinted || !executionPlan.stopAnchored || !executionPlan.beLocked || !executionPlan.tpLocked) {
                SharedTV.showToast(SysConfig.lang === 'en'
                    ? 'Complete all four safety confirmations before locking the execution plan.'
                    : '锁定执行计划前，必须逐项完成四项安全确认。', true);
                return;
            }
            store.submitExecution(executionPlan);
        }

        function submitResult(form) {
            const data = new FormData(form);
            const executed = toBool(data.get('executed'));
            store.submitResult({
                executed,
                ruleBroken: toBool(data.get('ruleBroken')),
                stoppedAt: data.get('stoppedAt'),
                notExecutedReason: executed ? 'executed' : data.get('notExecutedReason'),
                pnlR: String(data.get('pnlR') || '').trim(),
                comfortScore: String(data.get('comfortScore') || '').trim(),
                notes: String(data.get('resultNotes') || '').trim()
            });
        }

        function submitSettings(form) {
            const data = new FormData(form);
            store.saveSettings({
                ...state.settings,
                symbolPresets: c1_parseTradeGatePresetList(data.get('symbolPresets')),
                htfPresets: c1_parseTradeGatePresetList(data.get('htfPresets')),
                defaultSymbol: String(data.get('defaultSymbol') || '').trim(),
                defaultHtfMode: data.get('defaultHtfMode'),
                defaultDirection: data.get('defaultDirection'),
                executionDefaults: { ...C1_TRADE_GATE_DEFAULT_SETTINGS.executionDefaults }
            });
            SharedTV.showToast(tgText('settingsSaved'));
        }

        tgHost.addEventListener('click', async (event) => {
            event.stopPropagation();
            const actionEl = event.target.closest('[data-action]');
            if (!actionEl || !tgHost.contains(actionEl)) return;
            const action = actionEl.dataset.action;
            if (['go-main', 'toggle-history', 'toggle-settings', 'new-run'].includes(action)) c1_closeStyledSelects();
            if (action === 'go-main') {
                store.setView('main');
                return;
            }
            if (action === 'toggle-history') {
                store.setView(state.view === 'history' ? 'main' : 'history');
                return;
            }
            if (action === 'toggle-settings') {
                store.setView(state.view === 'settings' ? 'main' : 'settings');
                return;
            }
            if (action === 'close-window') {
                c1_closeTradeGateWindow();
                return;
            }
            if (action === 'new-run') {
                if (state.currentRun) {
                    const ok = await tradeGateConfirm({
                        title: tgText('discardRunTitle'),
                        body: tgText('discardRunBody'),
                        confirmText: tgText('newRun')
                    });
                    if (!ok) return;
                }
                store.clearRun();
                return;
            }
            if (action === 'set-scale') {
                const nextScale = parseFloat(actionEl.dataset.scale);
                c1_applyTradeGateScale(nextScale);
                if (document.getElementById('tv-scale-presets')) c1_renderScalePresets();
                syncToolbarScaleOnly(tgHost.querySelector(':scope > .tg-shell'));
                return;
            }
            if (action === 'answer') answerQuestion(actionEl.dataset.value === 'yes');
            if (action === 'use-symbol') {
                const input = tgGet('#tg-start-form [name="symbol"]');
                if (input) {
                    input.value = actionEl.dataset.value || '';
                    input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
                }
                syncStartPreviewFromForm();
            }
            if (action === 'back') goBack();
            if (action === 'invalidate') {
                if (state.currentRun) {
                    const ok = await tradeGateConfirm({
                        title: tgText('invalidateTitle'),
                        body: tgText('invalidateBody'),
                        confirmText: tgText('invalidate')
                    });
                    if (!ok) return;
                }
                manualInvalidate();
            }
            if (action === 'end') {
                if (state.currentRun) {
                    const ok = await tradeGateConfirm({
                        title: tgText('endReviewTitle'),
                        body: tgText('endReviewBody'),
                        confirmText: tgText('endReview')
                    });
                    if (!ok) return;
                }
                endReview();
            }
            if (action === 'set-bool') setBoolField(actionEl);
            if (action === 'export-history') downloadHistory();
            if (action === 'clear-history') {
                const ok = await tradeGateConfirm({
                    title: tgText('clearHistoryTitle'),
                    body: tgText('clearHistoryBody'),
                    confirmText: tgText('clearHistory'),
                    danger: true
                });
                if (!ok) return;
                clearHistory();
            }
            if (action === 'open-control-settings') { c1_closeTradeGateWindow({ immediate: true }); c1_toggleSettingsPanel(); }
        });

        tgHost.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
            if (event.target?.closest?.('#tg-start-form')) syncStartPreviewFromForm();
        });

        tgHost.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
            if (event.target?.closest?.('#tg-start-form')) syncStartPreviewFromForm();
        });

        tgHost.addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
            const form = event.target;
            if (!(form instanceof HTMLFormElement)) return;
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();
            c1_markSubmitting(form);
            if (form.id === 'tg-start-form') submitStart(form);
            if (form.id === 'tg-exec-form') submitExecution(form);
            if (form.id === 'tg-result-form') submitResult(form);
            if (form.id === 'tg-settings-form') submitSettings(form);
        });

        const unsubscribe = store.subscribe(() => { render(); });
        if (c1_tradeGateWindowEl && c1_tradeGateWindowEl.contains(tgHost)) c1_tradeGateWindowEl.__tgCleanup = unsubscribe;
        render();
        c1_startTradeGateWindowSymbolRefresh(() => {
            const nextSymbol = detectTradingViewSymbol();
            if (nextSymbol === c1_lastTradeGateDisplayedSymbol) return;
            c1_lastTradeGateDisplayedSymbol = nextSymbol;
            render();
        });
    }
    function c1_buildTradeGateFeature(root, sidebarContainer) {
        const tgFullHotkey = SysConfig.tools.tradegateFull || 'SHIFT + Z';
        const tgOpenFullBtn = document.createElement('button');
        tgOpenFullBtn.type = 'button';
        tgOpenFullBtn.id = 'tg-open-full-btn';
        tgOpenFullBtn.dataset.tooltip = tgFullHotkey;
        tgOpenFullBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', tgFullHotkey);
        tgOpenFullBtn.innerHTML = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8 3H5a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v3M16 3h3a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v3M8 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-3M16 21h3a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-3"/></svg>';
        const tgShell = c1_createPanelShell({
            id: 'panel-tradegate',
            title: t('tgPanelTitle'),
            bodyClass: 'tv-side-panel-content tg-host',
            bodyId: 'tradegate-host',
            headerActions: [tgOpenFullBtn]
        });
        const tgPanel = tgShell.panel;
        root.appendChild(tgPanel);
        tgOpenFullBtn.onclick = () => { c1_openTradeGateWindow(); };
        c1_initTradeGate(tgShell.body);
        c1_createSidebarButton(sidebarContainer, 'tradegate', ICON_DICT.target, tgPanel, null, t('tgPanelTitle'));
    }

    function c1_buildCustomPanelFeature(root, sidebarContainer, pData) {
        const shell = c1_createPanelShell({
            id: `panel-${pData.id}`,
            title: pData.title || t('customPanels'),
            bodyClass: 'tv-side-panel-content'
        });
        shell.body.textContent = (pData.content || '').trim();
        const pDom = shell.panel;
        root.appendChild(pDom);
        c1_createSidebarButton(sidebarContainer, pData.id, resolveIcon(pData.icon), pDom, null, pData.title || t('customPanels'));
    }

    function c1_buildMacroFeature(root, sidebarContainer) {
        let checkboxesHtml = MACRO_ASSETS.map(cur => `<label class="currency-checkbox"><input type="checkbox" value="${cur.id}" ${C2_CONFIG.macroPrefs.currencies.includes(cur.id) ? 'checked' : ''}><span>${cur.label}</span></label>`).join('');
        const macroRefreshBtn = document.createElement('span');
        macroRefreshBtn.id = 'macro-refresh-btn';
        macroRefreshBtn.dataset.tooltip = c1_lang('Force refresh', '强制刷新');
        macroRefreshBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', c1_lang('Force refresh', '强制刷新'));
        macroRefreshBtn.innerHTML = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 0 1-15.55 6.2L3 16m0 0v5h5M3 12A9 9 0 0 1 18.55 5.8L21 8m0 0V3h-5"/></svg>';
        const macroSettingsBtn = document.createElement('span');
        macroSettingsBtn.id = 'macro-settings-btn';
        macroSettingsBtn.dataset.tooltip = c1_lang('Settings', '设置');
        macroSettingsBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', c1_lang('Settings', '设置'));
        macroSettingsBtn.innerHTML = ICON_DICT.gear;
        const macroShell = c1_createPanelShell({
            id: 'panel-macro',
            title: `🌍 ${c1_lang('Macro Radar', '实时宏观雷达')} <span class="tv-native-pill">${c1_tradeGateEscape(C2_CONFIG.macroKey || t('unbound'))}</span>`,
            titleHtml: true,
            bodyClass: 'tv-side-panel-content',
            bodyId: 'tv-macro-content',
            bodyHtml: `<div class="macro-state is-syncing">${c1_lang('Syncing data...', '正在同步数据...')}</div>`,
            headerActions: [macroRefreshBtn, macroSettingsBtn]
        });
        const macroPanel = macroShell.panel;
        const macroDrawer = document.createElement('div');
        macroDrawer.id = 'macro-settings-drawer';
        macroDrawer.className = 'news-settings-panel';
        macroDrawer.innerHTML = `<div class="macro-filter-drawer"><div class="macro-filter-head"><span class="macro-filter-title">${c1_lang('Currency filters:', '筛选法币数据：')}</span><div class="macro-filter-actions"><span id="macro-sel-all" class="macro-filter-action is-primary">${c1_lang('All', '全选')}</span><span id="macro-sel-none" class="macro-filter-action is-muted">${c1_lang('Clear', '清空')}</span></div></div><div class="macro-filter-grid" id="macro-currency-filters">${checkboxesHtml}</div></div>`;
        macroShell.body.before(macroDrawer);
        const macroTitleEl = macroPanel.querySelector('.tv-side-panel-header h3');
        if (macroTitleEl?.firstChild && macroTitleEl.firstChild.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
            macroTitleEl.firstChild.textContent = `${SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Macro Radar ' : '实时宏观雷达 '}`;
        }
        root.appendChild(macroPanel);
        macroSettingsBtn.onclick = () => { macroDrawer.classList.toggle('open'); };
        macroRefreshBtn.onclick = () => { c2_fetchMacroData(true); };

        const updateMacroUI = () => {
            let checkedList = Array.from(macroPanel.querySelectorAll('.currency-checkbox input:checked')).map(cb => cb.value);
            if (checkedList.length === 0) { const usdBox = macroPanel.querySelector('.currency-checkbox input[value="USD"]'); if(usdBox) usdBox.checked = true; checkedList = ['USD']; }
            C2_CONFIG.macroPrefs.currencies = checkedList; c2_saveConfig();
            if(C2_CONFIG.cache && C2_CONFIG.cache.data) c2_renderMacroData(C2_CONFIG.cache.data);
        };
        macroPanel.querySelectorAll('.currency-checkbox input').forEach(box => { box.addEventListener('change', updateMacroUI); });
        macroPanel.querySelector('#macro-sel-all').onclick = () => { macroPanel.querySelectorAll('.currency-checkbox input').forEach(cb => { cb.checked = true; }); updateMacroUI(); };
        macroPanel.querySelector('#macro-sel-none').onclick = () => { macroPanel.querySelectorAll('.currency-checkbox input').forEach(cb => { cb.checked = false; }); macroPanel.querySelector('.currency-checkbox input[value="USD"]').checked = true; updateMacroUI(); };

        c1_createSidebarButton(sidebarContainer, 'macro', resolveIcon(C2_CONFIG.macroIcon || 'earth'), macroPanel, () => c2_fetchMacroData(), 'Macro');
    }

    function c1_registerCoreFeatures() {
        FeatureRegistry.clear();
        FeatureRegistry.register({
            id: 'tradegate',
            surface: 'sidebar',
            order: 10,
            triggerId: 'tradegate',
            build: c1_buildTradeGateFeature
        });
        SysConfig.panels.forEach((panel, idx) => {
            FeatureRegistry.register({
                id: `custom:${panel.id}`,
                triggerId: panel.id,
                surface: 'sidebar',
                order: 20 + idx,
                build: (root, sidebarContainer) => c1_buildCustomPanelFeature(root, sidebarContainer, panel)
            });
        });
        FeatureRegistry.register({
            id: 'macro',
            surface: 'sidebar',
            order: 30,
            triggerId: 'macro',
            build: c1_buildMacroFeature,
            refresh: () => c2_fetchMacroData()
        });
        FeatureRegistry.register({
            id: 'risk',
            surface: 'sidebar',
            order: 40,
            triggerId: 'risk',
            build: c1_buildRiskFeature
        });
    }

    function c1_renderSidebarSystem() {
        const root = getUIRoot();
        let sidebarContainer = c1_ensureSidebarContainer(root, 'left');
        let rightSidebarContainer = c1_ensureSidebarContainer(root, 'right');
        PanelManager.resetPanels();
        c1_registerCoreFeatures();
        sidebarContainer.innerHTML = '';
        rightSidebarContainer.innerHTML = '';
        document.querySelectorAll('.tv-side-panel').forEach(p => p.remove());

        FeatureRegistry.buildSidebar(root, { left: sidebarContainer, right: rightSidebarContainer });

        c1_applyTheme();
        c1_updateSidebarVisibility();
        c1_scheduleRightSidebarAlign();

        // 适配全屏的类添加
        if (document.fullscreenElement) {
            document.querySelectorAll('#tv-custom-sidebar, #tv-custom-sidebar-right, .tv-side-panel').forEach(el => el.classList.add('tv-is-fullscreen'));
        }
    }

    function c1_getDiagnosticsSnapshot() {
        return {
            activePanelId: c1_activePanel?.id || null,
            theme: SysConfig.theme,
            language: SysConfig.lang,
            featureIds: [...FeatureRegistry.features.keys()],
            panelIds: [...PanelManager.panelEntries.keys()],
            mountableIds: PanelManager.getMountedElements().map(el => el.id || el.className || '<anonymous>'),
            chartState: c1_getTVStateBridge().getChartState(),
            tradeProbe: c1_getTVStateBridge().getTradeProbe(),
            lastTradeData: c1_getTVStateBridge().getTradeDialogData(),
            tradeGate: {
                currentRun: c1_getTradeGateStore().state.currentRun,
                view: c1_getTradeGateStore().state.view
            }
        };
    }

    function c1_downloadJsonFile(fileName, data) {
        const payload = typeof data === 'string' ? data : JSON.stringify(data, null, 2);
        const blob = new Blob([payload], { type: 'application/json;charset=utf-8' });
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const anchor = document.createElement('a');
        anchor.href = url;
        anchor.download = fileName;
        document.body.appendChild(anchor);
        anchor.click();
        anchor.remove();
        setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
    }

    function c1_applyTheme() {
        SysConfig.theme = c1_normalizeTheme(SysConfig.theme);
        const classes = [...C1_THEME_OPTIONS.map(theme => `tv-custom-${theme.id}`), 'tv-custom-mocha', 'tv-custom-aurora'];
        document.querySelectorAll('.tv-custom-themed, #tv-custom-notifier-container').forEach(el => { if (el) { el.classList.remove(...classes); el.classList.add('tv-custom-' + SysConfig.theme); } });
        document.querySelectorAll('.tv-theme-dot').forEach(dot => { dot.style.boxShadow = dot.dataset.theme === SysConfig.theme ? '0 0 0 2px var(--my-bg), 0 0 0 4px var(--my-accent)' : 'none'; });
        c1_applyImmersiveHudTheme();
    }

    function c1_startClockUpdates() {
        if(c1_clockInterval) clearInterval(c1_clockInterval);
        const clockTzs = ['America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'Asia/Tokyo', 'Asia/Shanghai'];
        c1_clockInterval = setInterval(() => { if (document.visibilityState !== 'visible') return; const now = new Date(); clockTzs.forEach((tz, idx) => { const el = document.getElementById(`tv-clock-${idx}`); if(el) { el.textContent = now.toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { timeZone: tz, hour12: false }); } }); }, 1000);
    }

    function c1_getVisibleToolIdsForCategory(catKey) {
        const dict = TOOL_DICT[catKey] || {};
        const ids = Object.keys(dict);
        if (catKey !== 'draw') return ids;
        const enabled = new Set(c1_getEnabledDrawToolIds());
        return ids.filter((id) => !c1_isManagedDrawTool(id) || enabled.has(id));
    }

    function c1_buildToolCategoryHTML(catKey) {
        let html = '';
        const dict = TOOL_DICT[catKey] || {};
        c1_getVisibleToolIdsForCategory(catKey).forEach((id) => {
            const conf = dict[id] || {};
            const name = conf.name?.[SysConfig.lang] || conf.name?.zh || id;
            const displayKey = SysConfig.tools[id] || t('unbound');
            const removable = catKey === 'draw' && c1_isManagedDrawTool(id);
            const removeBtn = removable ? `<button class="tv-settings-icon-btn tv-draw-tool-remove" data-tool-id="${id}" aria-label="${t('drawToolRemove')}">${c1_tradeGateEscape(t('drawToolRemove'))}</button>` : '';
            let label = `<span class="tv-settings-row-label">${c1_tradeGateEscape(name)}</span>`;
            if (catKey === 'draw') {
                label = `<span class="tv-settings-row-label tv-tool-label"><span class="tv-tool-label-main">${c1_tradeGateEscape(name)}</span></span>`;
            } else if (catKey === 'basic') {
                const icon = c1_toolLabelIcon(name);
                const cleanName = c1_stripToolLabelIcon(name);
                label = `<span class="tv-settings-row-label tv-tool-label tv-basic-tool-label"><span class="tv-tool-label-icon" aria-hidden="true">${c1_tradeGateEscape(icon)}</span><span class="tv-tool-label-main">${c1_tradeGateEscape(cleanName)}</span></span>`;
            }
            html += `<div class="tv-settings-row tv-hotkey-row${catKey === 'basic' ? ' tv-basic-hotkey-row' : ''}">${label}<div class="tv-settings-row-actions"><button class="tv-record-btn p1-btn tv-settings-hotkey-btn" data-id="tool_${id}">${c1_tradeGateEscape(displayKey)}</button>${removeBtn}</div></div>`;
        });
        return `<div class="tv-hotkey-list">${html}</div>`;
    }

    function c1_buildIndicatorSlotDiagnosticsHTML() {
        const slots = c1_scanIndicatorSlots();
        const memory = c1_normalizeIndicatorSlotVisibility(SysConfig.indicatorSlotVisibility);
        const rows = slots.length
            ? slots.map(slot => `
                <div class="tv-settings-control-row is-flush tv-indicator-slot-row" data-slot-index="${slot.index}">
                    <span class="tv-indicator-slot-label"><span>${c1_tradeGateEscape(c1_lang(`Indicator Slot ${slot.index}`, `指标槽位 ${slot.index}`))}</span></span>
                    <strong class="tv-settings-row-value tv-indicator-slot-pill" draggable="true" data-slot-id="${c1_tradeGateEscape(slot.id || '')}" data-slot-name="${c1_tradeGateEscape(slot.name || '')}"><span class="tv-indicator-slot-drag" aria-hidden="true">${resolveIcon('list')}</span><span class="tv-indicator-slot-name">${c1_tradeGateEscape(slot.name)}${typeof memory[String(slot.index)] === 'boolean' ? ` · ${memory[String(slot.index)] ? 'show' : 'hide'}` : ''}</span></strong>
                </div>
            `).join('')
            : `<div class="tv-settings-empty">${c1_tradeGateEscape(c1_lang('No indicator slots detected yet', '暂未识别到指标槽位'))}</div>`;
        return `
            <div class="tv-settings-cluster tv-chart-settings-cluster" id="tv-indicator-slot-diagnostics-host">
                <div>
                    <div class="tv-col-title">${c1_settingsTitleLabel('list', c1_lang('Indicator Slots', '指标槽位诊断'))}</div>
                    <div class="tv-settings-context-grid tv-settings-toggle-list">${rows}</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
    }

    function c1_bindIndicatorSlotDiagnostics(panel = document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel')) {
        const host = panel?.querySelector?.('#tv-indicator-slot-diagnostics-host');
        const list = host?.querySelector?.('.tv-settings-toggle-list');
        if (!host || !list || list.dataset.indicatorDragBound === '1') return;
        list.dataset.indicatorDragBound = '1';
        let dragging = null;
        const getRows = () => Array.from(list.querySelectorAll('.tv-indicator-slot-row'));
        const getPillData = (row) => {
            const pill = row?.querySelector?.('.tv-indicator-slot-pill');
            return pill ? { id: pill.dataset.slotId || '', name: pill.dataset.slotName || '' } : null;
        };
        const clearDropState = () => getRows().forEach(row => row.classList.remove('is-drop-target'));
        const persistOrder = (fromIndex, toIndex) => {
            const rows = getRows();
            const assignments = rows.map(getPillData).filter(Boolean);
            if (!Number.isInteger(fromIndex) || !Number.isInteger(toIndex) || fromIndex === toIndex || !assignments[fromIndex] || !assignments[toIndex]) return;
            const [moved] = assignments.splice(fromIndex, 1);
            assignments.splice(toIndex, 0, moved);
            SysConfig.indicatorSlotOrder = c1_normalizeIndicatorSlotOrder(assignments);
            c1_saveConfig();
            host.outerHTML = c1_buildIndicatorSlotDiagnosticsHTML();
            c1_bindIndicatorSlotDiagnostics(panel);
            SharedTV.showToast(c1_lang('Indicator slot assignment saved', '指标槽位分配已保存'));
        };
        list.addEventListener('dragstart', (event) => {
            const pill = event.target?.closest?.('.tv-indicator-slot-pill');
            const row = pill?.closest?.('.tv-indicator-slot-row');
            if (!pill || !row) return;
            dragging = row;
            pill.classList.add('is-dragging');
            if (event.dataTransfer) {
                event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
                try { event.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', pill.dataset.slotName || 'indicator-slot'); } catch (e) {}
            }
        });
        list.addEventListener('dragover', (event) => {
            if (!dragging) return;
            const row = event.target?.closest?.('.tv-indicator-slot-row');
            if (!row || row === dragging) return;
            event.preventDefault();
            clearDropState();
            row.classList.add('is-drop-target');
        });
        list.addEventListener('drop', (event) => {
            if (!dragging) return;
            event.preventDefault();
            const targetRow = event.target?.closest?.('.tv-indicator-slot-row');
            const rows = getRows();
            const fromIndex = rows.indexOf(dragging);
            const toIndex = rows.indexOf(targetRow);
            dragging.querySelector('.tv-indicator-slot-pill')?.classList.remove('is-dragging');
            dragging = null;
            clearDropState();
            persistOrder(fromIndex, toIndex);
        });
        list.addEventListener('dragend', () => {
            if (dragging) dragging.querySelector('.tv-indicator-slot-pill')?.classList.remove('is-dragging');
            dragging = null;
            clearDropState();
        });
    }

    function c1_getDrawToolPickerOptionsHTML() {
        const enabled = new Set(c1_getEnabledDrawToolIds());
        const groups = {};
        C1_DRAW_TOOL_IDS.forEach((id) => {
            if (enabled.has(id)) return;
            const conf = C1_DRAW_TOOL_LIBRARY[id];
            const groupName = conf.group?.[SysConfig.lang] || conf.group?.zh || 'Other';
            if (!groups[groupName]) groups[groupName] = [];
            groups[groupName].push({ id, conf });
        });

        const groupNames = Object.keys(groups);
        if (!groupNames.length) return `<option value="">${t('drawToolAllAdded')}</option>`;

        return `<option value="">${t('drawToolSelect')}</option>` + groupNames.map((groupName) => {
            const options = groups[groupName].map(({ id, conf }) => {
                const name = conf.name[SysConfig.lang] || conf.name.zh;
                return `<option value="${id}">${c1_tradeGateEscape(name)}</option>`;
            }).join('');
            return `<optgroup label="${c1_tradeGateEscape(groupName)}">${options}</optgroup>`;
        }).join('');
    }

    function c1_getDrawToolPickerGroups() {
        const enabled = new Set(c1_getEnabledDrawToolIds());
        const groups = {};
        C1_DRAW_TOOL_IDS.forEach((id) => {
            if (enabled.has(id)) return;
            const conf = C1_DRAW_TOOL_LIBRARY[id];
            const groupName = conf.group?.[SysConfig.lang] || conf.group?.zh || 'Other';
            if (!groups[groupName]) groups[groupName] = [];
            groups[groupName].push({
                id,
                name: conf.name[SysConfig.lang] || conf.name.zh
            });
        });
        return groups;
    }

    function c1_buildDrawToolPickerHTML() {
        const groups = c1_getDrawToolPickerGroups();
        const groupNames = Object.keys(groups);
        const disabled = !groupNames.length;
        const label = disabled ? t('drawToolAllAdded') : t('drawToolSelect');
        const menu = groupNames.map((groupName) => {
            const options = groups[groupName].map(({ id, name }) => `<button type="button" class="tv-draw-tool-picker-option" data-tool-id="${id}">${c1_tradeGateEscape(name)}</button>`).join('');
            return `<div class="tv-draw-tool-picker-group"><div class="tv-draw-tool-picker-group-title">${c1_tradeGateEscape(groupName)}</div>${options}</div>`;
        }).join('');
        return `<div class="tv-draw-tool-picker${disabled ? ' is-disabled' : ''}" data-value=""><button type="button" class="tv-draw-tool-picker-btn" ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''}><span class="tv-draw-tool-picker-label">${c1_tradeGateEscape(label)}</span><span class="tv-draw-tool-picker-caret"></span></button><div class="tv-draw-tool-picker-menu">${menu}</div></div>`;
    }

    function c1_escapeSelectorValue(value) {
        if (window.CSS?.escape) return CSS.escape(String(value));
        return String(value).replace(/["\\]/g, '\\$&');
    }

    function c1_getDrawToolPickerMenu(picker) {
        if (!picker) return null;
        const inlineMenu = picker.querySelector?.('.tv-draw-tool-picker-menu');
        if (inlineMenu) return inlineMenu;
        const owner = picker.dataset?.pickerId;
        return owner ? document.querySelector(`.tv-draw-tool-picker-menu[data-picker-owner="${c1_escapeSelectorValue(owner)}"]`) : null;
    }

    function c1_portalDrawToolPickerMenu(picker) {
        if (!picker) return null;
        if (!picker.dataset.pickerId) picker.dataset.pickerId = `tvdraw-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
        const menu = c1_getDrawToolPickerMenu(picker);
        if (!menu) return null;
        menu.dataset.pickerOwner = picker.dataset.pickerId;
        if (menu.parentElement !== document.body) {
            const placeholder = document.createComment('tv-draw-tool-picker-menu');
            menu.parentNode?.insertBefore(placeholder, menu);
            picker.__tvDrawPickerPlaceholder = placeholder;
            document.body.appendChild(menu);
        }
        menu.classList.add('is-open');
        return menu;
    }

    function c1_restoreDrawToolPickerMenu(picker) {
        const menu = c1_getDrawToolPickerMenu(picker);
        if (!menu) return;
        menu.classList.remove('is-open');
        menu.style.left = '';
        menu.style.top = '';
        menu.style.width = '';
        menu.style.maxHeight = '';
        if (picker?.__tvDrawPickerPlaceholder?.parentNode) {
            picker.__tvDrawPickerPlaceholder.parentNode.insertBefore(menu, picker.__tvDrawPickerPlaceholder);
            picker.__tvDrawPickerPlaceholder.remove();
            picker.__tvDrawPickerPlaceholder = null;
        }
    }

    function c1_positionDrawToolPicker(picker) {
        const trigger = picker?.querySelector?.('.tv-draw-tool-picker-btn');
        const menu = c1_getDrawToolPickerMenu(picker);
        if (!trigger || !menu) return;
        const rect = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (rect.width <= 0 || rect.height <= 0 || rect.bottom < 0 || rect.top > window.innerHeight || rect.right < 0 || rect.left > window.innerWidth) {
            picker.classList.remove('is-open');
            c1_restoreDrawToolPickerMenu(picker);
            return;
        }
        const panel = picker.closest('#tv-settings-panel') || document.documentElement;
        const panelRect = panel.getBoundingClientRect?.() || { left: 8, right: window.innerWidth - 8, top: 8, bottom: window.innerHeight - 8 };
        const minLeft = Math.max(8, panelRect.left + 8);
        const maxRight = Math.min(window.innerWidth - 8, panelRect.right - 8);
        const availableWidth = Math.max(180, maxRight - minLeft);
        const viewportBottom = Math.min(window.innerHeight - 8, panelRect.bottom - 8);
        const viewportTop = Math.max(8, panelRect.top + 8);
        const spaceBelow = Math.max(0, viewportBottom - rect.bottom - 6);
        const spaceAbove = Math.max(0, rect.top - viewportTop - 6);
        const naturalHeight = Math.min(320, Math.max(160, menu.scrollHeight || 260));
        const openAbove = spaceBelow < Math.min(naturalHeight, 180) && spaceAbove > spaceBelow;
        const maxHeight = Math.max(120, Math.min(naturalHeight, openAbove ? spaceAbove : spaceBelow));
        const top = openAbove ? Math.max(viewportTop, rect.top - maxHeight - 6) : Math.min(viewportBottom - maxHeight, rect.bottom + 6);
        const width = Math.min(Math.max(rect.width, 220), availableWidth);
        const left = Math.max(minLeft, Math.min(rect.left, maxRight - width));
        picker.style.setProperty('--tv-draw-picker-width', `${width}px`);
        menu.style.width = `${width}px`;
        menu.style.maxHeight = `${maxHeight}px`;
        menu.style.left = `${left}px`;
        menu.style.top = `${top}px`;
    }

    let c1_portaledControlReflowRaf = 0;
    function c1_repositionOpenPortaledControls() {
        if (c1_portaledControlReflowRaf) return;
        c1_portaledControlReflowRaf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            c1_portaledControlReflowRaf = 0;
            document.querySelectorAll('.tv-select-shell.is-open').forEach(c1_positionStyledSelect);
            document.querySelectorAll('.tv-draw-tool-picker.is-open').forEach(c1_positionDrawToolPicker);
        });
    }

    function c1_closeDrawToolPickers(event = null) {
        document.querySelectorAll('#tv-settings-panel .tv-draw-tool-picker.is-open, .tv-draw-tool-picker[data-picker-id]').forEach((picker) => {
            const menu = c1_getDrawToolPickerMenu(picker);
            if (event?.target && (picker.contains(event.target) || menu?.contains(event.target))) return;
            picker.classList.remove('is-open');
            c1_restoreDrawToolPickerMenu(picker);
        });
    }

    function c1_cleanupPortaledMenus() {
        c1_closeStyledSelects();
        c1_closeDrawToolPickers();
        document.querySelectorAll('.tv-select-menu[data-select-owner], .tv-draw-tool-picker-menu[data-picker-owner]').forEach((menu) => {
            menu.classList.remove('is-open');
            menu.remove();
        });
    }

    function c1_closeStyledSelects(event = null) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.tv-select-shell.is-open').forEach((shell) => {
            const menu = c1_getStyledSelectMenu(shell);
            if (event?.target && (shell.contains(event.target) || menu?.contains(event.target))) return;
            shell.classList.remove('is-open');
            c1_restoreStyledSelectMenu(shell);
        });
    }

    function c1_getStyledSelectMenu(shell) {
        if (!shell) return null;
        const inlineMenu = shell.querySelector?.('.tv-select-menu');
        if (inlineMenu) return inlineMenu;
        const owner = shell.dataset?.selectId;
        return owner ? document.querySelector(`.tv-select-menu[data-select-owner="${c1_escapeSelectorValue(owner)}"]`) : null;
    }

    function c1_portalStyledSelectMenu(shell) {
        if (!shell) return null;
        if (!shell.dataset.selectId) shell.dataset.selectId = `tvsel-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
        const menu = c1_getStyledSelectMenu(shell);
        if (!menu) return null;
        menu.dataset.selectOwner = shell.dataset.selectId;
        if (menu.parentElement !== document.body) {
            const placeholder = document.createComment('tv-select-menu');
            menu.parentNode?.insertBefore(placeholder, menu);
            shell.__tvSelectPlaceholder = placeholder;
            menu.style.visibility = 'hidden';
            document.body.appendChild(menu);
        }
        menu.classList.add('tv-custom-themed', 'tv-custom-' + (SysConfig.theme || 'dark'));
        menu.classList.add('is-open');
        return menu;
    }

    function c1_restoreStyledSelectMenu(shell) {
        const menu = c1_getStyledSelectMenu(shell);
        if (!menu) return;
        menu.classList.remove('is-open');
        menu.style.left = '';
        menu.style.top = '';
        menu.style.width = '';
        menu.style.maxHeight = '';
        if (shell?.__tvSelectPlaceholder?.parentNode) {
            shell.__tvSelectPlaceholder.parentNode.insertBefore(menu, shell.__tvSelectPlaceholder);
            shell.__tvSelectPlaceholder.remove();
            shell.__tvSelectPlaceholder = null;
        }
    }

    function c1_positionStyledSelect(shell) {
        const trigger = shell?.querySelector?.('.tv-select-trigger');
        const menu = c1_getStyledSelectMenu(shell);
        if (!trigger || !menu) return;
        const rect = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (rect.width <= 0 || rect.height <= 0 || rect.bottom < 0 || rect.top > window.innerHeight || rect.right < 0 || rect.left > window.innerWidth) {
            shell.classList.remove('is-open');
            c1_restoreStyledSelectMenu(shell);
            return;
        }
        const panel = shell.closest('#tv-settings-panel, #tv-tradegate-window .tg-window-frame, #panel-tradegate, #panel-risk, .tv-side-panel') || document.documentElement;
        const panelRect = panel.getBoundingClientRect?.() || { left: 8, right: window.innerWidth - 8, top: 8, bottom: window.innerHeight - 8, width: window.innerWidth - 16 };
        const minLeft = Math.max(8, panelRect.left + 8);
        const maxRight = Math.min(window.innerWidth - 8, panelRect.right - 8);
        const availableWidth = Math.max(160, maxRight - minLeft);
        const viewportBottom = Math.min(window.innerHeight - 8, panelRect.bottom - 8);
        const viewportTop = Math.max(8, panelRect.top + 8);
        const spaceBelow = Math.max(0, viewportBottom - rect.bottom - 6);
        const spaceAbove = Math.max(0, rect.top - viewportTop - 6);
        const naturalHeight = Math.min(320, Math.max(120, menu.scrollHeight || 220));
        const openAbove = spaceBelow < Math.min(naturalHeight, 180) && spaceAbove > spaceBelow;
        const maxHeight = Math.max(96, Math.min(naturalHeight, openAbove ? spaceAbove : spaceBelow));
        const top = openAbove ? Math.max(viewportTop, rect.top - maxHeight - 6) : Math.min(viewportBottom - maxHeight, rect.bottom + 6);
        const width = Math.min(Math.max(rect.width, 180), availableWidth);
        const preferredLeft = Math.min(Math.max(rect.left, minLeft), maxRight - width);
        const left = Math.max(minLeft, preferredLeft);
        shell.style.setProperty('--tv-select-width', `${width}px`);
        menu.style.width = `${width}px`;
        menu.style.maxHeight = `${maxHeight}px`;
        menu.style.left = `${left}px`;
        menu.style.top = `${top}px`;
        menu.style.visibility = '';
    }

    function c1_syncStyledSelect(shell) {
        const select = shell?.querySelector?.('select.tv-styled-select-native');
        const label = shell?.querySelector?.('.tv-select-label');
        if (!select || !label) return;
        const selected = select.selectedOptions?.[0] || select.options?.[select.selectedIndex];
        label.textContent = selected?.textContent || '';
        const menu = c1_getStyledSelectMenu(shell);
        menu?.querySelectorAll('.tv-select-option').forEach((option) => {
            option.classList.toggle('is-selected', option.dataset.value === select.value);
        });
    }

    function c1_buildStyledSelectMenu(select) {
        const renderOption = (option) => `<button type="button" class="tv-select-option${option.selected ? ' is-selected' : ''}" data-value="${c1_tradeGateEscape(option.value)}"${option.disabled ? ' disabled' : ''}>${c1_tradeGateEscape(option.textContent || option.value)}</button>`;
        const parts = [];
        Array.from(select.children).forEach((child) => {
            if (child.tagName === 'OPTGROUP') {
                const options = Array.from(child.children).filter(item => item.tagName === 'OPTION').map(renderOption).join('');
                parts.push(`<div class="tv-select-group"><div class="tv-select-group-title">${c1_tradeGateEscape(child.label || '')}</div>${options}</div>`);
            } else if (child.tagName === 'OPTION') {
                parts.push(renderOption(child));
            }
        });
        return parts.join('');
    }

    function c1_styleSelect(select) {
        if (!(select instanceof HTMLSelectElement)) return;
        if (select.classList.contains('tv-draw-tool-native-select')) return;
        if (select.classList.contains('rk-hidden-pref-select')) return;
        if (select.closest('.tv-select-shell')) return;
        if (select.dataset.nativeSelect === 'true') return;
        const shell = document.createElement('span');
        shell.className = 'tv-select-shell';
        shell.innerHTML = `<button type="button" class="tv-select-trigger"${select.disabled ? ' disabled' : ''}><span class="tv-select-label"></span><span class="tv-select-caret"></span></button><div class="tv-select-menu">${c1_buildStyledSelectMenu(select)}</div>`;
        select.parentNode.insertBefore(shell, select);
        shell.insertBefore(select, shell.firstChild);
        select.classList.add('tv-styled-select-native');
        select.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
        c1_syncStyledSelect(shell);
        const trigger = shell.querySelector('.tv-select-trigger');
        trigger?.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
            event.stopPropagation();
            if (select.disabled) return;
            const willOpen = !shell.classList.contains('is-open');
            c1_closeStyledSelects();
            shell.classList.toggle('is-open', willOpen);
            if (willOpen) {
                c1_portalStyledSelectMenu(shell);
                c1_positionStyledSelect(shell);
                setTimeout(() => document.addEventListener('click', c1_closeStyledSelects, { once: true }), 0);
            } else {
                c1_restoreStyledSelectMenu(shell);
            }
        });
        trigger?.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
            if (event.key === 'Escape' && shell.classList.contains('is-open')) {
                event.stopPropagation();
                shell.classList.remove('is-open');
                c1_restoreStyledSelectMenu(shell);
                trigger.focus();
            }
        });
        shell.querySelectorAll('.tv-select-option').forEach((option) => {
            option.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
                event.stopPropagation();
                if (option.disabled) return;
                const nextValue = option.dataset.value || '';
                if (select.value !== nextValue) {
                    select.value = nextValue;
                    select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
                }
                c1_syncStyledSelect(shell);
                shell.classList.remove('is-open');
                c1_restoreStyledSelectMenu(shell);
            });
        });
        select.addEventListener('change', () => c1_syncStyledSelect(shell));
    }

    function c1_styleSelects(root = document) {
        const scope = root instanceof Element || root instanceof Document ? root : document;
        scope.querySelectorAll?.('select:not(.tv-draw-tool-native-select):not(.tv-styled-select-native):not(.rk-hidden-pref-select)').forEach(c1_styleSelect);
    }

    function c1_buildDrawToolsShellHTML() {
        return `
            <div class="tv-col-title tv-settings-section-head tv-draw-tools-head">
                <div class="tv-draw-tools-title">${c1_settingsTitleLabel('path', t('drawControl'))}</div>
                <div class="tv-draw-tools-toolbar">
                    <span class="tv-settings-meta-label">${t('drawToolCustom')}</span>
                    <div class="tv-draw-tools-actions">
                        <select id="tv-draw-tool-library-select" class="cfg-input tv-draw-tool-native-select" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true">${c1_getDrawToolPickerOptionsHTML()}</select>
                        ${c1_buildDrawToolPickerHTML()}
                        <button id="tv-add-draw-tool-btn" class="tv-settings-add-btn">${t('drawToolAddBtn')}</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            ${c1_buildToolCategoryHTML('draw')}
            ${c1_buildSmartMagnetSettingsHTML()}
        `;
    }

    function c1_bindDrawToolsShell(panel = document, shouldBindRecordButtons = true) {
        const host = panel.querySelector('#tv-draw-tools-shell');
        if (!host) return;

        if (shouldBindRecordButtons) c1_bindRecordButtons(host);
        c1_bindSmartMagnetControls(host);

        const addBtn = host.querySelector('#tv-add-draw-tool-btn');
        const picker = host.querySelector('.tv-draw-tool-picker');
        const pickerBtn = picker?.querySelector('.tv-draw-tool-picker-btn');
        const pickerLabel = picker?.querySelector('.tv-draw-tool-picker-label');
        const nativeSelect = host.querySelector('#tv-draw-tool-library-select');
        if (picker && pickerBtn && !picker.classList.contains('is-disabled')) {
            pickerBtn.onclick = (event) => {
                event.stopPropagation();
                const willOpen = !picker.classList.contains('is-open');
                host.querySelectorAll('.tv-draw-tool-picker.is-open').forEach(openPicker => {
                    if (openPicker !== picker) openPicker.classList.remove('is-open');
                });
                picker.classList.toggle('is-open', willOpen);
                if (willOpen) {
                    c1_portalDrawToolPickerMenu(picker);
                    c1_positionDrawToolPicker(picker);
                    setTimeout(() => document.addEventListener('click', c1_closeDrawToolPickers, { once: true }), 0);
                } else {
                    c1_restoreDrawToolPickerMenu(picker);
                }
            };
            c1_getDrawToolPickerMenu(picker)?.querySelectorAll('.tv-draw-tool-picker-option').forEach((option) => {
                option.onclick = (event) => {
                    event.stopPropagation();
                    const nextId = option.dataset.toolId || '';
                    picker.dataset.value = nextId;
                    if (nativeSelect) nativeSelect.value = nextId;
                    c1_getDrawToolPickerMenu(picker)?.querySelectorAll('.tv-draw-tool-picker-option.is-selected').forEach(item => item.classList.remove('is-selected'));
                    option.classList.add('is-selected');
                    if (pickerLabel) pickerLabel.textContent = option.textContent || t('drawToolSelect');
                    picker.classList.remove('is-open');
                    c1_restoreDrawToolPickerMenu(picker);
                };
            });
        }
        if (addBtn) {
            addBtn.onclick = () => {
                c1_syncAllDOMToConfig();
                const select = host.querySelector('#tv-draw-tool-library-select');
                const nextId = picker?.dataset.value || select?.value;
                if (!nextId || !C1_DRAW_TOOL_LIBRARY[nextId]) return;
                const enabled = c1_getEnabledDrawToolIds();
                if (!enabled.includes(nextId)) {
                    SysConfig.enabledDrawTools = enabled.concat(nextId);
                    c1_ensureSmartMagnetConfig();
                }
                c1_renderDrawToolsShell(panel);
                c1_scheduleSettingsAutoSave(panel.closest?.('#tv-settings-panel') || document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel') || panel, 0);
            };
        }

        host.querySelectorAll('.tv-draw-tool-remove').forEach((btn) => {
            btn.onclick = () => {
                c1_syncAllDOMToConfig();
                SysConfig.enabledDrawTools = c1_getEnabledDrawToolIds().filter((id) => id !== btn.dataset.toolId);
                c1_ensureSmartMagnetConfig();
                c1_renderDrawToolsShell(panel);
                c1_scheduleSettingsAutoSave(panel.closest?.('#tv-settings-panel') || document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel') || panel, 0);
            };
        });
    }

    function c1_renderDrawToolsShell(panel = document) {
        const host = panel.querySelector('#tv-draw-tools-shell');
        if (!host) return;
        host.innerHTML = c1_buildDrawToolsShellHTML();
        c1_bindDrawToolsShell(panel, true);
        c1_styleSelects(host);
    }

    function c1_renderDynamicList(containerId, dataList, type) {
        const container = document.getElementById(containerId); if(!container) return;
        container.classList.add('tv-dyn-list');
        container.dataset.listType = type;
        container.innerHTML = `<div class="tv-dyn-list-head"><span>${SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Item' : '项目'}</span><span>${SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Value' : '内容'}</span><span>${c1_lang('Hotkey', '快捷键')}</span><span></span></div>`;
        if (!dataList.length) {
            const empty = document.createElement('div');
            empty.className = 'tv-dyn-empty';
            empty.textContent = type === 'tf'
                ? (SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'No timeframe shortcuts yet' : '暂无周期快捷项')
                : (SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'No symbol shortcuts yet' : '暂无品种快捷项');
            container.appendChild(empty);
        }
        dataList.forEach((item, idx) => {
            const row = document.createElement('div'); row.className = 'tv-settings-row tv-dyn-row';
            const label = type === 'tf' ? `${t('tfLabel')} ${idx+1}` : `${t('symLabel')} ${idx+1}`;
            row.innerHTML = `<span class="tv-settings-row-label">${label}</span><input type="text" class="tv-dyn-input cfg-input" data-type="${type}" data-idx="${idx}" value="${c1_tradeGateEscape(item.val)}"><button class="tv-record-btn p1-btn tv-dyn-key-btn tv-settings-hotkey-btn" data-id="${type}_${idx}">${c1_tradeGateEscape(item.key || t('unbound'))}</button><button class="dyn-del-btn tv-settings-icon-btn" data-type="${type}" data-idx="${idx}">${SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Remove' : '移除'}</button>`;
            container.appendChild(row);
        });
        container.querySelectorAll('.dyn-del-btn').forEach(btn => { btn.onclick = function() { c1_syncAllDOMToConfig(); const t_type = this.dataset.type; const i = parseInt(this.dataset.idx); if(t_type === 'tf') SysConfig.timeframes.splice(i, 1); else SysConfig.symbols.splice(i, 1); c1_renderDynamicList(containerId, t_type === 'tf' ? SysConfig.timeframes : SysConfig.symbols, t_type); c1_scheduleSettingsAutoSave(document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel'), 0); }; });
        c1_bindRecordButtons(container);
        c1_styleSelects(container);
    }
    function c1_renderCustomPanelsBuilder() {
        const container = document.getElementById('cp-builder-container'); if(!container) return; container.innerHTML = '';
        SysConfig.panels.forEach((p, idx) => {
            const card = document.createElement('div'); card.className = 'cp-card tv-settings-surface';
            const iconOptions = [ {val:'note', txt:'📝'}, {val:'star', txt:'⭐'}, {val:'book', txt:'📖'}, {val:'flag', txt:'🚩'}, {val:'zap', txt:'⚡'}, {val:'target', txt:'🎯'} ];
            const optsHtml = iconOptions.map(o => `<option value="${o.val}" ${p.icon===o.val?'selected':''}>${o.txt}</option>`).join('');
            card.innerHTML = `<div class="cp-header"><select class="cp-icon-sel cp-dyn-icon" data-idx="${idx}">${optsHtml}</select><input class="cp-title cp-dyn-title" type="text" value="${c1_tradeGateEscape(p.title)}" data-idx="${idx}" placeholder="${t('panelTitleHolder')}"><button class="tv-record-btn p1-btn tv-cp-hotkey-btn" data-id="cp_${idx}">${c1_tradeGateEscape(p.key || t('unbound'))}</button><button class="cp-del" data-idx="${idx}" aria-label="${SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Remove' : '移除'}">${SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Remove' : '移除'}</button></div><textarea class="cp-content cp-dyn-content" data-idx="${idx}" placeholder="${t('panelContentHolder')}">${c1_tradeGateEscape(p.content)}</textarea>`;
            card.querySelector('.cp-del').onclick = function() { c1_syncAllDOMToConfig(); const removed = SysConfig.panels.splice(parseInt(this.dataset.idx), 1)[0]; if (removed?.id && SysConfig.sidebarItems) delete SysConfig.sidebarItems[`custom:${removed.id}`]; c1_ensureSidebarConfig(); c1_renderCustomPanelsBuilder(); c1_renderSidebarManagerBuilder(); c1_scheduleSettingsAutoSave(document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel'), 0); }; container.appendChild(card);
        });
        c1_bindRecordButtons(container);
        c1_styleSelects(container);
    }

    function c1_getSidebarSettingEntries() {
        c1_ensureSidebarConfig();
        const entries = Object.entries(C1_CORE_SIDEBAR_MODULES).map(([id, meta]) => ({
            id,
            icon: meta.icon,
            label: meta.label?.[SysConfig.lang] || meta.label?.zh || id,
            custom: false
        }));
        (SysConfig.panels || []).forEach((panel, idx) => {
            entries.push({
                id: `custom:${panel.id}`,
                panelIndex: idx,
                panelId: panel.id,
                icon: panel.icon || 'note',
                label: panel.title || (SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Custom Panel' : '自定义按钮'),
                custom: true,
                panel
            });
        });
        return entries.sort((a, b) => {
            const ao = Number(SysConfig.sidebarItems?.[a.id]?.order);
            const bo = Number(SysConfig.sidebarItems?.[b.id]?.order);
            return (Number.isFinite(ao) ? ao : 999) - (Number.isFinite(bo) ? bo : 999);
        });
    }

    function c1_getSidebarHotkeyBinding(entry) {
        if (!entry) return { cls: 'p1-btn', id: '', value: '' };
        if (entry.custom) return { cls: 'p1-btn', id: `cp_${entry.panelIndex}`, value: entry.panel?.key || '' };
        if (entry.id === 'macro') return { cls: 'p2-btn', id: 'macro', value: C2_CONFIG.macroKey || '' };
        const toolMap = { tradegate: 'tradegate', risk: 'riskWindow' };
        const toolId = toolMap[entry.id] || entry.id;
        return { cls: 'p1-btn', id: `tool_${toolId}`, value: SysConfig.tools?.[toolId] || '' };
    }

    function c1_getCustomPanelIconOptions(selected) {
        const iconOptions = [
            { val: 'note', txt: '📝' },
            { val: 'star', txt: '⭐' },
            { val: 'book', txt: '📖' },
            { val: 'flag', txt: '🚩' },
            { val: 'zap', txt: '⚡' },
            { val: 'target', txt: '🎯' },
            { val: 'shield', txt: '🛡️' },
            { val: 'earth', txt: '🌍' },
            { val: 'list', txt: '☷' }
        ];
        return iconOptions.map(o => `<option value="${o.val}" ${selected === o.val ? 'selected' : ''}>${o.txt}</option>`).join('');
    }

    function c1_buildSidebarManagerHTML() {
        c1_ensureSidebarConfig();
        const sideLabel = (side) => SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? (side === 'right' ? 'Right' : 'Left') : (side === 'right' ? '右侧' : '左侧');
        const rows = c1_getSidebarSettingEntries().map(entry => {
            const item = SysConfig.sidebarItems[entry.id] || { enabled: true, side: 'left', order: 50 };
            const enabled = item.enabled !== false;
            const side = item.side === 'right' ? 'right' : 'left';
            const hotkey = c1_getSidebarHotkeyBinding(entry);
            const keyLabel = hotkey.value || t('unbound');
            const customEditor = entry.custom ? `<div class="tv-sidebar-custom-editor">
                <select class="tv-sidebar-custom-icon" data-idx="${entry.panelIndex}">${c1_getCustomPanelIconOptions(entry.panel?.icon || 'note')}</select>
                <input type="text" class="tv-sidebar-custom-title" data-idx="${entry.panelIndex}" value="${c1_tradeGateEscape(entry.panel?.title || '')}" placeholder="${t('panelTitleHolder')}">
                <button type="button" class="tv-settings-icon-btn tv-sidebar-custom-delete" data-idx="${entry.panelIndex}">${SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Delete' : '删除'}</button>
                <textarea class="tv-sidebar-custom-content" data-idx="${entry.panelIndex}" placeholder="${t('panelContentHolder')}">${c1_tradeGateEscape(entry.panel?.content || '')}</textarea>
            </div>` : '';
            return `<div class="tv-sidebar-row${entry.custom ? ' is-custom' : ''}" data-sidebar-id="${c1_tradeGateEscape(entry.id)}">
                <button type="button" class="tv-sidebar-drag" draggable="true" aria-label="${SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Drag to reorder' : '拖拽排序'}">⋮⋮</button>
                <div class="tv-sidebar-card-head"${entry.custom ? ` role="button" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="${SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Click to expand' : '点击展开'}"` : ''}>
                    <div class="tv-sidebar-name"><span class="tv-sidebar-name-icon">${resolveIcon(entry.icon)}</span><span>${c1_tradeGateEscape(entry.label)}</span></div>
                </div>
                <div class="tv-sidebar-controls">
                    <label class="tv-sidebar-control"><span class="tv-sidebar-control-label">${SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Side' : '位置'}</span><select class="tv-sidebar-side"><option value="left" ${side === 'left' ? 'selected' : ''}>${sideLabel('left')}</option><option value="right" ${side === 'right' ? 'selected' : ''}>${sideLabel('right')}</option></select></label>
                    <label class="tv-sidebar-control"><span class="tv-sidebar-control-label">${SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Hotkey' : '快捷键'}</span><button type="button" class="tv-record-btn ${hotkey.cls} tv-sidebar-hotkey" data-id="${hotkey.id}">${c1_tradeGateEscape(keyLabel)}</button></label>
                </div>
                <div class="tv-sidebar-enabled-wrap">${c1_settingsToggleInputHTML('class="tv-sidebar-enabled"', enabled)}</div>
                ${customEditor}
            </div>`;
        }).join('');
        const head = SysConfig.lang === 'en'
            ? '<div class="tv-sidebar-manager-head" aria-hidden="true"><span>Module</span><span>Side</span><span>Hotkey</span><span>On</span></div>'
            : '<div class="tv-sidebar-manager-head" aria-hidden="true"><span>模块</span><span>位置</span><span>快捷键</span><span>启用</span></div>';
        return `<div class="tv-sidebar-manager">${head}${rows}</div>`;
    }

    function c1_renderSidebarManagerBuilder() {
        const container = document.getElementById('tv-sidebar-manager-container');
        if (!container) return;
        container.innerHTML = c1_buildSidebarManagerHTML();
        container.querySelectorAll('.tv-sidebar-enabled').forEach(toggle => {
            toggle.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                const settingsPanel = document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel');
                c1_persistSettingsPanelState(settingsPanel);
                c1_renderSidebarSystem();
            });
        });
        let draggedSidebarRow = null;
        const persistSidebarOrder = () => {
            c1_collectSettingsPanelState(document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel'));
            c1_scheduleSettingsAutoSave(document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel'), 0);
            c1_renderSidebarSystem();
        };
        container.querySelectorAll('.tv-sidebar-row').forEach(row => {
            const dragHandle = row.querySelector('.tv-sidebar-drag');
            dragHandle?.addEventListener('dragstart', (event) => {
                if (event.target.closest?.('input, textarea, select, button:not(.tv-sidebar-drag), .tv-select-shell, .tv-sidebar-custom-editor')) return;
                draggedSidebarRow = row;
                row.classList.add('is-dragging');
                event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
                event.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', row.dataset.sidebarId || '');
            });
            row.addEventListener('dragover', (event) => {
                if (event.target.closest?.('input, textarea, select, button:not(.tv-sidebar-drag), .tv-select-shell, .tv-sidebar-custom-editor')) return;
                if (!draggedSidebarRow || draggedSidebarRow === row) return;
                event.preventDefault();
                const rect = row.getBoundingClientRect();
                const after = event.clientY > rect.top + rect.height / 2;
                row.parentNode.insertBefore(draggedSidebarRow, after ? row.nextSibling : row);
            });
            dragHandle?.addEventListener('dragend', () => {
                if (!draggedSidebarRow) return;
                draggedSidebarRow.classList.remove('is-dragging');
                draggedSidebarRow = null;
                persistSidebarOrder();
            });
        });
        container.querySelectorAll('input, textarea, select, .tv-select-shell').forEach(control => {
            control.addEventListener('dragstart', event => event.stopPropagation());
            control.addEventListener('mousedown', event => event.stopPropagation());
            control.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => event.stopPropagation());
            control.addEventListener('touchstart', event => event.stopPropagation(), { passive: true });
        });
        container.querySelectorAll('.tv-sidebar-row.is-custom .tv-sidebar-card-head').forEach(head => {
            const toggleEditor = () => {
                const row = head.closest('.tv-sidebar-row');
                const editor = row?.querySelector('.tv-sidebar-custom-editor');
                if (!editor) return;
                const open = !editor.classList.contains('is-open');
                editor.classList.toggle('is-open', open);
                row.classList.toggle('is-open', open);
                head.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
                head.removeAttribute('title');
                head.setAttribute('aria-label', open ? (SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Click to collapse' : '点击收起') : (SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Click to expand' : '点击展开'));
            };
            head.addEventListener('click', toggleEditor);
            head.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
                if (event.key !== 'Enter' && event.key !== ' ') return;
                event.preventDefault();
                toggleEditor();
            });
        });
        container.querySelectorAll('.tv-sidebar-side').forEach(input => {
            input.addEventListener('change', () => {
                const settingsPanel = document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel');
                c1_persistSettingsPanelState(settingsPanel);
                c1_renderSidebarSystem();
            });
            input.addEventListener('input', () => c1_scheduleSettingsAutoSave(document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel')));
        });
        container.querySelectorAll('.tv-sidebar-custom-title, .tv-sidebar-custom-icon, .tv-sidebar-custom-content').forEach(input => {
            const markDirty = () => input.closest('.tv-sidebar-custom-editor')?.classList.add('is-dirty');
            input.addEventListener('change', () => { markDirty(); c1_scheduleSettingsAutoSave(document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel'), 0); });
            input.addEventListener('input', () => { markDirty(); c1_scheduleSettingsAutoSave(document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel')); });
        });
        container.querySelectorAll('.tv-sidebar-custom-delete').forEach(btn => {
            btn.onclick = () => {
                c1_collectSettingsPanelState(document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel'));
                const idx = parseInt(btn.dataset.idx, 10);
                const removed = SysConfig.panels.splice(idx, 1)[0];
                if (removed?.id && SysConfig.sidebarItems) delete SysConfig.sidebarItems[`custom:${removed.id}`];
                c1_ensureSidebarConfig();
                c1_renderCustomPanelsBuilder();
                c1_renderSidebarManagerBuilder();
                c1_scheduleSettingsAutoSave(document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel'), 0);
            };
        });
        c1_bindRecordButtons(container);
        c1_styleSelects(container);
    }

    function c1_syncAllDOMToConfig(root = document) {
        root.querySelectorAll('.tv-dyn-input').forEach(input => {
            const type = input.dataset.type;
            const idx = parseInt(input.dataset.idx);
            const value = String(input.value || '').trim();
            input.value = value;
            if(type === 'tf' && SysConfig.timeframes[idx]) SysConfig.timeframes[idx].val = value;
            else if (SysConfig.symbols[idx]) SysConfig.symbols[idx].val = value;
        });
        root.querySelectorAll('.cp-dyn-title').forEach(input => { if(SysConfig.panels[parseInt(input.dataset.idx)]) SysConfig.panels[parseInt(input.dataset.idx)].title = input.value; });
        root.querySelectorAll('.cp-dyn-icon').forEach(sel => { if(SysConfig.panels[parseInt(sel.dataset.idx)]) SysConfig.panels[parseInt(sel.dataset.idx)].icon = sel.value; });
        root.querySelectorAll('.cp-dyn-content').forEach(ta => { if(SysConfig.panels[parseInt(ta.dataset.idx)]) SysConfig.panels[parseInt(ta.dataset.idx)].content = ta.value; });
        root.querySelectorAll('.tv-sidebar-custom-editor.is-open, .tv-sidebar-custom-editor.is-dirty').forEach(editor => {
            const idx = parseInt(editor.querySelector('[data-idx]')?.dataset.idx, 10);
            const panel = SysConfig.panels[idx];
            if (!panel) return;
            const title = editor.querySelector('.tv-sidebar-custom-title');
            const icon = editor.querySelector('.tv-sidebar-custom-icon');
            const content = editor.querySelector('.tv-sidebar-custom-content');
            if (title) panel.title = title.value;
            if (icon) panel.icon = icon.value;
            if (content) panel.content = content.value;
        });

        root.querySelectorAll('.p1-btn').forEach(btn => {
            const id = btn.dataset.id; const keyStr = (btn.textContent === t('unbound') || btn.textContent === t('pressKey')) ? '' : SharedTV.normalizeShortcutString(btn.textContent);
            if (!id) return;
            if(id.startsWith('tool_')) {
                const toolId = id.replace('tool_','');
                SysConfig.tools[toolId] = keyStr;
            }
            else if(id === 'global_immersive') { SysConfig.immersiveKey = keyStr; }
            else if(id.startsWith('tf_')) { if(SysConfig.timeframes[parseInt(id.replace('tf_',''))]) SysConfig.timeframes[parseInt(id.replace('tf_',''))].key = keyStr; }
            else if(id.startsWith('sym_')) { if(SysConfig.symbols[parseInt(id.replace('sym_',''))]) SysConfig.symbols[parseInt(id.replace('sym_',''))].key = keyStr; }
            else if(id.startsWith('cp_')) { if(SysConfig.panels[parseInt(id.replace('cp_',''))]) SysConfig.panels[parseInt(id.replace('cp_',''))].key = keyStr; }
        });
        root.querySelectorAll('.p2-btn').forEach(btn => {
            const id = btn.dataset.id;
            const keyStr = (btn.textContent === t('unbound') || btn.textContent === t('pressKey')) ? '' : SharedTV.normalizeShortcutString(btn.textContent);
            if (id === 'macro') C2_CONFIG.macroKey = keyStr;
        });

        const smartMagnetToggle = root.querySelector('#tv-smart-magnet-toggle');
        if (smartMagnetToggle) {
            c1_ensureSmartMagnetConfig();
            SysConfig.smartMagnet.enabled = !!smartMagnetToggle.checked;
        }
        root.querySelectorAll('.tv-smart-magnet-rule').forEach((select) => {
            c1_ensureSmartMagnetConfig();
            if (select.dataset.toolId) SysConfig.smartMagnet.toolRules[select.dataset.toolId] = ['on', 'off', 'ignore'].includes(select.value) ? select.value : 'ignore';
        });
    }

    function c1_collectSettingsPanelState(panel = document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel')) {
        if (!panel) return;
        SysConfig.avatar = c1_tempAvatar;
        const usernameEl = panel.querySelector('#tv-username-input');
        if (usernameEl) SysConfig.username = usernameEl.value.trim() || 'Trader';
        SysConfig.riskDisplayMode = 'floating';

        const emojiToggle = panel.querySelector('#tv-emoji-toggle');
        if (emojiToggle) SysConfig.showToastEmoji = !!emojiToggle.checked;

        const notificationToggle = panel.querySelector('#tv-notification-toggle');
        if (notificationToggle) SysConfig.showNotifications = !!notificationToggle.checked;
        const keepAutoScaleToggle = panel.querySelector('#tv-keep-auto-scale-after-reset-toggle');
        if (keepAutoScaleToggle) SysConfig.keepAutoScaleAfterReset = !!keepAutoScaleToggle.checked;
        const immersiveEnabledToggle = panel.querySelector('#tv-immersive-enabled-toggle');
        if (immersiveEnabledToggle) SysConfig.immersiveEnabled = !!immersiveEnabledToggle.checked;

        const immersiveAutoToggle = panel.querySelector('#tv-immersive-auto-toggle');
        if (immersiveAutoToggle) SysConfig.immersiveAutoStart = !!immersiveAutoToggle.checked;

        const suppressNativeToastToggle = panel.querySelector('#tv-suppress-native-toast-toggle');
        if (suppressNativeToastToggle) SysConfig.suppressNativeImmersiveToast = !!suppressNativeToastToggle.checked;
        const immersiveHudModeSelect = panel.querySelector('#tv-immersive-hud-mode');
        if (immersiveHudModeSelect) SysConfig.immersiveHudMode = c1_normalizeImmersiveHudMode(immersiveHudModeSelect.value);
        const immersiveHudThemeSelect = panel.querySelector('#tv-immersive-hud-theme');
        if (immersiveHudThemeSelect) {
            SysConfig.immersiveHudTheme = c1_normalizeImmersiveHudTheme(immersiveHudThemeSelect.value);
            c1_applyImmersiveHudTheme();
        }
        const immersiveHudDynamicMsInput = panel.querySelector('#tv-immersive-hud-dynamic-ms');
        if (immersiveHudDynamicMsInput) SysConfig.immersiveHudDynamicMs = c1_normalizeImmersiveHudDynamicMs(immersiveHudDynamicMsInput.value);
        const immersiveHudScaleInput = panel.querySelector('#tv-immersive-hud-scale');
        if (immersiveHudScaleInput) SysConfig.immersiveHudScale = c1_normalizeImmersiveHudScale(immersiveHudScaleInput.value);
        const immersiveProfileScaleInput = panel.querySelector('#tv-immersive-profile-scale');
        if (immersiveProfileScaleInput) SysConfig.immersiveProfileScale = c1_normalizeImmersiveProfileScale(immersiveProfileScaleInput.value);

        SysConfig.immersiveMarketColors = c1_normalizeImmersiveMarketColors(SysConfig.immersiveMarketColors);
        panel.querySelectorAll('.tv-immersive-color-input').forEach(input => {
            const kind = input.dataset.kind;
            if (kind && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(SysConfig.immersiveMarketColors, kind) && c1_isValidHexColor(input.value)) {
                SysConfig.immersiveMarketColors[kind] = input.value;
            }
        });
        const immersiveTipsInput = panel.querySelector('#tv-immersive-tips-input');
        if (immersiveTipsInput) SysConfig.immersiveTips = c1_normalizeImmersiveTips(immersiveTipsInput.value);

        SysConfig.bearPet = c1_normalizeBearPetConfig(SysConfig.bearPet);
        const bearEnabledToggle = panel.querySelector('#tv-bear-enabled-toggle');
        if (bearEnabledToggle) SysConfig.bearPet.enabled = !!bearEnabledToggle.checked;
        const bearScaleInput = panel.querySelector('#tv-bear-scale-input');
        if (bearScaleInput) {
            const scale = Number(bearScaleInput.value);
            if (Number.isFinite(scale)) SysConfig.bearPet.scale = Math.min(Math.max(scale, 0.55), 1.8);
        }
        const bearMoodSelect = panel.querySelector('#tv-bear-mood-select');
        if (bearMoodSelect && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(C1_BEAR_MOODS, bearMoodSelect.value)) SysConfig.bearPet.mood = bearMoodSelect.value;
        const bearImmersiveMode = panel.querySelector('#tv-bear-immersive-mode');
        if (bearImmersiveMode && ['show', 'hide', 'only'].includes(bearImmersiveMode.value)) SysConfig.bearPet.immersiveMode = bearImmersiveMode.value;

        const riskToggle = panel.querySelector('#tv-risk-toggle');
        if (riskToggle) SysConfig.riskEnabled = !!riskToggle.checked;

        const posWrap = panel.querySelector('#tv-risk-float-position');
        if (posWrap) SysConfig.riskFloatPosition = posWrap.value === 'right' ? 'right' : 'left';

        const macroUrlEl = panel.querySelector('#tv-macro-api-url');
        const macroIconEl = panel.querySelector('#macro-icon-sel');
        if (macroUrlEl) C2_CONFIG.macroApiUrl = macroUrlEl.value.trim() || C2_CONFIG.macroApiUrl;
        if (macroIconEl) C2_CONFIG.macroIcon = macroIconEl.value || 'earth';

        panel.querySelectorAll('.p2-btn').forEach(btn => {
            if (btn.dataset.id === 'macro') {
                const keyStr = (btn.textContent === t('unbound') || btn.textContent === t('pressKey')) ? '' : SharedTV.normalizeShortcutString(btn.textContent);
                C2_CONFIG.macroKey = keyStr;
            }
        });

        c1_syncAllDOMToConfig(panel);
        const sidebarRows = panel.querySelectorAll('#tv-sidebar-manager-container .tv-sidebar-row');
        if (sidebarRows.length) {
            c1_ensureSidebarConfig();
            sidebarRows.forEach((row, idx) => {
                const id = row.dataset.sidebarId;
                if (!id) return;
                const enabledEl = row.querySelector('.tv-sidebar-enabled');
                const sideEl = row.querySelector('.tv-sidebar-side');
                SysConfig.sidebarItems[id] = {
                    enabled: enabledEl ? !!enabledEl.checked : true,
                    side: sideEl && sideEl.value === 'right' ? 'right' : 'left',
                    order: (idx + 1) * 10
                };
            });
            SysConfig.riskFloatPosition = SysConfig.sidebarItems.risk?.side === 'right' ? 'right' : 'left';
        } else {
            c1_ensureSidebarConfig();
        }
    }

    function c1_persistSettingsPanelState(panel = document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel')) {
        try {
            c1_collectSettingsPanelState(panel);
            const c2Ok = c2_saveConfig();
            const c1Ok = c1_saveConfig();
            if (!c2Ok || !c1Ok) throw new Error('storage quota or write failure');
            c1_updateSettingsSaveStatus('saved');
            return true;
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('[TV-GCC] Failed to save settings', err);
            c1_updateSettingsSaveStatus('error');
            try { SharedTV.showToast(c1_lang('Settings save failed. Check console for details.', '配置保存失败，请查看控制台错误。'), true); } catch (toastErr) {}
            return false;
        }
    }

    function c1_scheduleSettingsAutoSave(panel = document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel'), delay = 220) {
        if (!panel || !panel.isConnected) return;
        if (c1_recordingId || c2_recordingId) return;
        if (c1_settingsAutoSaveTimer) clearTimeout(c1_settingsAutoSaveTimer);
        c1_updateSettingsSaveStatus('saving');
        c1_settingsAutoSaveTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            c1_settingsAutoSaveTimer = null;
            if (!panel.isConnected) return;
            c1_persistSettingsPanelState(panel);
        }, Math.max(0, delay));
    }

    function c1_bindRecordButtons(contextNode = document) {
        contextNode.querySelectorAll('.p1-btn, .p2-btn').forEach(btn => {
            if (!btn.dataset.id) return;
            if (btn.dataset.recordBound === '1') return;
            btn.dataset.recordBound = '1';
            btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                document.querySelectorAll('.p1-btn, .p2-btn').forEach(b => {
                    if (!b.dataset.id) return;
                    b.style.background = 'var(--my-bg-input)'; b.style.color = 'var(--my-text)'; b.style.borderColor = 'var(--my-border)';
                    if(b.textContent === t('pressKey') || b.textContent === '按键...') {
                        const id = b.dataset.id; let origKey = '';
                        if(b.classList.contains('p1-btn')) {
                            if(id.startsWith('tool_')) origKey = SysConfig.tools[id.replace('tool_','')];
                            else if(id === 'global_immersive') origKey = SysConfig.immersiveKey;
                            else if(id.startsWith('tf_')) origKey = SysConfig.timeframes[parseInt(id.replace('tf_',''))]?.key;
                            else if(id.startsWith('sym_')) origKey = SysConfig.symbols[parseInt(id.replace('sym_',''))]?.key;
                            else if(id.startsWith('cp_')) origKey = SysConfig.panels[parseInt(id.replace('cp_',''))]?.key;
                            b.textContent = origKey || t('unbound');
                        } else {
                            if(id === 'macro') origKey = C2_CONFIG.macroKey;
                            b.textContent = origKey || t('unbound');
                        }
                    }
                });
                c1_recordingButton = this;
                if(this.classList.contains('p1-btn')) { c1_recordingId = this.dataset.id; c2_recordingId = null; this.textContent = t('pressKey'); }
                else { c2_recordingId = this.dataset.id; c1_recordingId = null; this.textContent = t('pressKey'); }
                this.style.background = 'var(--my-accent)'; this.style.color = 'white'; this.style.borderColor = 'var(--my-accent)'; this.blur();
            });
        });
    }

    function c1_bindSettingsDetailsToggles(panel = document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel')) {
        if (!panel) return;
        panel.querySelectorAll('.tv-settings-details > summary').forEach(summary => {
            if (summary.dataset.detailsBound === '1') return;
            summary.dataset.detailsBound = '1';
            summary.setAttribute('role', 'button');
            summary.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
            const details = summary.closest('details');
            const sync = () => summary.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!!details?.open));
            sync();
            if (details?.dataset.settingsDetailsId === 'work-journey-bear') {
                details.addEventListener('toggle', sync);
                return;
            }
            summary.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
                event.stopPropagation();
                requestAnimationFrame(sync);
                requestAnimationFrame(() => c1_captureSettingsUiState(panel));
            });
            summary.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
                if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
                    event.stopPropagation();
                    requestAnimationFrame(sync);
                    requestAnimationFrame(() => c1_captureSettingsUiState(panel));
                }
            });
            details?.addEventListener('toggle', sync);
        });
    }

    function c1_captureSettingsUiState(panel = document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel')) {
        if (!panel) return c1_settingsUiState;
        const activeTab = panel.querySelector('.tv-settings-nav-btn.is-active')?.dataset.settingsTab
            || panel.querySelector('.tv-settings-category.is-active')?.dataset.settingsPanel
            || c1_settingsUiState.tab
            || 'today';
