        const scrollTop = panel.querySelector('.tv-settings-content')?.scrollTop || 0;
        const detailsOpen = {};
        panel.querySelectorAll('.tv-settings-details[data-settings-details-id]').forEach(details => {
            if (details.dataset.settingsDetailsId === 'work-journey-bear') return;
            detailsOpen[details.dataset.settingsDetailsId] = !!details.open;
        });
        c1_settingsUiState = { tab: activeTab, scrollTop, detailsOpen };
        return c1_settingsUiState;
    }

    function c1_restoreSettingsUiState(panel = document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel'), state = c1_settingsUiState) {
        if (!panel || !state) return;
        const tab = state.tab || 'today';
        const hasTab = !!panel.querySelector(`.tv-settings-nav-btn[data-settings-tab="${tab}"]`);
        const nextTab = hasTab ? tab : 'today';
        panel.querySelectorAll('.tv-settings-nav-btn').forEach(item => item.classList.toggle('is-active', item.dataset.settingsTab === nextTab));
        panel.querySelectorAll('.tv-settings-category').forEach(item => item.classList.toggle('is-active', item.dataset.settingsPanel === nextTab));
        Object.entries(state.detailsOpen || {}).forEach(([id, open]) => {
            if (id === 'work-journey-bear') return;
            const details = panel.querySelector(`.tv-settings-details[data-settings-details-id="${c1_escapeSelectorValue(id)}"]`);
            if (details) details.open = !!open;
        });
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            const content = panel.querySelector('.tv-settings-content');
            if (content) content.scrollTop = state.scrollTop || 0;
            c1_mountToggleMotion(panel);
        });
    }

    function c1_activateSettingsTab(panel, tab, options = {}) {
        if (!panel || !tab) return;
        const targetBtn = panel.querySelector(`.tv-settings-nav-btn[data-settings-tab="${tab}"]`);
        if (!targetBtn) return;
        panel.querySelectorAll('.tv-settings-nav-btn').forEach(item => item.classList.toggle('is-active', item === targetBtn));
        panel.querySelectorAll('.tv-settings-category').forEach(item => item.classList.toggle('is-active', item.dataset.settingsPanel === tab));
        if (options.resetScroll) {
            const content = panel.querySelector('.tv-settings-content');
            if (content) content.scrollTop = 0;
        }
        c1_captureSettingsUiState(panel);
        requestAnimationFrame(() => c1_mountToggleMotion(panel));
    }

    function c1_hideSettingsPanel() {
        const panel = document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel');
        if (panel) {
            document.removeEventListener('mousedown', c1_handleSettingsOutsidePointer, true);
            c1_cleanupPortaledMenus();
            if (c1_settingsAutoSaveTimer) { clearTimeout(c1_settingsAutoSaveTimer); c1_settingsAutoSaveTimer = null; }
            c1_captureSettingsUiState(panel);
            c1_syncAllDOMToConfig(panel);
            c1_persistSettingsPanelState(panel);
            panel.style.opacity = '0'; panel.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) scale(${SysConfig.panelScale * 0.925})`;
            c1_recordingId = null; c2_recordingId = null; c1_recordingButton = null; if(c1_clockInterval) { clearInterval(c1_clockInterval); c1_clockInterval = null; }
            setTimeout(() => { panel.remove(); c1_loadConfig(); c1_syncOverlayStackState(); }, 265);
        }
    }

    function c1_handleSettingsOutsidePointer(event) {
        const panel = document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel');
        if (!panel || panel.style.visibility !== 'visible') return;
        const target = event.target;
        if (target?.closest?.('#tv-settings-panel, #tv-danger-confirm-modal, .tv-select-menu, .tv-draw-tool-picker-menu, #tv-custom-notifier-container')) return;
        c1_hideSettingsPanel();
    }

    async function c1_clearTradingViewLocalCacheKeepPluginData() {
        const keepLocal = new Map();
        [
            V20_STORAGE_KEY,
            P2_STORAGE_KEY,
            C1_TRADE_GATE_RUNTIME_KEY,
            V20_FIRST_TIME_KEY,
            'tv_rk_broker',
            'tv_rk_icon',
            'tv_rk_bal'
        ].forEach(key => {
            try {
                const value = localStorage.getItem(key);
                if (value != null) keepLocal.set(key, value);
            } catch (e) {}
        });

        try { localStorage.clear(); } catch (e) {}
        keepLocal.forEach((value, key) => {
            try { localStorage.setItem(key, value); } catch (e) {}
        });
        try { sessionStorage.clear(); } catch (e) {}

        try {
            if (window.indexedDB?.databases) {
                const dbs = await indexedDB.databases();
                await Promise.all((dbs || []).map(db => new Promise(resolve => {
                    if (!db?.name) return resolve();
                    const req = indexedDB.deleteDatabase(db.name);
                    req.onsuccess = req.onerror = req.onblocked = () => resolve();
                })));
            }
        } catch (e) {}

        try {
            if (window.caches?.keys) {
                const keys = await caches.keys();
                await Promise.all(keys.map(key => caches.delete(key)));
            }
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    function c1_applyTradeGateScale(nextScale) {
        const value = Number(nextScale);
        if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) return;
        SysConfig.panelScale = value;
        const settingsPanel = document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel');
        if (settingsPanel) settingsPanel.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) scale(${value})`;
        if (c1_tradeGateCompactHost) c1_tradeGateCompactHost.style.setProperty('--tg-scale', String(value));
        if (c1_tradeGateWindowEl) c1_tradeGateWindowEl.style.setProperty('--tg-scale', String(value));
        const riskPanel = document.getElementById('panel-risk');
        if (riskPanel) riskPanel.style.setProperty('--rk-scale', String(value));
        setTimeout(c1_saveConfig, 0);
    }

    function c1_formatPanelScaleLabel(scale = SysConfig.panelScale || 1) {
        const value = Number(scale);
        if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return '1x';
        return `${Math.round(value * 10) / 10}x`;
    }

    function c1_markSubmitting(form, duration = 520) {
        if (!(form instanceof HTMLFormElement)) return;
        const submitter = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"], .tg-btn-primary');
        if (!submitter) return;
        submitter.classList.add('is-loading');
        submitter.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
        clearTimeout(submitter._loadingTimer);
        submitter._loadingTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            submitter.classList.remove('is-loading');
            submitter.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
        }, duration);
    }

    function c1_syncScalePillsActive(value) {
        const containers = document.querySelectorAll('#tv-scale-presets, #tv-scale-presets-inline, #tv-scale-presets-toolbar');
        containers.forEach((container) => {
            container.querySelectorAll('.tg-scale-pill').forEach(btn => {
                btn.classList.toggle('is-active', Math.abs(parseFloat(btn.dataset.scale) - value) < 0.001);
            });
            const group = container.querySelector('.tv-toggle-motion');
            if (group) c1_updateToggleIndicator(group);
        });
    }

    function c1_renderScalePresets() {
        const scales = [0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 1.1, 1.2, 1.3];
        const containers = document.querySelectorAll('#tv-scale-presets, #tv-scale-presets-inline, #tv-scale-presets-toolbar');
        if (!containers.length) return;
        containers.forEach((container) => {
            container.innerHTML = `<div class="tg-scale-group tv-toggle-motion">${scales.map(s => `<button type="button" class="tg-scale-pill${Math.abs((SysConfig.panelScale || 1) - s) < 0.001 ? ' is-active' : ''}" data-scale="${s}">${s}x</button>`).join('')}</div>`;
            container.querySelectorAll('.tg-scale-pill').forEach(btn => { btn.onclick = function() { const v = parseFloat(this.dataset.scale); c1_applyTradeGateScale(v); c1_syncScalePillsActive(v); }; });
            c1_mountToggleMotion(container);
        });
        const displayBtn = document.getElementById('tv-display-menu-btn');
        if (displayBtn) displayBtn.textContent = SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'View' : '视图';
    }

    function c1_formatSettingsSaveTime(date = new Date()) {
        try { return date.toLocaleTimeString(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'en-GB' : 'zh-CN', { hour12: false, hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }); }
        catch (e) { return date.toTimeString().slice(0, 8); }
    }

    function c1_updateSettingsSaveStatus(state = 'saved', detail = '') {
        const el = document.getElementById('tv-settings-save-status');
        if (!el) return;
        el.classList.remove('is-saving', 'is-error');
        if (state === 'saving') {
            el.classList.add('is-saving');
            el.textContent = SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Saving...' : '正在保存...';
            return;
        }
        if (state === 'error') {
            el.classList.add('is-error');
            el.textContent = detail || (SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Save failed' : '保存失败');
            return;
        }
        const time = detail || c1_formatSettingsSaveTime();
        el.textContent = SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? `Saved ${time}` : `已保存 ${time}`;
    }

    function c1_findToolNameById(id) {
        const meta = c1_findToolMetaById(id);
        return meta ? (meta.name[SysConfig.lang] || meta.name.zh || id) : id;
    }

    function c1_getSettingsHotkeyBindings() {
        const bindings = [];
        const add = (key, label, target) => {
            const normalized = SharedTV.normalizeShortcutString(key);
            if (!normalized) return;
            bindings.push({ key: normalized, label, target });
        };
        add('P', c1_lang('Settings (reserved)', '设置面板（保留键）'), { type: 'reserved', id: 'settings' });
        const tools = SysConfig.tools || {};
        c1_getActiveToolBindingEntries().forEach(({ id, conf }) => {
            const label = conf?.name?.[SysConfig.lang] || conf?.name?.zh || c1_findToolNameById(id);
            add(tools[id], label, { type: 'tool', id });
        });
        add(SysConfig.immersiveKey, c1_getImmersiveModeLabel(), { type: 'immersive' });
        (SysConfig.timeframes || []).forEach((tf, index) => add(tf.key, `${c1_lang('Timeframe', '周期')} ${tf.val || ''}`.trim(), { type: 'tf', index }));
        (SysConfig.symbols || []).forEach((sym, index) => add(sym.key, `${c1_lang('Symbol', '品种')} ${sym.val || ''}`.trim(), { type: 'sym', index }));
        (SysConfig.panels || []).forEach((panel, index) => add(panel.key, panel.title || c1_lang('Custom panel', '自定义面板'), { type: 'panel', index }));
        try { add(C2_CONFIG?.macroKey, c1_lang('Macro Calendar', '实时宏观日历'), { type: 'macro' }); } catch (e) {}
        return bindings;
    }

    function c1_getSettingsHotkeyConflicts() {
        const map = new Map();
        c1_getSettingsHotkeyBindings().forEach(binding => {
            if (!map.has(binding.key)) map.set(binding.key, []);
            map.get(binding.key).push({ label: binding.label, target: binding.target });
        });
        return Array.from(map.entries())
            .filter(([, bindings]) => bindings.length > 1)
            .map(([key, bindings]) => ({ key, bindings }));
    }

    function c1_buildHotkeyConflictPanelHTML(conflicts = c1_getSettingsHotkeyConflicts()) {
        if (!conflicts.length) return '';
        const rows = conflicts.map(conflict => {
            const labels = conflict.bindings.map(item => item.label).join(' / ');
            return `<div class="tv-hotkey-conflict-row"><span class="tv-hotkey-conflict-key">${c1_tradeGateEscape(conflict.key)}</span><span class="tv-hotkey-conflict-bindings">${c1_tradeGateEscape(labels)}</span></div>`;
        }).join('');
        return `
            <div class="tv-hotkey-conflict-panel" id="tv-hotkey-conflict-panel">
                <div class="tv-hotkey-conflict-head">
                    <strong>${c1_lang('Hotkey conflicts detected', '检测到快捷键冲突')}</strong>
                    <button type="button" class="tv-settings-mini-btn" id="tv-clear-hotkey-conflicts">${c1_lang('Clear duplicates', '清理重复绑定')}</button>
                </div>
                <div class="tv-hotkey-conflict-list">${rows}</div>
            </div>
        `;
    }

    function c1_clearDuplicateHotkeyBindings() {
        const conflicts = c1_getSettingsHotkeyConflicts();
        const clearTarget = (target) => {
            if (!target) return;
            if (target.type === 'tool' && SysConfig.tools) SysConfig.tools[target.id] = '';
            if (target.type === 'immersive') SysConfig.immersiveKey = '';
            if (target.type === 'tf' && SysConfig.timeframes?.[target.index]) SysConfig.timeframes[target.index].key = '';
            if (target.type === 'sym' && SysConfig.symbols?.[target.index]) SysConfig.symbols[target.index].key = '';
            if (target.type === 'panel' && SysConfig.panels?.[target.index]) SysConfig.panels[target.index].key = '';
            if (target.type === 'macro' && C2_CONFIG) C2_CONFIG.macroKey = '';
        };
        conflicts.forEach(conflict => conflict.bindings.slice(1).forEach(item => clearTarget(item.target)));
        return conflicts.length;
    }

    function c1_getHotkeyTargetByRecordId(recordId, isP2 = false) {
        if (!recordId) return null;
        if (isP2) return recordId === 'macro' ? { type: 'macro' } : null;
        if (recordId.startsWith('tool_')) return { type: 'tool', id: recordId.replace('tool_', '') };
        if (recordId === 'global_immersive') return { type: 'immersive' };
        if (recordId.startsWith('tf_')) return { type: 'tf', index: parseInt(recordId.replace('tf_', ''), 10) };
        if (recordId.startsWith('sym_')) return { type: 'sym', index: parseInt(recordId.replace('sym_', ''), 10) };
        if (recordId.startsWith('cp_')) return { type: 'panel', index: parseInt(recordId.replace('cp_', ''), 10) };
        return null;
    }

    function c1_getRecordIdByHotkeyTarget(target) {
        if (!target) return null;
        if (target.type === 'reserved') return { reserved: true, id: target.id };
        if (target.type === 'macro') return { selector: '.p2-btn', id: 'macro', isP2: true };
        if (target.type === 'tool') return { selector: '.p1-btn', id: `tool_${target.id}`, isP2: false };
        if (target.type === 'immersive') return { selector: '.p1-btn', id: 'global_immersive', isP2: false };
        if (target.type === 'tf') return { selector: '.p1-btn', id: `tf_${target.index}`, isP2: false };
        if (target.type === 'sym') return { selector: '.p1-btn', id: `sym_${target.index}`, isP2: false };
        if (target.type === 'panel') return { selector: '.p1-btn', id: `cp_${target.index}`, isP2: false };
        return null;
    }

    function c1_findHotkeyConflictForRecord(shortcutStr, recordId, isP2 = false) {
        const normalized = SharedTV.normalizeShortcutString(shortcutStr);
        if (!normalized) return null;
        const currentTarget = c1_getHotkeyTargetByRecordId(recordId, isP2);
        const sameTarget = (a, b) => !!a && !!b && a.type === b.type && String(a.id ?? a.index ?? '') === String(b.id ?? b.index ?? '');
        const target = c1_getSettingsHotkeyBindings()
            .filter(item => item.key === normalized)
            .map(item => item.target)
            .find(target => !sameTarget(target, currentTarget));
        return c1_getRecordIdByHotkeyTarget(target);
    }

    function c1_clearHotkeyTargetByRecordId(recordId, isP2 = false) {
        if (!recordId) return;
        if (isP2) {
            if (recordId === 'macro') C2_CONFIG.macroKey = '';
            return;
        }
        if (recordId.startsWith('tool_')) {
            const toolId = recordId.replace('tool_', '');
            if (SysConfig.tools) SysConfig.tools[toolId] = '';
            return;
        }
        if (recordId === 'global_immersive') { SysConfig.immersiveKey = ''; return; }
        if (recordId.startsWith('tf_')) {
            const idx = parseInt(recordId.replace('tf_', ''), 10);
            if (SysConfig.timeframes?.[idx]) SysConfig.timeframes[idx].key = '';
            return;
        }
        if (recordId.startsWith('sym_')) {
            const idx = parseInt(recordId.replace('sym_', ''), 10);
            if (SysConfig.symbols?.[idx]) SysConfig.symbols[idx].key = '';
            return;
        }
        if (recordId.startsWith('cp_')) {
            const idx = parseInt(recordId.replace('cp_', ''), 10);
            if (SysConfig.panels?.[idx]) SysConfig.panels[idx].key = '';
        }
    }

    function c1_buildTodaySummaryHTML(tradeGateSettings, defaultDirectionLabel) {
        const riskEnabled = SysConfig.riskEnabled !== false;

        const tradeKey = SysConfig.tools?.tradegate || t('unbound');

        const conflictSub = conflicts.length ? conflicts.slice(0, 2).map(item => item.key).join(' / ') : c1_lang('Ready for chart work', '快捷键可直接使用');
        return `
            <div class="tv-today-summary">
                <div class="tv-today-summary-card"><span class="tv-today-summary-label">Trade Gate</span><span class="tv-today-summary-value">${c1_tradeGateEscape(tradeKey)} / ${c1_tradeGateEscape(tradeFullKey)}</span><span class="tv-today-summary-sub">${c1_lang('Sidebar / full window', '侧栏 / 完整浮窗')}</span></div>
                <div class="tv-today-summary-card"><span class="tv-today-summary-label">${t('riskBase')}</span><span class="tv-today-summary-value">${riskEnabled ? c1_lang('Enabled', '已启用') : c1_lang('Disabled', '已关闭')} · ${riskSide} · ${c1_tradeGateEscape(riskKey)}</span><span class="tv-today-summary-sub">${c1_lang('Position sizing panel', '仓位核算面板')}</span></div>
                <div class="tv-today-summary-card"><span class="tv-today-summary-label">${c1_lang('Default Trade', '默认交易')}</span><span class="tv-today-summary-value">${c1_tradeGateEscape(tradeGateSettings.defaultSymbol)} · ${c1_tradeGateEscape(tradeGateSettings.defaultHtfMode)} · ${c1_tradeGateEscape(defaultDirectionLabel)}</span><span class="tv-today-summary-sub">${c1_lang('New checklist defaults', '新检查默认带入')}</span></div>

' is-warning' : ''}"><span class="tv-today-summary-label">${c1_lang('Hotkeys', '快捷键状态')}</span><span class="tv-today-summary-value">${c1_tradeGateEscape(conflictText)}</span><span class="tv-today-summary-sub">${c1_tradeGateEscape(conflictSub)}</span></div>
                ${c1_buildHotkeyConflictPanelHTML(conflicts)}
            </div>
        `;
    }

    function c1_buildMaintenanceStatusHTML() {

    let c1_activeDangerConfirmFinish = null;

    function c1_finishActiveDangerConfirm(value = false, options = {}) {
        if (typeof c1_activeDangerConfirmFinish !== 'function') return false;
        c1_activeDangerConfirmFinish(value === true, options);
        return true;
    }

    function c1_showDangerConfirm({ title, subtitle = '', body = '', items = [], confirmText = '', cancelText = '' }) {
        c1_ensureDeferredPanelStyles();
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            const old = document.getElementById('tv-danger-confirm-modal');
            if (!c1_finishActiveDangerConfirm(false, { immediate: true }) && old) old.remove();
            const previouslyFocused = document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement ? document.activeElement : null;
            let settled = false;
            const modal = document.createElement('div');
            modal.id = 'tv-danger-confirm-modal';
            modal.className = 'tv-custom-themed tv-custom-' + (SysConfig.theme || 'dark');
            if (document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel')) modal.classList.add('is-over-settings');
            const listHtml = Array.isArray(items) && items.length
                ? `<ul class="tv-danger-confirm-list">${items.map(item => `<li>${c1_tradeGateEscape(item)}</li>`).join('')}</ul>`
                : '';
            modal.innerHTML = `
                <div class="tv-danger-confirm-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="tv-danger-confirm-title">
                    <div class="tv-danger-confirm-head">
                        <div class="tv-danger-confirm-mark">!</div>
                        <div><h3 id="tv-danger-confirm-title" class="tv-danger-confirm-title">${c1_tradeGateEscape(title)}</h3>${subtitle ? `<p class="tv-danger-confirm-sub">${c1_tradeGateEscape(subtitle)}</p>` : ''}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="tv-danger-confirm-body">${body ? `<p class="tv-danger-confirm-copy">${c1_tradeGateEscape(body)}</p>` : ''}${listHtml}</div>
                    <div class="tv-danger-confirm-actions">
                        <button type="button" class="tv-danger-confirm-btn" data-confirm-action="cancel">${c1_tradeGateEscape(cancelText || (SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Cancel' : '取消'))}</button>
                        <button type="button" class="tv-danger-confirm-btn is-danger" data-confirm-action="confirm">${c1_tradeGateEscape(confirmText || (SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Confirm' : '确认'))}</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
            getUIRoot().appendChild(modal);
            c1_applyTheme();
            const finish = (value, options = {}) => {
                if (settled) return false;
                settled = true;
                if (c1_activeDangerConfirmFinish === finish) c1_activeDangerConfirmFinish = null;
                modal.classList.remove('is-open');
                document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
                const removeAndRestore = () => {
                    modal.remove();
                    if (previouslyFocused?.isConnected) {
                        try { previouslyFocused.focus({ preventScroll: true }); } catch (e) {}
                    }
                };
                if (options.immediate) removeAndRestore();
                else setTimeout(removeAndRestore, 180);
                resolve(value === true);
                return true;
            };
            const onKey = (event) => {
                if (settled || c1_activeDangerConfirmFinish !== finish) return;
                if (event.key === 'Escape') {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    event.stopPropagation();
                    event.stopImmediatePropagation?.();
                    finish(false);
                    return;
                }
                if (event.key === 'Enter') {
                    const focusedAction = document.activeElement?.closest?.('[data-confirm-action]');
                    const action = focusedAction && modal.contains(focusedAction)
                        ? focusedAction.dataset.confirmAction
                        : 'cancel';
                    event.preventDefault();
                    event.stopPropagation();
                    event.stopImmediatePropagation?.();
                    finish(action === 'confirm');
                    return;
                }
                if (event.key === 'Tab') {
                    const focusable = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('[data-confirm-action]'))
                        .filter(button => !button.disabled && button.getAttribute('aria-disabled') !== 'true');
                    if (!focusable.length) return;
                    const currentIndex = focusable.indexOf(document.activeElement);
                    const nextIndex = event.shiftKey
                        ? (currentIndex <= 0 ? focusable.length - 1 : currentIndex - 1)
                        : (currentIndex < 0 || currentIndex === focusable.length - 1 ? 0 : currentIndex + 1);
                    event.preventDefault();
                    event.stopPropagation();
                    event.stopImmediatePropagation?.();
                    focusable[nextIndex].focus();
                }
            };
            modal.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
                event.stopPropagation();
                if (event.target === modal) {
                    finish(false);
                    return;
                }
                const action = event.target?.closest?.('[data-confirm-action]')?.dataset.confirmAction;
                if (action === 'cancel') finish(false);
                if (action === 'confirm') finish(true);
            }, true);
            c1_activeDangerConfirmFinish = finish;
            document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                if (settled || !modal.isConnected) return;
                modal.classList.add('is-open');
                modal.querySelector('[data-confirm-action="cancel"]')?.focus();
            });
        });
    }

    function c1_toggleSettingsPanel() {
        c1_ensureDeferredPanelStyles();
        let panel = document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel');
        if (panel) { if (panel.style.visibility === 'visible' || panel.style.opacity === '1') { c1_hideSettingsPanel();return; } else { c1_destroySettingsPanelNow({ persist: false }); } }
        if (c1_tradeGateWindowEl) c1_closeTradeGateWindow({ immediate: true });
        PanelManager.closePanel('tradegate');

        panel = document.createElement('div'); panel.id = 'tv-settings-panel'; panel.className = 'tv-custom-themed';
        const settingsPanelScale = Math.max(0.7, Math.min(1.3, Number(SysConfig.panelScale) || 1)) * 0.925;
        panel.dataset.scaleLevel = settingsPanelScale >= 1.18 ? 'large' : 'normal';
        panel.style.cssText = `--tv-settings-panel-scale:${settingsPanelScale}; position: fixed; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(${settingsPanelScale}); background: var(--my-bg); border: 1px solid var(--my-border); padding: 20px; border-radius: var(--ui-radius-frame); box-shadow: var(--my-shadow-lg); z-index: var(--ui-z-panel); width: min(1180px, calc(95vw / ${settingsPanelScale})); max-width: calc(95vw / ${settingsPanelScale}); font-family: var(--ui-font-family); opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transition: transform .2625s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1), opacity .2625s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1);`;

        const clockData = [ { name: 'US 纽约 (NY)', tz: 'America/New_York' }, { name: 'GB 伦敦 (LON)', tz: 'Europe/London' }, { name: 'JP 东京 (TYO)', tz: 'Asia/Tokyo' }, { name: 'CN 北京 (BJS)', tz: 'Asia/Shanghai' } ];
        let clocksHtml = ''; clockData.forEach((c, i) => { clocksHtml += `<div class="tv-settings-clock-row"><span class="tv-settings-clock-label">${c.name}</span><span id="tv-clock-${i}" class="tv-settings-clock-time">--:--:--</span></div>`; });
        const tradeGateSettings = c1_ensureTradeGateConfig().settings;
        const defaultDirectionLabel = tradeGateSettings.defaultDirection === 'bearish' ? (SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Bearish' : '看跌') : (SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Bullish' : '看涨');
        const displayLabel = SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'View' : '视图';

        panel.innerHTML = `

        document.getElementById('tv-export-btn').onclick = () => {
            const payload = {
                version: C1_CONFIG_EXPORT_VERSION,
                exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                sysConfig: SysConfig,
                macroConfig: C2_CONFIG,
                tradeGateRuntime: c1_readTradeGateRuntime()
            };
            const dataStr = JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2);
            const blob = new Blob([dataStr], { type: "application/json" });
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = url;
            a.download = c1_buildConfigExportFileName(new Date(), payload.version);
            document.body.appendChild(a);
            a.click();
            document.body.removeChild(a);
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            SharedTV.showToast(t('tDlSuccess'));
        };
        document.getElementById('tv-import-btn').onclick = () => {
            const input = document.createElement('input');
            input.type = 'file';
            input.accept = '.json';
            input.onchange = e => {
                const file = e.target.files[0];
                if (!file) return;
                if (file.size > C1_CONFIG_IMPORT_MAX_BYTES) {
                    SharedTV.showToast(c1_lang('Import failed: file is too large', '导入失败：文件过大'), true);
                    return;
                }
                const reader = new FileReader();
                reader.onload = function(event) {
                    try {
                        const raw = String(event.target.result || '');
                        if (!raw || raw.length > C1_CONFIG_IMPORT_MAX_BYTES) throw new Error('Invalid or oversized config file');
                        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
                        c1_applyConfigPayload(parsed);
                        SharedTV.showToast(t('tImportSucc'));
                        setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 1000);
                    } catch(err) {
                        console.warn('[TV-GCC] Config import rejected', err);
                        SharedTV.showToast(t('tImportFail'), true);
                    }
                };
                reader.onerror = () => SharedTV.showToast(t('tImportFail'), true);
                reader.onabort = () => SharedTV.showToast(t('tImportFail'), true);
                reader.readAsText(file);
            };
            input.click();
        };

        escapeAttr: function(value) {
            return String(value || '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, (char) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[char]));
        },
        normalizeBrokerKey: function(value) {
            return String(value || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
        },
        formatBrokerImgHtml: function(src, label = '') {
            if (!src) return '';
            return `<img src="${this.escapeAttr(src)}" alt="${this.escapeAttr(label)}" referrerpolicy="no-referrer" loading="lazy">`;
        },
        getKnownBrokerIconHtml: function(label = '') {
            const key = this.normalizeBrokerKey(label);
            if (!key) return '';
            if (key.includes('bitget')) return this.formatBrokerImgHtml(this.knownBrokerLogoUrls.bitget, 'Bitget');

        cloneBrokerIconHtml: function(el) {
            if (!el) return '';
            const clone = el.cloneNode(true);
            clone.removeAttribute('class');
            clone.removeAttribute('width');
            clone.removeAttribute('height');
            clone.removeAttribute('style');
            if (clone.tagName === 'IMG') {
                clone.setAttribute('referrerpolicy', 'no-referrer');
                clone.setAttribute('loading', 'lazy');
            }
            return clone.outerHTML || '';
        },
        readBackgroundIconUrl: function(btn) {
            const nodes = [btn, ...Array.from(btn?.querySelectorAll?.('*') || [])];
            for (const node of nodes) {
                try {
                    const bg = getComputedStyle(node).backgroundImage || '';
                    const match = bg.match(/url\(["']?([^"')]+)["']?\)/);
                    if (match?.[1]) return match[1];
                } catch (e) {}
            }
            return '';
        },
        readBrokerIconHtml: function(btn, brokerName = '') {
            const imgEl = btn?.querySelector?.('img[src]');
            const imgHtml = this.cloneBrokerIconHtml(imgEl);
            if (imgHtml) return imgHtml;

            const svgHtml = this.cloneBrokerIconHtml(btn?.querySelector?.('svg'));
            if (svgHtml) return svgHtml;

            const bgUrl = this.readBackgroundIconUrl(btn);
            if (bgUrl) return this.formatBrokerImgHtml(bgUrl, brokerName);

            return this.getKnownBrokerIconHtml(brokerName || c1_readElementLabel(btn));
        },
        applyBrokerIconHtml: function(iconHtml, persist = true) {
            if (!iconHtml) return false;
            const safeIconHtml = c1_safeHtml(iconHtml);
            if (!/<(img|svg)\b/i.test(safeIconHtml)) return false;
            this.cachedIcon = safeIconHtml;
            if (persist) localStorage.setItem('tv_rk_icon', safeIconHtml);
            if (this.dom.icon) this.setNodeHtml(this.dom.icon, safeIconHtml);
            return true;
        },
        applyCachedAccountState: function() {
            if (this.cachedIcon) this.applyBrokerIconHtml(this.cachedIcon, false);
            if (this.cachedBroker) this.setAccountTitle(this.cachedBroker);
            if (this.cachedBal > 0) {

                this.renderRisks(this.cachedBal);
            }

        init: function() {
            this.stop();
            if (!this.enabled || !document.getElementById('panel-risk')) return;
            this.cacheDom();
            c1_styleSelects(this.dom.panel);
            this.applyCachedAccountState();
            this.renderSettingsView();
            this.bindEvents();
            this.updateRiskViewVisibility();
            this.start();
        },
        countDecimals: function(value) {
            if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return 0;
            const text = String(value).toLowerCase();
            if (text.includes('e-')) {
                const [coefficient, exponentText] = text.split('e-');
                const exponent = parseInt(exponentText, 10);
                const coefficientDecimals = (coefficient.split('.')[1] || '').replace(/0+$/, '').length;
                return Number.isFinite(exponent) ? exponent + coefficientDecimals : 0;
            }
            if (!text.includes('.')) return 0;
            return text.split('.')[1].replace(/0+$/, '').length;
        },
        formatNumber: function(value, decimals, trimTrailingZeros) {
            if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return '--';
            let output = Number(value).toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: decimals, maximumFractionDigits: decimals });
            if (trimTrailingZeros && output.includes('.')) output = output.replace(/(\.\d*?[1-9])0+$/, '$1').replace(/\.0+$/, '');
            return output;
        },
        formatCompactBalance: function(value) {
            const num = Number(value);
            if (!Number.isFinite(num)) return '';
            const abs = Math.abs(num);
            if (abs >= 1e9) return `${this.formatNumber(num / 1e9, 2, true)}B`;
            if (abs >= 1e6) return `${this.formatNumber(num / 1e6, 2, true)}M`;
            if (abs >= 1e4) return `${this.formatNumber(num / 1e3, 1, true)}K`;
            return this.formatNumber(num, 2, false);
        },
        formatCompactAmountText: function(value, currency, sign) {
            if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) return '--';
            const abs = Math.abs(value);
            let compact;
            if (abs >= 1e9) compact = `${this.formatNumber(value / 1e9, 2, true)}B`;
            else if (abs >= 1e6) compact = `${this.formatNumber(value / 1e6, 2, true)}M`;
            else if (abs >= 1e3) compact = `${this.formatNumber(value / 1e3, 2, true)}K`;
            else compact = this.formatNumber(value, 2, false);
            return `${sign || ''}${compact} ${currency || 'USDT'}`.trim();
        },
        setCompactAmountNode: function(el, value, currency, sign, options = {}) {
            if (!el) return;
            const invalidText = options.invalidText || '--';
            const minValue = options.allowZero === false ? 0 : -Number.EPSILON;
            if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= minValue) {
                this.setNodeText(el, invalidText);
                el.removeAttribute('title');
                delete el.dataset.tooltip;
                return;
            }
            const full = `${sign || ''}${this.formatNumber(value, 2, false)} ${currency || 'USDT'}`.trim();
            const compact = this.formatCompactAmountText(value, currency, sign);
            this.setNodeText(el, compact || full);
            el.removeAttribute('title');
            el.dataset.tooltip = options.titleNote ? `${full}\n${options.titleNote}` : full;
        },
        setAccountTitle: function(name) {
            if (!this.dom.title) return;
            const broker = String(name || '').trim();
            const text = broker ? t('rmConn') + broker : t('rmUnconn');
            this.setNodeText(this.dom.title, text);
            this.dom.title.removeAttribute('title');
            this.dom.title.dataset.tooltip = text;
        },
        setBalanceText: function(value) {
            if (!this.dom.balance) return;
            const num = typeof value === 'number' ? value : parseFloat(String(value || '').replace(/,/g, ''));
            const full = Number.isFinite(num) ? this.formatNumber(num, 2, false) : String(value || '---');
            const compact = Number.isFinite(num) ? this.formatCompactBalance(num) : full;
            this.setNodeText(this.dom.balance, compact || full);
            this.dom.balance.removeAttribute('title');
            this.dom.balance.dataset.tooltip = full;
        },
        formatPercent: function(rate) {
            if (!Number.isFinite(rate) || rate < 0) return '--';
            return `${(rate * 100).toFixed(4)}%`;
        },
        quantizeValue: function(value, step, decimals) {
            if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return 0;
            if (!Number.isFinite(step) || step <= 0) return Number(value.toFixed(decimals));
            const scaled = Math.floor((value + (step * 1e-9)) / step);
            return Number((scaled * step).toFixed(decimals));
        },
        getSymbolMeta: function(symbol) {
            const display = c1_normalizeDomText(symbol || '');
            const prefix = display.includes(':') ? display.split(':')[0].toUpperCase() : '';
            const baseSym = display.includes(':') ? display.split(':').pop() : display;
            const clean = (baseSym.split('.')[0] || baseSym).replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/gi, '').toUpperCase();
            const isMetal = /^(XAU|XAG|XPT|XPD)[A-Z]{3}$/.test(clean);
            const isIndexCode = /^\d{6,8}$/.test(clean);
            let quoteCurrency = this.prefixCurrencyMap[prefix] || '';
            let baseCurrency = '';
            let matchedSuffix = '';
            this.quoteSuffixes.some(suffix => {
                if (clean.length > suffix.length && clean.endsWith(suffix)) {
                    matchedSuffix = suffix;
                    return true;
                }
                return false;
            });
            if (matchedSuffix) {
                quoteCurrency = matchedSuffix;
                baseCurrency = clean.slice(0, clean.length - matchedSuffix.length);
            } else if (clean.length === 6 && /^[A-Z]{6}$/.test(clean)) {
                baseCurrency = clean.slice(0, 3);
                quoteCurrency = clean.slice(3);
            }
            const cryptoQuotes = ['USDT', 'USDC', 'BUSD', 'USD', 'BTC', 'ETH'];
            const isCryptoExchange = this.cryptoExchangePrefixes.includes(prefix);
            const isKnownCryptoBase = this.knownCryptoBases.includes(baseCurrency);
            const isCrypto = !isMetal && (isCryptoExchange || (isKnownCryptoBase && cryptoQuotes.includes(quoteCurrency)));
            const isForex = !isCrypto && !isMetal && /^[A-Z]{3}$/.test(baseCurrency) && /^[A-Z]{3}$/.test(quoteCurrency) && clean.length === 6;
            return { display, prefix, clean, baseCurrency, quoteCurrency, isForex, isMetal, isCrypto, isIndexCode };
        },
        getSizingCurrencyBlockReason: function(symbol, conf) {
            const meta = this.getSymbolMeta(symbol || '');
            const quoteCurrency = String(conf?.notionalCurrency || meta.quoteCurrency || '').toUpperCase();
            if (!quoteCurrency || quoteCurrency === 'USD' || quoteCurrency === 'USDT') return '';
            return SysConfig.lang === 'en'
                ? `Sizing blocked: risk budget is USDT but ${quoteCurrency} conversion is unavailable.`
                : `已阻止仓位计算：风险预算为 USDT，但缺少 ${quoteCurrency} 兑换汇率。`;
        },
        guessTickSize: function(priceValue, meta) {
            if (meta?.isForex) return meta.quoteCurrency === 'JPY' ? 0.001 : 0.00001;
            if (meta?.clean === 'XAUUSD') return 0.01;
            if (meta?.clean === 'XAGUSD') return 0.001;
            if (!Number.isFinite(priceValue)) return 0.01;
            if (priceValue > 10000) return 0.1;
            if (priceValue > 1000) return 0.01;
            if (priceValue > 100) return 0.001;
            if (priceValue > 1) return 0.0001;
            return 0.00001;
        },
        guessQtyStep: function(priceValue, meta) {
            if (meta?.isForex) return 1000;
            if (meta?.isMetal) return 1;
            if (meta?.isCrypto) {
                if (priceValue > 10000) return 0.001;
                if (priceValue > 1000) return 0.01;
                if (priceValue > 100) return 0.1;
                return 1;
            }
            return meta?.isIndexCode ? 1 : 1;
        },
        inferAssetConfig: function(symbol, priceValue) {
            const meta = this.getSymbolMeta(symbol);
            const tickSize = this.guessTickSize(priceValue, meta);
            const qtyPerLot = meta.isForex ? 100000 : meta.clean === 'XAUUSD' ? 100 : meta.clean === 'XAGUSD' ? 5000 : 1;
            const qtyStep = this.guessQtyStep(priceValue, meta);
            const qtyDecimals = this.countDecimals(qtyStep);
            const lotStep = qtyPerLot > 0 ? qtyStep / qtyPerLot : 1;
            const unitLabel = meta.baseCurrency || meta.clean || (symbol || '');
            return this.normalizeAssetConfig({
                tickSize,
                qtyPerLot,
                qtyStep,
                qtyDecimals,
                lotDecimals: qtyPerLot > 1 ? Math.max(2, this.countDecimals(lotStep)) : qtyDecimals,
                lotLabel: qtyPerLot > 1 ? ' Lots' : (SysConfig.lang === 'zh' ? ' 个' : ' units'),
                unitLabelZh: meta.isMetal ? ' 盎司' : ` ${unitLabel}`,
                unitLabelEn: meta.isMetal ? ' oz' : ` ${unitLabel}`,
                notionalCurrency: meta.quoteCurrency || this.prefixCurrencyMap[meta.prefix] || 'USD',
                presets: meta.isForex ? [50, 100, 150, 200] : meta.isMetal ? [150, 200, 300, 500] : [100, 500, 1000, 2000],
                inferred: true
            }, symbol, priceValue);
        },
        normalizeAssetConfig: function(raw, symbol, priceValue) {
            const meta = this.getSymbolMeta(symbol);
            const tickSize = Number.isFinite(raw?.tickSize) && raw.tickSize > 0 ? raw.tickSize : (Number.isFinite(raw?.tick) && raw.tick > 0 ? raw.tick : this.guessTickSize(priceValue, meta));
            const qtyPerLot = Number.isFinite(raw?.qtyPerLot) && raw.qtyPerLot > 0 ? raw.qtyPerLot : (Number.isFinite(raw?.lotSize) && raw.lotSize > 0 ? raw.lotSize : 1);
            const qtyStep = Number.isFinite(raw?.qtyStep) && raw.qtyStep > 0 ? raw.qtyStep : this.guessQtyStep(priceValue, meta);
            const qtyDecimals = Number.isInteger(raw?.qtyDecimals) ? raw.qtyDecimals : this.countDecimals(qtyStep);
            const lotStep = Number.isFinite(raw?.lotStep) && raw.lotStep > 0 ? raw.lotStep : (qtyPerLot > 0 ? qtyStep / qtyPerLot : 1);
            const lotDecimals = Number.isInteger(raw?.lotDecimals) ? raw.lotDecimals : (qtyPerLot > 1 ? Math.max(2, this.countDecimals(lotStep)) : qtyDecimals);
            return {
                tickSize,
                qtyPerLot,
                qtyStep,
                qtyDecimals,
                lotStep,
                lotDecimals,
                lotLabel: raw?.lotLabel || raw?.lotName || (qtyPerLot > 1 ? ' Lots' : (SysConfig.lang === 'zh' ? ' 个' : ' units')),
                unitLabelZh: raw?.unitLabelZh || (meta.isMetal ? ' 盎司' : ` ${meta.baseCurrency || meta.clean || symbol}`),
                unitLabelEn: raw?.unitLabelEn || (meta.isMetal ? ' oz' : ` ${meta.baseCurrency || meta.clean || symbol}`),
                notionalCurrency: raw?.notionalCurrency || meta.quoteCurrency || this.prefixCurrencyMap[meta.prefix] || 'USD',
                pointValue: Number.isFinite(raw?.pointValue) && raw.pointValue > 0 ? raw.pointValue : 1,
                presets: Array.isArray(raw?.presets) && raw.presets.length ? raw.presets : [100, 500, 1000, 2000],
                inferred: !!raw?.inferred
            };
        },
        resolveAssetConfig: function(symbol, priceValue) {
            const meta = this.getSymbolMeta(symbol);
            const candidates = [meta.display, meta.clean, (symbol || '').toUpperCase()];
            for (const key of candidates) {
                if (key && this.assetConfig[key]) return this.normalizeAssetConfig(this.assetConfig[key], symbol, priceValue);
            }
            return this.inferAssetConfig(symbol, priceValue);
        },
        getConfigSignature: function(conf) {
            if (!conf) return '';
            return [conf.tickSize, conf.qtyPerLot, conf.qtyStep, conf.lotLabel, conf.notionalCurrency, (conf.presets || []).join(',')].join('|');
        },
        formatUnitsText: function(quantity, conf) {
            const label = SysConfig.lang === 'zh' ? conf.unitLabelZh : conf.unitLabelEn;
            return this.formatNumber(quantity, conf.qtyDecimals, true) + label;
        },
        formatLotsText: function(quantity, conf) {
            const lots = conf.qtyPerLot > 0 ? quantity / conf.qtyPerLot : quantity;
            return this.formatNumber(lots, conf.lotDecimals, true) + conf.lotLabel;
        },
        formatNotionalText: function(quantity, entry, conf) {
            const notional = quantity * entry;
            return this.formatNumber(notional, 2, false) + ' ' + conf.notionalCurrency;
        },
        formatNotionalPctText: function(quantity, entry) {
            const balance = Number(this.cachedBal);
            const notional = quantity * entry;
            if (!Number.isFinite(notional) || notional <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(balance) || balance <= 0) return '--';
            return `${this.formatNumber((notional / balance) * 100, 2, false)}%`;
        },
        formatRRText: function(value, isNet = false) {
            if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) return '--';
            const label = isNet ? (SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? ' net' : ' 净') : '';
            return `${this.formatNumber(value, 2, true)} R${label}`;
        },
        getRRLevelClass: function(value) {
            if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0 || value < 3) return 'rk-rr-low';
            if (value < 5) return 'rk-rr-mid';
            return 'rk-rr-high';
        },
        applyRRLevel: function(el, value) {
            if (!el) return;
            el.classList.add('rk-rr-value');
            el.classList.remove('rk-rr-low', 'rk-rr-mid', 'rk-rr-high');
            el.classList.add(this.getRRLevelClass(value));
        },
        formatPriceText: function(value, conf) {
            if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) return '--';
            const decimals = Math.max(this.countDecimals(conf?.tickSize || 0.01), 2);
            return `${this.formatNumber(value, decimals, true)} ${conf?.notionalCurrency || ''}`.trim();
        },
        parseNumericText: function(value) {
            if (value == null) return NaN;
            const match = String(value).replace(/,/g, '').match(/[+\-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?/);
            return match ? parseFloat(match[0]) : NaN;
        },
        formatEntryInputValue: function(value, conf = this.currentAssetConfig) {
            const num = this.parseNumericText(value);
            if (!Number.isFinite(num)) return String(value ?? '');
            const tickSize = Number(conf?.tickSize);
            if (!Number.isFinite(tickSize) || tickSize <= 0) return String(num);
            const decimals = Math.min(Math.max(this.countDecimals(tickSize), 0), 12);
            const rounded = Math.round((num / tickSize) + Number.EPSILON) * tickSize;
            return rounded.toFixed(decimals).replace(/(\.\d*?[1-9])0+$/, '$1').replace(/\.0+$/, '');
        },
        formatAmountText: function(value, currency, sign) {
            if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) return '-';
            return `${sign || ''}${this.formatNumber(value, 2, false)} ${currency || 'USDT'}`;
        },
        formatFeeText: function(value, currency) {
            if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) return '--';
            return `${this.formatNumber(value, 2, false)} ${currency || 'USDT'}`;
        },
        formatEditablePercent: function(rate) {
            if (!Number.isFinite(rate) || rate < 0) return '';
            return String((rate * 100).toFixed(4)).replace(/\.?0+$/, '');
        },
        parsePercentInput: function(value, fallback) {
            const parsed = parseFloat(String(value ?? '').trim());
            return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed >= 0 ? parsed / 100 : fallback;
        },
        getRiskPrefs: function() {
            return c1_ensureRiskPrefs();
        },
        getFeeModeLabel: function(mode) {
            if (mode === 'taker') return 'Taker';
            if (mode === 'both') return 'Maker / Taker';
            return 'Maker';
        },
        getFeeSideLabel: function(side) {
            return side === 'taker' ? 'Taker' : 'Maker';
        },
        getConfiguredFeePathLabel: function() {
            const prefs = this.getRiskPrefs();
            return `${this.getFeeSideLabel(prefs.entryFeeSide)} in / ${this.getFeeSideLabel(prefs.exitFeeSide)} out`;
        },
        isBitgetContractSymbol: function(symbol = this.currentSymbol) {
            const meta = this.getSymbolMeta(symbol || '');
            return meta.prefix === 'BITGET' && !!this.resolveBitgetProductType(symbol || '');
        },
        formatEntryExitRateText: function(entryRate, exitRate) {
            if (!Number.isFinite(entryRate) || !Number.isFinite(exitRate)) return '--';
            return `${this.formatPercent(entryRate)} / ${this.formatPercent(exitRate)}`;
        },
        getEffectiveFeeRates: function() {
            const prefs = this.getRiskPrefs();
            const manualMaker = prefs.manualMakerFeeRate;
            const manualTaker = prefs.manualTakerFeeRate;
            return { makerRate: manualMaker, takerRate: manualTaker, source: 'manual' };
        },
        getSideRateValue: function(side, rates) {
            return side === 'taker' ? rates.takerRate : rates.makerRate;
        },
        buildEntryExitFeeBasis: function(entryPrice, symbol = this.currentSymbol) {
            const prefs = this.getRiskPrefs();
            const rates = this.getEffectiveFeeRates();
            if (!this.isBitgetContractSymbol(symbol)) {
                return { ready: false, scope: 'non_bitget', ...rates };
            }
            const safeEntryPrice = Number.isFinite(entryPrice) && entryPrice > 0 ? entryPrice : NaN;
            const entryRate = this.getSideRateValue(prefs.entryFeeSide, rates);
            const exitRate = this.getSideRateValue(prefs.exitFeeSide, rates);
            if (!Number.isFinite(safeEntryPrice) || safeEntryPrice <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(entryRate) || entryRate < 0 || !Number.isFinite(exitRate) || exitRate < 0) {
                return { ready: false, ...rates, entryRate, exitRate };
            }
            return {
                ready: true,
                ...rates,
                entryRate,
                exitRate,
                entryPrice: safeEntryPrice,
                entryFeePerUnit: safeEntryPrice * entryRate,
                exitFeePerUnit: safeEntryPrice * exitRate,
                totalFeePerUnit: safeEntryPrice * (entryRate + exitRate)
            };
        },
        buildEntryExitFeeScenario: function(quantity, entryPrice, exitPrice, symbol = this.currentSymbol) {
            const basis = this.buildEntryExitFeeBasis(entryPrice, symbol);
            if (!basis.ready || !Number.isFinite(quantity) || quantity <= 0) {
                return { ready: false, ...basis };
            }
            const entryFee = quantity * basis.entryFeePerUnit;
            const exitFee = quantity * basis.exitFeePerUnit;
            return {
                ready: true,
                ...basis,
                entryFee,
                exitFee,
                totalFee: entryFee + exitFee
            };
        },
        formatFeeModeText: function(mode, makerValue, takerValue, currency, kind = 'amount') {
            if (mode === 'both') {
                if (kind === 'rate') return `M ${this.formatPercent(makerValue)} / T ${this.formatPercent(takerValue)}`;
                return `M ${this.formatFeeText(makerValue, currency)} / T ${this.formatFeeText(takerValue, currency)}`;
            }
            if (mode === 'taker') return kind === 'rate' ? this.formatPercent(takerValue) : this.formatFeeText(takerValue, currency);
            return kind === 'rate' ? this.formatPercent(makerValue) : this.formatFeeText(makerValue, currency);
        },
        buildFeePreview: function(baseSnapshot) {
            const conf = baseSnapshot?.conf || this.currentAssetConfig;
            const entry = Number.isFinite(baseSnapshot?.entry) ? baseSnapshot.entry : NaN;
            const quantity = Number.isFinite(baseSnapshot?.quantity) ? baseSnapshot.quantity : NaN;
            const symbol = baseSnapshot?.symbol || this.currentSymbol;
            const rates = this.getEffectiveFeeRates();
            if (!this.isBitgetContractSymbol(symbol)) {
                return { ready: false, scope: 'non_bitget', conf, markPrice: NaN, markSource: '', ...rates };
            }
            const markPrice = this.getPreferredMarkPrice(entry);
            const markSource = 'tv_last';
            const ready = !!conf && Number.isFinite(quantity) && quantity > 0 && Number.isFinite(markPrice) && markPrice > 0 &&
                Number.isFinite(rates.makerRate) && rates.makerRate >= 0 && Number.isFinite(rates.takerRate) && rates.takerRate >= 0;
            if (!ready) return { ready: false, conf, markPrice, markSource, ...rates };
            const notional = quantity * markPrice;
            const oneWayMakerFee = notional * rates.makerRate;
            const oneWayTakerFee = notional * rates.takerRate;
            return {
                ready: true,
                conf,
                markPrice,
                markSource,
                ...rates,
                oneWayMakerFee,
                oneWayTakerFee,
                roundTripMakerFee: oneWayMakerFee * 2,
                roundTripTakerFee: oneWayTakerFee * 2
            };
        },
        resolveBitgetProductType: function(symbol) {
            const meta = this.getSymbolMeta(symbol);
            if (!meta?.clean || !meta.isCrypto) return '';
            if (meta.quoteCurrency === 'USDT' || meta.quoteCurrency === 'BUSD') return 'usdt-futures';
            if (meta.quoteCurrency === 'USDC') return 'usdc-futures';
            if (meta.quoteCurrency === 'USD') return 'coin-futures';
            return '';
        },
        getBitgetContractKey: function(symbol) {
            if (!this.isBitgetContractSymbol(symbol)) return '';
            const apiSymbol = this.getSymbolMeta(symbol).clean;
            const productType = this.resolveBitgetProductType(symbol);
            return apiSymbol && productType ? `${productType}:${apiSymbol}` : '';
        },
        buildBitgetContractConfigFromApi: function(row) {
            const pricePlace = Number(row?.pricePlace);
            const priceEndStep = Number(row?.priceEndStep);
            const sizeMultiplier = parseFloat(row?.sizeMultiplier);
            const volumePlace = Number(row?.volumePlace);
            const minTradeNum = parseFloat(row?.minTradeNum);
            if (!Number.isFinite(pricePlace) || pricePlace < 0) return null;
            const tickBase = Math.pow(10, -pricePlace);
            const tickFactor = Number.isFinite(priceEndStep) && priceEndStep > 0 ? priceEndStep : 1;
            const tickSize = tickBase * tickFactor;
            const qtyStep = Number.isFinite(sizeMultiplier) && sizeMultiplier > 0 ? sizeMultiplier : (Number.isFinite(minTradeNum) && minTradeNum > 0 ? minTradeNum : 1);
            const qtyDecimals = Number.isInteger(volumePlace) && volumePlace >= 0 ? volumePlace : this.countDecimals(qtyStep);
            const symbol = String(row?.symbol || '').trim().toUpperCase();
            const meta = this.getSymbolMeta(symbol);
            return this.normalizeAssetConfig({
                tickSize,
                qtyPerLot: 1,
                qtyStep,
                qtyDecimals,
                lotDecimals: qtyDecimals,
                lotLabel: SysConfig.lang === 'zh' ? ' 个' : ' units',
                unitLabelZh: ` ${meta.baseCurrency || symbol}`,
                unitLabelEn: ` ${meta.baseCurrency || symbol}`,
                notionalCurrency: meta.quoteCurrency || 'USDT',
                presets: Array.isArray(this.assetConfig[symbol]?.presets) ? this.assetConfig[symbol].presets : [100, 200, 500, 1000],
                inferred: false
            }, symbol, NaN);
        },
        refreshBitgetContractConfig: function(symbol, force = false) {
            this.bitgetContractConfig.pendingKey = '';
            return;
        },
        refreshBitgetFeeRate: function() {
            return;
        },
        refreshBitgetMarkPrice: function(symbol, force = false) {
            const market = this.bitgetMarket;
            market.symbol = this.getSymbolMeta(symbol).clean || '';
            market.productType = '';
            market.markPrice = NaN;
            market.lastMarkFetchAt = 0;
            market.pendingMarkKey = '';
            this.renderResultFeeEstimate();
            if (this.lastTradeSnapshot) this.renderTradeSnapshot(this.lastTradeSnapshot);
        },
        getPreferredMarkPrice: function(entry) {
            const markPrice = this.bitgetMarket.markPrice;
            if (Number.isFinite(markPrice) && markPrice > 0) return markPrice;
            const livePrice = this.parseNumericText(this.dom.livePrice?.innerText);
            if (Number.isFinite(livePrice) && livePrice > 0) return livePrice;
            return Number.isFinite(entry) && entry > 0 ? entry : NaN;
        },
        blockCalc: function(reason, fields = []) {
            this.lastCalcBlockReason = reason || '';
            this.lastCalcBlockFields = Array.isArray(fields) ? fields : [fields].filter(Boolean);
            return null;
        },
        clearCalcBlockHighlights: function() {
            const panel = this.dom.panel || document.getElementById('panel-risk');
            if (!panel) return;
            panel.querySelectorAll('.rk-row.is-blocked').forEach(row => row.classList.remove('is-blocked'));
        },
        applyCalcBlockHighlights: function() {
            this.clearCalcBlockHighlights();
            const fields = Array.isArray(this.lastCalcBlockFields) ? this.lastCalcBlockFields : [];
            const mark = (el) => el?.closest?.('.rk-row')?.classList.add('is-blocked');
            fields.forEach((field) => {
                if (field === 'entry') mark(this.dom.price || document.getElementById('rk-price'));
                if (field === 'risk') mark(this.dom.risk || document.getElementById('rk-risk'));
                if (field === 'ticks') mark(this.dom.ticks || document.getElementById('rk-ticks'));
                if (field === 'stop') mark(this.dom.sl || document.getElementById('rk-sl'));
                if (field === 'symbol') mark(this.dom.symbol || document.getElementById('rk-symbol-display'));
            });
        },
        buildCalcSnapshot: function() {
            const entry = parseFloat(this.dom.price?.value);
            const risk = parseFloat(this.dom.risk?.value);
            const type = this.dom.slType?.value;
            const conf = this.currentAssetConfig;
            const symbol = this.currentSymbol || '';
            this.lastCalcBlockReason = '';
            this.lastCalcBlockFields = [];
            if (!Number.isFinite(entry) || entry <= 0) return this.blockCalc(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Missing entry price.' : '缺少计划入场价。', ['entry']);
            if (!Number.isFinite(risk) || risk <= 0) return this.blockCalc(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Missing risk budget.' : '缺少单笔风险预算。', ['risk']);
            if (!conf) return this.blockCalc(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Missing contract spec.' : '缺少合约规格数据。', ['symbol']);
            const currencyBlockReason = this.getSizingCurrencyBlockReason(symbol, conf);
            if (currencyBlockReason) return this.blockCalc(currencyBlockReason, ['symbol']);
            const rawStopPrice = parseFloat(this.dom.sl?.value);
            const rawTicks = parseFloat(this.dom.ticks?.value);
            if (type === 'price' && (!Number.isFinite(rawStopPrice) || rawStopPrice <= 0)) {
                return this.blockCalc(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Missing stop price.' : '缺少有效止损价。', ['stop']);
            }
            if (type !== 'price' && (!Number.isFinite(rawTicks) || rawTicks <= 0)) {
                return this.blockCalc(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Missing positive stop ticks.' : '止损 Ticks 必须为正数。', ['ticks']);
            }
            const diff = type === 'price' ? Math.abs(entry - rawStopPrice) : rawTicks * conf.tickSize;
            if (!Number.isFinite(diff) || diff <= 0) return this.blockCalc(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Missing stop distance.' : '缺少有效止损距离。', [type === 'price' ? 'stop' : 'ticks']);
            const riskPerUnit = diff * (conf.pointValue || 1);
            if (!Number.isFinite(riskPerUnit) || riskPerUnit <= 0) return this.blockCalc(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Invalid stop value.' : '止损价值无效。', [type === 'price' ? 'stop' : 'ticks']);
            const isBitget = this.isBitgetContractSymbol(symbol);
            let stopPrice = type === 'price' && Number.isFinite(rawStopPrice) && rawStopPrice > 0 ? rawStopPrice : entry + diff;
            let rawQuantity = risk / riskPerUnit;
            let feeScenario = null;
            const prefs = this.getRiskPrefs();
            if (isBitget && prefs.includeFeesInSizing) {
                const feeBasis = this.buildEntryExitFeeBasis(entry, symbol);
                if (!feeBasis.ready) {
                    return this.blockCalc(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Missing manual fee rates.' : '缺少手动手续费率。');
                }
                const totalRiskPerUnit = riskPerUnit + feeBasis.totalFeePerUnit;
                if (!Number.isFinite(totalRiskPerUnit) || totalRiskPerUnit <= 0) {
                    return this.blockCalc(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Invalid fee-inclusive risk.' : '含手续费风险无效。', ['entry']);
                }
                rawQuantity = risk / totalRiskPerUnit;
            }
            const quantity = this.quantizeValue(rawQuantity, conf.qtyStep, conf.qtyDecimals);
            if (!Number.isFinite(quantity) || quantity <= 0) return this.blockCalc(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Quantity is below contract step.' : '计算仓位低于合约最小步进。', ['risk']);
            const priceLoss = quantity * riskPerUnit;
            if (isBitget) feeScenario = this.buildEntryExitFeeScenario(quantity, entry, stopPrice, symbol);
            const feeTotal = feeScenario?.ready ? feeScenario.totalFee : 0;
            const totalMaxLoss = priceLoss + feeTotal;
            return { entry, stopPrice, conf, quantity, symbol, riskBudget: risk, stopDiff: diff, priceLoss, feeScenario, feeTotal, totalMaxLoss, isBitgetContract: isBitget };
        },
        resolveTradeSizing: function(trade) {
            if (!trade) return null;
            const entry = this.parseNumericText(trade.entry);
            const sl = this.parseNumericText(trade.sl);
            const tp = this.parseNumericText(trade.tp);
            const rr = this.parseNumericText(trade.rr);
            const riskBudget = this.parseNumericText(this.dom.risk?.value);
            const symbol = trade.symbol || this.currentSymbol || '';
            const conf = this.resolveAssetConfig(symbol, entry);
            if (!Number.isFinite(entry) || !Number.isFinite(sl) || !Number.isFinite(riskBudget) || riskBudget <= 0 || !conf) return null;
            if (this.getSizingCurrencyBlockReason(symbol, conf)) return null;
            const pointValue = conf.pointValue || 1;
            const stopDiff = Math.abs(entry - sl);
            const stopAmountPerUnit = stopDiff * pointValue;
            if (!Number.isFinite(stopAmountPerUnit) || stopAmountPerUnit <= 0) return null;
            const isBitget = this.isBitgetContractSymbol(symbol);
            let rawQuantity = riskBudget / stopAmountPerUnit;
            const prefs = this.getRiskPrefs();
            if (isBitget && prefs.includeFeesInSizing) {
                const feeBasis = this.buildEntryExitFeeBasis(entry, symbol);
                if (!feeBasis.ready) return null;
                const totalRiskPerUnit = stopAmountPerUnit + feeBasis.totalFeePerUnit;
                if (!Number.isFinite(totalRiskPerUnit) || totalRiskPerUnit <= 0) return null;
                rawQuantity = riskBudget / totalRiskPerUnit;
            }
            const quantity = this.quantizeValue(rawQuantity, conf.qtyStep, conf.qtyDecimals);
            if (!Number.isFinite(quantity) || quantity <= 0) return null;
            let actualProfit = NaN;
            const priceLoss = quantity * stopAmountPerUnit;
            const lossFeeScenario = isBitget ? this.buildEntryExitFeeScenario(quantity, entry, sl, symbol) : null;
            const feeTotal = lossFeeScenario?.ready ? lossFeeScenario.totalFee : 0;
            const totalMaxLoss = priceLoss + feeTotal;
            if (Number.isFinite(rr) && rr > 0) actualProfit = priceLoss * rr;
            else if (Number.isFinite(tp)) actualProfit = quantity * Math.abs(tp - entry) * pointValue;
            const targetExitPrice = Number.isFinite(rr) && rr > 0
                ? (sl > entry ? entry - (stopDiff * rr) : entry + (stopDiff * rr))
                : tp;
            return { entry, sl, tp, rr, targetExitPrice, conf, quantity, symbol, riskBudget, stopDiff, stopPrice: sl, priceLoss, feeScenario: lossFeeScenario, feeTotal, totalMaxLoss, actualLoss: priceLoss, actualProfit, isBitgetContract: isBitget };
        },
        buildTradeRRInfo: function(trade, sizing = null) {
            if (!trade) return { value: NaN, isNet: false };
            const parsedRR = this.parseNumericText(trade.rr);
            if (Number.isFinite(parsedRR) && parsedRR > 0) return { value: parsedRR, isNet: false };
            const entry = this.parseNumericText(trade.entry);
            const sl = this.parseNumericText(trade.sl);
            const tp = this.parseNumericText(trade.tp);
            const lossDistance = Math.abs(entry - sl);
            const profitDistance = Math.abs(tp - entry);
            if (Number.isFinite(lossDistance) && lossDistance > 0 && Number.isFinite(profitDistance) && profitDistance > 0) {
                return { value: profitDistance / lossDistance, isNet: false };
            }
            return { value: NaN, isNet: false };
        },
        buildResultProfitInfo: function(snapshot = null, trade = this.lastTradeSnapshot) {
            if (!snapshot) return { value: NaN, gross: NaN, fee: NaN, currency: this.currentAssetConfig?.notionalCurrency || 'USDT', isNet: false };
            const rrInfo = this.buildTradeRRInfo(trade, null);
            const gross = Number.isFinite(rrInfo.value) && rrInfo.value > 0 && Number.isFinite(snapshot.priceLoss)
                ? snapshot.priceLoss * rrInfo.value
                : NaN;
            const fee = snapshot.isBitgetContract && Number.isFinite(snapshot.feeTotal) ? snapshot.feeTotal : 0;
            return {
                value: Number.isFinite(gross) ? gross - fee : NaN,
                gross,
                fee,
                currency: snapshot.conf?.notionalCurrency || 'USDT',
                isNet: !!snapshot.isBitgetContract
            };
        },
        renderResultRR: function(trade = this.lastTradeSnapshot, sizing = null) {
            const rrEl = this.dom.resRr || document.getElementById('rk-res-rr');
            if (!rrEl) return;
            const rrInfo = this.buildTradeRRInfo(trade, null);
            this.setNodeText(rrEl, this.formatRRText(rrInfo.value, rrInfo.isNet));
            this.applyRRLevel(rrEl, rrInfo.value);
        },
        getDisplayedFeeTotal: function(sizing = null) {
            const currentSnapshot = this.buildCalcSnapshot();
            if (currentSnapshot?.isBitgetContract && Number.isFinite(currentSnapshot.feeTotal)) return currentSnapshot.feeTotal;
            if (sizing?.isBitgetContract && Number.isFinite(sizing.feeTotal)) return sizing.feeTotal;
            return 0;
        },
        buildTradeProfitInfo: function(trade, sizing = null) {
            if (!trade) return { value: NaN, currency: 'USDT', isNet: false };
            const effectiveSizing = sizing || this.resolveTradeSizing(trade);
            if (!effectiveSizing || !Number.isFinite(effectiveSizing.actualProfit) || effectiveSizing.actualProfit <= 0) {
                return { value: NaN, currency: effectiveSizing?.conf?.notionalCurrency || this.currentAssetConfig?.notionalCurrency || 'USDT', isNet: false };
            }
            const targetFee = effectiveSizing.isBitgetContract ? this.getDisplayedFeeTotal(effectiveSizing) : 0;
            const netProfit = effectiveSizing.actualProfit - targetFee;
            return {
                value: netProfit,
                gross: effectiveSizing.actualProfit,
                fee: targetFee,
                currency: effectiveSizing.conf.notionalCurrency,
                isNet: !!effectiveSizing.isBitgetContract
            };
        },
        renderResultProfit: function(trade = this.lastTradeSnapshot, sizing = null) {
            const grossEl = this.dom.resGrossProfit || document.getElementById('rk-res-gross-profit');
            const profitEl = this.dom.resProfit || document.getElementById('rk-res-profit');
            if (!profitEl && !grossEl) return;
            const info = sizing?.priceLoss !== undefined ? this.buildResultProfitInfo(sizing, trade) : this.buildTradeProfitInfo(trade, sizing);
            if (grossEl) this.setCompactAmountNode(grossEl, info.gross, info.currency, '+', { allowZero: false });
            const note = info.isNet ? (SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Net profit after displayed fees' : '已扣除当前显示口径下的手续费') : '';
            this.setCompactAmountNode(profitEl, info.value, info.currency, '+', { allowZero: false, titleNote: note });
        },
        renderResultFeeEstimate: function(snapshot = undefined) {
            const feeRowEl = this.dom.resFeeSummaryRow || document.getElementById('rk-res-fee-summary-row');
            const feeLabelEl = this.dom.resFeeSummaryLabel || document.getElementById('rk-res-fee-summary-label');
            const feeValueEl = this.dom.resFeeSummary || document.getElementById('rk-res-fee-summary');
            const feeNoteEl = this.dom.feeNote || document.getElementById('rk-res-fee-note');
            if (!feeRowEl || !feeLabelEl || !feeValueEl || !feeNoteEl) return;
            const prefs = this.getRiskPrefs();
            const nextSnapshot = snapshot === undefined ? this.buildCalcSnapshot() : snapshot;
            if (!this.isBitgetContractSymbol(nextSnapshot?.symbol || this.currentSymbol)) {
                this.setNodeDisplay(feeRowEl, 'none');
                this.setNodeDisplay(feeNoteEl, 'none');
                return;
            }
            this.setNodeDisplay(feeNoteEl, prefs.showResultFeeNote ? '' : 'none');
            this.setNodeDisplay(feeRowEl, prefs.showResultFeeSummary ? 'flex' : 'none');
            this.setNodeText(feeLabelEl, `${SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Fees in Max Loss' : '计入亏损手续费'} (${this.getConfiguredFeePathLabel()})`);
            const preview = this.buildFeePreview(nextSnapshot);
            if (!preview.ready || !nextSnapshot?.feeScenario?.ready) {
                this.setNodeText(feeValueEl, '--');
                this.setNodeText(feeNoteEl, this.lastCalcBlockReason || (SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Complete Bitget data before sizing.' : 'Bitget 数据完整后再计算。'));
                return;
            }
            this.setNodeText(feeValueEl, this.formatFeeText(nextSnapshot.feeTotal, nextSnapshot.conf.notionalCurrency));
            const markLabel = SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'TV last price' : 'TV 最新价';
            const feePct = Number.isFinite(nextSnapshot.feeTotal) && Number.isFinite(nextSnapshot.riskBudget) && nextSnapshot.riskBudget > 0
                ? nextSnapshot.feeTotal / nextSnapshot.riskBudget
                : NaN;
            const warn = Number.isFinite(feePct) && feePct >= 0.2
                ? ` · ${SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'fee ratio high' : '手续费占比偏高'} ${(feePct * 100).toFixed(1)}%`
                : '';
            this.setNodeText(feeNoteEl, `${markLabel} · ${SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'manual rates' : '手动费率'}${warn}`);
        },
        resetCalcResult: function() {
            const fallbackCurrency = this.currentAssetConfig?.notionalCurrency || 'USDT';
            this.applyCalcBlockHighlights();
            if (this.dom.resStatus) {
                const reason = this.lastCalcBlockReason || (SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Waiting for entry, stop and risk.' : '等待入场、止损与风险预算。');
                this.setNodeText(this.dom.resStatus, reason);
                this.dom.resStatus.classList.add('is-visible');
            }
            if (this.dom.resLots) this.setNodeText(this.dom.resLots, '0.00');
            if (this.dom.resUnits) this.setNodeText(this.dom.resUnits, '');
            if (this.dom.resNotional) this.setNodeText(this.dom.resNotional, `0.00 ${fallbackCurrency}`);
            if (this.dom.resNotionalPct) this.setNodeText(this.dom.resNotionalPct, '--');
            if (this.dom.resRr) { this.setNodeText(this.dom.resRr, '--'); this.applyRRLevel(this.dom.resRr, NaN); }
            if (this.dom.resGrossProfit) this.setNodeText(this.dom.resGrossProfit, '--');
            if (this.dom.resProfit) this.setNodeText(this.dom.resProfit, '--');
            if (this.dom.resMaxLoss) this.setNodeText(this.dom.resMaxLoss, '--');
            this.renderResultFeeEstimate(null);
        },
        renderFeeEstimate: function(snapshot = undefined) {
            const feeMarkEl = this.dom.feeMark || document.getElementById('rk-res-mark');
            const feeRateEl = this.dom.feeRate || document.getElementById('rk-res-fee-rate');
            const feeOneWayEl = this.dom.feeOneWay || document.getElementById('rk-res-oneway-fee');
            const feeRoundTripEl = this.dom.feeRoundTrip || document.getElementById('rk-res-roundtrip-fee');
            const feeNoteEl = this.dom.feeNote || document.getElementById('rk-res-fee-note');
            if (!feeMarkEl || !feeRateEl || !feeOneWayEl || !feeRoundTripEl || !feeNoteEl) return;
            const nextSnapshot = snapshot === undefined ? this.buildCalcSnapshot() : snapshot;
            const conf = nextSnapshot?.conf || this.currentAssetConfig;
            const makerFeeRate = this.bitgetMarket.makerFeeRate;
            const takerFeeRate = this.bitgetMarket.takerFeeRate;
            const markPrice = this.getPreferredMarkPrice(nextSnapshot?.entry);
            this.setNodeText(feeMarkEl, this.formatPriceText(markPrice, conf));
            this.setNodeText(
                feeRateEl,
                Number.isFinite(makerFeeRate) && Number.isFinite(takerFeeRate)
                    ? `Maker ${this.formatPercent(makerFeeRate)} / Taker ${this.formatPercent(takerFeeRate)}`
                    : '--'
            );
            if (!nextSnapshot || !conf || !Number.isFinite(markPrice) || markPrice <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(makerFeeRate) || makerFeeRate < 0 || !Number.isFinite(takerFeeRate) || takerFeeRate < 0) {
                this.setNodeText(feeOneWayEl, '--');
                this.setNodeText(feeRoundTripEl, '--');
                this.setNodeText(feeNoteEl, SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Bitget maker / taker estimate will appear after quantity is ready.' : '仓位数量出来后会显示 Bitget maker / taker 费用预估。');
                return;
            }
            const notional = nextSnapshot.quantity * markPrice;
            const oneWayMakerFee = notional * makerFeeRate;
            const oneWayFee = notional * takerFeeRate;
            const roundTripMakerFee = oneWayMakerFee * 2;
            const roundTripFee = oneWayFee * 2;
            this.setNodeText(feeOneWayEl, this.formatFeePairText(oneWayMakerFee, oneWayFee, conf.notionalCurrency));
            this.setNodeText(feeRoundTripEl, this.formatFeePairText(roundTripMakerFee, roundTripFee, conf.notionalCurrency));
            const markLabel = SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'TV last price' : 'TV 最新价';
            this.setNodeText(
                feeNoteEl,
                SysConfig.lang === 'en'
                    ? `${markLabel} x local manual maker / taker`
                    : `${markLabel} × 本地手动 maker / taker`
            );
        },
        resolveTradeAmounts: function(trade) {
            if (!trade) return null;
            const entry = this.parseNumericText(trade.entry);
            const sl = this.parseNumericText(trade.sl);
            const tp = this.parseNumericText(trade.tp);
            const rr = this.parseNumericText(trade.rr);
            const riskBudget = this.parseNumericText(this.dom.risk?.value);
            const conf = this.resolveAssetConfig(trade.symbol || this.currentSymbol || '', entry);
            if (!Number.isFinite(entry) || !Number.isFinite(sl) || !Number.isFinite(riskBudget) || riskBudget <= 0 || !conf) {
                return { lossText: '-', profitText: '-' };
            }

            const pointValue = conf.pointValue || 1;
            const stopDiff = Math.abs(entry - sl);
            const stopAmountPerUnit = stopDiff * pointValue;
            if (!Number.isFinite(stopAmountPerUnit) || stopAmountPerUnit <= 0) {
                return { lossText: '-', profitText: '-' };
            }

            const rawQuantity = riskBudget / stopAmountPerUnit;
            const quantity = this.quantizeValue(rawQuantity, conf.qtyStep, conf.qtyDecimals);
            if (!Number.isFinite(quantity) || quantity <= 0) {
                return { lossText: '-', profitText: '-' };
            }

            const actualLoss = quantity * stopAmountPerUnit;
            let actualProfit = NaN;
            if (Number.isFinite(rr) && rr > 0) {
                actualProfit = actualLoss * rr;
            } else if (Number.isFinite(tp)) {
                actualProfit = quantity * Math.abs(tp - entry) * pointValue;
            }

            return {
                lossText: this.formatAmountText(actualLoss, conf.notionalCurrency, '-'),
                profitText: this.formatAmountText(actualProfit, conf.notionalCurrency, '+')
            };
        },
