'Keep one compact fee line under the calculator result.' : '在仓位计算结果下保留一条紧凑的费用摘要。'}</span></div>${toggle('rk-pref-show-result-fee', prefs.showResultFeeSummary)}</div>
                        <div class="rk-settings-toggle-row is-compact"><div class="rk-settings-toggle-copy"><strong>${SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Show fee note' : '显示价格 / 费率说明'}</strong><span>${SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Show the TV last price and manual-rate note under the result.' : '在结果底部显示 TV 最新价与手动费率说明。'}</span></div>${toggle('rk-pref-show-result-fee-note', prefs.showResultFeeNote)}</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
            c1_styleSelects(host);
        },
        updateRiskViewVisibility: function() {
            const prefs = this.getRiskPrefs();
            const feeEnabled = this.isBitgetContractSymbol(this.currentSymbol);
            if (this.dom.tradeMarkRow) this.dom.tradeMarkRow.classList.toggle('is-hidden', !prefs.showTradeMark || !feeEnabled);
            if (this.dom.tradeFeeRateRow) this.dom.tradeFeeRateRow.classList.toggle('is-hidden', !prefs.showTradeFees || !feeEnabled);
            if (this.dom.tradeFeeRow) this.dom.tradeFeeRow.classList.toggle('is-hidden', !prefs.showTradeFees || !feeEnabled);
            if (this.dom.tradeFeeRoundRow) this.dom.tradeFeeRoundRow.classList.toggle('is-hidden', !prefs.showTradeFees || !feeEnabled);
            if (this.dom.tradeLossAmt?.parentElement) this.dom.tradeLossAmt.parentElement.style.display = prefs.showTradePnl ? '' : 'none';
            if (this.dom.tradeProfitAmt?.parentElement) this.dom.tradeProfitAmt.parentElement.style.display = prefs.showTradePnl ? '' : 'none';
            if (this.dom.resNotionalRow) this.setNodeDisplay(this.dom.resNotionalRow, prefs.showResultNotional ? 'flex' : 'none');
            if (this.dom.resNotionalPctRow) this.setNodeDisplay(this.dom.resNotionalPctRow, prefs.showResultNotionalPct ? 'flex' : 'none');
            if (this.dom.resGrossProfitRow) this.setNodeDisplay(this.dom.resGrossProfitRow, prefs.showResultGrossProfit ? 'flex' : 'none');
            if (this.dom.resFeeSummaryRow) this.setNodeDisplay(this.dom.resFeeSummaryRow, prefs.showResultFeeSummary && feeEnabled ? 'flex' : 'none');
            if (this.dom.feeNote) this.setNodeDisplay(this.dom.feeNote, prefs.showResultFeeNote && feeEnabled ? '' : 'none');
            if (this.dom.resFeeSummaryLabel) this.setNodeText(this.dom.resFeeSummaryLabel, `${SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Fees in Max Loss' : '计入亏损手续费'} (${this.getConfiguredFeePathLabel()})`);
            if ((prefs.compactMode || !prefs.showTradeSnapshot) && this.dom.tradeSnapshot) this.setNodeDisplay(this.dom.tradeSnapshot, 'none');
        },
        openSettingsView: function() {
            this.cacheDom?.();
            this.renderSettingsView();
            c1_styleSelects(this.dom.panel || document.getElementById('panel-risk'));
            if (this.dom.mainView) this.setNodeDisplay(this.dom.mainView, 'none');
            if (this.dom.settingsView) this.dom.settingsView.style.display = 'flex';
            this.dom.panel?.classList.add('is-settings-open');
            this.dom.openSettings?.classList.add('is-active');
            if (this.dom.openSettings) {
                this.dom.openSettings.removeAttribute('title');
                this.dom.openSettings.dataset.tooltip = SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Back to risk calculator' : '返回风控主面板';
                this.dom.openSettings.setAttribute('aria-label', this.dom.openSettings.dataset.tooltip);
            }
        },
        closeSettingsView: function() {
            this.cacheDom?.();
            if (this.dom.settingsView) this.setNodeDisplay(this.dom.settingsView, 'none');
            if (this.dom.mainView) this.dom.mainView.style.display = '';
            this.dom.panel?.classList.remove('is-settings-open');
            this.dom.openSettings?.classList.remove('is-active');
            if (this.dom.openSettings) {
                this.dom.openSettings.removeAttribute('title');
                this.dom.openSettings.dataset.tooltip = SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Risk settings' : '风控设置';
                this.dom.openSettings.setAttribute('aria-label', this.dom.openSettings.dataset.tooltip);
            }
            this.updateRiskViewVisibility();
            if (this.lastTradeSnapshot) this.renderTradeSnapshot(this.lastTradeSnapshot);
            else if (this.dom.tradeSnapshot && this.getRiskPrefs().showTradeSnapshot) this.setNodeDisplay(this.dom.tradeSnapshot, 'none');
            this.renderResultFeeEstimate();
        },
        saveSettingsFromView: function() {
            const prefs = this.getRiskPrefs();
            prefs.feeSource = 'manual';
            const nextBudget = parseFloat(document.getElementById('rk-pref-risk-budget')?.value);
            if (Number.isFinite(nextBudget) && nextBudget > 0) prefs.riskBudget = nextBudget;
            prefs.stopMode = document.getElementById('rk-pref-stop-mode')?.value === 'price' ? 'price' : 'ticks';
            const snapshotFeeModeEl = document.getElementById('rk-pref-snapshot-fee-mode');
            if (snapshotFeeModeEl) prefs.snapshotFeeMode = ['maker', 'taker', 'both'].includes(snapshotFeeModeEl.value) ? snapshotFeeModeEl.value : prefs.snapshotFeeMode;
            prefs.entryFeeSide = document.getElementById('rk-pref-entry-fee-side')?.value === 'taker' ? 'taker' : 'maker';
            prefs.exitFeeSide = document.getElementById('rk-pref-exit-fee-side')?.value === 'maker' ? 'maker' : 'taker';
            prefs.includeFeesInSizing = !!document.getElementById('rk-pref-include-fees-sizing')?.checked;
            prefs.manualMakerFeeRate = this.parsePercentInput(document.getElementById('rk-pref-manual-maker')?.value, prefs.manualMakerFeeRate);
            prefs.manualTakerFeeRate = this.parsePercentInput(document.getElementById('rk-pref-manual-taker')?.value, prefs.manualTakerFeeRate);
            prefs.showTradeSnapshot = !!document.getElementById('rk-pref-show-snapshot')?.checked;
            prefs.showTradeMark = !!document.getElementById('rk-pref-show-mark')?.checked;
            prefs.showTradePnl = !!document.getElementById('rk-pref-show-pnl')?.checked;
            prefs.showTradeFees = !!document.getElementById('rk-pref-show-trade-fees')?.checked;
            prefs.compactMode = !!document.getElementById('rk-pref-compact-mode')?.checked;
            prefs.showResultNotional = !!document.getElementById('rk-pref-show-result-notional')?.checked;
            prefs.showResultNotionalPct = !!document.getElementById('rk-pref-show-result-notional-pct')?.checked;
            prefs.showResultGrossProfit = !!document.getElementById('rk-pref-show-result-gross-profit')?.checked;
            prefs.showResultFeeSummary = !!document.getElementById('rk-pref-show-result-fee')?.checked;
            prefs.showResultFeeNote = !!document.getElementById('rk-pref-show-result-fee-note')?.checked;
            SysConfig.riskPrefs = c1_normalizeRiskPrefs(prefs);
            c1_saveConfig();
            if (this.dom.risk && Number.isFinite(SysConfig.riskPrefs.riskBudget)) this.setNodeValue(this.dom.risk, SysConfig.riskPrefs.riskBudget);
            if (this.dom.slType) {
                this.setNodeValue(this.dom.slType, SysConfig.riskPrefs.stopMode);
                if (this.dom.rowPrice) this.setNodeDisplay(this.dom.rowPrice, SysConfig.riskPrefs.stopMode === 'price' ? 'flex' : 'none');
                if (this.dom.rowTicks) this.setNodeDisplay(this.dom.rowTicks, SysConfig.riskPrefs.stopMode === 'ticks' ? 'flex' : 'none');
            }
            this.calc();
            this.flashSavedChip();
        },
        flashSavedChip: function() {
            const chip = document.getElementById('rk-saved-chip');
            if (!chip) return;
            chip.classList.remove('is-fade');
            chip.classList.add('is-show');
            clearTimeout(this._savedChipFadeTimer);
            clearTimeout(this._savedChipHideTimer);
            this._savedChipFadeTimer = setTimeout(() => chip.classList.add('is-fade'), 1100);
            this._savedChipHideTimer = setTimeout(() => chip.classList.remove('is-show', 'is-fade'), 1400);
        },
        setNodeText: function(el, value) {
            if (!el) return;
            const next = String(value ?? '');
            if (el.innerText !== next) el.innerText = next;
        },
        setNodeHtml: function(el, value) {
            if (!el) return;
            const next = String(value ?? '');
            if (el.innerHTML !== next) el.innerHTML = next;
        },
        setNodeDisplay: function(el, value) {
            if (!el) return;
            el.classList.toggle('is-hidden', value === 'none');
            if (el.style.display !== value) el.style.display = value;
        },
        setNodeValue: function(el, value) {
            if (!el) return;
            const next = String(value ?? '');
            if (el.value !== next) el.value = next;
        },
        renderTradeSnapshot: function(trade) {
            const snapshotEl = this.dom.tradeSnapshot || document.getElementById('rk-trade-snapshot');
            const dirEl = this.dom.tradeDir || document.getElementById('rk-trade-dir');
            const entryEl = this.dom.tradeEntry || document.getElementById('rk-trade-entry');
            const slEl = this.dom.tradeSl || document.getElementById('rk-trade-sl');
            const tpEl = this.dom.tradeTp || document.getElementById('rk-trade-tp');
            const rrEl = this.dom.tradeRr || document.getElementById('rk-trade-rr');
            const lossAmtEl = this.dom.tradeLossAmt || document.getElementById('rk-trade-loss-amt');
            const profitAmtEl = this.dom.tradeProfitAmt || document.getElementById('rk-trade-profit-amt');
            const tradeMarkEl = this.dom.tradeMark || document.getElementById('rk-trade-mark');
            const tradeFeeRateLabelEl = this.dom.tradeFeeRateLabel || document.getElementById('rk-trade-fee-rate-label');
            const tradeFeeRateEl = this.dom.tradeFeeRate || document.getElementById('rk-trade-fee-rate');
            const tradeFeeLabelEl = this.dom.tradeFeeLabel || document.getElementById('rk-trade-fee-label');
            const tradeFeeEl = this.dom.tradeFee || document.getElementById('rk-trade-fee');
            const tradeFeeRoundLabelEl = this.dom.tradeFeeRoundLabel || document.getElementById('rk-trade-fee-round-label');
            const tradeFeeRoundEl = this.dom.tradeFeeRound || document.getElementById('rk-trade-fee-round');
            const prefs = this.getRiskPrefs();
            if (!snapshotEl || !dirEl || !entryEl || !slEl || !tpEl || !rrEl || !lossAmtEl || !profitAmtEl || !tradeMarkEl || !tradeFeeRateLabelEl || !tradeFeeRateEl || !tradeFeeLabelEl || !tradeFeeEl || !tradeFeeRoundLabelEl || !tradeFeeRoundEl) return;
            this.lastTradeSnapshot = trade || null;
            if (!trade) {
                this.setNodeDisplay(snapshotEl, 'none');
                this.setNodeText(dirEl, '-'); dirEl.style.color = 'var(--my-accent)';
                this.setNodeText(entryEl, '-'); this.setNodeText(slEl, '-'); this.setNodeText(tpEl, '-'); this.setNodeText(rrEl, '-'); this.applyRRLevel(rrEl, NaN);
                this.setNodeText(lossAmtEl, '-'); this.setNodeText(profitAmtEl, '-');
                this.setNodeText(tradeFeeRateLabelEl, SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Open / Close Rate' : '开 / 平费率');
                this.setNodeText(tradeFeeLabelEl, SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Open Fee' : '开仓手续费');
                this.setNodeText(tradeFeeRoundLabelEl, SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Stop Total Fee' : '止损总手续费');
                this.setNodeText(tradeMarkEl, '-'); this.setNodeText(tradeFeeRateEl, '-'); this.setNodeText(tradeFeeEl, '-'); this.setNodeText(tradeFeeRoundEl, '-');
                this.renderResultRR(null, null);
                this.renderResultProfit(null, null);
                return;
            }
            const sizing = this.resolveTradeSizing(trade);
            const calcSnapshot = this.buildCalcSnapshot();
            this.renderResultRR(trade, calcSnapshot);
            this.renderResultProfit(trade, calcSnapshot);
            if (prefs.compactMode || !prefs.showTradeSnapshot) {
                this.setNodeDisplay(snapshotEl, 'none');
                return;
            }
            this.setNodeDisplay(snapshotEl, 'flex');
            this.setNodeText(dirEl, trade.direction || '-');
            dirEl.style.color = (trade.direction || '').includes('Short') || (trade.direction || '').includes('空') ? 'var(--my-danger)' : 'var(--my-success)';
            this.setNodeText(entryEl, trade.entry || '-');
            this.setNodeText(slEl, trade.sl || '-');
            this.setNodeText(tpEl, trade.tp || '-');
            const snapshotRRInfo = this.buildTradeRRInfo(trade, sizing);
            this.setNodeText(rrEl, this.formatRRText(snapshotRRInfo.value, snapshotRRInfo.isNet));
            this.applyRRLevel(rrEl, snapshotRRInfo.value);
            const tradeSymbol = trade.symbol || this.currentSymbol || '';
            const lossFeeScenario = sizing?.isBitgetContract ? this.buildEntryExitFeeScenario(sizing.quantity, sizing.entry, sizing.sl, tradeSymbol) : null;
            const netLoss = sizing ? (Number.isFinite(sizing.totalMaxLoss) ? sizing.totalMaxLoss : sizing.actualLoss) : NaN;
            const netProfitFee = sizing?.isBitgetContract ? this.getDisplayedFeeTotal(sizing) : 0;
            const netProfit = sizing && Number.isFinite(sizing.actualProfit) ? sizing.actualProfit - netProfitFee : NaN;
            this.setNodeText(lossAmtEl, sizing ? this.formatAmountText(netLoss, sizing.conf.notionalCurrency, '-') : '-');
            this.setNodeText(profitAmtEl, sizing ? this.formatAmountText(netProfit, sizing.conf.notionalCurrency, '+') : '-');
            const preview = this.buildFeePreview(this.buildCalcSnapshot());
            this.setNodeText(tradeMarkEl, preview.ready || Number.isFinite(preview.markPrice) ? this.formatPriceText(preview.markPrice, preview.conf) : '-');
            this.setNodeText(tradeFeeRateLabelEl, SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Open / Close Rate' : '开 / 平费率');
            this.setNodeText(tradeFeeLabelEl, SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Open Fee' : '开仓手续费');
            this.setNodeText(tradeFeeRoundLabelEl, SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Stop Total Fee' : '止损总手续费');
            this.setNodeText(tradeFeeRateEl, lossFeeScenario?.ready ? this.formatEntryExitRateText(lossFeeScenario.entryRate, lossFeeScenario.exitRate) : '-');
            this.setNodeText(tradeFeeEl, lossFeeScenario?.ready ? this.formatFeeText(lossFeeScenario.entryFee, sizing.conf.notionalCurrency) : '-');
            this.setNodeText(tradeFeeRoundEl, lossFeeScenario?.ready ? this.formatFeeText(lossFeeScenario.totalFee, sizing.conf.notionalCurrency) : '-');
            this.updateRiskViewVisibility();
        },
        unbindEvents: function() {
            this.eventCleanups.forEach(cleanup => {
                try { cleanup(); } catch (e) {}
            });
            this.eventCleanups = [];
            clearTimeout(this._settingsAutoSaveTimer);
            this._settingsAutoSaveTimer = null;
        },
        bindEvents: function() {
            this.unbindEvents();
            const listen = (target, type, handler, options) => {
                if (!target || typeof target.addEventListener !== 'function') return;
                target.addEventListener(type, handler, options);
                this.eventCleanups.push(() => target.removeEventListener(type, handler, options));
            };
            listen(this.dom.openSettings, 'click', () => {
                const settingsVisible = this.dom.settingsView && getComputedStyle(this.dom.settingsView).display !== 'none';
                if (settingsVisible) this.closeSettingsView();
                else this.openSettingsView();
            });
            listen(this.dom.slType, 'change', (e) => {
                if (this.dom.rowPrice) this.setNodeDisplay(this.dom.rowPrice, e.target.value === 'price' ? 'flex' : 'none');
                if (this.dom.rowTicks) this.setNodeDisplay(this.dom.rowTicks, e.target.value === 'ticks' ? 'flex' : 'none');
                this.calc();
            });
            listen(this.dom.price, 'input', () => { this.calc(); });
            listen(this.dom.sl, 'input', () => { this.calc(); });
            listen(this.dom.ticks, 'input', () => { this.calc(); });
            listen(this.dom.risk, 'input', () => {
                const nextBudget = parseFloat(this.dom.risk.value);
                if (Number.isFinite(nextBudget) && nextBudget > 0) {
                    this.getRiskPrefs().riskBudget = nextBudget;
                    c1_saveConfig();
                }
                this.calc();
                if (this.lastTradeSnapshot) this.renderTradeSnapshot(this.lastTradeSnapshot);
            });
            if (this.dom.settingsView) {
                const scheduleAutoSave = () => {
                    clearTimeout(this._settingsAutoSaveTimer);
                    this._settingsAutoSaveTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                        this._settingsAutoSaveTimer = null;
                        this.saveSettingsFromView();
                    }, 150);
                };
                listen(this.dom.settingsView, 'change', scheduleAutoSave);
                listen(this.dom.settingsView, 'input', scheduleAutoSave);
            }
            listen(document, 'keydown', (event) => {
                if (event.key !== 'Escape') return;
                if (!this.dom.panel?.classList.contains('is-settings-open')) return;
                const tag = document.activeElement?.tagName;
                if (tag === 'INPUT' || tag === 'SELECT' || tag === 'TEXTAREA') document.activeElement.blur();
                this.closeSettingsView();
            });
        },
        calc: function() {
            const snapshot = this.buildCalcSnapshot();
            if (!snapshot) {
                this.resetCalcResult();
                return;
            }
            if (this.dom.resStatus) {
                this.setNodeText(this.dom.resStatus, '');
                this.dom.resStatus.classList.remove('is-visible');
            }
            this.clearCalcBlockHighlights();
            const { entry, conf, quantity } = snapshot;
            if (this.dom.resLots) this.setNodeText(this.dom.resLots, this.formatLotsText(quantity, conf));
            if (this.dom.resUnits) this.setNodeText(this.dom.resUnits, this.formatUnitsText(quantity, conf));
            if (this.dom.resNotional) this.setNodeText(this.dom.resNotional, this.formatNotionalText(quantity, entry, conf));
            if (this.dom.resNotionalPct) this.setNodeText(this.dom.resNotionalPct, this.formatNotionalPctText(quantity, entry));
            this.setCompactAmountNode(this.dom.resMaxLoss, snapshot.totalMaxLoss, conf.notionalCurrency, '', { allowZero: true });
            this.renderResultRR(this.lastTradeSnapshot, snapshot);
            this.renderResultProfit(this.lastTradeSnapshot, snapshot);
            this.renderResultFeeEstimate(snapshot);
        },
        renderTicks: function() {
            const c = this.dom.presets || document.getElementById('rk-presets');
            if (!this.currentAssetConfig || !c) return; c.innerHTML = '';
            this.currentAssetConfig.presets.forEach(v => { const tBtn = document.createElement('span'); tBtn.className = 'rk-preset-tag'; tBtn.innerText = v; tBtn.onclick = () => { (this.dom.ticks || document.getElementById('rk-ticks')).value = v; this.calc(); }; c.appendChild(tBtn); });
        },
        renderRisks: function(bal) { const c = this.dom.riskPresets || document.getElementById('rk-risk-presets'); if (!c) return; c.innerHTML = ''; c.classList.remove('hidden'); [0.5, 1, 2, 3, 5].forEach(p => { const tBtn = document.createElement('span'); tBtn.className = 'rk-preset-tag'; tBtn.innerText = p + '%'; tBtn.onclick = () => { const nextBudget = (bal * (p / 100)).toFixed(2); (this.dom.risk || document.getElementById('rk-risk')).value = nextBudget; this.getRiskPrefs().riskBudget = parseFloat(nextBudget); c1_saveConfig(); this.calc(); if (this.lastTradeSnapshot) this.renderTradeSnapshot(this.lastTradeSnapshot); }; c.appendChild(tBtn); }); },
        flashBox: function(el) { if(!el) return; el.classList.remove('rk-flash-revert'); el.classList.add('rk-flash-active'); setTimeout(() => { el.classList.remove('rk-flash-active'); el.classList.add('rk-flash-revert'); }, 100); },
        syncAccount: function() {
            if (document.visibilityState !== 'visible') return;
            const wrap = this.dom.panel || document.getElementById('panel-risk'); if (!wrap || !wrap.classList.contains('show')) return;

            // 回放开关会让 TradingView 暂时替换账户 DOM；这段时间不覆盖账户缓存。
            if (c1_isReplayStateUnstable()) return;

            const btn = c1_queryFirstVisible(C1_TV_RUNTIME_SELECTORS.accountButton);

            if (!btn) {
                this.applyCachedAccountState();
                return;
            }

            const imgEl = btn.querySelector('img'); let cName = "";
            const nameEl = btn.querySelector('[class*="titleText"]');
            if (nameEl && nameEl.textContent) cName = nameEl.textContent.trim(); else if (imgEl && imgEl.alt) cName = imgEl.alt; else cName = c1_normalizeDomText(btn.innerText || btn.textContent);

            if (cName && cName !== this.cachedBroker) { this.cachedBroker = cName; localStorage.setItem('tv_rk_broker', cName); this.setAccountTitle(cName); this.forceLoadCount = 0; }
            const nextIcon = this.readBrokerIconHtml(btn, cName);
            if (nextIcon && nextIcon !== this.cachedIcon) this.applyBrokerIconHtml(nextIcon, true);
            else if (this.cachedIcon && this.dom.icon && this.dom.icon.innerHTML !== this.cachedIcon) this.applyBrokerIconHtml(this.cachedIcon, false);

            let fBal = ""; const bArea = document.querySelector('.layout__area--bottom') || document.getElementById('footer-chart-panel');
            if (bArea) { const bNode = bArea.querySelector('[class*="value-"]') || Array.from(bArea.querySelectorAll('div')).find(el => /^\$?[0-9,]+\.[0-9]{2}$/.test(el.textContent.trim())); if (bNode) { let m = bNode.textContent.trim().match(/[0-9,.]+/); if (m) fBal = m[0]; } }

            if (!fBal) {
                this.applyCachedAccountState();
                return;
            }

            if (fBal && fBal !== '.') {
                this.setBalanceText(fBal);
                const num = parseFloat(fBal.replace(/,/g, ''));
                if (!isNaN(num)) {
                    const fallbackBroker = cName || this.cachedBroker || (SysConfig.lang === 'zh' ? '交易账户' : 'Trading Account');
                    this.cachedBroker = fallbackBroker;
                    localStorage.setItem('tv_rk_broker', fallbackBroker);
                    this.setAccountTitle(fallbackBroker);
                    if (num !== this.cachedBal) { this.cachedBal = num; localStorage.setItem('tv_rk_bal', num); this.renderRisks(num); }
                } this.forceLoadCount = 0;
            }
        },
        clearSymbolBoundInputs: function(previousSymbol, nextSymbol) {
            [this.dom.price, this.dom.sl, this.dom.ticks].forEach(input => {
                if (input) this.setNodeValue(input, '');
            });
            this.lastTradeSnapshot = null;
            this.lastCalcBlockReason = SysConfig.lang === 'en'
                ? `Symbol changed from ${previousSymbol} to ${nextSymbol}; old entry and stop values were cleared.`
                : `品种已从 ${previousSymbol} 切换为 ${nextSymbol}，已清空旧的入场与止损数据。`;
            this.lastCalcBlockFields = ['entry', 'stop', 'ticks'];
            this.renderTradeSnapshot(null);
            this.resetCalcResult();
        },
        syncTV: function() {
            if (document.visibilityState !== 'visible') return;
            const wrap = this.dom.panel || document.getElementById('panel-risk');
            if (!wrap || !wrap.classList.contains('show')) return;
            const snapshot = c1_getTVStateBridge().getChartState(true);
            const s = snapshot?.symbol || '';
            const p = snapshot?.priceText || '';
            const priceVal = Number.isFinite(snapshot?.priceValue) ? snapshot.priceValue : parseFloat(String(p).replace(/,/g, ''));
            if (!s && !p) return;

            if (s && this.currentSymbol !== s) {
                const previousSymbol = this.currentSymbol;
                this.currentSymbol = s;
                if (previousSymbol) {
                    this.currentAssetConfig = null;
                    this.clearSymbolBoundInputs(previousSymbol, s);
                }
                const rkEl = this.dom.symbol || document.getElementById('rk-symbol-display'); if (rkEl) this.setNodeText(rkEl, s);
                this.updateRiskViewVisibility();
                this.renderResultFeeEstimate();
            }
            if (s) {
                const nextConfig = this.resolveAssetConfig(s, priceVal);
                if (nextConfig && Number.isFinite(snapshot?.tickSize) && snapshot.tickSize > 0) {
                    nextConfig.tickSize = snapshot.tickSize;
                }
                if (this.getConfigSignature(nextConfig) !== this.getConfigSignature(this.currentAssetConfig)) {
                    this.currentAssetConfig = nextConfig;
                    this.renderTicks();
                    this.calc();
                }
            }
            if (p) {
                const priceEl = this.dom.livePrice || document.getElementById('rk-live-price'); if (priceEl) this.setNodeText(priceEl, p);
                const rkPriceInput = this.dom.price || document.getElementById('rk-price'); if (rkPriceInput && !rkPriceInput.value) { this.setNodeValue(rkPriceInput, this.formatEntryInputValue(p, this.currentAssetConfig)); this.calc(); }
                else this.renderResultFeeEstimate();
            }
        },
        tracker: function() {
            if (document.visibilityState !== 'visible') return;
            const wrap = this.dom.panel || document.getElementById('panel-risk');
            if (!wrap || !wrap.classList.contains('show')) return;
            const parsed = c1_getTVStateBridge().getTradeDialogData(true);
            this.renderTradeSnapshot(parsed);
            if (!parsed) return;
            const entry = parsed.entry;
            const sl = parsed.sl;
            const ticks = c1_normalizeDomText(parsed.slTicks || '') || (() => {
                const entryVal = parseFloat(entry);
                const slVal = parseFloat(sl);
                if (!Number.isFinite(entryVal) || !Number.isFinite(slVal) || !this.currentAssetConfig?.tickSize) return '';
                const diff = Math.abs(entryVal - slVal);
                if (!diff) return '';
                return String((diff / this.currentAssetConfig.tickSize).toFixed(2).replace(/\.00$/, ''));
            })();
            if (entry && this.dom.price) {
                const nextEntry = this.formatEntryInputValue(entry, this.currentAssetConfig);
                if (this.dom.price.value !== nextEntry) { let el = this.dom.price || document.getElementById('rk-price'); this.setNodeValue(el, nextEntry); this.calc(); this.flashBox(el); }
            }
            if (ticks && this.dom.ticks && this.dom.ticks.value !== ticks) {
                const typeEl = this.dom.slType || document.getElementById('rk-sl-type');
                if (typeEl && typeEl.value !== 'ticks') {
                    typeEl.value = 'ticks';
                    typeEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
                }
                let el = this.dom.ticks || document.getElementById('rk-ticks'); this.setNodeValue(el, ticks); this.calc(); this.flashBox(el);
            }
        },
        start: function() {
            this.stopIntervals();
            this.updateRiskViewVisibility();
            this.renderTicks();
            this.renderTradeSnapshot(null);
            this.renderResultFeeEstimate(null);
            if (this.cachedBal > 0) this.renderRisks(this.cachedBal);
            c1_applyTheme();
            this.intervals.push(c1_setVisibilityAwareInterval(() => this.syncAccount(), PERF_CONFIG.accountSyncMs));
            this.intervals.push(c1_setVisibilityAwareInterval(() => this.syncTV(), PERF_CONFIG.chartSyncMs));
            this.intervals.push(c1_setVisibilityAwareInterval(() => this.tracker(), PERF_CONFIG.trackerSyncMs));
        },
        stopIntervals: function() {
            this.intervals.forEach(timer => {
                if (timer?.stop) timer.stop();
                else clearInterval(timer);
            });
            this.intervals = [];
        },
        stop: function() {
            this.stopIntervals();
            this.unbindEvents();
        },
        destroy: function() {
            this.stop();
            this.dom = {};
        },
        toggle: function(state) { this.enabled = state; if (state) this.init(); else this.destroy(); }
    };

    const BearPet = {
        host: null, shadow: null, pet: null, deco: null, progressEl: null, confirmEl: null, dragHintEl: null, dragHintTimer: 0, sparkEffect: null,
        pos: { x: null, y: null }, mood: 'idle', frame: 0, frameTimer: 0, pauseUntil: 0,
        rafId: 0, moodTimer: 0, sleepTimer: 0, snoreTimer: 0, clickTimer: 0, clickCount: 0, lastClickAt: 0, confirmLockedUntil: 0,
        confirmTimer: 0, progressResetTimer: 0, audioContext: null, resizeHandler: null,
        pressTimer: 0, dragging: false, moved: false, pointerId: null, offsetX: 0, offsetY: 0, pressX: 0, pressY: 0,
        init() {
            SysConfig.bearPet = c1_normalizeBearPetConfig(SysConfig.bearPet);
            if (!SysConfig.bearPet.enabled) { this.destroy(); return; }
            if (!this.host || !this.host.isConnected) this.mount();
            this.applyConfig();
        },

                    .drag-hint.open { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: translate3d(0,0,0) scale(1); transition-delay: 0s; }
                    .drag-hint::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: 28px; bottom: -6px; width: 10px; height: 10px; background: var(--my-bg-panel, #1f1f23); border-right: 1px solid rgba(47,189,125,.38); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(47,189,125,.38); transform: rotate(45deg); }
                    @keyframes bear-bob { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg); } 50% { transform: translateY(-6px) rotate(3deg); } }
                    @keyframes bear-excited { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg); } 35% { transform: translateY(-11px) rotate(5deg); } 70% { transform: translateY(-4px) rotate(-5deg); } }
                    @keyframes bear-sleepy { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg); } 50% { transform: translateY(3px) rotate(3deg); } }
                    @keyframes bear-angry { 0%,100% { transform: rotate(0deg); } 25% { transform: rotate(-4deg); } 75% { transform: rotate(4deg); } }
                    @keyframes sparkle-pop { 0%,100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.65) translateY(4px); } 45% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.05) translateY(-2px); } }
                    @keyframes confirm-dot-pop { 0% { transform: scale(.52); } 70% { transform: scale(1.38); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } }
                </style>
                <div class="pet" data-mood="idle" role="button" tabindex="0">
                    <div class="drag-hint" role="status" aria-live="polite">${SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Long-press to drag me anywhere.' : '长按小熊，可以拖拽位置'}</div>
                    <div class="confirm-card" role="status" aria-live="polite">
                        <p class="confirm-title">可以下单！</p>
                        <p class="confirm-copy">小熊已完成 5 次确认，按你的交易计划执行。</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="deco" aria-hidden="true"></div>
                    <div class="sprite-wrap"><img class="sprite" src="${C1_BEAR_SHEET}" alt="Work Journey bear" draggable="false"></div>
                    <div class="confirm-progress" aria-hidden="true">${Array.from({ length: C1_BEAR_CONFIRM_STEPS }, () => '<span class="confirm-dot"></span>').join('')}</div>
                </div>`;
            this.pet = this.shadow.querySelector('.pet');
            this.deco = this.shadow.querySelector('.deco');
            this.progressEl = this.shadow.querySelector('.confirm-progress');
            this.confirmEl = this.shadow.querySelector('.confirm-card');
            this.dragHintEl = this.shadow.querySelector('.drag-hint');
            this.sparkEffect = c1_attachSparkClickEffect(this.pet, {
                sparkColor: '#ff7043',
                sparkCount: 12,
                sparkRadius: 27,
                sparkSize: 10,
                duration: 500,
                bleed: 44,
                triggerOnClick: false
            });
            this.bindEvents();
            const defaultPos = this.getDefaultPosition();
            this.pos.x = SysConfig.bearPet.x ?? defaultPos.x;
            this.pos.y = SysConfig.bearPet.y ?? defaultPos.y;
            this.pet.style.setProperty('--bear-scale', String(SysConfig.bearPet.scale || 1));
            this.applyPosition();
            this.setMood(SysConfig.bearPet.mood || 'idle');
            this.showInitialDragHint();
            this.resetSleepTimers();
            this.rafId = requestAnimationFrame((now) => this.tick(now));
        },
        bindEvents() {
            this.pet.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
                if (event.button !== 0) return;
                if (event.target.closest?.('.confirm-card')) return;
                clearTimeout(this.pressTimer);
                this.dragging = false; this.moved = false; this.pointerId = event.pointerId;
                this.pressX = event.clientX; this.pressY = event.clientY;
                this.offsetX = event.clientX - this.pos.x; this.offsetY = event.clientY - this.pos.y;
                this.pet.setPointerCapture(this.pointerId);
                this.pressTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                    if (!this.pet || this.pointerId !== event.pointerId || this.moved) return;
                    this.dragging = true;
                    this.pet.classList.add('is-dragging');
                    this.dismissDragHint();
                    this.setMood('dragging');
                }, 260);
            });
            this.pet.addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => {
                if (event.pointerId !== this.pointerId) return;
                if (!this.dragging) {
                    const distance = Math.hypot(event.clientX - this.pressX, event.clientY - this.pressY);
                    if (distance > 6) {
                        this.moved = true;
                        clearTimeout(this.pressTimer);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                this.moved = true;
                const scale = SysConfig.bearPet?.scale || 1;
                const bounds = this.getPositionBounds(scale);
                this.pos.x = this.clamp(event.clientX - this.offsetX, bounds.minX, bounds.maxX);
                this.pos.y = this.clamp(event.clientY - this.offsetY, bounds.minY, bounds.maxY);
                this.applyPosition();
            });
            this.pet.addEventListener('pointerup', (event) => {
                if (event.pointerId !== this.pointerId) return;
                clearTimeout(this.pressTimer);
                try { this.pet.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (e) {}
                const wasDragging = this.dragging;
                this.dragging = false; this.pointerId = null; this.pet.classList.remove('is-dragging');
                if (wasDragging) {
                    this.savePosition(); this.setMood(SysConfig.bearPet.mood || 'idle'); this.resetSleepTimers();
                    return;
                }
                if (!this.moved) {
                    c1_triggerSparkClickEffect(this.pet, event.clientX, event.clientY);
                    this.handleClick();
                }
            });
            this.pet.addEventListener('pointercancel', (event) => {
                if (event.pointerId !== this.pointerId) return;
                clearTimeout(this.pressTimer);
                this.dragging = false; this.pointerId = null; this.pet.classList.remove('is-dragging');
                this.setMood(SysConfig.bearPet.mood || 'idle');
            });
            this.pet.addEventListener('contextmenu', (event) => {
                event.preventDefault();
                event.stopPropagation();
                if (event.target.closest?.('.confirm-card')) return;
                c1_triggerSparkClickEffect(this.pet, event.clientX, event.clientY);
                this.handleClick();
            });
            this.pet.addEventListener('dblclick', (event) => event.preventDefault());
            this.pet.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => { if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') { event.preventDefault(); c1_triggerSparkClickEffect(this.pet); this.handleClick(); } });
            this.resizeHandler = () => this.applyConfig();
            window.addEventListener('resize', this.resizeHandler, { passive: true });
            this.visibilityHandler = () => {
                if (!this.pet || document.hidden || this.rafId) return;
                this.rafId = requestAnimationFrame((now) => this.tick(now));
            };
            document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', this.visibilityHandler);
        },
        applyConfig() {
            SysConfig.bearPet = c1_normalizeBearPetConfig(SysConfig.bearPet);
            if (!SysConfig.bearPet.enabled) { this.destroy(); return; }
            if (!this.pet) return;
            const root = getUIRoot();
            if (this.host && root && this.host.parentElement !== root) root.appendChild(this.host);
            const defaultPos = this.getDefaultPosition();
            this.pos.x = SysConfig.bearPet.x ?? defaultPos.x;
            this.pos.y = SysConfig.bearPet.y ?? defaultPos.y;
            this.pet.style.setProperty('--bear-scale', String(SysConfig.bearPet.scale || 1));
            this.applyPosition();
            this.setMood(SysConfig.bearPet.mood || 'idle');
            this.applyImmersiveVisibility();
        },
        applyImmersiveVisibility() {
            if (!this.pet) return;
            const root = getUIRoot();
            if (this.host && root && this.host.parentElement !== root) root.appendChild(this.host);
            const mode = SysConfig.bearPet?.immersiveMode || 'show';
            const riskPanelOpen = !c1_immersiveActive && c1_isElementShown(document.getElementById('panel-risk'));
            const hidden = riskPanelOpen || (mode === 'hide' && c1_immersiveActive) || (mode === 'only' && !c1_immersiveActive);
            this.pet.classList.toggle('is-hidden', hidden);
        },
        showInitialDragHint() {
            if (!this.dragHintEl || SysConfig.bearPet?.dragHintSeen) return;
            clearTimeout(this.dragHintTimer);
            this.temporaryMood('happy', 1800, SysConfig.bearPet.mood || 'idle');
            this.dragHintEl.classList.add('open');
            this.dragHintTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                this.dismissDragHint();
            }, 5200);
        },
        dismissDragHint() {
            if (SysConfig.bearPet?.dragHintSeen) return;
            clearTimeout(this.dragHintTimer);
            this.dragHintEl?.classList.remove('open');
            SysConfig.bearPet = c1_normalizeBearPetConfig({ ...SysConfig.bearPet, dragHintSeen: true });
            c1_saveConfig();
        },
        handleClick() {
            if (this.isConfirmLocked()) return;
            this.resetSleepTimers();
            this.advanceConfirmProgress();
            clearTimeout(this.clickTimer);
            this.clickTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                const nextMood = this.randomChoice(['idle', 'happy', 'love', 'excited', 'celebrate', 'sleepy', 'working', 'angry', 'surprised', 'shy']);
                this.temporaryMood(nextMood, 1900, SysConfig.bearPet.mood || 'idle');
            }, 120);
        },
        tick(now) {
            if (!this.pet) return;
            if (document.hidden) { this.rafId = 0; return; }
            const cfg = C1_BEAR_MOODS[this.mood] || C1_BEAR_MOODS.idle;
            const frameMs = 1000 / cfg.fps;
            if (now >= this.pauseUntil && now - this.frameTimer >= frameMs) {
                this.frame = (this.frame + 1) % C1_BEAR_COLS;
                if (this.frame === 0 && cfg.loopDelay) this.pauseUntil = now + cfg.loopDelay;
                this.applyFrame(); this.frameTimer = now;
            }
            this.rafId = requestAnimationFrame((next) => this.tick(next));
        },
        setMood(nextMood) {
            this.mood = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(C1_BEAR_MOODS, nextMood) ? nextMood : 'idle';
            this.frame = 0; this.frameTimer = 0; this.pauseUntil = 0;
            if (this.pet) this.pet.dataset.mood = this.mood;
            this.applyFrame(); this.renderDeco();
        },
        temporaryMood(nextMood, duration, after = 'idle') { clearTimeout(this.moodTimer); this.setMood(nextMood); this.moodTimer = setTimeout(() => this.setMood(after), duration); },
        applyFrame() {
            if (!this.pet) return;
            const row = (C1_BEAR_MOODS[this.mood] || C1_BEAR_MOODS.idle).row;
            this.pet.style.setProperty('--sprite-x', `${-this.frame * C1_BEAR_SIZE}px`);
            this.pet.style.setProperty('--sprite-y', `${-row * C1_BEAR_SIZE}px`);
        },
        renderDeco() {
            if (!this.deco) return;
            if (['excited', 'celebrate'].includes(this.mood)) this.deco.innerHTML = '<span class="sparkle">*</span><span class="sparkle">+</span><span class="sparkle">*</span>';
            else if (this.mood === 'love') this.deco.innerHTML = '<span class="sparkle">&hearts;</span><span class="sparkle">&hearts;</span><span class="sparkle">&hearts;</span>';
            else this.deco.textContent = '';
        },
        isConfirmLocked() {
            return !!(this.confirmEl?.classList.contains('open') || Date.now() < this.confirmLockedUntil);
        },
        advanceConfirmProgress() {
            if (this.isConfirmLocked()) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            if (now - this.lastClickAt > 2200) this.clickCount = 0;
            this.lastClickAt = now;
            this.clickCount = Math.min(C1_BEAR_CONFIRM_STEPS, this.clickCount + 1);
            this.updateConfirmProgress();
            this.playConfirmTone(this.clickCount);
            clearTimeout(this.progressResetTimer);
            if (this.clickCount >= C1_BEAR_CONFIRM_STEPS) {
                this.playConfirmCompleteTone();
                this.temporaryMood('celebrate', 1400, SysConfig.bearPet.mood || 'idle');
                this.showTradeConfirmPrompt();
                return;
            }
            this.progressResetTimer = setTimeout(() => this.resetConfirmProgress(), 2400);
        },
        updateConfirmProgress() {
            if (!this.progressEl) return;
            this.progressEl.classList.toggle('is-active', this.clickCount > 0);
            this.progressEl.querySelectorAll('.confirm-dot').forEach((dot, index) => {
                dot.classList.toggle('on', index < this.clickCount);
            });
        },
        resetConfirmProgress() {
            clearTimeout(this.progressResetTimer);
            clearTimeout(this.confirmTimer);
            this.clickCount = 0;
            this.confirmLockedUntil = 0;
            this.updateConfirmProgress();
            this.confirmEl?.classList.remove('open');
        },
        showTradeConfirmPrompt() {
            clearTimeout(this.confirmTimer);
            clearTimeout(this.progressResetTimer);
            clearTimeout(this.clickTimer);
            this.confirmLockedUntil = Date.now() + 3300;
            this.updateConfirmProgress();
            this.confirmEl?.classList.add('open');
            this.confirmTimer = setTimeout(() => this.resetConfirmProgress(), 3200);
        },
        getConfirmAudio() {
            const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
            if (!AudioContext) return null;
            this.audioContext = this.audioContext || new AudioContext();
            if (this.audioContext.state === 'suspended') this.audioContext.resume().catch(() => {});
            return this.audioContext;
        },
        playConfirmTone(level) {
            try {
                const context = this.getConfirmAudio();
                if (!context) return;
                const now = context.currentTime;
                const freq = [261.63, 329.63, 392, 523.25, 659.25][Math.max(0, Math.min(C1_BEAR_CONFIRM_STEPS - 1, level - 1))];
                const osc = context.createOscillator();
                const gain = context.createGain();
                osc.type = level >= 4 ? 'square' : 'triangle';
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now);
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now);
                gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.065 + level * 0.012, now + 0.012);
                gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.24 + level * 0.025);
                osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(context.destination);
                osc.start(now); osc.stop(now + 0.34 + level * 0.025);
            } catch (e) {}
        },
        playConfirmCompleteTone() {
            try {
                const context = this.getConfirmAudio();
                if (!context) return;
                const start = context.currentTime;
                [261.63, 329.63, 392, 523.25].forEach((freq, index) => {
                    const now = start + index * 0.07;
                    const osc = context.createOscillator();
                    const gain = context.createGain();
                    osc.type = 'square';
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now);
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now);
                    gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.05, now + 0.01);
                    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.38);
                    osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(context.destination);
                    osc.start(now); osc.stop(now + 0.42);
                });
            } catch (e) {}
        },
        resetSleepTimers() {
            clearTimeout(this.sleepTimer); clearTimeout(this.snoreTimer);
            this.sleepTimer = setTimeout(() => { if (!this.dragging) this.setMood('sleepy'); this.snoreTimer = setTimeout(() => { if (!this.dragging) this.setMood('snoring'); }, 12000); }, 30000);
        },
        applyPosition() {
            if (!this.pet) return;
            const scale = SysConfig.bearPet?.scale || 1;
            const defaultPos = this.getDefaultPosition();
            const bounds = this.getPositionBounds(scale);
            this.pos.x = this.clamp(this.pos.x ?? defaultPos.x, bounds.minX, bounds.maxX);
            this.pos.y = this.clamp(this.pos.y ?? defaultPos.y, bounds.minY, bounds.maxY);
            this.pet.style.setProperty('--bear-x', `${Math.round(this.pos.x)}px`);
            this.pet.style.setProperty('--bear-y', `${Math.round(this.pos.y)}px`);
            this.pet.classList.add('is-positioned');
        },
        savePosition(persist = true) {
            SysConfig.bearPet.x = Math.round(this.pos.x);
            SysConfig.bearPet.y = Math.round(this.pos.y);
            if (persist) c1_saveConfig();
        },
        resetPosition() {
            SysConfig.bearPet.x = null; SysConfig.bearPet.y = null;
            const defaultPos = this.getDefaultPosition();
            this.pos.x = defaultPos.x;
            this.pos.y = defaultPos.y;
            this.applyPosition(); c1_saveConfig();
        },
        getDefaultPosition() {
            const scale = SysConfig.bearPet?.scale || 1;
            const bounds = this.getPositionBounds(scale);
            return {
                x: bounds.maxX,
                y: bounds.maxY
            };
        },
        getPositionBounds(scale = SysConfig.bearPet?.scale || 1) {
            const rightReserve = 18;
            const bottomReserve = 18;
            return {
                minX: 8,
                minY: 8,
                maxX: Math.max(8, window.innerWidth - C1_BEAR_SIZE * scale - rightReserve),
                maxY: Math.max(8, window.innerHeight - C1_BEAR_SIZE * scale - bottomReserve)
            };
        },
        destroy() {
            if (SysConfig?.bearPet?.enabled !== true) c1_stopNativeAlertBearWatcher();
            if (this.rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(this.rafId);
            if (this.resizeHandler) {
                window.removeEventListener('resize', this.resizeHandler);
                this.resizeHandler = null;
            }
            if (this.visibilityHandler) {
                document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', this.visibilityHandler);
                this.visibilityHandler = null;
            }
            [this.moodTimer, this.sleepTimer, this.snoreTimer, this.clickTimer, this.confirmTimer, this.progressResetTimer, this.pressTimer, this.dragHintTimer].forEach(timer => clearTimeout(timer));
            this.sparkEffect?.destroy();
            this.rafId = 0; this.host?.remove();
            this.host = this.shadow = this.pet = this.deco = this.progressEl = this.confirmEl = this.dragHintEl = this.sparkEffect = null;
            this.dragHintTimer = 0;
        },
        randomChoice(items) { return items[Math.floor(Math.random() * items.length)]; },
        clamp(value, min, max) { return Math.min(Math.max(value, min), Math.max(min, max)); }
    };

        }
    }

    let c2_macroRequestGeneration = 0;

    function c2_validateMacroResponse(data) {
        if (!Array.isArray(data)) throw new Error('Macro response must be an array');
        if (data.length > C1_CONFIG_IMPORT_MAX_ARRAY_ITEMS) throw new Error('Macro response has too many items');
        return data.map((item, index) => {
            if (!c1_isPlainConfigObject(item)) throw new Error(`Macro item ${index} must be an object`);
            const normalized = { ...item };
            ['title', 'country', 'date', 'impact', 'forecast', 'previous'].forEach((field) => {
                const value = item[field] == null ? '' : String(item[field]);
                if (value.length > 1000) throw new Error(`Macro item ${index}.${field} is too long`);
                normalized[field] = value;
            });
            if (!normalized.date || !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(normalized.date))) throw new Error(`Macro item ${index}.date is invalid`);
            return normalized;
        });
    }

    function c2_fetchMacroData(forceRefresh = false) {
        const now = Date.now();
        const container = document.getElementById('tv-macro-content');
        const cacheTime = Number(C2_CONFIG.cache?.time);
        const cacheAge = now - cacheTime;
        if (!forceRefresh && Number.isFinite(cacheTime) && cacheAge >= 0 && cacheAge < PERF_CONFIG.macroCacheMs && Array.isArray(C2_CONFIG.cache?.data)) {
            if (c2_renderMacroData(C2_CONFIG.cache.data)) return;
        }
        const generation = ++c2_macroRequestGeneration;
        const isCurrent = () => generation === c2_macroRequestGeneration;
        const showFailure = (title, detail = '') => {
            if (!isCurrent() || !container) return;
            container.innerHTML = `<div class="macro-state is-danger"><strong>${c1_tradeGateEscape(title)}</strong>${detail ? `<br><small>${c1_tradeGateEscape(detail)}</small>` : ''}</div>`;
        };
        if (container) container.innerHTML = `<div class="macro-state is-syncing">${c1_lang('Syncing data...', '正在同步数据...')}</div>`;
        try {
            GM_xmlhttpRequest({
                method: 'GET',
                url: C2_CONFIG.macroApiUrl,
                timeout: 10000,
                onload: function(response) {
                    if (!isCurrent()) return;
                    if (response.status !== 200) {
                        showFailure(c1_lang('Request failed', '请求失败'), `HTTP ${response.status}`);
                        return;
                    }
                    try {
                        const responseText = String(response.responseText || '');
                        if (!responseText || responseText.length > C1_CONFIG_IMPORT_MAX_BYTES) throw new Error('Response is empty or too large');
                        const parsed = c2_validateMacroResponse(JSON.parse(responseText));
                        if (!isCurrent()) return;
                        C2_CONFIG.cache = { time: Date.now(), data: parsed };
                        if (!c2_saveConfig()) C1_LOG.warn('macro.cache', '宏观缓存写入失败');
                        c2_renderMacroData(parsed);
                    } catch (error) {
                        C1_LOG.warn('macro.parse', error);
                        showFailure(c1_lang('Parse failed', '数据解析失败'), c1_lang('Invalid response format', '响应格式无效'));
                    }
                },
                onerror: function() { showFailure(c1_lang('Network denied', '网络被拒绝')); },
                ontimeout: function() { showFailure(c1_lang('Request timed out', '请求超时')); },
                onabort: function() { showFailure(c1_lang('Request cancelled', '请求已取消')); }
            });
        } catch (error) {
            C1_LOG.warn('macro.request', error);
            showFailure(c1_lang('Request failed', '请求失败'));
        }
    }

    function c2_renderMacroData(data) {
        const container = document.getElementById('tv-macro-content');
        if (!Array.isArray(data)) {
            if (container) container.innerHTML = `<div class="macro-state is-danger">${c1_lang('Invalid macro data', '宏观数据格式无效')}</div>`;
            return false;
        }
        if (!container) return true;
        let html = '<div class="macro-event-list">'; const now = new Date();
        let activeCurrencies = new Set(Array.isArray(C2_CONFIG.macroPrefs?.currencies) ? C2_CONFIG.macroPrefs.currencies : ['USD']); if (activeCurrencies.has('XAU') || activeCurrencies.has('CRYPTO')) activeCurrencies.add('USD');
        const filteredData = data.filter(item => { const isTargetCurrency = activeCurrencies.has(item.country); const isHighOrMed = ['High', 'Medium'].includes(item.impact); const itemDate = new Date(item.date); return isTargetCurrency && isHighOrMed && itemDate >= new Date(now.setHours(0,0,0,0)); });
        if (filteredData.length === 0) { container.innerHTML = `<div class="macro-state is-empty">${c1_lang('No high-risk alerts this week, or they were filtered out', '本周暂无高危警报或已被过滤')}</div>`; return true; }
        filteredData.forEach(item => {
            const dateObj = new Date(item.date); const isToday = dateObj.toDateString() === new Date().toDateString();
            const dayStr = isToday ? '<span class="today-badge">🔥 Today</span>' : `<span class="macro-event-day">${c1_tradeGateEscape(dateObj.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN', { weekday: 'short', month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric' }))}</span>`;
            const timeStr = c1_tradeGateEscape(dateObj.toLocaleTimeString('zh-CN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: false }));
            const impactColor = item.impact === 'High' ? 'var(--my-danger)' : 'var(--my-warning)';
            const country = c1_tradeGateEscape(item.country || '');
            const title = c1_tradeGateEscape(item.title || '');
            const forecast = c1_tradeGateEscape(item.forecast || '---');
            const previous = c1_tradeGateEscape(item.previous || '---');
            html += `<div class="macro-event-card" style="--macro-impact-color: ${impactColor};"><div class="macro-event-head"><span class="macro-event-country">${country}</span><span class="macro-event-time">${dayStr} <span>${timeStr}</span></span></div><div class="macro-event-title">${title}</div><div class="macro-event-meta"><span class="macro-event-meta-item">${c1_lang('Forecast', '预测')}: <b class="macro-event-forecast">${forecast}</b></span><span class="macro-event-meta-item">${c1_lang('Previous', '前值')}: <b class="macro-event-previous">${previous}</b></span></div></div>`;
        });
        container.innerHTML = html + '</div>';
        return true;
    }

    function c2_renderCustomEngine(cp) {
        const container = document.getElementById(`content-${cp.id}`); if (!container) return;
        if (cp.type === 'html') { container.innerHTML = cp.content ? c1_safeHtml(cp.content) : `<div class="macro-state">${c1_lang('No content', '无内容')}</div>`; }
        else if (cp.type === 'api') {
            container.innerHTML = `<div class="macro-state is-syncing">${c1_lang('Requesting preset data...', '正在请求预设数据...')}</div>`;
            GM_xmlhttpRequest({
                method: "GET", url: cp.url, timeout: 15000,
                onload: function(res) {
                    if (res.status === 200) { let parsedData; try { parsedData = JSON.parse(res.responseText); } catch(e) { parsedData = res.responseText; } const templates = (typeof API_TEMPLATES !== 'undefined' && API_TEMPLATES) ? API_TEMPLATES : {}; const tpl = templates[cp.apiTemplate]; if (tpl && tpl.render) { try { tpl.render(parsedData, container); } catch(err) { container.innerHTML = `<div class="macro-state is-danger">${c1_lang('Template render error', '模板渲染出错')}</div>`; } } else { container.innerHTML = `<div class="macro-state is-danger">${c1_lang('Template not found', '模板不存在')}</div>`; } } else { container.innerHTML = `<div class="macro-state is-danger">HTTP ${res.status}</div>`; }
                },
                onerror: function() { container.innerHTML = `<div class="macro-state is-danger">${c1_lang('CORS request failed', '跨域失败')}</div>`; }
            });
        }
    }

    function c1_findToolBindingByShortcut(key) {
        const tools = SysConfig.tools || {};
        for (const { id, conf } of c1_getActiveToolBindingEntries()) {
            if (SharedTV.matchesShortcut(tools[id], key)) return { id, conf };
        }
        return null;
    }

    function c1_findToolMetaById(targetId) {
        for (let cat in TOOL_DICT) {
            if (TOOL_DICT[cat][targetId]) return TOOL_DICT[cat][targetId];
        }
        return null;
    }

    function c1_getBindingName(key) {
        const toolBinding = c1_findToolBindingByShortcut(key);
        if (toolBinding) return toolBinding.conf.name[SysConfig.lang] || toolBinding.conf.name.zh;
        for(let tf of SysConfig.timeframes) if(SharedTV.matchesShortcut(tf.key, key)) return `${c1_lang('Timeframe', '周期')} ${tf.val}`;
        for(let sym of SysConfig.symbols) if(SharedTV.matchesShortcut(sym.key, key)) return `${c1_lang('Symbol', '品种')} ${sym.val}`;
        for(let p of SysConfig.panels) if(SharedTV.matchesShortcut(p.key, key)) return `${c1_lang('Panel', '浮窗')} ${p.title}`;
        return null;
    }

    function c2_getBindingName(key) {
        if (SharedTV.matchesShortcut(C2_CONFIG.macroKey, key)) return c1_lang('Macro Calendar', '宏观日历');
        return null;
    }

    function c1_forEachSafeSelectorMatch(selectors, root, visit) {
        selectors.forEach(selector => {
            try {
                root.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach(visit);
            } catch (e) {}
        });
    }

    function c1_getChartLegendTopBoundary() {
        const selectors = [
            '#header-toolbar-symbol-search',
            '#header-toolbar-fullscreen',
            '#header-toolbar-intervals',
            '#header-toolbar-indicators',
            '[id^="header-toolbar"]',
            '[data-name*="header-toolbar" i]',
            '[class*="top-toolbar" i]',
            '[class*="header-toolbar" i]'
        ];
        let bottom = 0;
        c1_forEachSafeSelectorMatch(selectors, document, el => {
            if (!(el instanceof HTMLElement) || !c1_isVisibleNode(el)) return;
            const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (rect.top <= 80 && rect.height > 12 && rect.height < 96) bottom = Math.max(bottom, rect.bottom);
        });
        if (c1_immersiveActive || document.fullscreenElement) return 0;
        return bottom ? Math.max(48, Math.min(bottom, 96)) : 56;
    }

    function c1_isChartLegendTopLeftCandidate(el, options = {}) {
        if (!(el instanceof HTMLElement) || !c1_isVisibleNode(el)) return false;
        const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        const minTop = Number.isFinite(Number(options.minTop)) ? Number(options.minTop) : c1_getChartLegendTopBoundary();
        const maxTop = options.maxTop || 220;
        const maxLeft = options.maxLeft || 620;
        const maxWidth = options.maxWidth || 360;
        const maxHeight = options.maxHeight || 96;
        return rect.width > 0
            && rect.height > 0
            && rect.width <= maxWidth
            && rect.height <= maxHeight
            && rect.top >= minTop - 2
            && rect.top <= Math.min(maxTop, window.innerHeight * 0.35)
            && rect.left >= 0
            && rect.left <= Math.min(maxLeft, window.innerWidth * 0.62);
    }

    function c1_isPluginOwnedChartLegendNode(el) {
        return !!el?.closest?.('#tv-settings-panel, #tv-custom-sidebar, #tv-custom-sidebar-right, .tv-side-panel, #tv-tradegate-window, #tv-immersive-profile-card, #tv-work-journey-bear-host, #tv-custom-notifier-container, [id^="header-toolbar"], [data-name*="header-toolbar" i], [class*="top-toolbar" i], [class*="header-toolbar" i]');
    }

    function c1_isLikelyIndicatorVisibilityControl(el) {
        if (!(el instanceof HTMLElement) || c1_isPluginOwnedChartLegendNode(el)) return false;
        if (!c1_isChartLegendTopLeftCandidate(el, { maxTop: 360, maxLeft: 760, maxWidth: 52, maxHeight: 52 })) return false;
        const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        const leftToolbarWidth = c1_immersiveActive || document.fullscreenElement ? 0 : 72;
        if (rect.left < leftToolbarWidth) return false;
        const label = c1_normalizeDomText([
            el.getAttribute('aria-label'),
            el.getAttribute('title'),
            el.getAttribute('data-name'),
            el.getAttribute('data-tooltip'),
            el.getAttribute('data-tooltip-text'),
            el.innerText,
            el.textContent
        ].filter(Boolean).join(' ')).toLowerCase();
        if (/toggle-visibility-button|visibility|visible|invisible|hide|show|eye|隐藏|显示/.test(label)) return true;
        const svgText = String(el.querySelector('svg')?.innerHTML || '').toLowerCase();
        return !!svgText && /path|circle|line|slash|clip|stroke|fill/.test(svgText) && rect.width <= 42 && rect.height <= 42;
    }

    function c1_getCurrentChartSymbolAliases() {
        const aliases = new Set();
        try {
            const symbol = c1_getTVStateBridge().getState()?.symbol || '';
            String(symbol).split(':').forEach(part => {
                const value = c1_normalizeDomText(part);
                if (value) aliases.add(value.toUpperCase());
            });
            const shortSymbol = c1_formatTradeGateSymbol(symbol)?.short || '';
            if (shortSymbol) aliases.add(String(shortSymbol).toUpperCase());
        } catch (e) {}
        return aliases;
    }

    function c1_extractStudyEntityId(study) {
        if (!study || typeof study !== 'object') return null;
        return study.id ?? study.entityId ?? study.studyId ?? study.sourceId ?? null;
    }

    function c1_readStudyEntityName(study) {
        if (!study || typeof study !== 'object') return '';
        return c1_normalizeDomText(study.name || study.title || study.shortName || study.description || study.id || '');
    }

    function c1_getStudyApi(chart, study) {
        const id = c1_extractStudyEntityId(study);
        if (!chart || id == null || typeof chart.getStudyById !== 'function') return null;
        try {
            const api = chart.getStudyById(id);
            return api && typeof api === 'object' ? api : null;
        } catch (e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    function c1_readStudyVisible(studyApi, study = null) {
        try {
            if (studyApi && typeof studyApi.isVisible === 'function') {
                const visible = studyApi.isVisible();
                if (typeof visible === 'boolean') return visible;
            }
            if (study && typeof study.visible === 'boolean') return study.visible;
            if (study && typeof study.isVisible === 'boolean') return study.isVisible;
        } catch (e) {}
        return null;
    }

    function c1_getChartStudySlotsFromApi() {
        const chart = c1_getChartApi();
        if (!chart || typeof chart.getAllStudies !== 'function' || typeof chart.getStudyById !== 'function') return null;
        let studies = null;
        try { studies = chart.getAllStudies(); } catch (e) { return null; }
        if (!Array.isArray(studies)) return null;
        return studies
            .map((study, idx) => {
                const id = c1_extractStudyEntityId(study);
                const api = c1_getStudyApi(chart, study);
                const name = c1_readStudyEntityName(study) || `Study ${idx + 1}`;
                return {
                    index: idx + 1,
                    id,
                    name,
                    visible: c1_readStudyVisible(api, study),
                    api,
                    source: 'api'
                };
            })
            .filter(slot => slot.id != null && slot.api && typeof slot.api.setVisible === 'function');
    }

    function c1_getIndicatorSlotKey(slot) {
        const id = slot?.id == null ? '' : String(slot.id).trim();
        const name = c1_normalizeDomText(slot?.name || '');
        return id ? `id:${id}` : `name:${name.toLowerCase()}`;
    }

    function c1_sortIndicatorSlotsByUserOrder(slots = []) {
        const list = Array.isArray(slots) ? slots.filter(Boolean) : [];
        const order = c1_normalizeIndicatorSlotOrder(SysConfig.indicatorSlotOrder);
        if (!order.length || !list.length) {
            return list.map((slot, idx) => ({ ...slot, nativeIndex: slot.nativeIndex || slot.index || idx + 1, index: idx + 1 }));
        }
        const byKey = new Map(list.map(slot => [c1_getIndicatorSlotKey(slot), slot]));
        const used = new Set();
        const sorted = [];
        order.forEach(item => {
            const directKey = item.id ? `id:${item.id}` : `name:${String(item.name || '').toLowerCase()}`;
            let slot = byKey.get(directKey);
            if (!slot && item.name) {
                const wanted = String(item.name || '').toLowerCase();
                slot = list.find(candidate => !used.has(c1_getIndicatorSlotKey(candidate)) && c1_normalizeDomText(candidate.name).toLowerCase() === wanted);
            }
            if (!slot) return;
            const key = c1_getIndicatorSlotKey(slot);
            if (used.has(key)) return;
            used.add(key);
            sorted.push(slot);
        });
        list.forEach(slot => {
            const key = c1_getIndicatorSlotKey(slot);
            if (used.has(key)) return;
            used.add(key);
            sorted.push(slot);
        });
        return sorted.map((slot, idx) => ({ ...slot, nativeIndex: slot.nativeIndex || slot.index || idx + 1, index: idx + 1 }));
    }

    function c1_toggleIndicatorSlotViaApi(slotIndex) {
        const rawSlots = c1_getChartStudySlotsFromApi();
        const slots = rawSlots ? c1_sortIndicatorSlotsByUserOrder(rawSlots) : null;
        if (!slots) return { handled: false };
        const slot = slots[slotIndex - 1];
        if (!slot) return { handled: true, success: false, reason: 'slot_not_found' };
        const current = c1_readStudyVisible(slot.api, slot);
        if (typeof current !== 'boolean') return { handled: true, success: false, reason: 'visibility_unknown', slot };
        const target = !current;
        try {
            slot.api.setVisible(target);
            return { handled: true, success: true, slot, previous: current, target };
        } catch (e) {
            return { handled: true, success: false, reason: 'set_failed', slot, error: e };
        }
    }

    function c1_setIndicatorSlotMemory(slotIndex, visible) {
        SysConfig.indicatorSlotVisibility = c1_normalizeIndicatorSlotVisibility(SysConfig.indicatorSlotVisibility);
        SysConfig.indicatorSlotVisibility[String(slotIndex)] = visible === true;
        c1_saveConfig();
    }

    function c1_clearIndicatorSlotMemory(slotIndex) {
        SysConfig.indicatorSlotVisibility = c1_normalizeIndicatorSlotVisibility(SysConfig.indicatorSlotVisibility);
        delete SysConfig.indicatorSlotVisibility[String(slotIndex)];
        c1_saveConfig();
    }

    function c1_applyIndicatorSlotVisibilityMemory() {
        SysConfig.indicatorSlotVisibility = c1_normalizeIndicatorSlotVisibility(SysConfig.indicatorSlotVisibility);
        const saved = SysConfig.indicatorSlotVisibility;
        const entries = Object.entries(saved).filter(([, visible]) => typeof visible === 'boolean');
        if (!entries.length) return false;
        const slots = c1_sortIndicatorSlotsByUserOrder(c1_getChartStudySlotsFromApi() || []);
        if (!slots || !slots.length) return false;
        entries.forEach(([indexKey, visible]) => {
            const index = Number(indexKey);
            if (!Number.isInteger(index) || index < 1) return;
            const slot = slots[index - 1];
            if (!slot || !slot.api || typeof slot.api.setVisible !== 'function') return;
            const current = c1_readStudyVisible(slot.api, slot);
            if (current === visible) return;
            try { slot.api.setVisible(visible); } catch (e) {}
        });
        return true;
    }

    function c1_scheduleIndicatorSlotVisibilityRestore() {
        [250, 900, 1800, 3500].forEach(delay => setTimeout(c1_applyIndicatorSlotVisibilityMemory, delay));
    }

    function c1_isLikelyIndicatorSlotName(text, symbolAliases = c1_getCurrentChartSymbolAliases()) {
        const value = c1_normalizeDomText(text);
        if (!value || value.length < 2 || value.length > 96) return false;
        const upper = value.toUpperCase();
        if (symbolAliases.has(upper)) return false;
        if (/^[\d\s.,:+\-/%()]+$/.test(value)) return false;
        if (/^(1分|3分|5分|15分|30分|45分|1小时|2小时|3小时|4小时|天|周|月|1m|3m|5m|15m|30m|45m|1h|2h|3h|4h|d|w|m)$/i.test(value)) return false;
        if (/买入|卖出|买|卖|\bbuy\b|\bsell\b|\bbid\b|\bask\b|开市|闭市|market|volume\s*$/i.test(value)) return false;
        if (/^[A-Z0-9]{2,12}(?:USDT\.P|USD|USDT|PERP)?$/i.test(value)) return false;
        return /[A-Za-z\u4e00-\u9fff]/.test(value);
    }

    function c1_scanIndicatorSlots(root = document, options = {}) {
        if (!options.domOnly) {
            const apiSlots = c1_getChartStudySlotsFromApi();
            if (apiSlots) {
                return c1_sortIndicatorSlotsByUserOrder(apiSlots).slice(0, 12).map(slot => ({
                    index: slot.index,
                    id: slot.id,
                    name: slot.name,
                    visible: slot.visible,
                    source: 'api'
                }));
            }
        }
        const symbolAliases = c1_getCurrentChartSymbolAliases();
        const seen = new Set();
        const candidates = [];
        const selectors = [
            '[data-name*="legend-study" i]',
            '[data-name*="legend-indicator" i]',
            '[data-name*="study-title" i]',
            '[data-name*="study-name" i]',
            '[class*="legend"] span',
            '[class*="legend"] div'
        ];
        c1_forEachSafeSelectorMatch(selectors, root, el => {
            if (!(el instanceof HTMLElement) || c1_isPluginOwnedChartLegendNode(el)) return;
            const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (!c1_isChartLegendTopLeftCandidate(el, { maxTop: 420, maxLeft: 820, maxWidth: 520, maxHeight: 44 })) return;
            const text = c1_normalizeDomText(el.innerText || el.textContent);
            if (!c1_isLikelyIndicatorSlotName(text, symbolAliases)) return;
            const key = text.toLowerCase();
            if (seen.has(key)) return;
            seen.add(key);
            candidates.push({ name: text, element: el, top: rect.top, left: rect.left, area: rect.width * rect.height });
        });
        const domSlots = candidates
            .sort((a, b) => (a.top - b.top) || (a.left - b.left) || (a.area - b.area))
            .slice(0, 12)
            .map((slot, idx) => {
                const next = { index: idx + 1, name: slot.name, source: 'dom' };
                if (options.includeElements) next.element = slot.element;
                return next;
            });
        return c1_sortIndicatorSlotsByUserOrder(domSlots);
    }

    function c1_findIndicatorSlotRow(slot) {
        const source = slot?.element;
        if (!(source instanceof HTMLElement)) return null;
        const slotName = c1_normalizeDomText(slot.name).toLowerCase();
        const explicitRow = source.closest?.('[data-name*="legend" i][data-name*="item" i], [data-name*="study" i][data-name*="item" i]');
        if (explicitRow instanceof HTMLElement && !c1_isPluginOwnedChartLegendNode(explicitRow)) return explicitRow;
        let best = source;
        let current = source;
        while (current?.parentElement && current.parentElement !== document.body) {
            const parent = current.parentElement;
            if (c1_isPluginOwnedChartLegendNode(parent)) break;
            if (!c1_isChartLegendTopLeftCandidate(parent, { maxTop: 460, maxLeft: 900, maxWidth: 760, maxHeight: 56 })) break;
            const parentText = c1_normalizeDomText(parent.innerText || parent.textContent).toLowerCase();
            if (slotName && parentText.includes(slotName)) best = parent;
            current = parent;
        }
        return best;
    }

    function c1_scoreIndicatorVisibilityButton(button) {
        if (!(button instanceof HTMLElement) || !button.isConnected) return -1;
        const rect = button.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (!rect.width || !rect.height) return -1;
        const style = unsafeWindow.getComputedStyle ? unsafeWindow.getComputedStyle(button) : window.getComputedStyle(button);
        if (style.display === 'none' || style.visibility === 'hidden') return -1;
        const label = c1_normalizeDomText([
            button.getAttribute('aria-label'),
            button.getAttribute('title'),
            button.getAttribute('data-name'),
            button.getAttribute('data-tooltip'),
            button.getAttribute('data-tooltip-text'),
            button.innerText,
            button.textContent
        ].filter(Boolean).join(' ')).toLowerCase();
        let score = 0;
        if (/toggle-visibility-button/.test(label)) score += 160;
        if (/隐藏|显示|hide|show|visibility|visible|invisible|eye/.test(label)) score += 120;
        if (/设置|删除|移除|更多|format|settings|remove|delete|more/.test(label)) score -= 80;
        if (button.querySelector('svg')) score += 8;
        if (rect.width <= 42 && rect.height <= 42) score += 8;
        return score;
    }

    function c1_isIndicatorButtonNearSlotRow(button, row) {
        if (!(button instanceof HTMLElement) || !(row instanceof HTMLElement)) return false;
        if (c1_isPluginOwnedChartLegendNode(button)) return false;
        const btnRect = button.getBoundingClientRect();
        const rowRect = row.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (btnRect.width <= 0 || btnRect.height <= 0 || btnRect.width > 54 || btnRect.height > 54) return false;
        if (btnRect.top < c1_getChartLegendTopBoundary() - 4 || btnRect.top > Math.min(520, window.innerHeight * 0.55)) return false;
        const buttonCenterY = btnRect.top + btnRect.height / 2;
        const rowCenterY = rowRect.top + rowRect.height / 2;
        const verticallyNear = Math.abs(buttonCenterY - rowCenterY) <= Math.max(26, rowRect.height * 0.75);
        const horizontallyNear = btnRect.left >= Math.max(0, rowRect.left - 14) && btnRect.left <= Math.min(window.innerWidth, Math.max(rowRect.right + 320, 760));
        return verticallyNear && horizontallyNear;
    }

    function c1_getIndicatorSlotSearchRoots(row) {
        const roots = [row];
        let current = row;
        while (current?.parentElement && current.parentElement !== document.body && roots.length < 7) {
            current = current.parentElement;
            if (c1_isPluginOwnedChartLegendNode(current)) break;
            if (!c1_isChartLegendTopLeftCandidate(current, { maxTop: 520, maxLeft: 960, maxWidth: 860, maxHeight: 260 })) break;
            roots.push(current);
        }
        roots.push(document);
        return Array.from(new Set(roots));
    }

    function c1_findIndicatorSlotVisibilityButton(row) {
        if (!(row instanceof HTMLElement)) return null;
        const selectors = [
            '[data-name="toggle-visibility-button"]',
            '[data-name*="toggle-visibility" i]',
            'button[aria-label*="隐藏"]',
            'button[aria-label*="显示"]',
            'button[aria-label*="Hide" i]',
            'button[aria-label*="Show" i]',
            'button[title*="隐藏"]',
            'button[title*="显示"]',
            'button[title*="Hide" i]',
            'button[title*="Show" i]',
            '[role="button"][aria-label*="隐藏"]',
            '[role="button"][aria-label*="显示"]',
            '[role="button"][aria-label*="Hide" i]',
            '[role="button"][aria-label*="Show" i]',
            '[data-name*="visibility" i]',
            '[data-name*="visible" i]',
            '[data-name*="hide" i]',
            '[data-name*="show" i]'
        ];
        const candidates = [];
        c1_getIndicatorSlotSearchRoots(row).forEach(root => {
            c1_forEachSafeSelectorMatch(selectors, root, el => {
                if (el instanceof HTMLElement) candidates.push(el.closest?.('button,[role="button"]') || el);
            });
            root.querySelectorAll?.('button,[role="button"]').forEach(el => candidates.push(el));
        });
        const unique = Array.from(new Set(candidates));
        return unique
            .filter(el => c1_isIndicatorButtonNearSlotRow(el, row))
            .map(el => ({ el, score: c1_scoreIndicatorVisibilityButton(el) }))
            .filter(item => item.score > 0)
            .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)[0]?.el || null;
    }

    function c1_hoverIndicatorSlotRow(row, source = row) {
        const targets = Array.from(new Set([source, row, row.parentElement].filter(el => el instanceof HTMLElement)));
        const rect = row.getBoundingClientRect();
        const clientX = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerWidth - 1, rect.left + Math.min(rect.width - 4, Math.max(12, rect.width * 0.72))));
        const clientY = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerHeight - 1, rect.top + rect.height / 2));
        targets.forEach(target => {
            ['pointerover', 'pointerenter', 'mouseover', 'mouseenter', 'mousemove'].forEach(type => {
                try { target.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent(type, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, view: window, clientX, clientY })); } catch (e) {}
            });
        });
    }

    function c1_executeIndicatorSlotToggle(slotIndex) {
        const index = Number(slotIndex);
        if (!Number.isInteger(index) || index < 1) return false;
        const apiResult = c1_toggleIndicatorSlotViaApi(index);
        if (apiResult.handled) {
            if (apiResult.success) {
                c1_setIndicatorSlotMemory(index, apiResult.target === true);
                SharedTV.showToast(c1_lang(`Indicator slot ${index} ${apiResult.target ? 'shown' : 'hidden'}: ${apiResult.slot.name}`, `指标槽位 ${index} 已${apiResult.target ? '显示' : '隐藏'}：${apiResult.slot.name}`));
                return true;
            }
            if (apiResult.reason === 'slot_not_found') {
