                SharedTV.showToast(c1_lang(`Indicator slot ${index} not found`, `未找到指标槽位 ${index}`), true);
                return true;
            }
            SharedTV.showToast(c1_lang(`Cannot control indicator slot ${index} via TradingView API`, `无法通过 TradingView API 控制指标槽位 ${index}`), true);
            return true;
        }
        const slots = c1_scanIndicatorSlots(document, { includeElements: true, domOnly: true });
        const slot = slots[index - 1];
        if (!slot) {
            SharedTV.showToast(c1_lang(`Indicator slot ${index} not found`, `未找到指标槽位 ${index}`), true);
            return true;
        }
        const row = c1_findIndicatorSlotRow(slot);
        if (!row) {
            SharedTV.showToast(c1_lang(`Indicator slot ${index} row not found`, `未找到指标槽位 ${index} 的行`), true);
            return true;
        }
        const tryClick = () => {
            const button = c1_findIndicatorSlotVisibilityButton(row);
            if (!button) {
                SharedTV.showToast(c1_lang(`Visibility button not found for slot ${index}`, `未找到槽位 ${index} 的显示/隐藏按钮`), true);
                return;
            }
            SharedTV.simulateClick(button);
            setTimeout(() => {
                SharedTV.showToast(c1_lang(`Indicator slot ${index} toggled, verify manually: ${slot.name}`, `已尝试切换指标槽位 ${index}，请手动核对：${slot.name}`), false, '', 'neutral');
            }, 220);
        };
        c1_hoverIndicatorSlotRow(row, slot.element);
        setTimeout(() => {
            c1_hoverIndicatorSlotRow(row, slot.element);
            tryClick();
        }, 140);
        return true;
    }

    function c1_switchIntervalFallback(resCode) {
        const targetCode = c1_normalizeIntervalCode(resCode);
        if (!targetCode) return false;
        const buttons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role="radiogroup"] button[role="radio"], button[aria-label*="分钟"], button[aria-label*="小时"], button[aria-label*="日"], button[aria-label*="周"], button[aria-label*="月"], button[aria-label*="minute" i], button[aria-label*="hour" i], button[aria-label*="day" i], button[aria-label*="week" i], button[aria-label*="month" i]'))
            .filter(c1_isVisibleNode);
        const targetButton = buttons.find((button) => {
            const label = c1_readFirstValid([button.getAttribute('aria-label'), button.innerText, button.textContent]);
            return c1_normalizeIntervalCode(label) === targetCode;
        });
        if (!targetButton) return false;
        SharedTV.simulateClick(targetButton);
        return true;
    }

    const switchInterval = (resCode) => {
        const nextCode = c1_normalizeIntervalCode(resCode) || String(resCode);
        try {
            const chart = c1_getWidgetApi()?.activeChart?.();
            if (chart && typeof chart.setResolution === 'function') {
                chart.setResolution(nextCode);
                return true;
            }
        } catch (e) {}
        return c1_switchIntervalFallback(nextCode);
    };
    const switchSymbol = (symbolCode) => { try { const chart = c1_getWidgetApi()?.activeChart?.(); if (!chart) return false; chart.setSymbol(symbolCode); return true; } catch (e) { return false; } };

    function c1_getImmersiveShortcut() {
        return String(SysConfig.immersiveKey || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    }

    function c1_getImmersiveModeLabel() {
        return SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Immersive Mode' : '沉浸模式';
    }

    function c1_getChartHudParts(snapshot = c1_resolveChartSnapshot()) {
        const rawSymbol = c1_sanitizeSymbol(snapshot?.symbol || '');
        const symbolParts = rawSymbol.split(':');
        const exchange = symbolParts.length > 1 ? symbolParts[0] : '';
        const symbol = symbolParts.length > 1 ? symbolParts.slice(1).join(':') : rawSymbol;
        return {
            exchange: exchange || (SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Chart' : '图表'),
            symbol: symbol || (SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Unknown Symbol' : '未知品种'),
            interval: c1_formatIntervalLabel(snapshot?.interval || '') || '--'
        };
    }

    function c1_getTimePartsForZone(date, timeZone) {
        const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
            timeZone,
            weekday: 'short',
            hour: '2-digit',
            minute: '2-digit',
            hour12: false
        }).formatToParts(date).reduce((acc, part) => {
            if (part.type !== 'literal') acc[part.type] = part.value;
            return acc;
        }, {});
        const hour = Number(parts.hour === '24' ? 0 : parts.hour);
        const minute = Number(parts.minute || 0);
        return { weekday: parts.weekday || '', minutes: (hour * 60) + minute };
    }

    function c1_getTradingSessionState(date = new Date()) {
        const london = c1_getTimePartsForZone(date, 'Europe/London');
        const ny = c1_getTimePartsForZone(date, 'America/New_York');
        const isWeekend = ['Sat', 'Sun'].includes(london.weekday) || ['Sat', 'Sun'].includes(ny.weekday);
        const londonOpen = !isWeekend && london.minutes >= 8 * 60 && london.minutes < 17 * 60;
        const nyOpen = !isWeekend && ny.minutes >= 8 * 60 && ny.minutes < 17 * 60;
        if (londonOpen && nyOpen) return { id: 'overlap', label: SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Overlap' : '交叠盘', color: '#00a676' };
        if (londonOpen) return { id: 'london', label: SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'London' : '伦敦盘', color: '#2f80ed' };
        if (nyOpen) return { id: 'newyork', label: SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'New York' : '纽约盘', color: '#d89b12' };
        return { id: 'quiet', label: SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Low Liquidity' : '低流动性', color: '#8a96a3' };
    }

    function c1_applyImmersiveHudScale(hud = c1_immersiveHudEl) {
        SysConfig.immersiveHudScale = c1_normalizeImmersiveHudScale(SysConfig.immersiveHudScale);
        if (hud) hud.style.setProperty('--tv-immersive-hud-scale', String(SysConfig.immersiveHudScale));
    }

    function c1_getImmersiveHudAvoidRects() {
        const selectors = [
            '[data-name="left-toolbar"]',
            '[data-name="drawing-toolbar"]',
            '[data-name="linetool-toolbar"]',
            '[data-name="linetool-group-cursors"]',
            '[class*="drawing-toolbar"]',
            '[class*="drawingToolbar"]'
        ];
        const seen = new Set();
        const rects = [];
        const addRect = (el) => {
            if (!el || seen.has(el) || !c1_isVisibleNode(el)) return;
            seen.add(el);
            const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (rect.left <= 96 && rect.right >= 0 && rect.width >= 24 && rect.height >= 34) rects.push(rect);
        };
        selectors.forEach(selector => {
            try { document.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach(addRect); } catch (e) {}
        });
        if (!rects.length) try {
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-name], [class]').forEach(el => {
                if (seen.has(el) || !c1_isVisibleNode(el)) return;
                const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                if (rect.left > 80 || rect.top > window.innerHeight - 80) return;
                if (rect.width < 30 || rect.width > 112 || rect.height < 120) return;
                const style = unsafeWindow.getComputedStyle ? unsafeWindow.getComputedStyle(el) : window.getComputedStyle(el);
                if (!['fixed', 'absolute', 'sticky'].includes(style.position)) return;
                addRect(el);
            });
        } catch (e) {}
        return rects;
    }

    function c1_positionImmersiveChartHud(hud = c1_immersiveHudEl) {
        if (!hud) return;
        const margin = 18;
        let left = margin;
        let top = margin;
        c1_getImmersiveHudAvoidRects().forEach(rect => {
            const overlapsTopCorner = rect.left <= 96 && rect.top <= 160;
            const leftRail = rect.left <= 80 && rect.height >= 120;
            if (leftRail || overlapsTopCorner) left = Math.max(left, Math.ceil(rect.right + 12));
            if (rect.top <= 36 && rect.height <= 96 && rect.width > 240) top = Math.max(top, Math.ceil(rect.bottom + 10));
        });
        const scale = c1_normalizeImmersiveHudScale(SysConfig.immersiveHudScale);
        const width = Math.max(188, hud.offsetWidth || 220) * scale;
        const height = Math.max(72, hud.offsetHeight || 86) * scale;
        left = Math.min(Math.max(margin, left), Math.max(margin, window.innerWidth - width - margin));
        top = Math.min(Math.max(margin, top), Math.max(margin, window.innerHeight - height - margin));
        hud.style.setProperty('--tv-immersive-hud-left', `${Math.round(left)}px`);
        hud.style.setProperty('--tv-immersive-hud-top', `${Math.round(top)}px`);
        c1_immersiveHudRectCache.expires = 0;
    }

    function c1_focusChartForTradingViewShortcut() {
        const target = c1_queryFirstVisible([
            'canvas',
            '[data-name="legend-source-item"]',
            '.chart-container',
            '[class*="chart-widget"]'
        ].join(','), document, true) || document.body;
        try {
            if (typeof target.focus === 'function') target.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        } catch (e) {}
        return target;
    }

    let c1_immersiveOrderArm = { side: '', until: 0, button: null, timer: null };

    function c1_clearImmersiveOrderArm() {
        if (c1_immersiveOrderArm.timer) clearTimeout(c1_immersiveOrderArm.timer);
        const button = c1_immersiveOrderArm.button;
        if (button) {
            button.classList.remove('is-armed');
            button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
            if (button.dataset.orderIdleLabel) button.textContent = button.dataset.orderIdleLabel;
        }
        c1_immersiveOrderArm = { side: '', until: 0, button: null, timer: null };
    }

    function c1_sendTradingViewOrderShortcut(side, showToast = true) {
        const key = side === 'sell' ? 'S' : 'B';
        const target = c1_focusChartForTradingViewShortcut();
        try {
            const event = new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {
                key,
                code: `Key${key}`,
                shiftKey: true,
                bubbles: true,
                cancelable: true,
                composed: true
            });
            try { Object.defineProperty(event, 'keyCode', { get: () => key.charCodeAt(0) }); } catch (e) {}
            try { Object.defineProperty(event, 'which', { get: () => key.charCodeAt(0) }); } catch (e) {}
            target.dispatchEvent(event);
        } catch (e) {
            C1_LOG.warn('immersive.orderShortcut', e);
            return false;
        }
        if (showToast) {
            SharedTV.showToast(
                side === 'sell' ? c1_lang('Shift+S sent', 'Shift+S 已发送') : c1_lang('Shift+B sent', 'Shift+B 已发送'),
                c1_lang('Verify and confirm the order in TradingView. The plugin has not verified execution.', '请在 TradingView 中核对并确认订单；插件未验证下单或成交结果。'),
                'warning',
                4200
            );
        }
        return true;
    }

    function c1_dispatchTradingViewShiftOrderKey(side) {
        return c1_sendTradingViewOrderShortcut(side, true);
    }

    function c1_armOrDispatchImmersiveOrder(button, side) {
        const now = Date.now();
        if (c1_immersiveOrderArm.side === side && c1_immersiveOrderArm.button === button && now <= c1_immersiveOrderArm.until) {
            c1_clearImmersiveOrderArm();
            return c1_dispatchTradingViewShiftOrderKey(side);
        }
        c1_clearImmersiveOrderArm();
        button.dataset.orderIdleLabel = button.textContent || (side === 'sell' ? 'SELL' : 'BUY');
        button.textContent = side === 'sell'
            ? c1_lang('CONFIRM SELL', '确认 SELL')
            : c1_lang('CONFIRM BUY', '确认 BUY');
        button.classList.add('is-armed');
        button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
        const arm = { side, until: now + 2400, button, timer: null };
        arm.timer = setTimeout(() => {
            if (c1_immersiveOrderArm === arm) c1_clearImmersiveOrderArm();
        }, 2400);
        c1_immersiveOrderArm = arm;
        SharedTV.showToast(
            c1_lang(`Order shortcut armed: ${side.toUpperCase()}`, `已武装${side === 'sell' ? '卖出' : '买入'}快捷键`),
            c1_lang('Click the same button again within 2.4 seconds to send it. TradingView still requires verification.', '请在 2.4 秒内再次点击同一按钮才会发送；仍须在 TradingView 中人工核对。'),
            'warning',
            3000
        );
        return false;
    }

    function c1_bindImmersiveOrderButtons(hud) {
        if (!hud || hud.dataset.orderButtonsBound === '1') return;
        hud.dataset.orderButtonsBound = '1';
        hud.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
            const button = event.target?.closest?.('.tv-immersive-order-btn');
            if (!button || !hud.contains(button)) return;
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();
            const side = button.dataset.orderSide === 'sell' ? 'sell' : 'buy';
            c1_armOrDispatchImmersiveOrder(button, side);
        }, true);
    }

    function c1_applyImmersiveProfileScale(card = c1_immersiveProfileEl) {
        SysConfig.immersiveProfileScale = c1_normalizeImmersiveProfileScale(SysConfig.immersiveProfileScale);
        if (!card) return;
        const scale = SysConfig.immersiveProfileScale;
        card.style.setProperty('--tv-immersive-profile-scale', String(scale));
        card.style.setProperty('--tv-immersive-profile-hover-scale', String(Math.round(scale * 1.015 * 1000) / 1000));
        card.style.setProperty('--tv-immersive-profile-pop-scale', String(Math.round(scale * 1.035 * 1000) / 1000));
    }

    function c1_ensureImmersiveChartHud() {
        const root = getUIRoot();
        if (!c1_immersiveHudEl || !c1_immersiveHudEl.isConnected) {
            c1_immersiveHudEl = document.createElement('div');
            c1_immersiveHudEl.id = 'tv-immersive-chart-hud';
            c1_immersiveHudEl.innerHTML = `
                <div class="tv-immersive-hud-inner">
                    <div class="tv-immersive-hud-kicker"><span class="tv-immersive-hud-dot"></span><span class="tv-immersive-hud-mode">${c1_tradeGateEscape(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Immersive Chart' : '沉浸图表')}</span></div>
                    <div class="tv-immersive-hud-symbol">--</div>
                    <div class="tv-immersive-hud-tf">--</div>
                    <div class="tv-immersive-hud-exchange">--</div>
                    <div class="tv-immersive-hud-session"><span class="tv-immersive-hud-session-dot"></span><span class="tv-immersive-hud-session-label">--</span></div>
                    <div class="tv-immersive-order-actions" aria-label="${c1_tradeGateEscape(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Order actions' : '下单操作')}">
                        <button type="button" class="tv-immersive-order-btn is-buy" data-order-side="buy" title="Shift+B">BUY</button>
                        <button type="button" class="tv-immersive-order-btn is-sell" data-order-side="sell" title="Shift+S">SELL</button>
                    </div>
                </div>`;
            c1_bindImmersiveOrderButtons(c1_immersiveHudEl);
        }
        if (c1_immersiveHudEl.parentElement !== root) root.appendChild(c1_immersiveHudEl);
        c1_bindImmersiveOrderButtons(c1_immersiveHudEl);
        c1_applyImmersiveHudScale(c1_immersiveHudEl);
        c1_positionImmersiveChartHud(c1_immersiveHudEl);
        return c1_immersiveHudEl;
    }

    function c1_ensureImmersiveProfileCard() {
        const root = getUIRoot();
        if (!c1_immersiveProfileEl || !c1_immersiveProfileEl.isConnected) {
            c1_immersiveProfileEl = document.createElement('div');
            c1_immersiveProfileEl.id = 'tv-immersive-profile-card';
            c1_immersiveProfileEl.innerHTML = `
                <div class="tv-immersive-tip-bubble">
                    <div class="tv-immersive-tip-head"><span class="tv-immersive-tip-icon">*</span><span class="tv-immersive-tip-title">Trading Tips</span></div>
                    <p class="tv-immersive-tip-text"></p>
                </div>
                <div class="tv-immersive-profile-avatar"><img alt=""></div>
                <div class="tv-immersive-profile-copy">
                    <div class="tv-immersive-profile-kicker"></div>
                    <div class="tv-immersive-profile-name"></div>
                </div>`;
            c1_immersiveProfileEl.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
                event.preventDefault();
                c1_playImmersiveTipSound();
                c1_showImmersiveProfileTipSafe();
            });
            c1_attachSparkClickEffect(c1_immersiveProfileEl, {
                sparkColor: '#ff7043',
                sparkCount: 12,
                sparkRadius: 25,
                sparkSize: 10,
                duration: 500,
                bleed: 42
            });
        }
        if (c1_immersiveProfileEl.parentElement !== root) root.appendChild(c1_immersiveProfileEl);
        c1_applyImmersiveProfileScale(c1_immersiveProfileEl);
        c1_immersiveProfileEl.classList.toggle('is-panel-obscured', c1_shouldHideImmersiveProfileCard());
        return c1_immersiveProfileEl;
    }

    function c1_getImmersiveGreeting() {
        const hour = new Date().getHours();
        const name = String(SysConfig.username || '').trim() || 'Trader';
        if (hour >= 5 && hour < 11) return SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? `Morning focus, ${name}` : `早盘专注，${name}`;
        if (hour >= 11 && hour < 14) return SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? `Midday reset, ${name}` : `午间校准，${name}`;
        if (hour >= 14 && hour < 18) return SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? `Afternoon patience, ${name}` : `午后耐心，${name}`;
        if (hour >= 18 && hour < 23) return SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? `Evening clarity, ${name}` : `晚盘清醒，${name}`;
        return SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? `Quiet chart, ${name}` : `夜盘慢一点，${name}`;
    }

    function c1_showImmersiveProfileTip() {
        if (!c1_immersiveProfileEl || !c1_immersiveActive) return;
        const tips = c1_normalizeImmersiveTips(SysConfig.immersiveTips);
        const icons = ['✦', '✓', '↗', '◆', '⚡', '※'];
        const tip = tips[Math.floor(Math.random() * tips.length)];
        const bubble = c1_immersiveProfileEl.querySelector('.tv-immersive-tip-bubble');
        const text = c1_immersiveProfileEl.querySelector('.tv-immersive-tip-text');
        const icon = c1_immersiveProfileEl.querySelector('.tv-immersive-tip-icon');
        if (text) text.textContent = tip;
        if (icon) icon.textContent = icons[Math.floor(Math.random() * icons.length)];
        if (bubble) {
            bubble.classList.remove('is-open');
            void bubble.offsetWidth;
            bubble.classList.add('is-open');
        }
        c1_immersiveProfileEl.classList.remove('is-tip-open');
        void c1_immersiveProfileEl.offsetWidth;
        c1_immersiveProfileEl.classList.add('is-tip-open');
        clearTimeout(c1_immersiveProfileEl._tipTimer);
        c1_immersiveProfileEl._tipTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            bubble?.classList.remove('is-open');
            c1_immersiveProfileEl?.classList.remove('is-tip-open');
        }, 3000);
    }

    function c1_getImmersiveGreetingSafe() {
        const hour = new Date().getHours();
        if (SysConfig.lang === 'en') {
            if (hour >= 5 && hour < 11) return 'Morning focus';
            if (hour >= 11 && hour < 14) return 'Midday reset';
            if (hour >= 14 && hour < 18) return 'Afternoon patience';
            if (hour >= 18 && hour < 23) return 'Evening clarity';
            return 'Quiet chart';
        }
        if (hour >= 5 && hour < 11) return '早盘专注';
        if (hour >= 11 && hour < 14) return '午间校准';
        if (hour >= 14 && hour < 18) return '午后耐心';
        if (hour >= 18 && hour < 23) return '晚盘清醒';
        return '夜盘慢一点';
    }

    function c1_showImmersiveProfileTipSafe() {
        if (!c1_immersiveProfileEl || !c1_immersiveActive) return;
        const tips = c1_normalizeImmersiveTips(SysConfig.immersiveTips);
        const icons = ['*', '+', '>', '#', '^'];
        const bubble = c1_immersiveProfileEl.querySelector('.tv-immersive-tip-bubble');
        const text = c1_immersiveProfileEl.querySelector('.tv-immersive-tip-text');
        const icon = c1_immersiveProfileEl.querySelector('.tv-immersive-tip-icon');
        const title = c1_immersiveProfileEl.querySelector('.tv-immersive-tip-title');
        if (text) text.textContent = tips[Math.floor(Math.random() * tips.length)];
        if (icon) icon.textContent = icons[Math.floor(Math.random() * icons.length)];
        if (title) title.textContent = SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Trading Tips' : '交易 Tips';
        if (bubble) {
            bubble.classList.remove('is-open');
            void bubble.offsetWidth;
            bubble.classList.add('is-open');
        }
        c1_immersiveProfileEl.classList.remove('is-tip-open');
        void c1_immersiveProfileEl.offsetWidth;
        c1_immersiveProfileEl.classList.add('is-tip-open');
        clearTimeout(c1_immersiveProfileEl._tipTimer);
        c1_immersiveProfileEl._tipTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            bubble?.classList.remove('is-open');
            c1_immersiveProfileEl?.classList.remove('is-tip-open');
        }, 3000);
    }

    function c1_updateImmersiveProfileCard() {
        const card = c1_ensureImmersiveProfileCard();
        const avatar = card.querySelector('.tv-immersive-profile-avatar img');
        const kicker = card.querySelector('.tv-immersive-profile-kicker');
        const name = card.querySelector('.tv-immersive-profile-name');
        if (avatar) avatar.src = SysConfig.avatar || defaultAvatar;
        if (kicker) kicker.textContent = c1_getImmersiveGreetingSafe();
        if (name) name.textContent = String(SysConfig.username || '').trim() || 'Trader';
        c1_applyImmersiveProfileScale(card);
        const hiddenByOverlay = c1_shouldHideImmersiveProfileCard();
        card.classList.toggle('is-active', !!c1_immersiveActive && !hiddenByOverlay);
        card.classList.toggle('is-panel-obscured', hiddenByOverlay);
    }

    function c1_scheduleImmersiveHudHide(delay = c1_normalizeImmersiveHudDynamicMs(SysConfig.immersiveHudDynamicMs)) {
        if (c1_immersiveHudHideTimer) clearTimeout(c1_immersiveHudHideTimer);
        c1_immersiveHudHideTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            c1_immersiveHudHideTimer = null;
            if (SysConfig.immersiveHudMode === 'dynamic') c1_immersiveHudEl?.classList.remove('is-active');
        }, Math.max(0, delay));
    }

    function c1_isPointerInImmersiveHudHotspot(event) {
        if (!event) return false;
        const hud = c1_immersiveHudEl;
        if (!hud) return event.clientX <= 240 && event.clientY <= 120;
        const now = performance.now();
        let rect = c1_immersiveHudRectCache.rect;
        if (!rect || now >= c1_immersiveHudRectCache.expires) {
            rect = hud.getBoundingClientRect?.();
            c1_immersiveHudRectCache = { rect: (rect && rect.width && rect.height) ? rect : null, expires: now + 500 };
            rect = c1_immersiveHudRectCache.rect;
        }
        if (!rect) return event.clientX <= 240 && event.clientY <= 120;
        return event.clientX >= Math.max(0, rect.left - 18)
            && event.clientY >= Math.max(0, rect.top - 18)
            && event.clientX <= rect.right + 22
            && event.clientY <= rect.bottom + 22;
    }

    function c1_handleImmersiveHudHotspotMove(event) {
        if (!c1_immersiveActive || SysConfig.immersiveHudMode !== 'dynamic') return;
        const now = Date.now();
        if (now - c1_immersiveHudHoverLastAt < 450) return;
        if (!c1_isPointerInImmersiveHudHotspot(event)) return;
        c1_immersiveHudHoverLastAt = now;
        c1_updateImmersiveChartHud(true);
    }

    function c1_updateImmersiveChartHud(forcePulse = false) {
        const hud = c1_ensureImmersiveChartHud();
        const parts = c1_getChartHudParts();
        const marketKind = c1_getImmersiveMarketKind(parts);
        const sessionState = c1_getTradingSessionState();
        hud.dataset.marketKind = marketKind;
        hud.dataset.session = sessionState.id;
        hud.style.setProperty('--tv-immersive-market-color', c1_getImmersiveMarketColor(marketKind));
        hud.style.setProperty('--tv-session-color', sessionState.color);
        c1_applyImmersiveHudScale(hud);
        c1_positionImmersiveChartHud(hud);
        const key = `${parts.exchange}|${parts.symbol}|${parts.interval}|${marketKind}|${sessionState.id}`;
        const changed = key !== c1_immersiveHudLastKey;
        const dynamicHud = SysConfig.immersiveHudMode === 'dynamic';
        const wasActive = hud.classList.contains('is-active');
        if (changed || forcePulse) {
            hud.querySelector('.tv-immersive-hud-symbol').textContent = parts.symbol;
            hud.querySelector('.tv-immersive-hud-exchange').textContent = parts.exchange;
            hud.querySelector('.tv-immersive-hud-tf').textContent = parts.interval;
            const sessionLabel = hud.querySelector('.tv-immersive-hud-session-label');
            if (sessionLabel) sessionLabel.textContent = sessionState.label;
            c1_immersiveHudLastKey = key;
            if (wasActive) {
                hud.classList.remove('is-updating');
                requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    if (!hud.isConnected || !hud.classList.contains('is-active')) return;
                    hud.classList.add('is-updating');
                    setTimeout(() => hud.classList.remove('is-updating'), 360);
                });
            }
        }
        if (c1_immersiveActive && (!dynamicHud || changed || forcePulse)) hud.classList.add('is-active');
        else if (!c1_immersiveActive) hud.classList.remove('is-active');
        if (c1_immersiveActive && dynamicHud && (changed || forcePulse)) c1_scheduleImmersiveHudHide(SysConfig.immersiveHudDynamicMs);
        if (!dynamicHud && c1_immersiveHudHideTimer) { clearTimeout(c1_immersiveHudHideTimer); c1_immersiveHudHideTimer = null; }
        try { c1_updateImmersiveProfileCard(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[TV-GCC] immersive profile disabled after error', e); }
    }

    function c1_rehomeImmersiveOverlays() {
        const root = getUIRoot();
        if (c1_immersiveHudEl && c1_immersiveHudEl.parentElement !== root) root.appendChild(c1_immersiveHudEl);
        if (c1_immersiveProfileEl && c1_immersiveProfileEl.parentElement !== root) root.appendChild(c1_immersiveProfileEl);
        if (BearPet.host && BearPet.host.parentElement !== root) root.appendChild(BearPet.host);
    }

    function c1_forceImmersiveOverlaysVisibleNow() {
        c1_bearAlertHiddenUntil = 0;
        document.documentElement.removeAttribute('data-tv-control-native-alert-active');
        if (c1_bearAlertRestoreTimer) { clearTimeout(c1_bearAlertRestoreTimer); c1_bearAlertRestoreTimer = null; }
        c1_ensureImmersiveChartHud();
        c1_ensureImmersiveProfileCard();
        if (SysConfig.bearPet?.enabled !== false && (!BearPet.host || !BearPet.host.isConnected || !BearPet.pet)) BearPet.init();
        c1_rehomeImmersiveOverlays();
        c1_immersiveHudEl?.classList.add('is-immersive-instant');
        c1_immersiveProfileEl?.classList.add('is-immersive-instant');
        BearPet.host?.classList.add('is-immersive-instant');
        c1_updateImmersiveChartHud(true);
        c1_updateImmersiveProfileCard();
        try { BearPet.applyImmersiveVisibility(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[TV-GCC] bear immersive sync failed', e); }
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            c1_immersiveHudEl?.classList.remove('is-immersive-instant');
            c1_immersiveProfileEl?.classList.remove('is-immersive-instant');
            BearPet.host?.classList.remove('is-immersive-instant');
        });
    }

    function c1_warmImmersiveOverlays() {
        c1_preloadImmersiveAssets();
        c1_ensureImmersiveChartHud();
        c1_ensureImmersiveProfileCard();
        c1_updateImmersiveChartHud(true);
        c1_updateImmersiveProfileCard();
        c1_immersiveHudEl?.classList.remove('is-active', 'is-updating', 'is-immersive-instant');
        if (c1_immersiveProfileEl) {
            c1_immersiveProfileEl.classList.remove('is-active', 'is-tip-open', 'is-immersive-instant');
            c1_immersiveProfileEl.querySelector('.tv-immersive-tip-bubble')?.classList.remove('is-open');
        }
        if (SysConfig.bearPet?.enabled !== false) {
            if (!BearPet.host || !BearPet.host.isConnected || !BearPet.pet) BearPet.init();
            else BearPet.applyConfig();
        }
    }

    function c1_startImmersiveChartHud() {
        c1_forceImmersiveOverlaysVisibleNow();
        [0, 16, 40, 160, 420, 900].forEach(delay => setTimeout(() => {
            if (c1_immersiveActive) c1_forceImmersiveOverlaysVisibleNow();
        }, delay));
        if (c1_immersiveHudTimer) clearInterval(c1_immersiveHudTimer);
        c1_immersiveHudTimer = setInterval(() => {
            if (!c1_immersiveActive) {
                c1_stopImmersiveChartHud();
                return;
            }
            c1_updateImmersiveChartHud(false);
        }, 1000);
        window.addEventListener('mousemove', c1_handleImmersiveHudHotspotMove, { passive: true });
        try { BearPet.applyImmersiveVisibility(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[TV-GCC] bear immersive sync failed', e); }
    }

    function c1_stopImmersiveChartHud() {
        c1_clearImmersiveOrderArm();
        if (c1_immersiveHudTimer) clearInterval(c1_immersiveHudTimer);
        c1_immersiveHudTimer = null;
        window.removeEventListener('mousemove', c1_handleImmersiveHudHotspotMove, { passive: true });
        if (c1_immersiveHudHideTimer) clearTimeout(c1_immersiveHudHideTimer);
        c1_immersiveHudHideTimer = null;
        if (c1_immersiveHudEl) c1_immersiveHudEl.classList.remove('is-active', 'is-updating');
        if (c1_immersiveProfileEl) {
            c1_immersiveProfileEl.classList.remove('is-active', 'is-tip-open');
            c1_immersiveProfileEl.querySelector('.tv-immersive-tip-bubble')?.classList.remove('is-open');
        }
        try { BearPet.applyImmersiveVisibility(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[TV-GCC] bear immersive sync failed', e); }
    }

    function c1_getImmersiveModeButton() {
        const button = c1_queryFirstVisible(C1_TV_RUNTIME_SELECTORS.fullscreenButton, document, false);
        return button?.closest?.('button') || button || null;
    }

    function c1_scheduleNativeImmersiveToastScan() {
        if (SysConfig.suppressNativeImmersiveToast === false) return;
        if (c1_nativeImmersiveToastScanTimer) return;
        c1_nativeImmersiveToastScanTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            c1_nativeImmersiveToastScanTimer = null;
            c1_suppressTradingViewImmersiveHint(document);
        }, 120);
    }

    function c1_isNativeImmersiveToastText(text) {
        const value = c1_normalizeDomText(text);
        if (!value) return false;
        if (value.length > 90) return false;
        if (/面板隐藏|按\s*ESC\s*键显示面板|panel.*hidden|show.*panel/i.test(value)) return true;
        return /面板隐藏|按ESC键显示面板|panels?\s+hidden|press\s+esc.*panels?/i.test(value);
    }

    function c1_hideNativeImmersiveToastElement(el) {
        if (!el || !(el instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
        let target = el;
        let cursor = el;
        let hops = 0;
        while (cursor && cursor !== document.body && hops < 5) {
            const rect = cursor.getBoundingClientRect();
            const style = getComputedStyle(cursor);
            if ((style.position === 'fixed' || style.position === 'absolute') && rect.width <= 620 && rect.height <= 140) {
                target = cursor;
                break;
            }
            cursor = cursor.parentElement;
            hops++;
        }
        target.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
        target.setAttribute('data-tv-control-hidden-native-toast', '1');
    }

    function c1_isNativeAlertToastText(text) {
        const value = c1_normalizeDomText(text);
        if (!value || value.length > 220) return false;
        return /编辑警报|Edit alert|警报|Alert/i.test(value) && /\d{1,2}:\d{2}:\d{2}|通过|Crossing|Greater|Less|SOLUSDT|BTCUSDT|ETHUSDT|XAUUSD|EURUSD|GBPUSD/i.test(value);
    }

    function c1_findNativeToastHost(el) {
        let host = el;
        let cursor = el;
        let hops = 0;
        while (cursor && cursor !== document.body && hops < 6) {
            const rect = cursor.getBoundingClientRect?.();
            const style = getComputedStyle(cursor);
            const compact = rect && rect.width >= 160 && rect.width <= 620 && rect.height >= 44 && rect.height <= 220;
            const floating = style.position === 'fixed' || style.position === 'absolute' || rect?.bottom > window.innerHeight - 260;
            if (compact && floating) {
                host = cursor;
                if (style.position === 'fixed' || style.position === 'absolute') break;
            }
            cursor = cursor.parentElement;
            hops++;
        }
        return host;
    }

    function c1_detectNativeAlertToasts(root = document) {
        if (!c1_immersiveActive) return;
        const scanRoot = root && root.querySelectorAll ? root : document;
        const nodes = [];
        if (scanRoot instanceof HTMLElement) nodes.push(scanRoot);
        try { nodes.push(...Array.from(scanRoot.querySelectorAll('div, span, [role="status"], [role="alert"]'))); } catch (e) {}
        const seen = new Set();
        nodes.forEach((el) => {
            if (!el || seen.has(el) || el.closest?.('#tv-custom-sidebar-right, #tv-custom-sidebar, .tv-side-panel, #tv-settings-panel, #tv-tradegate-window, #tv-immersive-profile-card')) return;
            const text = el.innerText || el.textContent || '';
            if (!c1_isNativeAlertToastText(text)) return;
            const host = c1_findNativeToastHost(el);
            if (!host || seen.has(host) || host === document.body || host === document.documentElement) return;
            seen.add(host);
            const rect = host.getBoundingClientRect?.();
            if (!rect || rect.bottom < window.innerHeight - 320 || rect.left > 520) return;
            host.removeAttribute('data-tv-control-alert-relocated');
            c1_markNativeAlertActive();
        });
    }

    function c1_shouldWatchNativeAlertsForBear() {
        return SysConfig?.bearPet?.enabled === true;
    }

    function c1_scanNativeAlertsForBear(root = document) {
        if (!c1_shouldWatchNativeAlertsForBear()) return false;
        const scanRoot = root && root.querySelectorAll ? root : document;
        const nodes = [];
        if (scanRoot instanceof HTMLElement) nodes.push(scanRoot);
        try { nodes.push(...Array.from(scanRoot.querySelectorAll('div, span, [role="status"], [role="alert"]'))); } catch (e) {}
        for (const el of nodes) {
            if (!el || el.closest?.('#tv-custom-sidebar-right, #tv-custom-sidebar, .tv-side-panel, #tv-settings-panel, #tv-tradegate-window, #tv-immersive-profile-card, #tv-work-journey-bear-host')) continue;
            const text = el.innerText || el.textContent || '';
            if (!c1_isNativeAlertToastText(text)) continue;
            const host = c1_findNativeToastHost(el);
            const rect = host?.getBoundingClientRect?.();
            if (!rect || rect.width < 160 || rect.height < 44) continue;
            if (rect.bottom < window.innerHeight - 340 || rect.left > window.innerWidth - 260) continue;
            c1_markNativeAlertActive();
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    function c1_scheduleNativeAlertBearScan(root = document) {
        if (!c1_shouldWatchNativeAlertsForBear()) {
            c1_stopNativeAlertBearWatcher();
            return;
        }
        const scanRoot = root && root.querySelectorAll
            ? root
            : (root?.parentElement && root.parentElement.querySelectorAll ? root.parentElement : null);
        if (scanRoot) c1_nativeAlertPendingRoots.add(scanRoot);
        if (c1_nativeAlertScanTimer) return;
        c1_nativeAlertScanTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            c1_nativeAlertScanTimer = null;
            if (!c1_shouldWatchNativeAlertsForBear()) {
                c1_stopNativeAlertBearWatcher();
                return;
            }
            const roots = [...c1_nativeAlertPendingRoots];
            c1_nativeAlertPendingRoots.clear();
            for (const pendingRoot of roots) {
                if ((pendingRoot === document || pendingRoot?.isConnected) && c1_scanNativeAlertsForBear(pendingRoot)) break;
            }
        }, 60);
    }

    function c1_startNativeAlertBearWatcher() {
        if (!c1_shouldWatchNativeAlertsForBear()) {
            c1_stopNativeAlertBearWatcher();
            return;
        }
        if (c1_nativeAlertObserver) return;
        c1_scanNativeAlertsForBear(document);
        c1_nativeAlertObserver = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
            mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
                if (mutation.type !== 'childList') return;
                mutation.addedNodes.forEach((node) => {
                    const root = node instanceof HTMLElement ? node : node.parentElement;
                    if (root) c1_scheduleNativeAlertBearScan(root);
                });
            });
        });
        c1_nativeAlertObserver.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }

    function c1_stopNativeAlertBearWatcher() {
        if (c1_nativeAlertObserver) {
            c1_nativeAlertObserver.disconnect();
            c1_nativeAlertObserver = null;
        }
        if (c1_nativeAlertScanTimer) {
            clearTimeout(c1_nativeAlertScanTimer);
            c1_nativeAlertScanTimer = null;
        }
        c1_nativeAlertPendingRoots.clear();
    }

    function c1_hideNativeImmersiveToasts(root = document) {
        if (SysConfig.suppressNativeImmersiveToast === false) return;
        const scanRoot = root && root.querySelectorAll ? root : document;
        const candidates = [];
        if (scanRoot instanceof HTMLElement) candidates.push(scanRoot);
        try { candidates.push(...Array.from(scanRoot.querySelectorAll('div, span, [role="status"], [role="alert"]'))); } catch (e) {}
        candidates.forEach(el => {
            if (!el || el.getAttribute?.('data-tv-control-hidden-native-toast') === '1') return;
            if (c1_isNativeImmersiveToastText(el.innerText || el.textContent)) c1_hideNativeImmersiveToastElement(el);
        });
    }

    function c1_suppressTradingViewImmersiveHint(root = document) {
        if (!c1_immersiveActive) return;
        if (SysConfig.suppressNativeImmersiveToast === false) return;
        c1_hideNativeImmersiveToasts(root);
        c1_detectNativeAlertToasts(root);
        const scanRoot = root && root.querySelectorAll ? root : document;
        const queryWithin = (selector) => {
            const nodes = [];
            if (scanRoot instanceof HTMLElement) {
                try { if (scanRoot.matches?.(selector)) nodes.push(scanRoot); } catch (e) {}
            }
            try { nodes.push(...Array.from(scanRoot.querySelectorAll(selector))); } catch (e) {}
            return nodes;
        };

        const hintPattern = /面板隐藏|按\s*ESC\s*键显示面板|Press ESC|panel.*hidden|show.*panel/i;
        const zoomPattern = /缩小|放大|重置|Zoom\s*out|Zoom\s*in|Reset/i;
        const isVisibleCompact = (el) => {
            if (!el || !el.isConnected) return false;
            const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
            const style = unsafeWindow.getComputedStyle ? unsafeWindow.getComputedStyle(el) : window.getComputedStyle(el);
            return rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0 && rect.width < 620 && rect.height < 180 && style.display !== 'none' && style.visibility !== 'hidden';
        };
        const findFloatingHost = (el) => {
            let host = el;
            while (host?.parentElement && host.parentElement !== document.body && host.parentElement !== document.documentElement) {
                const parent = host.parentElement;
                const rect = parent.getBoundingClientRect();
                const style = unsafeWindow.getComputedStyle ? unsafeWindow.getComputedStyle(parent) : window.getComputedStyle(parent);
                const text = String(parent.innerText || parent.textContent || '').trim();
                const compact = rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0 && rect.width < 620 && rect.height < 180;
                const floating = style.position === 'fixed' || style.position === 'absolute' || rect.top < 180 || rect.bottom > window.innerHeight - 180;
                if (!compact || !floating || (!hintPattern.test(text) && !zoomPattern.test(text))) break;
                host = parent;
            }
            return host;
        };

        queryWithin('div, span')
            .filter((el) => {
                const text = String(el.innerText || el.textContent || '').trim();
                if (!text || !hintPattern.test(text)) return false;
                const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                return rect.width > 120 && rect.width < 620 && rect.height > 24 && rect.height < 120;
            })
            .forEach((el) => {
                const host = el.closest('[role="status"], [class*="toast"], [class*="notification"], [class*="hint"], [class*="tooltip"]') || el;
                if (host && host !== document.body && host !== document.documentElement) host.remove();
            });

        queryWithin('div, span, button, [role="button"]')
            .filter(isVisibleCompact)
            .filter((el) => {
                const text = String(el.innerText || el.textContent || el.getAttribute?.('aria-label') || el.getAttribute?.('title') || '').trim();
                if (!zoomPattern.test(text)) return false;
                const host = findFloatingHost(el);
                const hostText = String(host.innerText || host.textContent || '').trim();
                const hostButtons = host.querySelectorAll('button, [role="button"]').length;
                return hostButtons >= 3 || /Ctrl|⌘|\+|-|←|→|↑|↓/.test(hostText);
            })
            .forEach((el) => {
                const host = findFloatingHost(el);
                if (host && host !== document.body && host !== document.documentElement) host.remove();
            });
    }

    function c1_startNativeImmersiveToastSuppressor() {
        if (!c1_immersiveActive || SysConfig.suppressNativeImmersiveToast === false || c1_nativeImmersiveToastObserver) return;
        c1_suppressTradingViewImmersiveHint(document);
        c1_nativeImmersiveToastObserver = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
            if (SysConfig.suppressNativeImmersiveToast === false) return;
            for (const mutation of mutations) {
                if (mutation.type !== 'childList') continue;
                mutation.addedNodes.forEach(node => {
                    if (node instanceof HTMLElement) c1_suppressTradingViewImmersiveHint(node);
                });
            }
        });
        c1_nativeImmersiveToastObserver.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }

    function c1_stopNativeImmersiveToastSuppressor() {
        if (c1_nativeImmersiveToastObserver) c1_nativeImmersiveToastObserver.disconnect();
        c1_nativeImmersiveToastObserver = null;
        if (c1_nativeImmersiveToastScanTimer) clearTimeout(c1_nativeImmersiveToastScanTimer);
        c1_nativeImmersiveToastScanTimer = null;
    }

    function c1_applyImmersiveRuntimeState(active, options = {}) {
        const targetActive = !!active;
        c1_immersiveActive = targetActive;
        c1_updateSidebarVisibility();
        if (targetActive) {
            if (options.clearIntent !== false) c1_immersiveReturnIntent = null;
            if (SysConfig.hideNotificationsInImmersive !== false) SharedTV.removeNotification();
            c1_forceImmersiveOverlaysVisibleNow();
            c1_startImmersiveChartHud();
            c1_startNativeImmersiveToastSuppressor();
        } else {
            c1_stopImmersiveChartHud();
            c1_stopNativeImmersiveToastSuppressor();
        }
        try { BearPet.applyImmersiveVisibility(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[TV-GCC] bear immersive sync failed', e); }
    }

    function c1_scheduleImmersiveRuntimeReconcile(generation = c1_immersiveGeneration) {
        [80, 180, 360, 720].forEach((delay) => {
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (generation !== c1_immersiveGeneration) return;
                if (c1_immersiveDesiredActive !== c1_immersiveActive) c1_applyImmersiveRuntimeState(c1_immersiveDesiredActive, { clearIntent: false });
                else if (c1_immersiveDesiredActive) c1_forceImmersiveOverlaysVisibleNow();
            }, delay);
        });
    }

    function c1_clearPendingImmersiveEnter() {
        if (c1_pendingImmersiveTimer) clearTimeout(c1_pendingImmersiveTimer);
        c1_pendingImmersiveTimer = null;
        c1_pendingImmersiveEnter = null;
    }

    function c1_queueImmersiveEnter(options = {}) {
        if (c1_pendingImmersiveEnter) return true;
        c1_immersiveDesiredActive = true;
        const generation = ++c1_immersiveGeneration;
        c1_pendingImmersiveEnter = { attempts: 0, options: { ...options } };
        const tryEnter = () => {
            if (!c1_pendingImmersiveEnter || generation !== c1_immersiveGeneration) return;
            if (c1_immersiveActive) { c1_clearPendingImmersiveEnter(); return; }
            c1_pendingImmersiveEnter.attempts += 1;
            if (c1_isChartReadyForImmersive()) {
                const pendingOptions = c1_pendingImmersiveEnter.options || {};
                c1_clearPendingImmersiveEnter();
                c1_setImmersiveMode(true, { ...pendingOptions, force: true });
                return;
            }
            if (c1_pendingImmersiveEnter.attempts >= 80) {
                c1_immersiveDesiredActive = false;
                c1_clearPendingImmersiveEnter();
                if (!options.silent) SharedTV.showToast(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Chart is still loading, immersive mode was not started' : '图表仍在加载，已取消进入沉浸模式', true);
                return;
            }
            c1_pendingImmersiveTimer = setTimeout(tryEnter, 250);
        };
        c1_pendingImmersiveTimer = setTimeout(tryEnter, 80);
        if (!options.silent) SharedTV.showToast(SysConfig.lang === 'en' ? 'Waiting for chart to finish loading...' : '等待图表加载完成后进入沉浸...');
        return true;
    }

    function c1_setImmersiveMode(active, options = {}) {
        const targetActive = !!active;
        if (targetActive && SysConfig.immersiveEnabled === false) return false;
        if (c1_immersiveActive === targetActive) {
            c1_updateSidebarVisibility();
            if (!options.silent) SharedTV.showToast(`${c1_getImmersiveModeLabel()}${targetActive ? t('tOpened') : t('tClosed')}`);
            return true;
        }

        if (targetActive && !options.force && !c1_isChartReadyForImmersive()) return c1_queueImmersiveEnter(options);
        if (!targetActive) {
            c1_immersiveDesiredActive = false;
            c1_clearPendingImmersiveEnter();
        }

        c1_immersiveInternalToggleUntil = Date.now() + 800;
        const usedWidgetApi = c1_setWidgetFullscreenMode(targetActive);
        const button = usedWidgetApi ? null : c1_getImmersiveModeButton();
        if (!usedWidgetApi && !button) {
            c1_immersiveDesiredActive = false;
            c1_applyImmersiveRuntimeState(false, { clearIntent: false });
            if (!options.silent) SharedTV.showToast(`${t('tNotFound')}${c1_getImmersiveModeLabel()}${t('tNotFoundSuffix')}`, true);
            return false;
        }

        const generation = ++c1_immersiveGeneration;
        c1_immersiveDesiredActive = targetActive;
        if (!usedWidgetApi) SharedTV.simulateClick(button);
        c1_applyImmersiveRuntimeState(targetActive);
        c1_scheduleImmersiveRuntimeReconcile(generation);
        [80, 220, 520].forEach(delay => setTimeout(() => c1_suppressTradingViewImmersiveHint(document), delay));
        if (!options.silent) SharedTV.showToast(`${c1_getImmersiveModeLabel()}${targetActive ? t('tOpened') : t('tClosed')}`);
        return true;
    }

    function c1_enterImmersiveMode(reason = 'manual') {
        return c1_setImmersiveMode(true, { silent: reason === 'auto' });
    }

    function c1_exitImmersiveMode(options = {}) {
        const exited = c1_setImmersiveMode(false, { silent: !!options.silent || !!options.remember });
        if (exited) c1_immersiveReturnIntent = options.remember ? { id: options.id || 'manual-panel' } : null;
        return exited;
    }

    function c1_toggleImmersiveModeByHotkey() {
        if (SysConfig.immersiveEnabled === false) return false;
        if (c1_immersiveActive) return c1_exitImmersiveMode({ remember: false });
        return c1_enterImmersiveMode(c1_immersiveReturnIntent ? 'resume' : 'manual');
    }

    function c1_requestImmersiveExitForPanelOpen(id = 'manual-panel') {
        if (!c1_immersiveActive) return false;
        return c1_exitImmersiveMode({ remember: true, id, silent: true });
    }

    function c1_isNativePanelOpenTarget(target) {
        if (!(target instanceof HTMLElement)) return false;
        try {
            return !!target.closest([
                'button[data-name="base"]',
                'button[data-name="alerts"]',
                'button[data-name="object_tree"]',
                'button[aria-label*="Open account manager"]',
                'button[aria-label*="account manager" i]',
                '[data-name="toggle-visibility-button"]'
            ].join(','));
        } catch (e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    function c1_bindImmersivePanelIntentWatcher() {
        document.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
            if (!c1_immersiveActive) return;
            if (c1_isNativePanelOpenTarget(event.target)) c1_requestImmersiveExitForPanelOpen();
        }, true);
    }

    function c1_scheduleImmersiveAutoStart() {
        if (SysConfig.immersiveEnabled === false || !SysConfig.immersiveAutoStart) return;
        let attempts = 0;
        const tryEnter = () => {
            if (document.visibilityState !== 'visible') return;
            if (SysConfig.immersiveEnabled === false || !SysConfig.immersiveAutoStart || c1_immersiveActive) return;
            if (document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel') || document.getElementById('tv-first-time-modal')) return;
            attempts++;
            if (!c1_isChartReadyForImmersive()) {
                if (attempts < 30) setTimeout(tryEnter, 500);
                return;
            }
            c1_setImmersiveMode(true, { silent: true, force: true });
        };
        setTimeout(tryEnter, 900);
    }

    function c1_getPanelToggleStateForTool(id, conf) {
        const target = id === 'tradingPanel' ? c1_queryFirstVisible(C1_TV_RUNTIME_SELECTORS.accountButton, document, false) : c1_resolveNativeToolTarget(id, conf);
        return target ? c1_readToggleState(target) : null;
    }

    function c1_scoreBrokerSelectionDialog(dialog) {
        if (!dialog || !c1_isVisibleNode(dialog)) return 0;
        if (dialog.closest?.('#tv-settings-panel, #tv-custom-sidebar, #tv-custom-sidebar-right, .tv-side-panel, #tv-tradegate-window, #panel-risk, #panel-macro')) return 0;
        const rect = dialog.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (rect.width < 420 || rect.height < 260) return 0;
        const text = c1_normalizeDomText(dialog.innerText || dialog.textContent);
        if (!text) return 0;
        let score = 0;
        if (/\u4f7f\u7528.{0,12}\u7ecf\u7eaa\u5546.{0,8}\u4ea4\u6613|trade\s+with\s+your\s+broker|select\s+(a\s+)?broker/i.test(text)) score += 80;
        if (/\u9700\u8981\u7ecf\u7eaa\u5546|need\s+a\s+broker|broker/i.test(text)) score += 24;
        if (/Paper\s*Trading|Capital\.com|Bitget|Binance|OKX|Pepperstone|Interactive\s*Brokers|Bybit|easyMarkets|Trade\s*Nation|IC\s*Markets|AMP|Fusion\s*Markets|ActivTrades|Tickmill|Eightcap/i.test(text)) score += 36;
        const centerDx = Math.abs((rect.left + rect.width / 2) - window.innerWidth / 2);
        const centerDy = Math.abs((rect.top + rect.height / 2) - window.innerHeight / 2);
        if (centerDx < window.innerWidth * 0.18 && centerDy < window.innerHeight * 0.22) score += 18;
        return score;
    }

    function c1_findBrokerSelectionDialog() {
        const selectors = C1_TV_RUNTIME_SELECTORS.dialogRoots.concat([
            '[data-name*="broker" i]',
            '[data-dialog-name*="broker" i]',
            'div[class*="broker" i]'
        ]);
        const candidates = Array.from(new Set(selectors.flatMap((selector) => {
            try { return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(selector)); } catch (e) { return []; }
        })));
        let best = null;
        let bestScore = 0;
        candidates.forEach((candidate) => {
            const score = c1_scoreBrokerSelectionDialog(candidate);
            if (score > bestScore) {
                best = candidate;
                bestScore = score;
            }
        });
        return bestScore >= 90 ? best : null;
    }

    function c1_findDialogCloseButton(dialog) {
        if (!dialog) return null;
        const dialogRect = dialog.getBoundingClientRect();
        const controls = Array.from(dialog.querySelectorAll('button, [role="button"], [aria-label], [title], [data-name], [data-tooltip], [data-tooltip-text]'))
            .map(el => el.closest?.('button') || el)
            .filter((el, idx, arr) => el && arr.indexOf(el) === idx && c1_isVisibleNode(el));
        let best = null;
        let bestScore = 0;
        controls.forEach((control) => {
            const rect = control.getBoundingClientRect();
            const label = c1_readElementLabel(control);
            let score = 0;
            if (/\u5173\u95ed|close|dismiss/i.test(label)) score += 90;
            if (/^\s*(?:\u00d7|x)\s*$/i.test(control.textContent || '')) score += 36;
            if (rect.width <= 64 && rect.height <= 64) score += 12;
            if (rect.top <= dialogRect.top + 84 && rect.right >= dialogRect.right - 120) score += 36;
            if (score > bestScore) {
                best = control;
                bestScore = score;
            }
        });
        return bestScore >= 48 ? best : null;
    }

    function c1_closeBrokerSelectionDialog() {
        const dialog = c1_findBrokerSelectionDialog();
        if (!dialog) return false;
        const closeButton = c1_findDialogCloseButton(dialog);
        if (closeButton) {
            c1_clickNativeButton(closeButton);
            return true;
        }
        if (c1_closeNativePopupsAndDialogs()) return true;
        ['keydown', 'keyup'].forEach((type) => {
            try {
                document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(type, { key: 'Escape', code: 'Escape', bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
            } catch (e) {}
        });
        return true;
    }

    function c1_isImmersiveReturnTool(id, conf) {
        if (!conf) return false;
        return conf.type === 'panel' || ['tradingPanel', 'watchlist', 'alerts', 'objTree'].includes(id);
    }

    function c1_scheduleImmersiveRestoreAfterPanelClose(id, conf) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (id === 'tradingPanel' && c1_findBrokerSelectionDialog()) {
                c1_immersiveReturnIntent = { id };
                return;
            }
            const panelStillOpen = id === 'tradingPanel' ? false : c1_getPanelToggleStateForTool(id, conf) === true;
            if (panelStillOpen) {
                c1_immersiveReturnIntent = { id };
                return;
            }
            c1_immersiveReturnIntent = null;
            c1_setImmersiveMode(true, { silent: true });
        }, 260);
    }

    function c1_runWithCursorPrep(runAction) {
        const cursorDelay = c1_prepareCursorForUiSwitch();
        if (cursorDelay > 0) setTimeout(() => { runAction(); }, cursorDelay);
        else runAction();
    }

    function c1_handleImmersivePanelMemory(id, conf, runAction) {
        if (!c1_isImmersiveReturnTool(id, conf)) return false;

        if (c1_immersiveActive) {
            const wasOpen = c1_getPanelToggleStateForTool(id, conf) === true;
            const exited = c1_setImmersiveMode(false, { silent: true });
            if (!exited) return false;
            c1_immersiveReturnIntent = wasOpen ? null : { id };
            setTimeout(() => { c1_runWithCursorPrep(runAction); }, 180);
            return true;
        }

        if (!c1_immersiveReturnIntent) return false;

        const sameIntent = c1_immersiveReturnIntent.id === id;
        const wasOpen = c1_getPanelToggleStateForTool(id, conf) === true;
        c1_runWithCursorPrep(runAction);
        if (sameIntent || wasOpen) c1_scheduleImmersiveRestoreAfterPanelClose(id, conf);
        else c1_immersiveReturnIntent = { id };
        return true;
    }

    function c1_executeTradingPanelBinding(toolName) {
        const shouldRestoreImmersive = !!c1_immersiveReturnIntent && c1_immersiveReturnIntent.id === 'tradingPanel';
        if (c1_immersiveActive) c1_requestImmersiveExitForPanelOpen('tradingPanel');
        if (c1_closeBrokerSelectionDialog()) {
            c1_scheduleRiskRefresh();
            SharedTV.showToast(toolName + t('tClosed'));
            if (shouldRestoreImmersive) {
                c1_immersiveReturnIntent = null;
                setTimeout(() => c1_setImmersiveMode(true, { silent: true }), 220);
            }
            return true;
        }
        let bottomBtn = c1_queryFirstVisible(C1_TV_RUNTIME_SELECTORS.accountButton);
        if (bottomBtn) {
            SharedTV.simulateClick(bottomBtn);
            if (shouldRestoreImmersive) c1_immersiveReturnIntent = { id: 'tradingPanel' };
            c1_scheduleRiskRefresh();
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (c1_findBrokerSelectionDialog()) c1_immersiveReturnIntent = { id: 'tradingPanel' };
                const toggleState = c1_readToggleState(bottomBtn);
                const collapsed = c1_isTradingPanelCollapsed();
                const nowActive = toggleState !== null ? toggleState : (collapsed === null ? true : !collapsed);
                SharedTV.showToast(toolName + (nowActive ? t('tOpened') : t('tClosed')));
            }, 120);
            return true;
        }
        const topContainer = document.getElementById('header-toolbar-trade-desktop');
        const topBtn = topContainer ? topContainer.querySelector('button') : null;
        if (topBtn) {
            SharedTV.simulateClick(topBtn);
            c1_scheduleRiskRefresh();
            SharedTV.showToast(toolName + t('tExecuted'));
            return true;
        }
        SharedTV.showToast(t('tNotFound') + toolName + t('tNotFoundSuffix'), true);
        return true;
    }

    function c1_clickNativeButton(target, opts = {}) {
        if (!target) return false;
        if (!opts.light) {
            try { target.focus({ preventScroll: true }); } catch (e) {}
        }
        try {
            if (typeof target.click === 'function') target.click();
            else target.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, view: unsafeWindow, button: 0 }));
            return true;
        } catch (e) {
            C1_LOG.warn('native.buttonClick', e);
            return false;
        }
    }

    function c1_findSelectedObjectAlertButton() {
        const candidates = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, [role="button"], [aria-label*="添加警报"], [aria-label*="Add alert" i], [title*="添加警报"], [title*="Add alert" i], [data-tooltip*="添加警报"], [data-tooltip*="Add alert" i], [data-tooltip-text*="添加警报"], [data-tooltip-text*="Add alert" i]'))
            .map(el => el.closest?.('button') || el)
            .filter((el, idx, arr) => el && arr.indexOf(el) === idx)
            .filter(c1_isVisibleNode)
            .map((el) => {
                const label = c1_readElementLabel(el);
                if (!/(添加|新增|建立).{0,4}警报|add\s*alert/i.test(label)) return null;
                const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                const style = unsafeWindow.getComputedStyle ? unsafeWindow.getComputedStyle(el) : window.getComputedStyle(el);
                let score = 100;
                if (/添加警报|add\s*alert/i.test(label)) score += 60;
                if (style.position === 'fixed' || style.position === 'absolute') score += 20;
                if (rect.top > 36 && rect.top < window.innerHeight * 0.5) score += 18;
                if (rect.left > 80 && rect.right < window.innerWidth - 80) score += 12;
                if (rect.width <= 64 && rect.height <= 64) score += 10;
                return { el, score };
            })
            .filter(Boolean)
            .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
        return candidates[0]?.el || null;
    }

    function c1_clickCreateAlertToolbarButton(conf, visibleOnly = true) {
        if (visibleOnly) {
            const objectAlertButton = c1_findSelectedObjectAlertButton();
            if (objectAlertButton) return c1_clickNativeButton(objectAlertButton);
        }
        const targetElement = c1_resolveNativeToolTarget('createAlert', conf, visibleOnly);
        if (!targetElement) return false;
        return c1_clickNativeButton(targetElement);
    }

    function c1_rankVisibilityButtons(elements = [], { allowLeftToolbar = false } = {}) {
        const candidates = Array.from(new Set(elements))
            .map(el => el.closest?.('button') || el)
            .filter((el, idx, arr) => el && arr.indexOf(el) === idx)
            .filter(c1_isVisibleNode)
            .map((el) => {
                const label = c1_readElementLabel(el);
                const normalized = c1_normalizeDomText(label);
                if (!/隐藏|显示|hide|show/i.test(normalized)) return null;
                if (/面板|图例|周期|收藏|更多|展开|panel|legend|interval|favorite|more|expand/i.test(normalized)) return null;
                const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                const style = unsafeWindow.getComputedStyle ? unsafeWindow.getComputedStyle(el) : window.getComputedStyle(el);
                let score = 0;
                if (/^(隐藏|显示|hide|show)$/i.test(normalized)) score += 110;
                if (/对象|绘图|选中|drawing|object|selection|selected/i.test(normalized)) score += 40;
                if (/隐藏所有|显示所有|hide\s*all|show\s*all/i.test(normalized)) score += 10;
                if (style.position === 'fixed' || style.position === 'absolute') score += 18;
                if (rect.top > 36 && rect.top < window.innerHeight * 0.48) score += 30;
                if (rect.left > 80 && rect.right < window.innerWidth - 80) score += 30;
                if (rect.width <= 68 && rect.height <= 68) score += 14;
                if (!allowLeftToolbar && rect.left <= 70) score -= 80;
                return score >= 80 ? { el, score } : null;
            })
            .filter(Boolean)
            .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
        return candidates[0]?.el || null;
    }

    function c1_findSelectedObjectVisibilityButton() {
        const directSelectors = [
            'button[aria-label="隐藏"]',
            'button[aria-label="显示"]',
            'button[title="隐藏"]',
            'button[title="显示"]',
            '[role="button"][aria-label="隐藏"]',
            '[role="button"][aria-label="显示"]',
            '[role="button"][title="隐藏"]',
            '[role="button"][title="显示"]',
            'button[aria-label*="Hide" i]',
            'button[aria-label*="Show" i]',
            'button[title*="Hide" i]',
            'button[title*="Show" i]',
            '[data-tooltip-text*="隐藏"]',
            '[data-tooltip-text*="显示"]',
            '[data-tooltip-text*="Hide" i]',
            '[data-tooltip-text*="Show" i]'
        ];
        const direct = directSelectors.flatMap((selector) => {
            try { return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(selector)); } catch (e) { return []; }
        });
        return c1_rankVisibilityButtons(direct) || c1_rankVisibilityButtons(
            Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, [role="button"], [aria-label], [title], [data-tooltip], [data-tooltip-text]'))
        );
    }

    function c1_executeHideAllBinding(conf, toolName) {
        const apiResult = c1_setWidgetWatchedBoolean('hideAllDrawingTools');
        if (apiResult) {
            SharedTV.showToast(`${toolName}${apiResult.target ? t('tOpened') : t('tClosed')}`);
            return true;
        }

        const objectVisibilityButton = c1_findSelectedObjectVisibilityButton();
        if (objectVisibilityButton) {
            c1_clickNativeButton(objectVisibilityButton);
            SharedTV.showToast(`${toolName}${t('tExecuted')}`);
            return true;
        }

        const targetElement = c1_resolveNativeToolTarget('hideAll', conf, true) || c1_resolveNativeToolTarget('hideAll', conf, false);
        if (targetElement) {
            c1_clickNativeButton(targetElement);
            SharedTV.showToast(`${toolName}${t('tExecuted')}`);
            return true;
        }

        SharedTV.showToast(`${t('tNotFound')}${toolName}${t('tNotFoundSuffix')}`, true);
        return true;
    }

    function c1_executeMagnetBinding(conf, toolName) {
        const apiResult = c1_setWidgetWatchedBoolean('magnetEnabled');
        if (apiResult) {
            SharedTV.showToast(`${toolName}${apiResult.target ? t('tOpened') : t('tClosed')}`);
            return true;
        }
        return c1_executeNativeToolBindingCore('magnet', conf, toolName);
    }

    function c1_executeReplayBinding(conf, toolName) {
        c1_markReplayTransition();
        const targetElement = c1_resolveNativeToolTarget('replay', conf, true) || c1_resolveNativeToolTarget('replay', conf, false);
        if (targetElement) {
            c1_clickNativeButton(targetElement, { light: true });
            SharedTV.showToast(`${toolName}${t('tExecuted')}`);
            return true;
        }

        SharedTV.showToast(`${t('tNotFound')}${toolName}${t('tNotFoundSuffix')}`, true);
        return true;
    }

    function c1_executeCreateAlertBinding(conf, toolName) {
        if (c1_clickCreateAlertToolbarButton(conf, true)) {
            SharedTV.showToast(`${toolName}${t('tExecuted')}`);
            return true;
        }

        if (c1_clickCreateAlertToolbarButton(conf, false)) {
            SharedTV.showToast(`${toolName}${t('tExecuted')}`);
            return true;
        }

        c1_dispatchNativeAltA();
        SharedTV.showToast(`${toolName}${t('tExecuted')}`);
        return true;
    }

    function c1_resolveNativeToolTarget(id, conf, visibleOnly = true) {
        if (!conf?.selector) return null;
        let targetElement = c1_queryFirstVisible(conf.selector, document, visibleOnly);
        if (!targetElement && id === 'watchlist') {
            for (const btn of document.querySelectorAll('button')) {
                if ((visibleOnly ? c1_isVisibleNode(btn) : true) && btn.querySelector('svg') && btn.querySelector('svg').innerHTML.includes("M28 16H16v1h12v-1Z")) {
                    targetElement = btn;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        return targetElement;
    }

    function c1_readToggleState(targetElement) {
        const candidates = [targetElement, targetElement?.closest?.('button'), targetElement?.parentElement].filter(Boolean);
        for (const el of candidates) {
            const ariaPressed = el.getAttribute && el.getAttribute('aria-pressed');
            if (ariaPressed === 'true') return true;
            if (ariaPressed === 'false') return false;
            const ariaChecked = el.getAttribute && el.getAttribute('aria-checked');
            if (ariaChecked === 'true') return true;
            if (ariaChecked === 'false') return false;
            const dataActive = el.getAttribute && el.getAttribute('data-active');
            if (dataActive === 'true') return true;
            if (dataActive === 'false') return false;
            const dataSelected = el.getAttribute && el.getAttribute('data-selected');
            if (dataSelected === 'true') return true;
            if (dataSelected === 'false') return false;
            if (el.classList?.contains('isActive') || el.classList?.contains('active') || el.classList?.contains('selected')) return true;
        }
        return null;
    }

    function c1_getWidgetWatchedValue(methodName) {
        const widgetApi = c1_getWidgetApi();
        if (!widgetApi || typeof widgetApi[methodName] !== 'function') return null;
        try {
            const watched = widgetApi[methodName]();
            return watched && typeof watched.setValue === 'function' ? watched : null;
        } catch (e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    function c1_readWatchedBoolean(watched) {
        if (!watched) return null;
        try {
            if (typeof watched.value === 'function') {
                const value = watched.value();
                return typeof value === 'boolean' ? value : null;
            }
            if (typeof watched.getValue === 'function') {
                const value = watched.getValue();
                return typeof value === 'boolean' ? value : null;
            }
        } catch (e) {}
        return null;
    }

    function c1_setWidgetWatchedBoolean(methodName, nextValue = null) {
        const watched = c1_getWidgetWatchedValue(methodName);
        if (!watched) return null;
        const current = c1_readWatchedBoolean(watched);
        const target = typeof nextValue === 'boolean' ? nextValue : (typeof current === 'boolean' ? !current : null);
        if (typeof target !== 'boolean') return null;
        try {
            watched.setValue(target);
            return { current, target };
        } catch (e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    function c1_prepareSmartMagnetForTool(id) {
        const smartMagnet = c1_ensureSmartMagnetConfig();
        if (!smartMagnet.enabled || !c1_getSmartMagnetToolIds(c1_getEnabledDrawToolIds()).includes(id)) return 0;
        const rule = smartMagnet.toolRules[id];
        if (rule !== 'on' && rule !== 'off') return 0;

        const targetState = rule === 'on';
        const apiResult = c1_setWidgetWatchedBoolean('magnetEnabled', targetState);
        if (apiResult) return apiResult.current === targetState ? 0 : 80;

        const magnetConf = TOOL_DICT.draw?.magnet;
        const magnetButton = magnetConf && magnetConf.selector ? c1_queryFirstVisible(magnetConf.selector) : null;
        if (!magnetButton) return 0;

        const currentState = c1_readToggleState(magnetButton);
        if (currentState === null) return 0;

        if (currentState === targetState) return 0;

        SharedTV.simulateClick(magnetButton);
        return 80;
    }

    function c1_normalizeDrawingControlLabel(value) {
        return String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
    }

    function c1_readDrawingControlLabel(el) {
        return c1_readFirstValid([
            el?.getAttribute?.('aria-label'),
            el?.getAttribute?.('title'),
            el?.getAttribute?.('data-tooltip'),
            el?.getAttribute?.('data-tooltip-text'),
            el?.textContent
        ]);
    }

    function c1_findDrawingControlByLabels(labels, root = document) {
        const wanted = new Set((labels || []).map(c1_normalizeDrawingControlLabel).filter(Boolean));
        if (!wanted.size || !root?.querySelectorAll) return null;
        const controls = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('button, [role="menuitem"], [role="menuitemradio"], [role="option"], [role="row"], [role="gridcell"]'));
        return controls.find((el) => c1_isVisibleNode(el) && wanted.has(c1_normalizeDrawingControlLabel(c1_readDrawingControlLabel(el)))) || null;
    }

    function c1_selectLineToolViaDom(id, toolName, onFailure = null) {
        const fallback = C1_DRAW_TOOL_DOM_FALLBACKS[id];
        if (!fallback) return false;

        const clickTarget = () => {
            const target = c1_findDrawingControlByLabels(fallback.labels);
            if (!target) return false;
            SharedTV.simulateClick(target);
            SharedTV.showToast(`${toolName}${t('tExecuted')}`);
            return true;
        };

        if (clickTarget()) return true;
        const groupButton = c1_findDrawingControlByLabels(fallback.groups);
        if (!groupButton || !SharedTV.simulateClick(groupButton)) return false;

        let settled = false;
        [0, 80, 180, 360].forEach((delay, index, delays) => {
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (settled) return;
                if (clickTarget()) {
                    settled = true;
                    return;
                }
                if (index === delays.length - 1) {
                    settled = true;
                    if (typeof onFailure === 'function') onFailure();
                    else SharedTV.showToast(`${t('tDrawApiFail')}${toolName}`, true);
                }
            }, delay);
        });
        return true;
    }

    function c1_selectLineToolViaApi(conf, onFailure = null) {
        if (!conf?.tvLineTool) return false;
        const widgetApi = c1_getWidgetApi();
        if (!widgetApi || typeof widgetApi.selectLineTool !== 'function') return false;
        try {
            const result = widgetApi.selectLineTool(conf.tvLineTool);
            if (result && typeof result.catch === 'function') {
                result.catch((e) => {
                    console.warn('[TV Control] selectLineTool async failed:', conf.tvLineTool, e);
                    if (typeof onFailure === 'function') onFailure();
                });
            }
            return true;
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('[TV Control] selectLineTool failed:', conf.tvLineTool, e);
            if (typeof onFailure === 'function') onFailure();
            return false;
        }
    }

    function c1_getSelectedLineTool() {
        const widgetApi = c1_getWidgetApi();
        if (!widgetApi || typeof widgetApi.selectedLineTool !== 'function') return '';
        try {
            return String(widgetApi.selectedLineTool() || '').trim();
        } catch (e) {
            return '';
        }
    }

    function c1_isSameLineToolActive(conf) {
        if (!conf?.tvLineTool) return false;
        const currentTool = c1_getSelectedLineTool();
        return !!currentTool && currentTool === conf.tvLineTool;
    }

    function c1_resetToCursorFallback() {
        const button = c1_queryFirstVisible(C1_TV_RUNTIME_SELECTORS.cursorButton);
        if (button) {
            SharedTV.simulateClick(button);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    function c1_resetToCursor(toolName, onFailure = null, options = null) {
        const silent = !!options?.silent;
        const showResetToast = () => {
            if (!silent) SharedTV.showToast(`${toolName}${t('tCursorReset')}`, false, '', 'neutral');
        };
        const widgetApi = c1_getWidgetApi();
        if (widgetApi && typeof widgetApi.selectLineTool === 'function') {
            try {
                const result = widgetApi.selectLineTool('cursor');
                if (result && typeof result.catch === 'function') {
                    result.catch((e) => {
                        console.warn('[TV Control] cursor reset async failed:', e);
                        if (c1_resetToCursorFallback()) showResetToast();
                        else if (typeof onFailure === 'function') onFailure();
                    });
                }
                showResetToast();
                return true;
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('[TV Control] cursor reset failed:', e);
            }
        }
        if (c1_resetToCursorFallback()) {
            showResetToast();
            return true;
        }
        if (typeof onFailure === 'function') onFailure();
        return false;
    }

    function c1_hasActiveDrawingSelection() {
        const currentTool = c1_getSelectedLineTool();
        if (!currentTool) return false;
        return currentTool !== 'cursor';
    }

    function c1_prepareCursorForUiSwitch() {
        if (!c1_hasActiveDrawingSelection()) return 0;
        return c1_resetToCursor('', null, { silent: true }) ? PERF_CONFIG.cursorResetMs : 0;
    }

    let c1_balloonEditorSuppressUntil = 0;
    let c1_balloonEditorSuppressObserver = null;
    let c1_balloonEditorSuppressTimer = null;

    function c1_isLikelyNativeBalloonEditor(host) {
        if (!(host instanceof HTMLElement) || !host.isConnected) return false;
        const rect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (rect.width < 260 || rect.height < 180 || rect.width > 760 || rect.height > 820) return false;
        const style = unsafeWindow.getComputedStyle ? unsafeWindow.getComputedStyle(host) : window.getComputedStyle(host);
        if (style.display === 'none' || style.visibility === 'hidden' || Number(style.opacity || 1) === 0) return false;
        const text = c1_normalizeDomText(host.innerText || host.textContent);
        if (!/(气球|Balloon)/i.test(text)) return false;
        if (!/(文本|坐标|可见范围|模板|取消|确认|Text|Coordinates|Visibility|Template|Cancel|OK)/i.test(text)) return false;
        return !!host.querySelector('textarea, [contenteditable="true"], input, [role="textbox"]');
    }

    function c1_findNativeBalloonEditor(root = document) {
        const roots = [];
        if (root instanceof HTMLElement) roots.push(root);
        const scanRoot = root?.querySelectorAll ? root : document;
        try {
            roots.push(...Array.from(scanRoot.querySelectorAll([
                '[role="dialog"]',
                '[class*="dialog" i]',
                '[class*="modal" i]',
                '[class*="popup" i]',
                '[data-name*="dialog" i]'
            ].join(','))));
        } catch (e) {}
        return Array.from(new Set(roots)).find(c1_isLikelyNativeBalloonEditor) || null;
    }

    function c1_findNativeDialogCloseButton(host) {
        if (!(host instanceof HTMLElement)) return null;
        const selectors = [
            'button[aria-label*="关闭"]',
            'button[aria-label*="Close" i]',
            'button[title*="关闭"]',
            'button[title*="Close" i]',
            '[role="button"][aria-label*="关闭"]',
            '[role="button"][aria-label*="Close" i]'
        ];
        for (const selector of selectors) {
            try {
                const found = Array.from(host.querySelectorAll(selector)).find(c1_isVisibleElement);
                if (found) return found;
            } catch (e) {}
        }
        const hostRect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
        return Array.from(host.querySelectorAll('button, [role="button"]'))
            .filter(c1_isVisibleElement)
            .map(el => ({ el, rect: el.getBoundingClientRect(), label: c1_normalizeDomText([el.getAttribute('aria-label'), el.getAttribute('title'), el.innerText, el.textContent].filter(Boolean).join(' ')) }))
            .filter(item => item.rect.top <= hostRect.top + 86 && item.rect.left >= hostRect.right - 96 && (!item.label || /关闭|Close|×|✕/i.test(item.label)))
            .sort((a, b) => (b.rect.left - a.rect.left) || (a.rect.top - b.rect.top))[0]?.el || null;
    }

    function c1_trySuppressNativeBalloonEditor(root = document) {
        if (Date.now() > c1_balloonEditorSuppressUntil) return false;
        const host = c1_findNativeBalloonEditor(root);
        if (!host) return false;
        const closeButton = c1_findNativeDialogCloseButton(host);
        if (closeButton) SharedTV.simulateClick(closeButton);
