        else {
            try { host.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape', bubbles: true, cancelable: true, view: unsafeWindow })); } catch (e) {}
        }
        return true;
    }

    function c1_stopBalloonEditorSuppressor() {
        if (c1_balloonEditorSuppressObserver) c1_balloonEditorSuppressObserver.disconnect();
        c1_balloonEditorSuppressObserver = null;
        if (c1_balloonEditorSuppressTimer) clearTimeout(c1_balloonEditorSuppressTimer);
        c1_balloonEditorSuppressTimer = null;
    }

    function c1_armBalloonEditorSuppressor() {
        c1_balloonEditorSuppressUntil = Date.now() + 12000;
        c1_stopBalloonEditorSuppressor();
        const scan = (root = document) => {
            if (Date.now() > c1_balloonEditorSuppressUntil) {
                c1_stopBalloonEditorSuppressor();
                return;
            }
            if (c1_trySuppressNativeBalloonEditor(root)) {
                c1_stopBalloonEditorSuppressor();
            }
        };
        [80, 180, 360, 720, 1200, 2200].forEach(delay => setTimeout(scan, delay));
        c1_balloonEditorSuppressObserver = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
            mutations.forEach(mutation => {
                mutation.addedNodes.forEach(node => {
                    if (node instanceof HTMLElement) scan(node);
                });
            });
        });
        try { c1_balloonEditorSuppressObserver.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true }); } catch (e) {}
        c1_balloonEditorSuppressTimer = setTimeout(c1_stopBalloonEditorSuppressor, 12200);
    }

    function c1_executeNativeToolBindingCore(id, conf, toolName, targetElement = null) {
        const resolvedTarget = targetElement || c1_resolveNativeToolTarget(id, conf);
        if (resolvedTarget) {
            SharedTV.simulateClick(resolvedTarget);
            if (id === 'balloon') c1_armBalloonEditorSuppressor();
            setTimeout(() => {
                let statusText = t('tExecuted');
                if (resolvedTarget.hasAttribute('aria-pressed')) statusText = resolvedTarget.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true' ? t('tOpened') : t('tClosed');
                else if (resolvedTarget.hasAttribute('data-active')) statusText = resolvedTarget.getAttribute('data-active') === 'true' ? t('tExpanded') : t('tCollapsed');
                SharedTV.showToast(`${toolName}${statusText}`);
            }, 50);
        } else {
            SharedTV.showToast(`${t('tNotFound')}${toolName}${t('tNotFoundSuffix')}`, true);
        }
        return true;
    }

    function c1_executeNativeToolBinding(id, conf, toolName) {
        if (id === 'tradingPanel') return c1_executeTradingPanelBinding(toolName);
        if (id === 'createAlert') return c1_executeCreateAlertBinding(conf, toolName);
        if (id === 'replay') return c1_executeReplayBinding(conf, toolName);
        if (id === 'hideAll') return c1_executeHideAllBinding(conf, toolName);
        if (id === 'magnet') return c1_executeMagnetBinding(conf, toolName);

        const executeBinding = () => {
            if (['watchlist', 'alerts', 'objTree'].includes(id)) c1_requestImmersiveExitForPanelOpen(id);
            const targetElement = c1_resolveNativeToolTarget(id, conf);
            const runDrawingFallback = () => {
                if (targetElement) return c1_executeNativeToolBindingCore(id, conf, toolName, targetElement);
                return c1_selectLineToolViaDom(id, toolName, () => {
                    SharedTV.showToast(`${t('tDrawApiFail')}${toolName}`, true);
                });
            };
            if (c1_isSameLineToolActive(conf)) {
                return c1_resetToCursor(toolName, () => {
                    SharedTV.showToast(`${t('tDrawApiFail')}${toolName}`, true);
                });
            }
            if (conf?.tvLineTool && c1_selectLineToolViaApi(conf, () => {
                if (!runDrawingFallback()) SharedTV.showToast(`${t('tDrawApiFail')}${toolName}`, true);
            })) {
                if (id === 'balloon') c1_armBalloonEditorSuppressor();
                SharedTV.showToast(`${toolName}${t('tExecuted')}`);
                return true;
            }

            if (runDrawingFallback()) return true;

            if (conf?.tvLineTool && !conf?.selector) {
                SharedTV.showToast(`${t('tDrawApiFail')}${toolName}`, true);
                return true;
            }

            SharedTV.showToast(`${t('tNotFound')}${toolName}${t('tNotFoundSuffix')}`, true);
            return true;
        };

        const magnetDelay = c1_prepareSmartMagnetForTool(id);
        if (magnetDelay > 0) {
            setTimeout(() => { executeBinding(); }, magnetDelay);
            return true;
        }

        return executeBinding();
    }

    let c1_alertInstantArmUntil = 0;
    let c1_alertInstantPollTimer = null;
    let c1_alertInstantRetryDueAt = 0;
    let c1_alertInstantObserver = null;
    let c1_alertInstantRetryIndex = 0;
    let c1_alertInstantBaselineDialogs = new Set();
    let c1_alertInstantTouchedDialogs = new Set();
    const C1_INSTANT_ALERT_RETRY_DELAYS = [80, 180, 360, 720, 1200, 1800];
    const C1_INSTANT_ALERT_DIALOG_SELECTOR = '[role="dialog"], [data-dialog-name], .tv-dialog, .js-dialog';

    function c1_isVisibleElement(el) {
        if (!el || !el.isConnected) return false;
        const style = unsafeWindow.getComputedStyle ? unsafeWindow.getComputedStyle(el) : window.getComputedStyle(el);
        if (!style || style.display === 'none' || style.visibility === 'hidden' || Number(style.opacity || 1) === 0) return false;
        const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        return rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0;
    }

    function c1_clearInstantAlertArm() {
        c1_alertInstantArmUntil = 0;
        if (c1_alertInstantPollTimer) clearTimeout(c1_alertInstantPollTimer);
        c1_alertInstantPollTimer = null;
        c1_alertInstantRetryDueAt = 0;
        c1_alertInstantRetryIndex = 0;
        if (c1_alertInstantObserver) c1_alertInstantObserver.disconnect();
        c1_alertInstantObserver = null;
        c1_alertInstantBaselineDialogs.clear();
        c1_alertInstantTouchedDialogs.clear();
    }

    function c1_getInstantAlertDialogRoots(root = document, visibleOnly = true) {
        const scanRoot = root && root.querySelectorAll ? root : document;
        const dialogs = [];
        if (scanRoot instanceof HTMLElement) {
            if (scanRoot.matches?.(C1_INSTANT_ALERT_DIALOG_SELECTOR)) dialogs.push(scanRoot);
            const closest = scanRoot.closest?.(C1_INSTANT_ALERT_DIALOG_SELECTOR);
            if (closest) dialogs.push(closest);
        }
        try { dialogs.push(...scanRoot.querySelectorAll(C1_INSTANT_ALERT_DIALOG_SELECTOR)); } catch (e) {}
        return [...new Set(dialogs)].filter(dialog => !visibleOnly || c1_isVisibleElement(dialog));
    }

    function c1_getInstantAlertDialogIdentity(dialog) {
        if (!dialog) return '';
        const labelledBy = String(dialog.getAttribute('aria-labelledby') || '')
            .split(/\s+/)
            .map(id => document.getElementById(id)?.textContent || '')
            .filter(Boolean);
        const headings = Array.from(dialog.querySelectorAll('h1, h2, h3, [role="heading"], [data-name*="title" i]'))
            .slice(0, 4)
            .map(node => node.textContent || '');
        return c1_normalizeDomText([
            dialog.getAttribute('data-dialog-name'),
            dialog.getAttribute('aria-label'),
            dialog.getAttribute('title'),
            ...labelledBy,
            ...headings
        ].filter(Boolean).join(' '));
    }

    function c1_isVerifiedNewInstantAlertDialog(dialog) {
        if (!dialog || !dialog.isConnected || !c1_isVisibleElement(dialog)) return false;
        if (c1_alertInstantBaselineDialogs.has(dialog) || !c1_alertInstantTouchedDialogs.has(dialog)) return false;
        if (dialog.closest?.('#tv-settings-panel, #tv-tradegate-window, .tv-side-panel, #tv-danger-confirm-modal')) return false;
        const identity = c1_getInstantAlertDialogIdentity(dialog);
        if (!identity || /创建订单|提交订单|下单|place\s+order|order\s+ticket|buy\s+order|sell\s+order/i.test(identity)) return false;
        return /(?:创建|新建|添加).{0,4}(?:警报|提醒)|(?:create|add|new)\s+(?:price\s+)?alert/i.test(identity);
    }

    function c1_findInstantAlertDialog() {
        const candidates = c1_getInstantAlertDialogRoots(document, true)
            .filter(c1_isVerifiedNewInstantAlertDialog);
        return candidates.length === 1 ? candidates[0] : null;
    }

    function c1_getInstantAlertButtonText(button) {
        return String(button.innerText || button.textContent || button.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').trim();
    }

    function c1_isInstantAlertCancelButton(button) {
        const all = `${c1_getInstantAlertButtonText(button)} ${button.className || ''}`.toLowerCase();
        return /取消|cancel|close|dismiss|^x$/.test(all);
    }

    function c1_isVerifiedInstantAlertConfirmButton(button) {
        if (!button || c1_isInstantAlertCancelButton(button)) return false;
        const label = c1_normalizeDomText(c1_getInstantAlertButtonText(button));
        const identity = c1_normalizeDomText([
            button.getAttribute('aria-label'),
            button.getAttribute('title'),
            button.getAttribute('data-name'),
            button.getAttribute('data-qa-id')
        ].filter(Boolean).join(' '));
        const alertActionPattern = /^(?:(?:创建|新建|添加).{0,3}(?:警报|提醒)|(?:create|add)\s+(?:price\s+)?alert)$/i;
        return alertActionPattern.test(label) || alertActionPattern.test(identity);
    }

    function c1_findInstantAlertConfirmButton(dialog = c1_findInstantAlertDialog()) {
        if (!dialog) return null;
        const buttons = Array.from(dialog.querySelectorAll('button, [role="button"]'))
            .filter(c1_isVisibleElement)
            .filter((button) => !button.disabled && button.getAttribute('aria-disabled') !== 'true')
            .filter(c1_isVerifiedInstantAlertConfirmButton);
        return buttons.length === 1 ? buttons[0] : null;
    }

    function c1_clickInstantAlertButton(button) {
        if (!button) return false;
        try {
            button.click();
            return true;
        } catch (e) {
            C1_LOG.warn('instantAlert.singleConfirm', e);
            return false;
        }
    }

    function c1_failInstantAlertClosed() {
        c1_clearInstantAlertArm();
        SharedTV.showToast(
            c1_lang('Instant alert was not auto-confirmed', '即时警报未自动确认'),
            c1_lang('A new Create Alert dialog and its alert-specific button could not be verified. Please confirm manually.', '无法同时验证本次新出现的“创建警报”弹窗及其警报专用按钮，请手动确认。'),
            'warning',
            4200
        );
    }

    function c1_tryInstantAlertConfirm() {
        if (!c1_alertInstantArmUntil || Date.now() > c1_alertInstantArmUntil) {
            c1_failInstantAlertClosed();
            return false;
        }
        const dialog = c1_findInstantAlertDialog();
        if (!dialog) return false;
        const button = c1_findInstantAlertConfirmButton(dialog);
        if (!button) return false;
        c1_clearInstantAlertArm();
        const clicked = c1_clickInstantAlertButton(button);
        if (!clicked) c1_failInstantAlertClosed();
        return clicked;
    }

    function c1_scheduleInstantAlertRetry(delay = null) {
        if (!c1_alertInstantArmUntil || Date.now() > c1_alertInstantArmUntil) {
            c1_clearInstantAlertArm();
            return;
        }
        const fallbackDelay = C1_INSTANT_ALERT_RETRY_DELAYS[Math.min(c1_alertInstantRetryIndex, C1_INSTANT_ALERT_RETRY_DELAYS.length - 1)];
        const nextDelay = Number.isFinite(Number(delay)) ? Number(delay) : fallbackDelay;
        const dueAt = Date.now() + nextDelay;
        if (c1_alertInstantPollTimer) {
            if (!c1_alertInstantRetryDueAt || c1_alertInstantRetryDueAt <= dueAt) return;
            clearTimeout(c1_alertInstantPollTimer);
            c1_alertInstantPollTimer = null;
        }
        c1_alertInstantRetryIndex += 1;
        c1_alertInstantRetryDueAt = dueAt;
        c1_alertInstantPollTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            c1_alertInstantPollTimer = null;
            c1_alertInstantRetryDueAt = 0;
            if (c1_tryInstantAlertConfirm()) return;
            if (c1_alertInstantRetryIndex < C1_INSTANT_ALERT_RETRY_DELAYS.length) {
                c1_scheduleInstantAlertRetry();
            } else c1_failInstantAlertClosed();
        }, nextDelay);
    }

    function c1_dispatchNativeAltA() {
        const target = c1_focusChartForTradingViewShortcut();
        ['keydown', 'keyup'].forEach((type) => {
            try {
                const event = new KeyboardEvent(type, {
                    key: 'a',
                    code: 'KeyA',
                    altKey: true,
                    bubbles: true,
                    cancelable: true
                });
                target.dispatchEvent(event);
            } catch (e) {}
        });
    }

    function c1_executeInstantAlertBinding(shortcutStr) {
        c1_clearInstantAlertArm();
        c1_alertInstantBaselineDialogs = new Set(c1_getInstantAlertDialogRoots(document, true));
        c1_alertInstantTouchedDialogs = new Set();
        c1_alertInstantArmUntil = Date.now() + 6000;
        if (c1_alertInstantPollTimer) clearTimeout(c1_alertInstantPollTimer);
        c1_alertInstantPollTimer = null;
        c1_alertInstantRetryDueAt = 0;
        c1_alertInstantRetryIndex = 0;
        c1_alertInstantObserver = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
            let touched = false;
            mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
                const roots = [];
                if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && mutation.target instanceof HTMLElement) roots.push(mutation.target);
                if (mutation.type === 'childList') {
                    if (mutation.target instanceof HTMLElement) {
                        const ownerDialog = mutation.target.matches?.(C1_INSTANT_ALERT_DIALOG_SELECTOR)
                            ? mutation.target
                            : mutation.target.closest?.(C1_INSTANT_ALERT_DIALOG_SELECTOR);
                        if (ownerDialog) roots.push(ownerDialog);
                    }
                    mutation.addedNodes.forEach(node => {
                        const root = node instanceof HTMLElement ? node : node.parentElement;
                        if (root) roots.push(root);
                    });
                }
                roots.forEach((root) => {
                    c1_getInstantAlertDialogRoots(root, false).forEach((dialog) => {
                        if (!c1_alertInstantBaselineDialogs.has(dialog)) {
                            c1_alertInstantTouchedDialogs.add(dialog);
                            touched = true;
                        }
                    });
                });
            });
            if (touched) c1_scheduleInstantAlertRetry(60);
        });
        c1_alertInstantObserver.observe(document.documentElement, {
            childList: true,
            subtree: true,
            attributes: true,
            attributeFilter: ['class', 'style', 'role', 'aria-hidden', 'data-dialog-name']
        });
        c1_scheduleInstantAlertRetry(80);

        if (SharedTV.matchesShortcut('ALT + A', shortcutStr)) {
            return { passthroughNative: true };
        }

        c1_dispatchNativeAltA();
        return { passthroughNative: false };
    }

    function c1_shouldPreserveDrawingSelectionForTool(id) {
        return id === 'createAlert' || id === 'hideAll' || id === 'replay';
    }

    function c1_executeToolBinding(id, conf = null, triggerShortcut = '') {
        const resolvedConf = conf || c1_findToolMetaById(id);
        if (!resolvedConf) return false;
        const toolName = resolvedConf.name[SysConfig.lang] || resolvedConf.name.zh;
        const executeBinding = () => {

        if (resolvedConf.type === 'risk_toggle') {
            if (SysConfig.riskEnabled) {
                const riskPanel = document.getElementById('panel-risk');
                const riskSettingsView = riskPanel?.querySelector('#rk-settings-view');
                if (riskSettingsView && getComputedStyle(riskSettingsView).display !== 'none') {
                    RiskManager.closeSettingsView?.();
                    return true;
                }
                const wasOpen = riskPanel?.classList.contains('show');
                FeatureRegistry.trigger('risk');
                if (!wasOpen) setTimeout(() => RiskManager.closeSettingsView?.(), 80);
            } else {
                SharedTV.showToast(c1_lang('⚠️ Risk Base is embedded or disabled', '⚠️ 风控为内嵌模式或未启用'), true);
            }
            return true;
        }

        if (resolvedConf.type === 'tradegate') {
            FeatureRegistry.trigger('tradegate');
            return true;
        }

        if (resolvedConf.type === 'tradegate_window') {
            if (c1_tradeGateWindowEl) c1_closeTradeGateWindow();
            else c1_openTradeGateWindow();
            return true;
        }

        if (resolvedConf.type === 'alert_instant') {
            return c1_executeInstantAlertBinding(triggerShortcut);
        }

        if (resolvedConf.type === 'indicator_slot_toggle') {
            return c1_executeIndicatorSlotToggle(resolvedConf.slotIndex);
        }

        if (resolvedConf.type === 'tool' || resolvedConf.type === 'panel') {
            return c1_executeNativeToolBinding(id, resolvedConf, toolName);
        }

            return false;
        };

        if (c1_handleImmersivePanelMemory(id, resolvedConf, executeBinding)) return true;

        if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(TOOL_DICT.draw, id) && !c1_shouldPreserveDrawingSelectionForTool(id)) {
            const cursorDelay = c1_prepareCursorForUiSwitch();
            if (cursorDelay > 0) {
                setTimeout(() => { executeBinding(); }, cursorDelay);
                return true;
            }
        }

        return executeBinding();
    }

    function c1_executeDynamicBinding(shortcutStr) {
        const actions = [];
        SysConfig.timeframes.forEach(tf => {
            if (SharedTV.matchesShortcut(tf.key, shortcutStr)) {
                actions.push(() => {
                    if (switchInterval(tf.val)) {
                        SharedTV.showToast(`${t('tTfSwitch')}${c1_formatIntervalLabel(tf.val)}`);
                        if (c1_immersiveActive) setTimeout(() => c1_updateImmersiveChartHud(true), 180);
                    }
                    else SharedTV.showToast(`${t('tTfFail')}${c1_formatIntervalLabel(tf.val)}`, true);
                });
            }
        });
        if (actions.length) {
            const cursorDelay = c1_prepareCursorForUiSwitch();
            if (cursorDelay > 0) setTimeout(() => { actions.forEach((run) => run()); }, cursorDelay);
            else actions.forEach((run) => run());
            return true;
        }

        actions.length = 0;
        SysConfig.symbols.forEach(sym => {
            if (SharedTV.matchesShortcut(sym.key, shortcutStr)) {
                actions.push(() => {
                    if (switchSymbol(sym.val)) {
                        SharedTV.showToast(`${t('tSymSwitch')}${sym.val}`);
                        if (c1_immersiveActive) setTimeout(() => c1_updateImmersiveChartHud(true), 360);
                    }
                    else SharedTV.showToast(`${t('tSymFail')}${sym.val}`, true);
                });
            }
        });
        if (actions.length) {
            const cursorDelay = c1_prepareCursorForUiSwitch();
            if (cursorDelay > 0) setTimeout(() => { actions.forEach((run) => run()); }, cursorDelay);
            else actions.forEach((run) => run());
            return true;
        }

        actions.length = 0;
        SysConfig.panels.forEach(panel => {
            if (SharedTV.matchesShortcut(panel.key, shortcutStr)) {
                actions.push(() => {
                    document.getElementById(`trigger-${panel.id}`)?.click();
                });
            }
        });
        if (actions.length) {
            const cursorDelay = c1_prepareCursorForUiSwitch();
            if (cursorDelay > 0) setTimeout(() => { actions.forEach((run) => run()); }, cursorDelay);
            else actions.forEach((run) => run());
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    // 全屏适配动态挂载侦听
    document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', () => {
        const root = getUIRoot();
        SharedTV.refreshNotifierMount();
        const uiElements = [
            document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel'),
            document.getElementById('tv-first-time-modal'),
            ...PanelManager.getMountedElements()
        ];
        uiElements.forEach(el => {
            if (el) {
                root.appendChild(el);
                if (document.fullscreenElement) el.classList.add('tv-is-fullscreen');
                else el.classList.remove('tv-is-fullscreen');
            }
        });
        c1_scheduleRightSidebarAlign();
        c1_repositionOpenPortaledControls();
        c1_positionImmersiveChartHud();
        const realFullscreen = !!document.fullscreenElement;
        ++c1_immersiveGeneration;
        c1_immersiveDesiredActive = realFullscreen;
        c1_applyImmersiveRuntimeState(realFullscreen, { clearIntent: false });
    });

    window.addEventListener('resize', c1_repositionOpenPortaledControls, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => c1_positionImmersiveChartHud(), { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('scroll', c1_repositionOpenPortaledControls, { passive: true, capture: true });

    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const target = e.target?.closest?.('#header-toolbar-fullscreen, [data-name="header-toolbar-fullscreen"]');
        if (!target) return;
        if (Date.now() < c1_immersiveInternalToggleUntil) return;
        const generation = ++c1_immersiveGeneration;
        const targetActive = !c1_immersiveDesiredActive;
        c1_immersiveDesiredActive = targetActive;
        c1_applyImmersiveRuntimeState(targetActive);
        c1_scheduleImmersiveRuntimeReconcile(generation);
        [80, 220, 520].forEach(delay => setTimeout(() => c1_suppressTradingViewImmersiveHint(document), delay));
    }, true);

    document.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => {
        const pluginRootSelectors = '#tv-custom-sidebar, #tv-custom-sidebar-right, .tv-side-panel, #tv-settings-panel, #tv-first-time-modal, #tv-tradegate-window, #tv-immersive-profile-card, #tv-work-journey-bear-host, #tv-custom-notifier-container';
        const path = typeof e.composedPath === 'function' ? e.composedPath() : [];
        const root = e.target?.closest?.(pluginRootSelectors) || path.find(node => node instanceof HTMLElement && node.matches?.(pluginRootSelectors));
        if (!root) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        const control = e.target.closest?.('button, [role="button"], .tv-sidebar-trigger, .tv-side-panel-close, .rk-head-btn, #macro-refresh-btn, #macro-settings-btn, .tv-settings-icon-btn, .tv-settings-mini-btn, .tv-record-btn, .tg-chip, .tg-answer, .tg-toggle, .tg-compact-chip');
        if (control) control.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, view: window, button: 0 }));
    }, true);

    const c1_managedHotkeyRepeatGuard = new Set();
    const c1_blockManagedHotkeyRepeat = (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        event.stopImmediatePropagation?.();
    };

    window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
        SharedTV.getShortcutCandidates(e).forEach(shortcutStr => c1_managedHotkeyRepeatGuard.delete(shortcutStr));
    }, true);
    window.addEventListener('blur', () => c1_managedHotkeyRepeatGuard.clear(), { passive: true });
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
        if (document.hidden) c1_managedHotkeyRepeatGuard.clear();
    });

    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        const isRecordingShortcut = !!(c1_recordingId || c2_recordingId);
        if (c1_shouldBypassGlobalShortcut(e, isRecordingShortcut)) return;
        const shortcutCandidates = SharedTV.getShortcutCandidates(e);
        const shortcutStr = shortcutCandidates[0] || null;
        if (e.repeat) {
            const isManagedRepeat = shortcutCandidates.some(candidate => c1_managedHotkeyRepeatGuard.has(candidate))
                || !!c1_getBindingName(shortcutCandidates)
                || !!c2_getBindingName(shortcutCandidates)
                || SharedTV.matchesShortcut('P', shortcutCandidates)
                || (SysConfig.immersiveEnabled !== false && SharedTV.matchesShortcut(c1_getImmersiveShortcut(), shortcutCandidates));
            if (isManagedRepeat) c1_blockManagedHotkeyRepeat(e);
            return;
        }

        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            if (c1_finishActiveDangerConfirm(false)) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                e.stopImmediatePropagation?.();
                return;
            }
            if (c1_recordingId || c2_recordingId) {
                if (c1_recordingId) {
                    let btn = (c1_recordingButton?.isConnected && c1_recordingButton.classList.contains('p1-btn')) ? c1_recordingButton : document.querySelector(`.p1-btn[data-id="${c1_recordingId}"]`);
                    if(btn) {
                        let id = btn.dataset.id; let origKey = '';
                        if(id.startsWith('tool_')) origKey = SysConfig.tools[id.replace('tool_','')];
                        else if(id === 'global_immersive') origKey = SysConfig.immersiveKey;
                        else if(id.startsWith('tf_')) origKey = SysConfig.timeframes[parseInt(id.replace('tf_',''))]?.key;
                        else if(id.startsWith('sym_')) origKey = SysConfig.symbols[parseInt(id.replace('sym_',''))]?.key;
                        else if(id.startsWith('cp_')) origKey = SysConfig.panels[parseInt(id.replace('cp_',''))]?.key;
                        document.querySelectorAll(`.p1-btn[data-id="${id}"]`).forEach(b => { b.textContent = origKey || t('unbound'); b.style.background = 'var(--my-bg-input)'; b.style.color = 'var(--my-text)'; b.style.borderColor = 'var(--my-border)'; });
                    }
                }
                if (c2_recordingId) {
                    let btn = (c1_recordingButton?.isConnected && c1_recordingButton.classList.contains('p2-btn')) ? c1_recordingButton : document.querySelector(`.p2-btn[data-id="${c2_recordingId}"]`);
                    if(btn) {
                        let id = btn.dataset.id; let origKey = '';
                        if(id === 'macro') origKey = C2_CONFIG.macroKey;
                        document.querySelectorAll(`.p2-btn[data-id="${id}"]`).forEach(b => { b.textContent = origKey || t('unbound'); b.style.background = 'var(--my-bg-input)'; b.style.color = 'var(--my-text)'; b.style.borderColor = 'var(--my-border)'; });
                    }
                }
                c1_recordingId = null; c2_recordingId = null; c1_recordingButton = null; SharedTV.showToast(c1_lang('Key recording cancelled', '已取消按键录制')); e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); return;
            }
            let p1_panel = document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel');
            if (p1_panel && (p1_panel.style.visibility === 'visible' || p1_panel.style.opacity === '1')) { c1_hideSettingsPanel(); e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); return; }
            if (c1_tradeGateWindowEl) { c1_closeTradeGateWindow(); e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); return; }
            if (c1_immersiveActive) {
                ++c1_immersiveGeneration;
                c1_immersiveDesiredActive = false;
                c1_immersiveReturnIntent = null;
                c1_applyImmersiveRuntimeState(false, { clearIntent: false });
                setTimeout(() => c1_suppressTradingViewImmersiveHint(document), 30);
            }
            c1_closeNativePopupsAndDialogs();
            c1_closeAllPanels(); return;
        }

        if (c1_handleTradeGateCompactKeydown(e)) return;

        if (c1_isTypingTarget(e.target)) return;

        if (!shortcutStr) return;
        if (SharedTV.matchesShortcut('ALT + R', shortcutCandidates)) c1_scheduleAltRResetScalePreference();

        let p1Binding = c1_getBindingName(shortcutCandidates);
        let p2Binding = c2_getBindingName(shortcutCandidates);
        const isSettingsHotkey = SharedTV.matchesShortcut('P', shortcutCandidates);
        const isImmersiveHotkey = SysConfig.immersiveEnabled !== false && SharedTV.matchesShortcut(c1_getImmersiveShortcut(), shortcutCandidates);
        const isManagedShortcut = !!(p1Binding || p2Binding || isSettingsHotkey || isImmersiveHotkey || c1_recordingId || c2_recordingId);
        if (isManagedShortcut) shortcutCandidates.forEach(candidate => c1_managedHotkeyRepeatGuard.add(candidate));

        if (c1_recordingId || c2_recordingId) {
            e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
            if (e.key === 'Backspace' || e.key === 'Delete') {
                const recordSelector = c1_recordingId ? `.p1-btn[data-id="${c1_recordingId}"]` : `.p2-btn[data-id="${c2_recordingId}"]`;
                document.querySelectorAll(recordSelector).forEach(targetBtn => { targetBtn.textContent = t('unbound'); targetBtn.style.background = 'var(--my-bg-input)'; targetBtn.style.color = 'var(--my-text)'; targetBtn.style.borderColor = 'var(--my-border)'; });
                c1_clearHotkeyTargetByRecordId(c1_recordingId || c2_recordingId, !!c2_recordingId);
                c1_recordingId = null; c2_recordingId = null; c1_recordingButton = null;
                c1_scheduleSettingsAutoSave(document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel'), 0);
                SharedTV.showToast(c1_lang('🗑️ Hotkey cleared and saved', '🗑️ 已清除快捷键并自动保存')); return;
            }

            const recordingRecordId = c1_recordingId || c2_recordingId;
            const conflictRecord = c1_findHotkeyConflictForRecord(shortcutStr, recordingRecordId, !!c2_recordingId);
            if (conflictRecord?.reserved) {
                SharedTV.showToast(c1_lang(`Reserved hotkey: ${shortcutStr}`, `保留快捷键不可绑定：${shortcutStr}`), true);
                return;
            }
            if (conflictRecord) {
                const conflictSelector = `${conflictRecord.selector}[data-id="${conflictRecord.id}"]`;
                document.querySelectorAll(conflictSelector).forEach(btn => { btn.textContent = t('unbound'); });
                c1_clearHotkeyTargetByRecordId(conflictRecord.id, conflictRecord.isP2);
            }

            const recordSelector = c1_recordingId ? `.p1-btn[data-id="${c1_recordingId}"]` : `.p2-btn[data-id="${c2_recordingId}"]`;
            document.querySelectorAll(recordSelector).forEach(targetBtn => { targetBtn.textContent = shortcutStr; targetBtn.style.background = 'var(--my-bg-input)'; targetBtn.style.color = 'var(--my-text)'; targetBtn.style.borderColor = 'var(--my-border)'; });
            c1_recordingId = null; c2_recordingId = null; c1_recordingButton = null;
            c1_scheduleSettingsAutoSave(document.getElementById('tv-settings-panel'), 0);
            SharedTV.showToast(conflictRecord ? c1_lang(`✅ Assigned hotkey: ${shortcutStr}; conflicting binding was cleared and saved`, `✅ 已分配按键: ${shortcutStr}，并自动保存冲突解绑`) : c1_lang(`✅ Assigned hotkey: ${shortcutStr} and saved`, `✅ 已分配按键: ${shortcutStr}，并自动保存`)); return;
        }

        if (isImmersiveHotkey) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            e.preventDefault();
            c1_toggleImmersiveModeByHotkey();
            return;
        }

        if (p1Binding && p2Binding) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); SharedTV.showToast(c1_lang(`🚨 Conflict! [${shortcutStr}] is bound in multiple places. Please change one.`, `🚨 冲突！[${shortcutStr}] 被多处绑定，请修改。`), true); return; }
        if (isSettingsHotkey) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            e.preventDefault();
            const cursorDelay = c1_prepareCursorForUiSwitch();
            if (cursorDelay > 0) setTimeout(() => { c1_toggleSettingsPanel(); }, cursorDelay);
            else c1_toggleSettingsPanel();
            return;
        }

        if (p1Binding) {
            const toolBinding = c1_findToolBindingByShortcut(shortcutCandidates);
            if (toolBinding) {
                const shouldPassthroughNative = toolBinding.id === 'instantAlert' && SharedTV.matchesShortcut('ALT + A', shortcutCandidates);
                if (!shouldPassthroughNative) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    e.stopImmediatePropagation?.();
                }
                const execResult = c1_executeToolBinding(toolBinding.id, toolBinding.conf, shortcutStr);
                if (execResult && execResult.passthroughNative) return;
                return;
            }
            if (c1_executeDynamicBinding(shortcutCandidates)) {
                e.stopPropagation();
                e.preventDefault();
            }
            return;
        }

        if (p2Binding) {
            e.stopPropagation(); e.preventDefault();
            const openMacro = () => {
                if (SharedTV.matchesShortcut(C2_CONFIG.macroKey, shortcutCandidates)) document.getElementById('trigger-macro')?.click();
            };
            const cursorDelay = c1_prepareCursorForUiSwitch();
            if (cursorDelay > 0) setTimeout(openMacro, cursorDelay);
            else openMacro();
            return;
        }
    }, true);

    function initApp() {
        if (c1_appInitialized) return;
        c1_appInitialized = true;
        c1_getTVStateBridge().init();
        c1_renderSidebarSystem();
        c1_startRightProductIconCleanup();
        c1_refreshTradeScanLoop();
        if (!C2_CONFIG.cache) c2_fetchMacroData();
        if(SysConfig.riskEnabled) RiskManager.init();
        if (c1_immersiveActive) c1_startNativeImmersiveToastSuppressor();
        c1_bindImmersivePanelIntentWatcher();
        c1_bindUnifiedTooltips();
        c1_scheduleIndicatorSlotVisibilityRestore();
        c1_scheduleImmersiveAutoStart();
        c1_scheduleRightSidebarAlign();
        c1_bindTradingViewRouteWatcher();
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => c1_scheduleRightSidebarAlign(3), { passive: true });
        window.addEventListener('resize', c1_scheduleRightProductIconCleanup, { passive: true });
        window.addEventListener('pagehide', c1_stopRightProductIconCleanup, { passive: true });
        window.addEventListener('beforeunload', c1_stopRightProductIconCleanup, { passive: true });
        window.addEventListener('pagehide', c1_stopNativeAlertBearWatcher, { passive: true });
        window.addEventListener('beforeunload', c1_stopNativeAlertBearWatcher, { passive: true });
        try { c1_warmImmersiveOverlays(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[TV-GCC] immersive warmup failed', e); }
        if (c1_shouldWatchNativeAlertsForBear()) c1_startNativeAlertBearWatcher();
        else c1_stopNativeAlertBearWatcher();
        c1_checkAndShowFirstTimeWarning();
    }

    if (localStorage.getItem(C1_DIAG_DEBUG_KEY) === '1') {
        Object.defineProperty(unsafeWindow, '__TV_GCC__', {
            value: Object.freeze({
                diag: () => c1_getDiagnosticsSnapshot(),
                tradeProbe: () => c1_getTVStateBridge().getTradeProbe(true),
                version: '2.0.5'
            }),
            writable: false,
            configurable: false,
            enumerable: false
        });
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'complete' || document.readyState === 'interactive') setTimeout(initApp, 1);
    else { window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initApp); window.addEventListener('load', initApp); }

})();
